title: [Tunnel] Splash at the entrance kills occupants and leaks pool slots
description:
## C++
`OpenContain::isEnclosingContainerFor` (`OpenContain.cpp:1472-1475`) returns TRUE; TunnelContain does not override it. `addToContain` (`OpenContain.cpp:320-323`) therefore `addOrRemoveObjFromWorld(rider, FALSE)` — hide drawable, leave group, `ThePartitionManager->unRegisterObject`, pathfind remove. `TunnelContain::onContaining` (`TunnelContain.cpp:171-186`) sets `DISABLED_HELD` and `handlePartitionCellMaintenance()`. C++ splash (`Weapon.cpp dealDamageInternal`) iterates partition-world objects only, so a unit inside the network cannot be hit. Occupant death goes through `removeFromContain` → `TunnelTracker::removeFromContain`, freeing the shared `MaxTunnelCapacity` slot.

## Leftover
`tunnel_contain.rs` `add_to_contain` (`:237-243`) calls `add_or_remove_obj_from_world(obj_id, false)` when enclosing. `on_containing` (`:415-429`) sets `DISABLED_HELD` and `handle_partition_cell_maintenance()`. `remove_from_contain` (`:292-293`) removes the id from the player `TunnelTracker`. Matches C++.

## Live
Enter (`support_states.rs` ~4556-4600) snaps the occupant to the entrance and sets `AIState::Docked` / MASKED, but the unit stays in `self.objects` at the entrance origin. `apply_instant_hit_splash_at` (`world_tick/shock.rs:347-392`) iterates every alive object with only relationship / airborne / same-template filters — no `contained_by` / enclosing gate. `mood.rs:818-826` blocks *direct* attacks on contained victims; splash bypasses it.

On death, `destroy_list_bounty.rs:184-188` only `container.remove_occupant(event.id)` (local door list). There is no `tunnel_network.record_exit` for the dying occupant (record_exit at `:298-313` / `:435-444` is only the container-death eject branch). The dead id stays in `PlayerTunnelNetwork::contained` and consumes one of the 10 shared slots.

## Player-visible
Artillery / tank splash on a Tunnel Network entrance kills infantry that retail treats as untouchable inside the network. Each such death silently eats a shared slot — after enough deaths the network refuses further enters while appearing empty.

## Not a closed duplicate
hq-xr8yk was occupants firing *out* of a tunnel. hq-agluh was DamagePercentToUnits on container death. hq-54vqz / hq-v1804 were cave-in / last-tunnel destroy. hq-pxp7d was pool-per-player. None cover occupant splash or the ghost-slot leak when an occupant dies by a non-container path.
close_reason: Splash at tunnel entrance skips enclosing/tunnel-pool occupants (apply_instant_hit_splash_at). Occupant death calls tunnel_network.record_exit so MaxTunnelCapacity slots are freed.

title: [Science] Rank-down reset drops PlayerTemplate intrinsic sciences
description:
## C++
`Player::resetRank` (Player.cpp:2638-2649) sets `m_sciencePurchasePoints = getPlayerTemplate()->getIntrinsicSciencePurchasePoints()` then adds Rank1 SciencePurchasePointsGranted, then `resetSciences`. `resetSciences` (Player.cpp:2478-2498) seeds `m_sciences = getPlayerTemplate()->getIntrinsicSciences()` (multi-science vector, e.g. SCIENCE_AMERICA SCIENCE_AirForce) plus rank-granted sciences. `setRankLevel` downgrade (Player.cpp:2671-2673) calls resetRank then climbs, so template intrinsics are re-applied.

## Leftover
`reset_rank_impl` (GameLogic/src/player/science_management.rs:19-45) reads `template.get_intrinsic_science_purchase_points()`. `reset_sciences_impl` (:546-575) seeds `template.get_intrinsic_sciences()` then rank-granted sciences.

## Live
`Player::reset_rank` (Main/src/game_logic/game_logic/player.rs:760-773) uses `reset_rank_residual(0)` (intrinsic SPP hardcoded 0) then `apply_faction_intrinsic_sciences()` which grants only faction SCIENCE_AMERICA/CHINA/GLA + SCIENCE_Rank1 (comment admits "Fail-closed: not full PlayerTemplate multi-science vector"). `set_rank_level` downgrade (:790-794) calls reset_rank. Script PLAYER SetRankLevel lower (scripts_camera.rs HostScriptRankRequest::SetRankLevel) therefore permanently drops General-specific IntrinsicSciences and IntrinsicSciencePurchasePoints that `apply_player_template_start_state` honored at match start.

## Evidence
Player.cpp:2638-2649, 2478-2498, 2671-2673. science_management.rs:19-45, 546-575. player.rs:760-773, 1146-1173, 774-821. Not a duplicate of closed hq-zxqwq (rank scripts never reached live) or hq-lw2i (Rank.ini store).
close_reason: reset_rank_from_template reseeds PlayerTemplate IntrinsicSciences and IntrinsicSciencePurchasePoints; scripts use set_player_rank_level

title: [BuildAssistant] Live canMake missing/dead producer reports FACTORY_IS_DISABLED
description:

`BuildAssistant::canMakeUnit` (BuildAssistant.cpp:1282-1283) returns `CANMAKE_NO_PREREQ` when builder or whatToBuild is NULL. There is no is-alive / is-constructed gate in canMakeUnit (ControlBar greys constructing factories separately). AISkirmishPlayer.cpp:206 treats that NO_PREREQ as "money or technology missing".

title: [Player] MSG_SELF_DESTRUCT transfer/kill never moves or wipes cash
description:
## C++
`GameLogicDispatch.cpp:1762-1797` MSG_SELF_DESTRUCT: optional living mutual ALLY `transferAssetsFromThat` then `killPlayer`. `Player::transferAssetsFromThat` (Player.cpp:2100-2144) moves non-beacon objects onto dest default team then withdraws/deposits all cash. `Player::killPlayer` (Player.cpp:2023-2071) evacuates containers, Neutral-transfers KINDOF_TECH_BUILDING, kills remaining (incl. beacons via killTeam), then `m_money.withdraw(countMoney())`.

Common `Player::kill_player` (:2120-2180) and GameLogic `Player::kill_player` (player/production.rs:232-323) evacuate, mark dead, kill/transfer tech, then zero money.

## Live
`execute_self_destruct` (command_executor/leftover.rs:1046-1061) calls `host_transfer_assets_from` then `host_kill_player`. `host_transfer_assets_from` (:1160-1175) moves objects only — no cash. `host_kill_player` (:1177-1191) `destroy_object`s remaining owned objects and clears `is_alive`; no evacuate, no Neutral-tech, no money wipe. Script `host_script_transfer_assets_from` (scripts_camera.rs:1391-1428) already transfers cash; the self-destruct path does not. Surrender-to-ally leaves the dying player's cash on the corpse and never gives it to the ally. Closed hq-4hs5b only wired the dispatch, not leftover/C++ money+evac.

## Evidence
Player.cpp:2100-2144, 2023-2071. leftover Common player.rs:2120-2217. command_executor/leftover.rs:1046-1191. Not a duplicate of closed hq-4hs5b (dispatch missing), hq-zucm (old leftover cash-only), hq-w7ia7 (script transfer), hq-gs3t0/hq-p4ejr (victory killPlayer).

title: [Pathfind] find_path_via_crate falls back to nearest_static_open when adjustDestination fails
description:
## C++
`Pathfinder::adjustDestination` (AIPathfind.cpp:5331-5407) spirals with `checkForAdjust` (occupancy, human `m_logicalExtent`, zone path-exist, surfaces). On failure it returns false and leaves dest unchanged. `internalFindPath` then `checkDestination` (AIPathfind.cpp:6491) returns NULL — no second “any statically open cell” fallback.

## Leftover
`pathfind_complete/check_movement.rs` `adjust_destination_from` is the same spiral + `try_adjust_cell`. Returns false if nothing passes. Callers do not then pick `nearest_static_open`. `find_path_internal` refuses invalid dests (zone / passable / checkDestination).

## Live
`find_path_via_crate` (pathfinding.rs:5041-5070) does:
`adjust_destination_on_layer(...).or_else(|| nearest_static_open(seed, 16)).unwrap_or(seed)`.
`nearest_static_open` (pathfinding.rs:2683) only tests `!is_static_blocked` — ignores occupancy, human extent, and zone connectivity. Those cells already failed `checkForAdjust` inside the 400-cell spiral. Live then pathfinds to that pocket (or the raw cliff/water click).

hq-muu69 closed “never adjustDestination”. Remaining: the post-adjust static-open fallback is extra vs leftover/C++ and can accept dests leftover would refuse.

## Player-visible
Clicks that leftover/C++ reject (occupied pad, disconnected pocket, off logical map) still produce a march to a nearby statically-clear cell.
close_reason: find_path_via_crate no longer falls back to nearest_static_open after adjustDestination failure; dest stays unchanged then zone/checkDestination refuse.

title: [Pathfind] find_path_ex_surfaces infers seeker from nearest object to start, not the mover
description:
## C++
`Pathfinder::findPath(obj, locomotorSet, from, rawTo)` takes the moving `Object*`. Crusher, human, dozerHack, downhill-only, infantry-through-infantry, path diameter, and `m_logicalExtent` all come from that object for the whole search (AIPathfind.cpp:6364-6373, 6451-6458, 6532).

## Leftover
`PathRequest.object_id` is the mover. `find_path` / `find_path_internal` keep that id for `check_for_movement`, DozerHack, downhill, human clamp, and occupancy extras (find_path.rs:148-269). Multi-segment leftover requests do not re-bind the seeker to whatever is nearest the next waypoint.

## Live
`PathfindingSystem::find_path_ex_surfaces` (pathfinding.rs:6441-6474) sets `seeker_*` from the **nearest living object to `start`**, not a unit id. Callers that know the mover still omit it:
- `GameLogic::compute_assigned_unit_path` (world_save.rs:1612) walks waypoint segments with `segment_start` = previous goal (often empty ground).
- After hop 1, nearest object is some other unit/building or `None` (path_diameter=1, no human clamp, no infantry stream, no DozerHack).

`is_crusher` is passed in, but infantry/dozer/human/downhill/diameter/seeker_id are inferred.

## Player-visible
Scripted/multi-click waypoint paths after the first hop use the wrong occupancy/dozer/human rules. Stacked units can steal each other's seeker flags. Group/shared spine after a snapped start can pick a neighbor as seeker.
close_reason: find_path_ex_surfaces binds seeker from mover ObjectId, not nearest living object to start. Callers pass the unit id.

title: [Pathfind] ignoreObstacle never reaches crate A* ignore_cells — static footprints still wall
description:
## C++
`AIUpdateInterface::ignoreObstacle` sets `Pathfinder::m_ignoreObstacleID`. `internalFindPath` (AIPathfind.cpp:6544) treats `goalCell->isObstaclePresent(m_ignoreObstacleID)` as terrain-zone (not building-zone). `validMovementPosition` / `linePassableCallback` / `isLinePassable` skip that object's `CELL_OBSTACLE` cells. Used by factory `aiFollowExitProductionPath`, contain exit, and `DozerAIUpdate.cpp:210` (`ignoreObstacle(scaffold)` then `aiMoveToPosition`).

## Leftover
`pathfind_complete/types.rs` `ignored_obstacle_cells` collects the ignored object's footprint cells. `find_path_internal` (find_path.rs:111) and `optimize_path_blocked` (line_passable.rs:22) pass that set into crate A* `is_passable_with_ignore` so those static obstacle cells are walkable for this query.

## Live
`PathfindingSystem::set_ignore_obstacle` (pathfinding.rs:4872) only skips that id in `update_dynamic_obstacles_ignoring` (occupancy stamp). `find_path_via_crate` (pathfinding.rs:5339-5359) calls `find_path_with_start_layer(..., ignore_cells=None, ...)`. Classified `CELL_OBSTACLE` of the producer/scaffold stays impassable.

hq-6gy32 / hq-fsjbr closed dozer-dock and factory-exit *wiring* of `assign_unit_path_ignoring`. Remaining: ignore never reaches leftover A* ignore_cells, so non-dozer exits still path around the building (dozers may still cheat via DozerHack).

## Player-visible
Factory/garrison/contain exits walk around the structure instead of through the ignored footprint. Dozer pad approach still depends on DozerHack, not ignoreObstacle.
close_reason: ignored_obstacle_cells from m_ignoreObstacleID footprint now passed to crate A* find_path_with_start_layer ignore_cells; zone/tunnel gates treat ignored/start-obstacle as walkable.

title: [Pathfind] processPathfindQueue drains all waiters — no PATHFIND_CELLS_PER_FRAME budget
description:
## C++
`Pathfinder::processPathfindQueue` (AIPathfind.cpp:5857-5920) resets `m_cumulativeCellsAllocated` then drains the ObjectID ring only while `m_cumulativeCellsAllocated < PATHFIND_CELLS_PER_FRAME` (AIPathfind.cpp:1079, **5000** cells). Excess waiters stay queued (`m_waitingForPath`) until later frames. AI.cpp:332-339 calls this once per AI update.

## Leftover
`pathfind_complete/construct.rs` `process_queue` (line 217+) matches that structure: dirty zones rebuild and return; else drain ObjectID ring / PathRequest queue while `cumulative_cells_allocated < PATHFIND_CELLS_PER_FRAME`. Leftover constant is 500 (`types.rs:13`) vs C++ 5000, but the **budget exists**.

## Live
`PathfindingSystem::queue_path` (pathfinding.rs:5397) only enforces `PATHFIND_QUEUE_LEN`. `GameLogic::process_pathfind_queue` (world_save.rs:1785-1838) `take_pending_paths()` and computes **every** waiter the next frame. No `m_cumulativeCellsAllocated` / `PATHFIND_CELLS_PER_FRAME` stop.

hq-is19 closed the older sync-vs-queue gap (one-frame deferral). hq-su78f closed overflow eviction. Remaining: live still pathfinds a 50-unit group move in one frame; C++/leftover spread after the cell budget.

## Player-visible
Large group/waypoint orders all resolve the same frame (CPU spike; every unit starts together). C++/leftover leave later waiters idle until later frames.
close_reason: process_pathfind_queue now resets m_cumulativeCellsAllocated and drains only while cells < PATHFIND_CELLS_PER_FRAME (5000). Excess waiters stay queued.

title: [Locomotor] Live lift treats any goal_y as PRECISE_Z_POS
description:
## C++
`handleBehaviorZ` SurfaceRelative / Absolute / SmoothHighest (`Locomotor.cpp:2296-2300`, `:2265-2267`):
`preferredHeight = m_preferredHeight + surfaceHt`; `goalPos.z` replaces it **only** when `getFlag(PRECISE_Z_POS)`.
`locoUpdate_maintainCurrentPosition` still passes `m_maintainPos` into handleBehaviorZ, but without PRECISE_Z the lift target stays preferredHeight+surface so hover/wings climb back to cruise altitude.

## Leftover (right)
`lift_relative_to_layer` (`GameEngine/GameLogic/src/locomotor/core_impl/behavior_z.rs:166-169`): `if self.uses_precise_z_pos() { preferred = goal_pos.z; }`.

## Live (wrong)
`apply_surface_relative_lift` (`object/physics.rs:623-627`): `if let Some(gy) = goal_y { gy } else { preferred + surface }` — **any** `Some(goal_y)` overrides, no `precise_z_pos` check.
Callers always pass Some:
- hover maintain (`:685-686`) `handle_behavior_z(ground_y, maintain_pos.y)`
- wings maintain (`:1341`) `handle_behavior_z(p.y /* current Y as surface */, Some(maintain.y))`
- leftover-adjacent `update.rs:377` `Some(target_pos.y)`

## Evidence
A Comanche that finishes a move over a hill then idles holds that hill Y forever instead of damping back to PreferredHeight+surface (C++/leftover). Wings circle also feeds current altitude as the surface sample. Not hq-i1k4a (Fixed/building snaps). Not hq-sgive (hover brake force).
close_reason: apply_surface_relative_lift and AbsoluteHeight only override preferred+surface with goal_y when precise_z_pos (PRECISE_Z_POS).

title: [Locomotor] NoSlowDown locos latch IS_BRAKING after path-raise
description:
## C++
`locoUpdate_moveTowardsPosition` (`Locomotor.cpp:940-946`) unconditionally clears `IS_BRAKING` and `m_brakingFactor=1` when `onPathDistToGoal > PATHFIND_CELL_SIZE_F && > distToStopAtMaxSpeed`, **before** appearance dispatch and regardless of `NO_SLOW_DOWN_AS_APPROACHING_DEST`.
The raise at `:980-992` (`dist > 2*onPathDistToGoal` sets `IS_BRAKING`) has no NO_SLOW_DOWN guard; the entry clear is what un-latches it.

## Leftover (right)
`loco_update_move_towards_position` (`GameEngine/GameLogic/src/locomotor/core_impl/move_dispatch.rs:24-32`) does the same unconditional far-from-goal clear.

## Live (wrong)
`update_movement` (`world_tick/movement.rs:607-612`) sets `obj.is_braking = true` on the same raise with no no_slow_down guard.
The only live clear is inside `Object::apply_cpp_approach_brake` (`object/physics_motion.rs:1209-1215`), which:
- is skipped entirely when `no_slow_down_as_approaching_dest` (`:1204-1206` and `movement.rs:644-650`)
- so a NoSlowDown loco that trips the raise latches `is_braking` for the rest of the march
Then every frame uses the OBJECT_STATUS_BRAKING pose cheat (`movement.rs:802-805`) and braking-scaled accel (`:782-787`) until waypoint-complete / `stop_moving`.

## Evidence
Jets/projectiles (and any INI `NoSlowDownAsApproachingDest`) that get slightly off the computed path snap-cheat toward the lead point instead of flying through. Wings is unaffected (Wings early-return in `apply_cpp_approach_brake` still clears). Not hq-iriyu (brake *curves*).
close_reason: update_movement now unconditionally clears IS_BRAKING/braking_factor when far from dest (Locomotor.cpp:941-946) before path-raise, so NoSlowDown locos no longer latch after a raise.

title: [Physics] Live motion step never destroys NaN-position objects
description:
## C++
`PhysicsBehavior::update` (`PhysicsUpdate.cpp:664-669`) destroys the object when the transform translation is NaN (bad force / 0-mass / explode).

## Leftover (right)
Leftover `update_simple` (hq-cha87 close) checks `pos.x/y/z.is_finite()` after integration and `TheGameLogic::destroy_object_by_id`. Unused by the host tick.

## Live (wrong)
`Object::tick_physics_motion_step` (`object/physics_motion.rs`) has no `is_finite` / NaN guard on `new_pos`. Grep of the live motion path finds no NaN-destroy. hq-cha87 closed the leftover crate only.

## Evidence
A bad collide/shock force leaves a NaN object permanently in the world and partition (invisible, unkillable, pollutes neighbor queries). Not a leftovers-only report: leftover is the right reference; live host tick is the wrong path.

title: [Physics] Non-vehicle fall into structure never destroyObject
description:
## C++
`PhysicsBehavior::onCollide` (`PhysicsUpdate.cpp:1353-1365`): when `delta.z < 0` and `pos.z >= m_defaultStructureRubbleHeight` into `KINDOF_STRUCTURE`, fire `VehicleCrashesIntoBuildingWeapon` **only if** the falling object is a vehicle, then `TheGameLogic->destroyObject(obj)` **regardless of kind**. Infantry, debris, crew, and tossed riders that land on a building vanish.

## Leftover (right)
`on_collide` (`GameEngine/GameLogic/src/object/behavior/physics_collide.rs:238-251`): weapon gated on `KindOf::Vehicle`; `TheGameLogic::destroy_object_by_id` always runs for the structure case.

## Live (wrong)
`vehicle_crash_into_immobile_outcome` (`host_partition_collision_physics_residual.rs:587-596`) returns `None` when `!is_vehicle`. `apply_vehicle_crash_into_immobile` then never fires a weapon and never destroys. Tossed infantry/debris/crew landing on a building survive.

## Evidence
A Ranger tossed onto a War Factory (shockwave, Battle Bus throw, parachute miss) stays alive on the roof. C++/leftover destroy the object. Not hq-jwi1o / hq-0736 (those were vehicle weapon 100 Explosive vs INI).
close_reason: Live host: contained skip, 3D airborne bounce, stiffness zero-vel, non-vehicle structure destroy, NaN-pos destroy

title: [Physics] Structure stiffness bounce never zeros velocity
description:
## C++
`PhysicsBehavior::onCollide` immobile branch (`PhysicsUpdate.cpp:1346-1375`): after computing `factor = -mag * mass * stiffness`, **zeros** `m_vel` (x/y/z) and invalidates velMag, then applies the bounce force. Comment path: falling into a building may also `destroyObject`. The zero is what turns a graze into a rebound instead of a slide-through.

## Leftover (right)
`on_collide` (`GameEngine/GameLogic/src/object/behavior/physics_collide.rs:262-263`) sets `handle.state.vel = Coord3D::ZERO` and `vel_mag = INVALID_VEL_MAG` before `apply_force_with_obj`.

## Live (wrong)
`Object::apply_structure_stiffness_bounce` (`object/physics_motion.rs:445-470`, called from `world_tick/physics.rs` `apply_immobile_collide_bounce`) docs \"Zeros velocity then applies\" but the body only does `self.movement.velocity += force`. Tangential speed is kept.

## Evidence
Vehicles/wrecks that graze a building keep sliding into/through the hull instead of rebounding off a zeroed velocity plus the stiffness impulse. Not hq-exasi (that added the stiffness bounce at all). Not hq-j8gp8 (mobile overlap force).
close_reason: Live host: contained skip, 3D airborne bounce, stiffness zero-vel, non-vehicle structure destroy, NaN-pos destroy

title: [Shroud] RadarVanScan/SpySat looker mask uses faction Team not Player relationship
description:
## C++
`Object::look` (`Object.cpp:4949-4958`) builds `lookingMask` from `getControllingPlayer()->getRelationship(currentPlayer->getDefaultTeam()) == ALLIES`, then `| m_visionSpiedMask`. RadarVanPing / SpySatellitePing are real objects: `DynamicShroudClearingRangeUpdate` only changes `setShroudClearingRange`; the reveal is that object's look. FFA same-faction enemies do not share the ping disk.

## Leftover (right)
`Object::look` (`GameLogic/src/object/object_vision.rs:185-194`) uses `controller_relationship_to_player_default_team == Allies` then `|= vision_spied_mask`. Leftover `DynamicShroudClearingRangeUpdate` (`object/behavior/dynamic_shroud_clearing_range_update.rs`) calls `set_shroud_clearing_range` → `handle_partition_cell_maintenance` → look.

## Live
`activate_radar_scan` (`world_scripts/helix_radar.rs:1086-1120`) and `activate_spy_satellite` (`helix_radar.rs:1480-1516`) stamp `player_mask` with `player.team == team`, then `ShroudManager::do_shroud_reveal`. Spawned ping objects do not go through crate-vision relationship look for the shrink disk. Same-faction FFA allies/enemies share the scan.

## Evidence
hq-pzyzt fixed crate-vision `update_main_crate_vision` to `player_relationship`. Special-power residual disks still use faction Team. Not leftovers-only: leftover look matches C++; live scan/sat path is the running reveal.
close_reason: RadarVanScan/SpySat looker mask uses player_relationship Allies, not faction Team

title: [Weapon] Frenzy WeaponBonusUpdate uses same-team not Allies
description:
## C++
WeaponBonusUpdate::update (WeaponBonusUpdate.cpp:102-141) iterates PartitionFilterRelationship ALLOW_ALLIES (plus alive + same-map). Frenzy_InvisibleMarker WeaponBonusUpdate then doTempWeaponBonus on allies in BonusRange 200 that pass RequiredAffectKindOf=CAN_ATTACK / ForbiddenAffectKindOf=STRUCTURE, and iterateContained so garrison/transport passengers get the buff even when the container is STRUCTURE.

## Live
host_frenzy.rs:257-264 is_legal_frenzy_target requires same_team (obj.team == caster_team). activate_frenzy (world_combat/heroes_and_plans.rs:956-1003) snapshots objects in 200 XZ and applies apply_weapon_bonus_frenzy only when same-team. ## Player-visible
In 2v2 / campaign ally games, a USA Frenzy does not buff allied China/GLA CAN_ATTACK units in the 200 radius. C++/leftover do. Passengers of an in-radius transport/garrison also miss the leftover contained walk if their live position is not independently selected.
close_reason: activate_frenzy uses player relationship Allies (not faction Team equality) and walks contained occupants of in-range ally containers so 2v2/garrison passengers get FRENZY.

title: [FX] Structure topple CrushingFX plays at height 0
description:
## C++
`StructureToppleUpdate.cpp:407-419` `doDamageLine` sets `target.z = TheTerrainLogic->getGroundHeight(target.x, target.y)` then `FXList::doFXPos(m_crushingFXList, &target)`. Crush dust sits on the terrain under the falling building.

## Leftover (right)

## Live (wrong)
`StructureToppleCrushSample` only stores `x,z`. `apply_structure_topple_crush_samples` (`create_destroy_die.rs:3406-3410`) dispatches CrushingFX at `Vec3::new(s.x, 0.0, s.z)`. Host Y-up height 0 remaps to leftover `(x, z, 0)` so leftover FXList plays at world height 0.

## Player-visible
Falling-building crush dust/debris play at sea level / underground instead of on the terrain under the crush line.

Not hq-7aiod (flat 99999 damage / 3-point line). Not hq-3doyg (tree ToppleFX).
close_reason: apply_structure_topple_crush_samples samples terrain_height_at(x,z) and dispatches CrushingFX at host Y=height (C++ StructureToppleUpdate.cpp:407-419 getGroundHeight).

title: [FX] Weapon FireFX never passes drawable transform
description:
## C++
`Weapon.cpp:934-939` fallback `FXList::doFXPos(fx, where, sourceObj->getDrawable()->getTransformMatrix(), getWeaponSpeed(), &targetPos, getPrimaryDamageRadius(bonus))`. `ParticleSystemFXNugget::reallyDoFX` (`FXList.cpp:570-637`) `Rotate_Vector`s `Offset` by that matrix and `setLocalTransform` when `OrientToObject`. `doFXPos` passes `NULL` for `thingToAttachTo`, so `AttachToObject` never runs on FireFX — the drawable matrix is the only facing.

## Leftover (right)
`FXListManagerBridge::do_fx_pos_ex` (`GameClient/src/fx_list.rs:49-75`) accepts `matrix: Option<&Mat4>` and forwards it. `ParticleSystemWrapper::do_fx_pos` (`fx_list.rs:1562-1590`) converts the Mat4 to a 3x3 and `really_do_fx` (`fxlist_integration.rs:728-782`) does `offset = matrix * offset` plus `set_local_transform` when `orient_to_object`.

## Live (wrong)
`TheFXList::do_fx_at_position_ex` (`GameLogic/src/helpers/particles.rs:34-46`) always passes `None` for matrix. Live `dispatch_fx_list_at_pos_ex` has no matrix argument. `combat_particles::spawn_weapon_fire_fx_named_ocl` and `weapon_discharge::play_dispatch_fire_fx` only thread pos / secondary / speed / radius.

## Player-visible
FireFX authored with `Offset` / `OrientToObject` / `RotateX/Y/Z` spawn axis-aligned at the world point instead of following the unit. Muzzle flashes and exhaust sit beside the hull.

Not hq-40098 (UseCallersRadius). Not hq-2v2e0 (secondary). Not hq-758k0 (generic MuzzleFlash). Not leftover-only W3DModelDraw `handleWeaponFireFX` bone path.
close_reason: FireFX now passes leftover-space drawable transform: TheFXList::do_fx_at_position_ex forwards matrix; dispatch_fx_list_at_pos_oriented + spawn_weapon_fire_fx_named_ocl_oriented thread source get_transform_matrix (C++ Weapon.cpp:934-939 doFXPos mtx).

title: [Weapon] ECM jammer ignores ExclusiveWeaponDelay while disabler fires
description:
## C++
FireWeaponUpdate::isOkayToFire (FireWeaponUpdate.cpp:90-109) returns false when ExclusiveWeaponDelay > 0 and TheGameLogic->getFrame() < obj->getLastShotFiredFrame() + ExclusiveWeaponDelay. ChinaTankECM authors FireWeaponUpdate Weapon=ECMTankMissileJammer ExclusiveWeaponDelay=1000ms (30f). While the tank's WeaponSet ECMTankVehicleDisabler is firing (DelayBetweenShots 100ms), lastShotFiredFrame stays fresh so the jammer pulse never fires.

## Leftover
GeneralsRust/Code/GameEngine/GameLogic/src/object/behavior/fire_weapon_update.rs:290-297 and object/update/fire_weapon_update.rs:123-130 implement the same last_shot_fired_frame + exclusive_weapon_delay gate.

## Live
host_ecm_jam.rs documents ExclusiveWeaponDelay 1000ms→30f as a constant/honesty peel only. update_ecm_missile_jam (world_combat/gps_and_fields.rs:420+) pulses jammer for every alive constructed ECM tank with no last-shot / ExclusiveWeaponDelay check. Live Object has no getLastShotFiredFrame stamp. Comment at gps_and_fields.rs:354: "ExclusiveWeaponDelay fail-closed."

## Player-visible
Missiles keep getting jammed while the ECM tank is actively disabling a vehicle. C++/leftover suppress the jammer for 1s after each disabler shot (effectively the whole time the beam is up).
close_reason: Live ECM jammer honors FireWeaponUpdate ExclusiveWeaponDelay: vehicle-disabler pulse stamps last_fire_frame; update_ecm_missile_jam skips when current < last_shot + 30f. last_shot 0 (never fired) still allows the jammer.

title: [Physics] Live onCollide never skips container/contained pairs
description:
## C++
`PhysicsBehavior::onCollide` (`PhysicsUpdate.cpp:1167-1172`):
`if (otherContainedBy == obj || objContainedBy == other) return;`
Container and occupant never bounce/crush each other, even when both stay in the partition (non-enclosing Fire Base, parachute, Overlord portable).

## Leftover (right)
`on_collide` (`GameEngine/GameLogic/src/object/behavior/physics_collide.rs:70-73`) returns when `other_contained_by == Some(object_id) || obj_contained_by == Some(other_id)`.

## Live (wrong)
`GameLogic::try_physics_collide` (`world_tick/physics.rs:216-345`) has ignore-collisions, dual-parachute, ignored-obstacle recrew, crush, and immobile bounce — **no** `contained_by` mutual skip.
`tick_physics_collisions_all` (`world_tick/shock.rs:67-82`) correctly unregisters only *enclosing* riders (`enclosing_hidden_rider_ids`). Comment: Fire Base / parachute / Overlord portable stay registered (matches C++ `addOrRemoveObjFromWorld` / hq-j7mn9). Those registered pairs then hit `try_physics_collide` and bounce.

## Evidence
Paradrop infantry bounce off their own chute. Fire Base occupants shove the bunker (or get shoved out of station). Overlord Battle Bunker / portable structure riders collide with the hull. Not hq-j7mn9 (that only hid enclosing Humvee/Chinook/garrison riders from the partition).
close_reason: Live host: contained skip, 3D airborne bounce, stiffness zero-vel, non-vehicle structure destroy, NaN-pos destroy

title: [Locomotor] Live treatAsAirborne uses 9.0 not -(3*3)*gravity
description:
## C++
`Locomotor::locoUpdate_moveTowardsPosition` (`Locomotor.cpp:996-1056`):
`heightAboveSurface = pos.z - getLayerHeight(..., obj->getLayer())` (then optional carrier-deck peel).
`treatAsAirborne` when `heightAboveSurface > -(3*3)*TheGlobalData->m_gravity`.
Comment: high enough to stay up for 3 frames. Retail `GameData.ini` Gravity `-64` via `parseAccelerationReal` is `-64/900 ≈ -0.071`, so the threshold is **~0.64wu**, not 9wu.
2D appearance movers run only when `getAllowMotiveForceWhileAirborne() || !treatAsAirborne`. Blocked air units also clear `*blocked` with this same treatAsAirborne.

## Leftover (right)
`loco_update_move_towards_position` (`GameEngine/GameLogic/src/locomotor/core_impl/move_dispatch.rs:153-157`) uses
`get_height_above_terrain() > -(3.0 * 3.0) * loco_gravity()` (`types.rs:58-61` reads `TheGlobalData->m_gravity`).
Live `Object::is_significantly_above_terrain` (`object/physics.rs:1612-1616`) already uses the same `-(3*3)*leftover_loco_gravity()` formula (`SHOCK_GRAVITY = -64/900`). Unused by the march loop.

## Live (wrong)
`GameLogic::update_movement` (`world_tick/movement.rs:342-347`) hardcodes `height_above > 9.0` (ctor-default `g=-1` assumption). The blocked-air clear at `:558` uses the same `> 9.0`.
Does not call `is_significantly_above_terrain()`.

## Evidence
Units that hop a curb, crest a ramp, or walk off a 1–8wu ledge keep applying 2D walk motive for ~9wu of air time. C++/leftover stop 2D motive after ~0.64wu so they fall. Not hq-75idp (gate was missing entirely; that close added the 9.0 constant). Not leftover-only: leftover dispatcher and live `is_significantly_above_terrain` both use gravity.
close_reason: Live treatAsAirborne now uses -(3*3)*leftover_loco_gravity (~0.64wu) instead of hardcoded 9.0 in update_movement (2D motive skip + blocked-air clear).

title: [Physics] Airborne bounce uses 2D selection radius not 3D sphere
description:
## C++
`PhysicsBehavior::onCollide` (`PhysicsUpdate.cpp:1269-1284`): after geom contact, if `obj->isAboveTerrain()` use `getBoundingSphereRadius()` and 3D `delta`/`distSqr`; else bounding-circle and `delta.z=0`. Bounce force is `factor * delta/dist` including Z. If 3D dist exceeds the sphere sum, return (no force).

## Leftover (right)
`on_collide` (`GameEngine/GameLogic/src/object/behavior/physics_collide.rs:166-179, 271-275`) matches: `is_above_terrain()` → 3D sphere radii; else 2D circle; force uses full 3D delta.

## Live (wrong)
`host_geom_collides` already rejects non-overlapping heights, but the force path after contact is 2D:
- Pair loop passes `selection_radius` (`world_tick/shock.rs:87, 152`).
- Mobile-mobile `apply_overlap_collide_force` (`object/physics.rs:917-934`) zeros Y and uses XZ-only dist, `overlap.min(5)`.
No airborne sphere early-out.

## Evidence
A low-flying or landing helicopter/Comanche that geom-overlaps a ground unit is shoved sideways by 2D selection-radius overlap instead of C++/leftover 3D sphere (which often refuses force when vertical separation still exceeds the spheres, and otherwise includes a Z component). Not hq-o6c5 (oriented geom vs selection-radius *tests*; live geom now uses authored GeometryInfo).
close_reason: Live host: contained skip, 3D airborne bounce, stiffness zero-vel, non-vehicle structure destroy, NaN-pos destroy

title: [Cam] CAMERA_SET_DEFAULT never retargets live wheel clamp or home pitch
description:
## C++
`ScriptActions::doCameraSetDefault` (`ScriptActions.cpp:4511-4513`) calls `TheTacticalView->setDefaultView(pitch, angle, maxHeight)`.

`W3DView::setDefaultView` (`W3DView.cpp:1890-1898`) writes `m_defaultPitchAngle = pitch` (angle ignored) and `m_maxHeightAboveGround = TheGlobalData->m_maxCameraHeight * maxHeight` (floored to `m_minHeightAboveGround`).

`View::zoomIn`/`zoomOut` (`View.cpp:104-112`) change HAG by 10wu via `setHeightAboveGround`. `W3DView::setHeightAboveGround` (`W3DView.cpp:1902-1914`) clamps to `m_minHeightAboveGround`/`m_maxHeightAboveGround` when `m_zoomLimited`. `W3DView::update` settle (`W3DView.cpp:1309-1324`) uses the same View max when enforcing max height.

`InGameUI::resetCamera` / MMB short-click (`LookAtXlat.cpp:250-254`) call `setAngleAndPitchToDefault` (`View.cpp:163-166`) which restores `m_pitchAngle = m_defaultPitchAngle`, then `setZoomToDefault` which uses the scaled `m_maxHeightAboveGround`.

After a campaign `CAMERA_SET_DEFAULT`, wheel zoom and home pose follow the scripted ceiling and default pitch.

## Leftover (right)
`do_camera_set_default` (`GameLogic/src/scripting/executor/actions_camera.rs:659-678`) calls `handler.camera_set_default`. Leftover `GameClientScriptActionHandler::camera_set_default` (`script_action_handler.rs:1197-1199`) writes leftover `View::set_default_view` (`display/view.rs:1001-1007`): `default_pitch_angle = pitch`, `max_height_above_ground = global_max * max_height` (floored to min). Leftover `set_height_above_ground` (`view.rs:1029-1035`) clamps to that View max when `zoom_limited`. Leftover `set_angle_and_pitch_to_default` (`view.rs:996-998`) restores `pitch_angle = default_pitch_angle`. Unused leftover `look_at` zoomIn/Out and MetaCameraReset use those View fields.

## Live (wrong)
`apply_script_camera_default` (`scripts_camera.rs:4272-4284`) stores `script_default_camera_pitch` and `script_default_camera_max_height` (the raw scale). Presentation freeze + `ui_script_default_camera_max_height()` is used only by `reset_camera_pose_in_place` / script zoom-to-default (`shell.rs:1078-1081` product).

`apply_player_height_zoom_steps` (`mouse.rs:2398-2412`) and `ease_camera_height_above_ground` (`mouse.rs:2438-2493`) clamp HAG to raw `GameData.min_camera_height` / `max_camera_height`. They never multiply by the script scale.

`reset_camera_pose_in_place` (`mouse.rs:3846-3853`) restores `configured_startup_camera_defaults().pitch_degrees` (GameData CameraPitch). `ui_script_default_camera_pitch()` exists (`ui_commands.rs:1405-1414`) but has no production caller.

## Player-visible
Campaign `CAMERA_SET_DEFAULT` with maxHeight 0.5 should cap wheel/settle at half GameData MaxCameraHeight; live still zooms to the full INI ceiling. maxHeight 2.0 should allow twice the height; live cannot. MMB / KP5 home after a scripted default pitch still snaps to GameData CameraPitch instead of the scripted `m_defaultPitchAngle`.

Not hq-3puei (FXPitch=1.0 on home), hq-zrukg (letterbox zoomLimited), hq-qe6im (zoom multiplier vs HAG).
close_reason: Live wheel/settle clamp uses script-scaled View max; MMB/KP5 home restores scripted default pitch

title: [Hunt] CommandButtonHunt special scan skips ally/mine/priority gates
description:

CommandButtonHuntUpdate.cpp:259-345 special-power hunt: canDoSpecialPowerAtObject; capture skips same controlling player and ALLIES relationship (oil derricks still allowed by dropping the enemy filter); TNT/timed charges skip if an owned KINDOF_MINE is within ViewObjectRange; pick uses AttackPriorityInfo minus AIData AttackPriorityDistanceModifier, not raw nearest.

title: [Hunt] CommandButtonHunt enter scan uses Team/KindOf not ActionManager

title: [Hunt] CommandButtonHunt never quits after player/script command
description:

title: [Save] AutoDeposit schedule and capture bonus never persisted
description:
## C++
`AutoDepositUpdate::xfer` v2 (`AutoDepositUpdate.cpp:235-256`) writes `m_depositOnFrame`, `m_awardInitialCaptureBonus`, and `m_initialized`. Ctor comment at `AutoDepositUpdate.cpp:128-132` exists because load sets the team and must not re-award InitialCaptureBonus. Oil derricks keep the 12s clock and skip the $1000 bonus after load; Black Markets keep the 2s clock.

`HostOilDerrickRegistry` (`host_oil_derrick.rs:266-299`) and `HostBlackMarketRegistry` (`host_black_market.rs`) keep `next_deposit_frame` / `capture_bonus_awarded` on GameLogic. `save_load/snapshot` never captures them. `restore_from_snapshot` rebuilds objects via `Object::new` and `GameLogic::reset` clears both registries (`construct.rs:831-832`). After load a captured Tech Oil Derrick re-arms the 12s timer and can pay InitialCaptureBonus again; Black Markets restart the 2s cash clock.

No `oil_derrick` / `black_market` / `auto_deposit` tokens under `Main/src/save_load`. Lifecycle envelope has no AutoDeposit tag.
close_reason: Lifecycle-tail persist: AutoDeposit oil/black-market clocks+capture bonus (ADPS), OCL supply-drop timer (OCLT), JetAI RTB/takeoff/lock-on (JTAI), ChinookAI flight/combat-drop (CHNK), HackInternet unpack/hack/pack+pending (HKIN). restore_object reinstalls Chinook transport. No WorldSnapshot bump.

title: [Save] HackInternet unpack/hack/pack and pending command never persisted
description:
## C++
`HackInternetAIUpdate::xfer` v1 (`HackInternetAIUpdate.cpp:187-201`) writes `AIUpdateInterface` (state machine UNPACKING / HACK_INTERNET / PACKING + remaining frames) then `m_hasPendingCommand` + `m_pendingCommand`. A Hacker mid-unpack or mid-hack cash cycle continues after load; a pending move stored during pack is not dropped.

## Leftover
`hack_internet_ai_update.rs:817-848` persists state id + frames remaining and the pending command. That is the C++ SM + pending table the live host also models.

## Live
`HostHackerIncomeRegistry` (`host_hacker_income.rs:237-275`) holds `active_hackers`, `next_deposit_frame`, `pack_phase`, `pack_until_frame`, and `pending_command`. `save_load/snapshot` never writes the registry. `GameLogic::reset` clears `hacker_income` (`construct.rs:833`). `restore_from_snapshot` does not restore it. After load a field-hacking Hacker stops (or restarts unpack from scratch) and a pending post-pack command is lost. Cash interval also resets (field 60f / IC 54f).

## Evidence
No `hacker_income` / `hack_internet` persist suffix. Closed `hq-36j5h` is leftover InternetHackContain xfer no-op (leftover-not-right), not this AI module.
close_reason: Lifecycle-tail persist: AutoDeposit oil/black-market clocks+capture bonus (ADPS), OCL supply-drop timer (OCLT), JetAI RTB/takeoff/lock-on (JTAI), ChinookAI flight/combat-drop (CHNK), HackInternet unpack/hack/pack+pending (HKIN). restore_object reinstalls Chinook transport. No WorldSnapshot bump.

title: [FX] Weapon FireFX never passes UseCallersRadius damage radius
description:
## C++
`Weapon.cpp:904-939` `fireWeaponTemplate` always threads `getPrimaryDamageRadius(bonus)` into `Drawable::handleWeaponFireFX` and the fallback `FXList::doFXPos(..., overrideRadius)`. `ParticleSystemFXNugget::reallyDoFX` (`FXList.cpp:629-637`) applies that radius to sphere/cylinder emission volume when `UseCallersRadius` is set. Explosion/smoke clouds scale to the weapon's splash, not the INI default sphere.

## Leftover (right)
`ParticleSystemFXNugget` parses `UseCallersRadius` (`fx_list.rs:1139`) and `really_do_fx` (`fxlist_integration.rs:801-812`) sets sphere/cylinder radius when `override_radius > 0`. Booby-trap live already proves the leftover path works: `helix_radar.rs:482-487` passes `max_r` as `override_radius`.

## Live (wrong)
Weapon FireFX/DetonationFX never pass the radius:
- `combat_particles.rs:511-516` / `:548-553` `dispatch_fx_list_at_pos_ex(..., 0.0)`
- `weapon_discharge.rs:85-90` fallback also `0.0`
- `spawn_weapon_fire_fx_named_ocl` has no damage-radius parameter
Live already has `host_primary_damage_radius_for_weapon_name` (`host_structure_topple.rs:327-331`) unused here.

## Player-visible
Artillery, demo, and other FireFX/DetonationFX authored with `UseCallersRadius = Yes` emit at the template default sphere instead of the weapon's PrimaryDamageRadius. Explosion particle clouds stay tiny (or huge) regardless of splash.

Not hq-osd07 (present axis). Not hq-amed6 (double spawn). Not hq-6graz (tracer speed).
close_reason: Live FireFX/DetonationFX now thread host_primary_damage_radius_for_weapon_name into dispatch_fx_list_at_pos_ex overrideRadius (C++ Weapon.cpp:904-939 getPrimaryDamageRadius). spawn_weapon_fire_fx_named_ocl takes override_radius; weapon_discharge plan+fallback and ocl fire/impact pass it. Leftover ParticleSystemFXNugget UseCallersRadius already applies when override_radius > 0.

Live: teams.rs guard_retaliate_chase_should_exit applies AGGRESSOR radius outer+inner to every live victim including scan re-acquires. Retaliators chase scanned targets ~48% farther (human ~400 vs C++ inner 270) and a stale aggressor give-up frame can time-out a scan victim C++ would attack timer-free.

Not hq-vq33x (team common target in retaliate scan).

title: [Radar] Observer/defeated local still hides enemy stealth blips
description:
## C++
`StealthUpdate::calcStealthedStatusForPlayer` (`StealthUpdate.cpp:481-485`) forces `r = ALLIES` when `!player->isPlayerActive()` ("Observer players are friends to everyone!"). `isPlayerActive` is `!m_observer && !m_isPlayerDead` (`Player.cpp:3923-3926`). `RadarObject::isTemporarilyHidden` (`Radar.cpp:118-125`) hides only `STEALTHLOOK_INVISIBLE`, so a defeated/observer local still sees undetected enemy stealth as `VISIBLE_FRIENDLY` blips.

## Leftover (right)
Leftover `calc_stealth_look_for_player` (`stealth_update.rs:836-839`) returns `Relationship::Allies` when `!player_guard.is_player_active()`. Test `calc_stealth_look_treats_observer_as_ally` locks it.

## Live (wrong)
`host_radar_insert_spec` (`radar_live.rs:385-413`) sets `is_enemy = !host_owner_is_ally_of_local` and `observer_is_friendly = !is_enemy`. `host_owner_is_ally_of_local` (`:251-259`) uses `player_relationship`, and `player_relationship_from_map` (`object_queries.rs:384-385`) returns **Neutral** when either player `!is_alive`. Inactive local → friendly=false → `calc_stealthed_status_for_player` → `Invisible` → `hidden_by_stealth`. Overlay `should_render_object_overlay_blip` (`radar/mod.rs:2119-2126`) hides `is_stealth && is_enemy` too. `local_player_active` is stamped on the spec but only feeds disguise color and LOCAL_UNIT_ONLY (hq-bcb7d). Live camo look (`stealth_mines.rs:1336-1347`) *does* treat `local_inactive` as friendly — radar hide disagrees.

Distinct from hq-4yczp (disguise *color* isPlayerActive), hq-0lsmu (own CamoNetting look), hq-bcb7d (LOCAL_UNIT_ONLY unhide).

## Evidence
C++ `StealthUpdate.cpp:481-485`, `Radar.cpp:118-125`. Leftover `stealth_update.rs:836-839`. Live `radar_live.rs:251-259, 385-413`, `object_queries.rs:384-385`.

## Player-visible
After local defeat (or as observer), undetected enemy stealth units vanish from radar. Retail shows them as friendly-visible blips so the loser can watch the rest of the match.
close_reason: Live host_radar_insert_spec treats !isPlayerActive (dead/observer) as stealth-allies so undetected enemy stealth is VISIBLE_FRIENDLY, not hidden. Overlay hide gated on local_player_active. owner_is_ally_of_local unchanged for color.

title: [EVA] InsufficientFunds host throttle is 900 frames not Eva.ini
description:
C++ path: ControlBarCommandProcessing.cpp:229,272,313,388 and PlaceEventTranslator.cpp:175 call TheEva->setShouldPlay(EVA_InsufficientFunds) on every failed purchase/placement click. Replay suppression is only Eva::isTimeForCheck / playMessage / processPlayingMessages (Eva.cpp:380-470) while a check sits in m_checks, keyed to Eva.ini TimeBetweenChecksMS. An unplayed check expires after framesToExpire (default 150) and a new click re-queues.

Leftover path (matches C++): GameClient eva.rs ingest_logic_events + is_time_for_check / play_message / process_playing_messages use per-event frames_between_checks from Eva.ini. No extra producer throttle.

Live path (wrong): try_eva_insufficient_funds (eva_camera.rs:117-137) drops the event before TheEva::set_should_play whenever frame < eva_insufficient_funds_next_frame, using hard-coded EVA_FRAMES_BETWEEN_CHECKS_DEFAULT_RESIDUAL = 900 (host_ui_presentation_residual.rs). Called from live purchase (ui_production.rs). If a higher-priority EVA occupies speech past framesToExpire, C++/leftover re-queue the next click; live hard-drops for a full 30s. Also wrong whenever Eva.ini authors TimeBetweenChecksMS != 900.

Not a duplicate of hq-tuudr (LowPower energy poll), hq-ptzj (place skipped EVA entirely; closed), hq-qaknm / hq-t7eko (Eva update starve / drain).
close_reason: try_eva_insufficient_funds calls TheEva::set_should_play on every failed local click; Eva.ini TimeBetweenChecksMS is leftover Eva, not a 900-frame host gate. Removed eva_insufficient_funds_next_frame.

title: [Audio] Live drain rodio fallback replays leftover-muted events
description:
C++ path: GameAudio.cpp:382-464 addAudioEvent applies m_adjustedVolumes (setAudioEventEnabled / setAudioEventVolumeOverride, :567-605; ScriptActions.cpp:5101-5103 SOUND_DISABLE_TYPE) then culls volume < m_minVolume returning AHSV_Muted. shouldPlayLocally false returns AHSV_NotForLocal. Miles is the only backend — culled events stay silent.

Leftover path (matches C++): game_audio.rs add_audio_event applies adjusted_volumes then min_volume cull. play_sound_through_the_audio_at (assets/audio.rs:170-183) treats AHSV_MUTED / AHSV_NOT_FOR_LOCAL as no handle. Leftover ScriptEngine SOUND_DISABLE_TYPE / AUDIO_OVERRIDE_VOLUME_TYPE write leftover TheAudio on the live ScriptEngine::update walk.

Live path (wrong): subsystem_manager.rs:595-632 drain_and_dispatch_queued_audio. When leftover returns None the drain falls through to SoundEffectsTable.resolve_sound_path + play_cnc_sound_effect_scaled at live_gameplay_sfx_volume (assets/audio.rs:190-232), which builds a fresh AudioEventRts without adjusted_volumes or min_volume. Script-disabled / overridden / not-for-local events still play on a second sink. C++ has no second backend.

Not a duplicate of hq-p7htj (missing object_id), hq-2xymp (pose drop), hq-o8ldf (drain skipped locality), hq-8896r (Options sliders). MusicDisable/Enable unused-assets toggle is not filed (debug input_integration; retail mute is leftover TheAudio.set_on).
close_reason: Drain skips rodio when leftover TheAudio is live. AHSV_MUTED / AHSV_NOT_FOR_LOCAL stay silent; play_cnc_sound_effect_scaled only if leftover Miles is not constructed.

title: [AIGroup] Click-to-gather never applies the 2000-cell bbox cap
description:
C++: AIGroup.cpp:1598-1608 after the gather-rect test: dx=(max.x-min.x)/CELL; dy=(max.x-min.x)/CELL (x-span used twice); cells=dx*dy; only if cells<2000 does groupTightenToPosition run. A widely spread group clicked inside its bbox keeps relative offsets.

title: [Shroud] Vision-spied units never become moving lookers
description:
## C++
`Object::look` (`Object.cpp:4961-4962`) does `lookingMask |= m_visionSpiedMask` after the ally mask. `setVisionSpied` (`Object.cpp:5227-5253`) refcounts per player, rebuilds the mask, and `handlePartitionCellMaintenance()` so the unit relooks. A vision-spied enemy is a continuous looker for the spying player at `getShroudClearingRange()` from its *current* position; the reveal follows the unit until spy expires.

## Leftover (right)
`object_vision.rs:169-197` leftover `look()` ORs `self.vision_spied_mask` into `looking_mask` (ally branch and fallback). `get_shroud_clearing_range()` is the reveal radius. Unlook/relook parity matches C++.

## Live (wrong)
`update_main_crate_vision` (`spawn_templates.rs:4295-4310`) builds the look mask from owner-allies (or all players for RevealToAll) only — no `vision_spied_mask` term. Live `Object.vision_spied_mask` (`object/mod.rs:2321-2324`, `stealth.rs:585-600`) is set by CIA / Satellite Hack (`angry_mob_aurora.rs:131-136, 364-365`) but only consumed for camo presentation logging. The spy path then one-shot `do_shroud_reveal` + `queue_undo_shroud_reveal` at the *activation-time* snapshot (`:386-393`). Nothing re-stamps as the unit moves.

Distinct from closed hq-h0f5h (activation) and hq-erh3x (radius uses ShroudClearingRange on the ping). Those wired the snapshot ping, not the moving-looker contract leftover already has.

## Evidence
C++ `Object.cpp:4961-4962`, `:5227-5253`. Leftover `object_vision.rs:169-197`. Live `spawn_templates.rs:4295-4310` + `angry_mob_aurora.rs:131-136, 386-393`.

## Player-visible
CIA Intelligence / Satellite Hack reveal stays at the old position. Terrain the spied unit drives into stays fogged until the next interval ping. In retail the spy sees through the unit's eyes wherever it moves for the duration.
close_reason: update_main_crate_vision ORs vision_spied_mask into looking_mask (Object::look). Spy bits restamp on move via restamp_host_partition_look.

title: [Shroud] Under-construction look uses full ShroudClearingRange not getter clamp
description:
## C++
`Object::look` (`Object.cpp:4938`) calls `getShroudClearingRange()`. That getter (`Object.cpp:5128-5140`) returns `getGeometryInfo().getBoundingCircleRadius()` while `OBJECT_STATUS_UNDER_CONSTRUCTION` so a foundation only sees itself until complete. Completing construction clears the bit and the next look uses the stored ShroudClearingRange.

## Leftover (right)
`Object::get_shroud_clearing_range` (`GameLogic/src/object/vision.rs:12-18`) ports the getter: UnderConstruction → bounding-circle radius, else stored range. Leftover `look()` (`object_vision.rs:169`) consumes that getter. Closed hq-hjbf was leftover-crate only.

## Live (wrong)
`update_main_crate_vision` (`world_objects/spawn_templates.rs:4239-4246`) uses raw `obj.shroud_clearing_range` / template `resolved_shroud_clearing_range()` with no UnderConstruction clamp. Comment cites `Object::look` having no UC branch (`:4938-4966`) — true for look() itself; the clamp lives in the getter. `under_construction` only gates the separate ShroudRevealToAll look (`:4327`).

hq-9x27c closed by removing an invented `selection_radius` clamp and citing the same look() misread; leftover getter was never wired. Distinct from hq-hjbf (leftover crate) and hq-9x27c (wrong C++ cite).

## Evidence
C++ `Object.cpp:4938` + `:5128-5140`. Leftover `vision.rs:12-18`. Live `spawn_templates.rs:4239-4246`.

## Player-visible
Every placed structure reveals at full ShroudClearingRange during construction instead of only its footprint. Owner/allies see more map than retail while the building is going up.
close_reason: Live Object::get_shroud_clearing_range matches C++ getter: UNDER_CONSTRUCTION returns bounding-circle radius. update_main_crate_vision uses that getter instead of raw ShroudClearingRange.

title: [HUD] Queue cancel always CancelUnitProduction — upgrades untyped
description:
C++ path + behavior: populateBuildQueue (ControlBarCommand.cpp:~599-700) types each slot from ProductionUpdate: PRODUCTION_UNIT binds Command_CancelUnitCreate and stores production->getProductionID(); PRODUCTION_UPGRADE binds Command_CancelUpgradeCreate and cancels by upgrade name key. processCommandUI (ControlBarCommandProcessing.cpp:425-479 / 560-605) emits MSG_CANCEL_UNIT_CREATE vs MSG_CANCEL_UPGRADE.

Leftover path + behavior: leftover update_context_command / populate_build_queue keep construction_queue entries typed from the producer's production entries (unit vs upgrade). Cancel binds the matching command.

Live path + behavior: GameHUD ConstructionPanel.building_queue is a flat list of template names. handle_mouse_click (hud.rs:959-985) always emits CancelUnitProduction { template_name, production_id, queue_index }. add_to_queue (597-613) has no type field. Presentation upgrades live only in local_queued_upgrades and never appear as cancelable queue slots. A researching upgrade cannot be cancelled from the GameHUD queue the way C++ / leftover do.

Evidence: leftover-right typed unit-vs-upgrade cancel; live always unit-cancel. Distinct from closed hq-1wx0r (RMB last-match-by-template) and hq-30mpa (HUD locally ticks remaining_time).
close_reason: BuildQueueItem is typed is_upgrade from presentation production_queue; LMB emits CancelUpgradeProduction vs CancelUnitProduction; engine routes CancelUpgrade.

title: [HUD] Neutral garrison peek never binds Command_Stop
description:
C++ path + behavior: ControlBarStructureInventory.cpp:122-166 populateStructureInventory always binds Command_Stop at STOP_ID (slot 10) and Command_Evacuate at EVACUATE_ID (slot 11). Both unhide and enable when contain->getContainCount() != 0. Neutral garrisonable peek (ControlBar.cpp:1768-1773) uses this same inventory context, so occupied civilian buildings expose Stop + Evacuate + occupant exits.

Leftover path + behavior: append_structure_inventory_commands_with_presentation (control_bar_structure_inventory.rs:264-332) resolves Command_StructureExit + Command_Stop + Command_Evacuate and rebuilds slots 0-9 / 10 / 11. Stop and Evacuate enable when contained_count > 0.

Live path + behavior: populate_command_set_strip non-local branch (command_set_strip.rs:22-47) for Neutral && max_garrison > 0 pushes Command_StructureExit (always) and Command_Evacuate (if garrisoned_units non-empty) plus occupant overlay. Command_Stop is never added. An occupied neutral garrison cannot be ordered to Stop from the GameHUD strip.

Evidence: leftover-right inventory Stop; live peek omits it. Distinct from closed hq-21zua (portraits) and hq-kdksv (owned empty-CommandSet inventory missing entirely).
close_reason: Neutral garrison peek now calls populate_structure_inventory_strip (slots 0-9 StructureExit + Command_Stop at 10 + Command_Evacuate at 11).

title: [Particle] Main present draws leftover Z-up systems with Y-up view
description:
## C++
`W3DParticleSys.cpp:210-212` writes particle world pos as C++ Z-up `(x, y_ground, z_height)` into a Z-up W3D camera. `W3DDisplay::DoParticles` uses `TheTacticalView` (same Z-up convention). Tracers/rays are also Z-up drawables. One convention from emit through present.

## Leftover (right)
`ParticleSystemManager` stores C++ Z-up `Coord3D`. Live spawn already remaps host Y-up → leftover Z-up (`host_fx_list_dispatch.rs:33-35` `host_to_leftover_coord`, `combat_particles.rs:1319-1321` `host_local_to_cpp`; closed hq-lea2v / hq-9f985). Leftover `Display::build_particle_uniforms` (`display.rs:857-865`) builds `look_at_rh` with `up=+Z` from leftover `TheTacticalView` (also Z-up; live sync in `audio.rs:189-193` writes `(x, z_ground, y_height)`). Leftover TerrainVisual already remaps Y-up wgpu verts to Z-up before `doTheDynamicLight` (`impl_gpu.rs:2249-2260`). Visible-box cull on Main uses leftover View (Z-up) vs leftover particles (Z-up) and is consistent (`forward_render.rs:348-369`).

## Live (wrong)
Main present (`forward_render.rs:320-390`) submits leftover systems with the live Y-up `view_matrix` / `camera_position`. `particle_renderer.rs:467-473` writes leftover `(x, y_ground, z_height)` as GPU world position. Shader `particle_vertex.wgsl:72` does `view * world_pos` with no remap. Same callback submits leftover Z-up tracers/rays (`particle_renderer.rs:1490-1550`) through the same Y-up uniforms.

## Player-visible
Muzzle flashes, explosions, fire/smoke, tracers, and rays spawn at leftover `(x, groundY, height)` but draw in the live Y-up world as `(x, groundY, height)` — height and ground swapped. A tank at live `(100, 15, 200)` has leftover FX at `(100, 200, 15)` which draws ~200wu in the air at z=15.

Not hq-lea2v (spawn feed), not hq-9f985 (dispatch Coord3D), not hq-svz8p (cull now wired), not hq-y16zq (tracer submit now wired).
close_reason: Main present now submits leftover ParticleSystemManager / tracers / weather / decals with leftover TheTacticalView Z-up look_at_rh(up=+Z), matching C++ W3DDisplay::DoParticles.

title: [Save] ActiveBody crush flags and indestructible never persisted
description:
## C++
`ActiveBody::xfer` (`ActiveBody.cpp:1513-1573`) persists `m_frontCrushed`, `m_backCrushed`, `m_indestructible`, last-damage info/timestamps, and health. A car that is only front-crushed stays FRONTCRUSHED after load so the next crush hits the back; scripted `UNIT INDESTRUCTIBLE` stays invulnerable.

Lifecycle envelope `collect_module_states` has no crush/indestructible tag.

## Player-visible
Save after a tank front-crushes a car. After load FRONTCRUSHED is gone — the wreck looks intact and the next pass can crush the front again. Scripted indestructible props take damage after load.
close_reason: ActiveBody crush/indestructible + last-damage persist via TAG_ACTIVE_BODY lifecycle envelope

title: [Save] PhysicsBehavior stun and overlap-crush never persisted
description:
## C++
`PhysicsBehavior::xfer` v2 (`PhysicsUpdate.cpp` ~1830-1875) persists yaw/pitch/roll rates, accel/vel, `m_ignoreCollisionsWith`, flags (IS_STUNNED), mass, `m_currentOverlap` / `m_previousOverlap`, motive expiry, extra bounciness/friction. title: [Weapon] Live getAble rejects non-enclosing contained victims
description:
## C++
`WeaponSet::getAbleToAttackSpecificObject` (`GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Object/WeaponSet.cpp:545-550`) rejects a victim only when it is contained **and** the container `isEnclosingContainerFor(victim)`:

```
const Object* victimsContainer = victim->getContainedBy();
if (victimsContainer != NULL && victimsContainer->getContain()->isEnclosingContainerFor(victim) == TRUE)
    return ATTACKRESULT_NOT_POSSIBLE;
```

`OpenContain::isEnclosingContainerFor` defaults TRUE. Exceptions:
- `ParachuteContain` always FALSE (`ParachuteContain.h:45`)
- `OverlordContain` FALSE for the first passenger / portable bunker (`OverlordContain.cpp:470-479`)
- `HelixContain` FALSE for the portable structure
- `GarrisonContain` reads `IsEnclosingContainer` — America Fire Base is **No**

`Object::onContainedBy` (`Object.cpp:673-677`) sets `OBJECT_STATUS_MASKED` only when enclosing. Non-enclosing occupants stay unselectable but **targetable**. Fire Base crew standing at station bones can be auto-acquired and killed.

## Leftover
`GeneralsRust/Code/GameEngine/GameLogic/src/weapon/weapon_set_able.rs:314-318` matches C++: only `container_encloses(...)` (which calls `is_enclosing_container_for`) returns `NotPossible`.

Ports exist:
- `garrison_contain.rs:593-605` reads `IsEnclosingContainer` (default true)
- `parachute_contain.rs:1012-1013` returns false
- `overlord_contain.rs:596-599` first rider false
- `helix_contain.rs:549+` portable structure false

## Live
`GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/game_logic/world_tick/mood.rs:788-793` rejects **any** `contained_by`:

```
if victim.contained_by.is_some() {
    return CanAttackResult::NotPossible;
}
```

Live already models enclosing correctly for status:
- `orders.rs:1819-1832` `set_contained_by_enclosing` — MASKED only when enclosing; comment says Fire Base stays visible/targetable
- `support_states.rs:4486-4501` garrison enter uses `is_enclosing_garrison_container()` so Fire Base occupants are not MASKED
- `host_env_contain_residual.rs` `GARRISON_FIREBASE_IS_ENCLOSING = false`
- presentation draws Fire Base occupants (`presentation_frame/queries.rs` `firebase_occupant_should_draw`)

`getAble` never consults `is_enclosing_garrison_container`. MASKED already covers enclosing occupants, so the extra `contained_by.is_some()` gate only hits the C++-legal cases.

## Evidence
- Retail Fire Base crew is visible at station points and can be sniped/auto-acquired in ZH. Live mood/AI/auto-acquire call `get_able_to_attack_specific_object` and get `NotPossible`.
- Same gate also blocks Overlord/Helix portable structures and parachute riders (non-enclosing).
- Not a duplicate of closed `hq-3kmk` (leftover legality was missing, leftover now correct) or `hq-e6bkq` (source-contained InvalidShot / passenger fire, not victim enclose).
- Not leftovers-only: leftover is the C++ port; live host getAble is the running path.

## Player-visible effect
Fire Base infantry cannot be individually targeted or auto-acquired. Only the building takes fire. C++ lets weapons pick off the exposed crew.
close_reason: Live getAble now rejects contained victims only when container.is_enclosing_container_for(victim) (C++ WeaponSet.cpp:545-550). Fire Base crew and other non-enclosing occupants stay targetable.

title: [AIGroup] Group-path thresholds ignore AIData MinDistance/DistanceRequiresGroup
description:
C++: AIGroup.cpp:522-580 friend_computeGroundPath uses TheAI->getAiData()->m_minDistanceForGroup and m_distanceRequiresGroup (AI.cpp parse; ctor defaults 100 / 0.0; retail AIData.ini residual 100 / 500). Short clicks below min skip group/column path; far clicks force it.

title: [Victory] Live hasAnyObjects census never skips KINDOF_INERT
description:
## C++
Team::hasAnyObjects (Team.cpp:1751-1773) skips KINDOF_PROJECTILE, KINDOF_INERT (radiation fields are living so ambulances can attack them), and KINDOF_MINE. VictoryConditions::hasSinglePlayerBeenDefeated uses !player->hasAnyObjects() when both VICTORY_NOUNITS|VICTORY_NOBUILDINGS are set (VictoryConditions.cpp:258-263).

## Leftover
Player::has_any_objects (GameLogic/src/player/objects.rs:16-20) and Team::has_any_objects (Common/src/common/rts/team.rs:1330-1343) skip Projectile, Inert, and Mine. Matches C++.

## Live
counts_as_any_object (Main/src/game_logic/victory_conditions.rs:212-215) only skips Projectile and Mine. The comment admits "and inert, not hosted". is_defeated uses this census when both flags are set. Live VictoryType::default() and victory_rules_for_map default are both flags; configure_victory_rules_for_map applies that for every non-skirmish mode (world_tick/presence.rs:168-172). Radiation fields / other INERT objects keep a player from being eliminated on annihilation.

## Evidence
Live comment at victory_conditions.rs:212. Leftover objects.rs:17 KindOf::Inert. C++ Team.cpp:1765-1768. Not a duplicate of closed hq-comb6 / hq-tmjnd / hq-gs3t0.
close_reason: Live counts_as_any_object skips KINDOF_INERT in addition to projectile and mine (C++ Team::hasAnyObjects).

title: [Contain] Live evac never markAllPassengersDetected so stealth stays cloaked
description:
## C++
`AIUpdateInterface::aiEvacuate` / instant (`AIUpdate.cpp:3882, 3904`) calls `contain->markAllPassengersDetected()` immediately before `orderAllPassengersToExit`. `OpenContain::markAllPassengersDetected` (`OpenContain.cpp:1322-1343`) walks occupants and `stealth->markAsDetected()` on `KINDOF_STEALTH_GARRISON` (Ninja / stealth-garrison infantry).

## Leftover
`modules/contain.rs` `order_all_passengers_to_exit` (`:314-325`) calls `mark_all_passengers_detected` first. That helper (`:289-311`) matches C++ (STEALTH_GARRISON + `mark_as_detected`). Closed leftover-only `hq-4hckp` was this crate; leftover is now right.

## Live
`execute_evacuate` (`command_executor/transport.rs:574-638`) fans into `execute_exit`. `execute_exit` (`:230-559`) `unit_command_remove_occupant` + burst/ExitStart walk. No `mark_all_passengers_detected` / `mark_detected` / `set_status_detected`. Capture kick (`support_states.rs:2166-2192`) and onCollide kick (`:2112-2160`, `drones_and_garrison.rs:1389-1443`) do detect; player Evac does not.

## Player-visible
Evacuate a stealth-garrisoned civilian (Ninja) and the occupant walks out still cloaked. Retail reveals them on Evac. Not `hq-4hckp` (leftover-only, now fixed) / `hq-tr4w2` (enemy enter kick) / `hq-eulmf` (transport exposeStealthUnits).
close_reason: Live execute_exit dump-all and evacuate_container_now call mark_all_passengers_detected (STEALTH_GARRISON mark_detected) before occupants walk out, matching C++ privateEvacuate + leftover order_all_passengers_to_exit.

title: [Garrison] FIREPOINT occupancy never released so occupants hog windows
description:
## C++
`GarrisonContain::matchObjectsToGarrisonPoints` (`GarrisonContain.cpp:953-975`) runs every frame for enclosing garrisons:
- `removeInvalidObjectsFromGarrisonPoints` (`:564-607`) frees a FIREPOINT when the occupant is not `OBJECT_STATUS_IS_ATTACKING` or the current weapon is out of range.
- `addValidObjectsToGarrisonPoints` (`:613-650`) assigns the closest free window to occupants that have a victim.
- `trackTargets` (`:658-752`) if another free window is closer: `removeObjectFromGarrisonPoint` then `putObjectAtGarrisonPoint`.

## Leftover
`garrison_contain.rs` `match_objects_to_garrison_points` (`:2115-2120`) ports all three. `remove_invalid_objects_from_garrison_points` (`:1958-2006`) and `track_targets` (`:2009-2112`) free the old slot before taking a new one.

## Live
`try_garrison_residual_fire` (`drones_and_garrison.rs:991-998`) writes `garrison_point_occupant[point_index] = Some(garrisoned_id)` with no `free_garrison_point_for` of the occupant's previous slot. There is no per-frame `removeInvalid` / `trackTargets` reshuffle. `free_garrison_point_for` only runs on exit/death (`hq-av9eh`).

## Player-visible
A full bunker hog-ties windows: after the fight walks around the building, one occupant occupies several FIREPOINTs and later occupants fire from worse/center windows. Not `hq-av9eh` (exit/death free) / `hq-b6j31` (8-point ring vs bones) / `hq-csl6v` (gun aim).
close_reason: Live try_garrison_residual_fire frees the occupant's previous FIREPOINT before assigning a closer window and frees the slot when no in-range victim (C++ removeInvalid + trackTargets).

title: [Garrison] HealObjects occupants get a double sliver every frame
description:
## C++
`GarrisonContain::update` (`GarrisonContain.cpp:931`) calls `healObjects()` only when INI `HealObjects` (`m_doIHealObjects`). `healSingleObject` (`:1101-1161`) applies one sliver `maxHealth / framesForFullHeal` per frame (`DAMAGE_HEALING`), then snaps to max after `TimeForFullHeal` frames inside. No second heal pass.

## Leftover
`garrison_contain.rs` `update` (`:479-485`) gates on `do_heal_objects`, then one `heal_objects` / `garrison_heal_single_amount` (`:97-110`). Matches C++.

## Live
`tick_heal_contain_and_tunnel` (`support_states.rs`) has two independent Garrison loops:
1. `:7055-7092` — any Garrison with `frames_for_full_heal: Some(_)` (no `heal_objects` check) applies `tunnel_tracker_heal_amount` + `unit.heal`.
2. `:7139-7182` — Garrison with `heal_objects` applies `garrison_heal_single_amount` + `unit.heal`.

Retail HealObjects bunkers author both `HealObjects=Yes` and `TimeForFullHeal` (`spawn_templates.rs:1449-1484` parses both). They hit both loops every frame.

## Player-visible
Infantry inside a HealObjects garrison (TimeForFullHeal 2000ms → 60f) recover at 2× retail sliver and snap early. Closed `hq-vdeep` added the HealObjects pass; the unguarded TimeForFullHeal pass was left in. Not HealContain (`hq-ini85` / `hq-l2i03`).
close_reason: Live tick_heal_contain_and_tunnel TimeForFullHeal garrison loop skips heal_objects so HealObjects bunkers only apply garrison_heal_single_amount once per frame.

title: [HUD] GameHUD apply drops CommandSet holes, portraits, and clocks
description:
C++ path + behavior: populateCommand binds 14 WND slots in place (empty/SCRIPT_ONLY stay hidden holes so later buttons keep their slot). doTransportInventoryUI paints occupant ButtonImage + veterancy overlay onto EXIT slots. getCommandAvailability NotReady sets WIN_STATUS_NOT_READY inverse clock; Active+CHECK_LIKE depresses the gadget.

Leftover path + behavior: command_set_strip.rs:74-86 keeps None holes as empty UnitCommandButton. overlay_command_set_occupants (342-371) writes exit_object_id / button_image / overlay_image. leftover_evaluate_named_command returns Hidden/Restricted/NotReady/CantAfford/Active/Available.

Live path + behavior: apply_to_game_hud (apply.rs:574-579) maps unit_command_buttons to Vec<(String, bool)> — discarding images, exit ids, and availability enum. GameHUD::apply_presentation_unit_commands (hud.rs:758-781) then skips empty names (if name.is_empty() { continue }), so holes collapse and later commands shift left onto the wrong 48px slots. Occupant portraits never reach GameHUD. NotReady/Active look identical to Restricted/Available (enabled bool only). UnitCommandPanel.apply_commands keeps the full struct; GameHUD is the clickable strip.

Evidence: leftover/strip already preserve holes+portraits+availability; GameHUD apply throws them away. Distinct from closed hq-eddnz (strip-level flatten, now fixed in command_set_strip) and hq-21zua (overlay missing on strip).
close_reason: apply_to_game_hud passes full UnitCommandButton; apply_presentation_unit_commands keeps empty-name holes, occupant portraits, exit ids, and NotReady/Active clocks.

title: [HUD] GameHUD locally ticks production queue off ProductionUpdate
description:
C++ path + behavior: ControlBar queue clocks and cancel IDs come from ProductionUpdate (ControlBarCommand.cpp updateContextCommand / ControlBarCommandProcessing.cpp:448-479). The HUD never advances remaining time; completion is a logic event. There is no InGameUI toast for queue complete.

Leftover path + behavior: leftover ControlBar reads production queue residual from apply_to_control_bar (apply.rs:1167-1181) / ProductionUpdate. It does not decrement remaining_time from render dt.

Live path + behavior: apply_to_game_hud syncs queue from presentation (apply.rs:533-559 → hud.rs:809-829). Then GameHUD::update (hud.rs:891-910) calls construction_panel.update_queue(delta_time) which decrements remaining_time, pops the head when it hits 0, and invents \"{name} construction complete\". Cameo click also add_to_queue(..., 5.0) (hud.rs:1025-1026) with a hardcoded 5s build time. Queue can visually complete and toast before ProductionUpdate finishes, and production_id is assigned as queue index (hud.rs:823).

Evidence: leftover-right ProductionUpdate-owned queue; live GameHUD double-ticks and invents complete text. Distinct from closed hq-1wx0r (RMB cancel by template name).
close_reason: GameHUD no longer ticks production remaining_time from render dt or invents queue-complete toasts.

title: [HUD] OCL timer selection still shows CommandSet strip
description:
C++ path + behavior: ControlBar.cpp:1830-1871 evaluateContextUI. After UNDER_CONSTRUCTION, if the selected object has an OCLUpdate module, switchToContext(CB_CONTEXT_OCL_TIMER). That replaces the 14 ButtonCommand slots with OCLTimerWindow (ControlBarOCLTimer.cpp:55-111): countdown text/progress plus Sell (non-tech) or SetRallyPoint (TECH+AUTO_RALLYPOINT). A supply drop zone with a CommandSet still shows the timer, not the command set.

Leftover path + behavior: evaluate_context_ui (impl_lifecycle.rs:766-768) sets ControlBarState::OclTimer when presentation_ocl_timer_seconds > 0. update_context_ocl_timer (impl_contexts.rs:483-544) + apply_ocl_timer_windows write OCLTimerWindow. ocl_timer_button_kind matches C++ sell/rally/hide.

Live path + behavior: PresentationFrame stamps ocl_timer_seconds (build.rs:818-827) and apply_to_control_bar syncs leftover (apply.rs:1214-1218), but the player-facing GameHUD strip is populate_command_set_strip (command_set_strip.rs:12-107). It never reads ocl_timer_seconds. If the object has a CommandSet it binds slots 1-14; the countdown window never replaces the strip.

Evidence: leftover-right leftover OCL context; live GameHUD still shows CommandSet. Distinct from closed hq-jzdty/hq-4fr21/hq-bxi3t (leftover never revealed OCLTimerWindow — leftover now does).
close_reason: Live GameHUD strip: ocl_timer_seconds > 0 after UC replaces CommandSet with OCLTimer (countdown + Sell/Rally).

title: [HUD] GameHUD ConstructionPanel invents tabbed cameo grid
description:
C++ path + behavior: ControlBar::populateCommand (ControlBarCommand.cpp:246-323) binds CommandSet.ini slots 1-14 onto ButtonCommand01-14. Empty/SCRIPT_ONLY stay holes. There is no Buildings/Units/Upgrades tab strip and no second cameo grid.

That panel sits beside the command_buttons strip, so a barracks shows both the 14-slot CommandSet and an invented tabbed cameo UI. Structure tab click arms placement; unit tab click add_to_queue with invented 5s time.

Evidence: leftover-right 14-slot CommandSet only; live GameHUD invents a second tabbed construction UI. Distinct from closed hq-4bmpx (faction-heuristic cameos — now CommandSet-sourced, still tabbed/grid).

title: [HUD] Empty-CommandSet garrison never builds StructureInventory
description:
C++ path + behavior: ControlBar.cpp:1850-1865. If contain is garrisonable AND getCommandSetString() is empty, switchToContext(CB_CONTEXT_STRUCTURE_INVENTORY). populateStructureInventory rebuilds slots 0-9 as Command_StructureExit occupant portraits plus Stop (10) / Evacuate (11). Civilian bunkers and many garrisonable buildings use this path, not a CommandSet of EXIT buttons.

Leftover path + behavior: evaluate_context_ui (impl_lifecycle.rs:769-772) sets StructureInventory when presentation_max_garrison > 0 and presentation_primary_command_set is empty. append_structure_inventory_commands_with_presentation (control_bar_structure_inventory.rs:203-351) clears the command set and rebuilds 10 exit slots + Stop + Evacuate from presentation occupants / max_garrison.

Live path + behavior: populate_command_set_strip (command_set_strip.rs:66-72). command_set_slots_for empty → slots.is_empty() → return Vec::new(). overlay_command_set_occupants only paints existing EXIT slots, so a garrisonable object with no CommandSet shows a blank strip. Neutral peek invents StructureExit/Evacuate (lines 33-47); owned empty-CommandSet garrisons do not.

Evidence: leftover-right StructureInventory rebuild; live GameHUD empty. Distinct from closed hq-21zua (portraits on CommandSet EXIT overlay).
close_reason: Empty-CommandSet garrison rebuilds StructureInventory (10 StructureExit + Stop/Evacuate) on the live strip.

title: [HUD] leftover_availability_bar never stamps dock_open
description:
C++ path + behavior: ControlBarCommand.cpp:1488-1503 GUI_COMMAND_EXECUTE_RAILED_TRANSPORT is Available only when the object's DockUpdate is open (ferry not in transit). Closed dock → COMMAND_RESTRICTED.

Leftover path + behavior: leftover_presentation_stop_or_rail (impl_presentation_availability.rs:138-143) returns Available iff residual.dock_open, else Restricted. PresentationRestrictA::from_logic (restrict_a.rs:47-57) already computes dock_open = is_railed_transport && !railed_in_transit. leftover_evaluate_named_command will honor that residual when INI resolves ExecuteRailedTransport.

Live path + behavior: populate_command_set_strip leftover_availability_bar (command_set_strip.rs:185-226) builds PresentationAvailabilityResidual with ..Default::default() and never sets dock_open. apply_to_control_bar (apply.rs:1236-1272) also leaves dock_open at default false. stamp_host_restrict_a_availability and apply_host_restrict_a_command_strip exist in restrict_a.rs:68-97 but have zero callsites. Result: leftover always sees dock_open=false and Restricts ExecuteRailedTransport even when the ferry is docked.

Evidence: leftover-right dock_open check; live never stamps it. Distinct from closed hq-06z4z (leftover never restricted) and hq-5p2o9 (command execution InvalidCommand).
close_reason: leftover_availability_bar and apply_to_control_bar now call stamp_host_restrict_a_availability so leftover leftover_presentation_stop_or_rail sees dock_open. apply_leftover also applies apply_host_restrict_a_command_strip.

title: [ScriptAct] SKIRMISH_BUILD_BASE_DEFENSE leftover AIPlayer only
description:
## C++
`doBuildBaseDefense` / `doBuildBaseStructure` (`ScriptActions.cpp:1118-1136`) call `TheScriptEngine->getCurrentPlayer()->buildBaseDefense(flank)` / `buildBaseDefenseStructure(type, flank)` so the skirmish AI queues perimeter Patriots/Gattlings.

## Leftover (right)
`do_skirmish_build_base_defense_front/flank` and `do_skirmish_build_structure_front/flank` (`actions_skirmish.rs:138-189`) call leftover `AIPlayer::build_base_defense` / `build_base_defense_structure`. No `request_host_*` (unlike `SKIRMISH_BUILD_BUILDING` which queues `request_host_skirmish_build_building`).

Leftover AIPlayer is not the live host AI. Live `ai_skirmish.rs` `build_base_defense_structure` is never invoked from the script drain. `scripts_camera.rs` only drains `take_host_skirmish_build_requests` (building type), not defense front/flank.
