close_reason: SKIRMISH_BUILD_BASE_DEFENSE/STRUCTURE front/flank queue request_host; live AIPlayer build_script_base_defense places Patriots/Gattlings/Stingers on the scripted perimeter.

title: [ScriptAct] OBJECT_ALLOW_BONUSES leftover ScriptEngine unused by live XP/HP
description:
## C++
`doEnableOrDisableObjectDifficultyBonuses` (`ScriptActions.cpp:6339-6349`) walks every live Object `setReceivingDifficultyBonus`, then `TheScriptEngine->setObjectsShouldReceiveDifficultyBonus`. New objects consult that flag in `friend_applyDifficultyBonusesForObject`.

## Leftover (right)
`do_object_allow_bonuses` (`actions_attack_priority.rs:171-180`) → leftover `ScriptEngine::set_objects_should_receive_difficulty_bonus` (`named_trackers.rs:612-634`) walks leftover `OBJECT_REGISTRY` then stores the flag. Leftover `Object::init` reads the flag.

## Live (wrong)
Leftover registry walk is empty. Live `apply_difficulty_bonuses_for_object` (`create_destroy_die.rs:3843-3894`) always applies solo HP/weapon bonuses in SinglePlayer and never reads leftover `get_objects_should_receive_difficulty_bonus`. No host drain to strip existing bonuses.

## Player-visible
Campaign scripts that turn difficulty bonuses off (OBJECT_ALLOW_BONUSES false) leave Easy/Hard HP and weapon multipliers on every unit.
close_reason: OBJECT_ALLOW_BONUSES leftover flag now gates live apply_difficulty_bonuses_for_object; host tick strips/applies existing objects when the script flag changes.

title: [ScriptAct] CHOOSE_VICTIM_ALWAYS_USES_NORMAL leftover ScriptEngine unused by live acquire
description:
## C++
`doChooseVictimAlwaysUsesNormal` sets `TheScriptEngine->setChooseVictimAlwaysUsesNormal`. AI victim selection then forces `DIFFICULTY_NORMAL` so Easy/Hard AI pick the same target.

## Leftover (right)
`do_choose_victim_always_uses_normal` (`actions_attack_priority.rs:224-233`) writes leftover `ScriptEngine::set_choose_victim_always_uses_normal`. Leftover `ai/states/attack.rs:1513-1517` consults `get_choose_victim_always_uses_normal()`. Unused by the host tick.

## Live (wrong)
Live mood/acquire (`world_tick/mood.rs` / `find_closest_enemy`) never reads leftover `get_choose_victim_always_uses_normal()`. No host drain.

## Player-visible
Campaign scripts that force Normal victim choice on Easy/Hard AI are ignored — AI still prefers Easy/Hard targeting.
close_reason: CHOOSE_VICTIM_ALWAYS_USES_NORMAL leftover ScriptEngine flag forces live find_closest_enemy to closest/Normal so Easy/Hard AI pick the same target.

title: [ScriptAct] SCRIPTING_OVERRIDE_HULK_LIFETIME writes leftover atomic live hulks ignore
description:
## C++
`doScriptingHulkMaxLifetimeOverride` writes `TheGameLogic->setHulkMaxLifetimeOverride`. `LifetimeUpdate` ctor (`LifetimeUpdate.cpp:31-37`) replaces Min/Max with that frame count when != -1 so scripted hulks expire on cue.

## Leftover (right)
`do_scripting_override_hulk_lifetime` (`actions_attack_priority.rs:236-243`) calls leftover `TheGameLogic::set_hulk_max_lifetime_override` (`helpers/game_logic.rs:693-694`) — a leftover crate AtomicI32.

## Live (wrong)
Host hulks use a *second* atomic in `host_lifetime_update.rs:62-75` (`effective_lifetime_msec_range`). Script action never writes that store. Live hulks keep authored Min/Max (or never expire).

## Player-visible
Campaign scripts that force wreck hulks to vanish immediately (or linger) have no effect — hulks keep the INI lifetime.
close_reason: SCRIPTING_OVERRIDE_HULK_LIFETIME converts seconds to frames like C++; live effective_lifetime_msec_range reads leftover TheGameLogic atomic so host hulks expire on cue.

title: [ScriptAct] SKIRMISH_FOLLOW/MOVE_TO_APPROACH_PATH leftover TeamFactory empty
description:
## C++
`doTeamFollowSkirmishApproachPath` / `doTeamMoveToSkirmishApproachPath` (`ScriptActions.cpp:1656-1762`) take the live Team as an AIGroup, compute member center, append enemy `mpStartIndex+1` to the path label, `getClosestWaypointOnPath`, then `groupFollowWaypointPath(AsTeam)` / `groupMoveToPosition` with `CMD_FROM_SCRIPT`.

## Leftover (right)
`do_skirmish_follow_approach_path` / `do_skirmish_move_to_approach_path` (`actions_skirmish.rs:29-135`) match: leftover `get_team_by_name` → center → leftover enemy mp index → leftover TerrainLogic waypoint → leftover AIGroup command. No `request_host_*`.

## Live (wrong)
Leftover TeamFactory member lists are empty on the host path (`compute_team_center_and_first` returns None). Live `scripts_camera.rs` has no approach-path drain (follow-waypoints drain is a different action and needs an explicit path label, not `label+mpIndex`).

## Player-visible
Skirmish AI scripts that send a team down ApproachPath1/2 never move. Opening attacks stay idle at the start.
close_reason: SKIRMISH_FOLLOW/MOVE_TO_APPROACH_PATH queue request_host when leftover TeamFactory is empty; live drain appends enemy mpStartIndex+1 and follows/moves the host team.

title: [Locomotor] Blocked units still march instead of locoUpdate scrub
description:
## C++
After doLocomotor `bumpSpeedLimit` / blocked bookkeeping, `locoUpdate_moveTowardsPosition` (`Locomotor.cpp:1016-1040`) still owns the blocked frame: if `*blocked` (and not faster-than-desired / airborne-air), `scrubVelocity2D(desiredSpeed)`, `rotateObjAroundLocoPivot` when `wanderWidth==0`, `handleBehaviorZ`, **return** — no appearance 2D motive.

## Leftover
`loco_update_move_towards_position` (`move_dispatch.rs:94-137`) matches: may clear blocked if `desiredSpeed > |v|` or AIR surface, else `scrub_velocity_2d`, rotate, `handle_behavior_z_for`, return.

## Live
`update_movement` (`world_tick/movement.rs:386-506`) runs `tick_do_locomotor_blocked_frames` + `apply_do_locomotor_blocked_speed` (hq-89bqp) then continues the full appearance march (turn + accel + `pos += v*dt`). There is no blocked early-return / `scrubVelocity2D` + rotate-only path.

## Evidence
A tank blocked by a stopped unit still walks into it at the capped bump speed. C++/leftover stop applying motive and only rotate/scrub. hq-89bqp closed the missing speed cap, not this locoUpdate early-return.
close_reason: Live update_movement: blocked locoUpdate scrubs 2D motive, rotate+handleZ only (Locomotor.cpp:1016-1040).

title: [Locomotor] Live march never runs fixInvalidPosition 3x3 shove
description:
## C++
`locoUpdate_moveTowardsPosition` (`Locomotor.cpp:968-977`) on non-air locos: if `!validMovementTerrain` and `!ALLOW_INVALID_POSITION`, call `fixInvalidPosition` and return. `fixInvalidPosition` (`Locomotor.cpp:1500-1562`) exempts `KINDOF_DOZER`, 3×3-votes `validMovementTerrain` at ±cell, applies `mass/5` correction plus extra push when velocity-dot < 0, skips if already leaving (dot > 0.25).

## Leftover
`loco_update_move_towards_position` (`move_dispatch.rs:40-67`) matches that gate and calls `fix_invalid_position_with` (`maintain.rs:360-430`) — dozer exempt, 3×3 vote, dot skip, extra push. hq-pyfat closed leftover on this path.

## Live
Host tick `GameLogic::update_movement` never calls `Object::fix_invalid_position`. The residual on `object/physics.rs:1253-1285` is a velocity-opposite heuristic (no 3×3 vote) and is only invoked from unused `Object::update.rs:219-221`. `on_invalid_movement_terrain` is a log/writeback residual, not queried from the live pathfinder each march frame.

## Evidence
Units that clip a building/cliff/water cell stay stuck. C++/leftover shove them back onto legal terrain the same frame.
close_reason: Live march runs fixInvalidPosition 3x3 vote shove on invalid non-air terrain (Locomotor.cpp:968-977, 1500-1562).

title: [Locomotor] Live march ignores stamped CloseEnoughDist
description:
## C++
`AIInternalMoveToState::update` (`AIStates.cpp:1885-1916`) plants when `getLocomotorDistanceToGoal() < getCurLocomotor()->getCloseEnoughDist()`. Default is 1.0 (`Locomotor.cpp:321`); INI `CloseEnoughDist`, `Locomotor::setCloseEnoughDist`, script `SET_STOPPING_DISTANCE` / `NAMED_SET_STOPPING_DISTANCE` (`ScriptActions.cpp:3865-3899`), and `ParachuteContain` opening (`ParachuteContain.cpp:385` → 10.0) all change that band. Ground sanity refuses to finish if 2D to last node > `4*PATHFIND_CELL_SIZE`.

## Leftover
`Locomotor` stores `close_enough_dist` from the template (`core_impl/locomotor.rs:105`). `AIInternalMoveToState::update` (`ai_internal_move_to_state.rs:260-267`) and `path_following.rs:242-257` use `get_close_enough_dist()` plus the 40wu sanity. Script drain queues `HostScriptStoppingDistanceRequest`; leftover parachute sets 10.0 (`parachute_contain.rs:827`).

## Live
`scripts_camera.rs:1115-1134` correctly stamps `obj.close_enough_dist` (hq-y4d80). Host tick `GameLogic::update_movement` (`world_tick/movement.rs:419`, `:738`) still plants at hardcoded `horiz < 1.0` / `dist < 1.0` and never reads `close_enough_dist`. `HostLocomotorBinding` (`locomotor_bootstrap.rs:240-274`) has no CloseEnoughDist field. The hq-y4d80 "arrives at that band" path is unused `Object::update.rs:407-410`, not the host tick.

## Evidence
Campaign `SET_STOPPING_DISTANCE 25` and opened parachutes (10wu) still walk to 1wu. hq-n8rwt only fixed the old 5.0/2.0 hop to the 1.0 default. hq-y4d80 wired the unused leftover `Object::update_movement`.
close_reason: Host tick plants at stamped CloseEnoughDist (default 1.0) with 4*cell ground sanity; INI binding + parachute 10.0.

title: [ScriptAct] NAMED_SET_TOPPLE_DIRECTION unused by live host topple
description:
## C++
`doSetToppleDirection` (`ScriptActions.cpp:5128-5130`) writes `TheScriptEngine->setToppleDirection`. `StructureToppleUpdate` / `ToppleUpdate` call `adjustToppleDirection` so the named building/tree falls along the scripted vector instead of away-from-attacker.

## Leftover (right)
`do_named_set_topple_direction` (`actions_named.rs:1460-1471`) writes leftover `ScriptEngine::set_topple_direction`. Leftover `structure_topple_update.rs:739-744` and `topple_update.rs:443-446` call `adjust_topple_direction`. Unused by the host tick.

## Live (wrong)

title: [Cam] CAMERA_RESET/MMB never restores FXPitch to 1.0
description:
## C++
`W3DView::setAngleAndPitchToDefault` (`W3DView.cpp:1877-1885`) calls `View::setAngleAndPitchToDefault` then `m_FXPitch = 1.0` and rebuilds the transform. LookAt MMB short-click (`LookAtXlat.cpp:250-254`) uses that plus `setZoomToDefault`.

`InGameUI::resetCamera` (`InGameUI.cpp:4139-4143`) keeps the current look-at and calls `TheTacticalView->resetCamera(&pos, 1, 0, 0)`. `W3DView::resetCamera` drives the FXPitch endpoint to `1.0f`. CommandMap `CAMERA_RESET` (KP5) goes through CommandXlat → this path.

After a script `CAMERA_PITCH`, home/MMB restore the default look-target multiplier.

## Leftover (right)
`View::reset_camera` (`GameClient/src/display/view.rs:2323-2366`) sets `fx_pitch = 1.0` on the instant path and `CameraPitchTransition::new_fx(1.0, …)` on the animated path. Matches C++ `resetCamera` / `pitchCamera(1.0f)`.

## Live (wrong)
`mouse.rs:3845-3868` `reset_camera_pose_in_place` is the live KP5 (`hotkeys.rs:1662`) and MMB-click (`mouse.rs:3838`) helper. It restores yaw, orbit pitch, and default zoom. It never writes `camera_fx_pitch = 1.0` or starts an FXPitch ease. `camera_fx_pitch` is only assigned from script pitch (`start_game.rs` / `update_camera` pitch target) and new-game boot.

## Player-visible
Campaign `CAMERA_PITCH` leaves the look-target squashed/pulled (`FXPitch != 1`). KP5 or MMB-click snaps heading/height home but the cinematic pitch multiplier stays, so the view does not return to the default look.

## Evidence
- C++ W3DView.cpp:1877-1885, 250-254 LookAtXlat.cpp, InGameUI.cpp:4139-4143
- leftover view.rs:2323-2366 reset_camera
- live mouse.rs:3838-3868 reset_camera_pose_in_place
- live hotkeys.rs:1662 reset_camera_view_hotkey
close_reason: Live reset_camera_pose_in_place (KP5 CAMERA_RESET + MMB short-click) now sets camera_fx_pitch = 1.0 before apply_camera_orbit_transform, matching C++ W3DView::setAngleAndPitchToDefault / resetCamera.

title: [Pathfind] Live optimize skips leftover ALLOWED_STEPS=3 on bridge layers
description:
## C++
`Path::optimize` (`AIPathfind.cpp:450-573`) walks farthest-to-nearest LOS. When the path changes layers (ground ↔ bridge deck / wall), it only looks `ALLOWED_STEPS = 3` cells past the transition (`:472-485`). Same cap in `optimizeGroundPath` (`:595-608`). `isLinePassable` is called on the **anchor node's layer** (`:501-502`), so deck shortcuts stay on the deck and ramp entry/exit cells are kept.

## Leftover (right)
`PathOptimizer::optimize` (`path_optimization.rs:25-101`) stores `allowed_bridge_steps: 3` (`:13, :19`) and breaks the farthest-node scan when `count > allowed_bridge_steps` on a layer change (`:53-62`). `pathfind_complete::optimize_path` (`line_passable.rs:15-65`) feeds per-waypoint layers into that optimizer, then `optimize_ground_path` jig-jog. `find_path_internal` (`find_path.rs:365-367`) calls it after `buildActualPath`.

## Live (wrong)
`PathfindingGrid::optimize_ground_path_ex` (`pathfinding.rs:3996-4051`) is XZ-only: no layers, no `ALLOWED_STEPS`. It shortcuts as far as layer-blind `line_passable_ex` (`:3935-3984`) allows, then drops short jigs. `find_path_via_crate` (`:5212-5219`) always runs this host optimizer — leftover `PathOptimizer` is never used.

## Evidence
C++ `AIPathfind.cpp:472-485, 595-608`. Leftover `path_optimization.rs:13-62`, `line_passable.rs:15-65`, `find_path.rs:365-367`. Live `pathfinding.rs:3996-4051, 5212-5219`. Closed hq-o1pc0 added *a* ground optimize; it never ported the 3-step layer cap. hq-csg1b / hq-5iup4 are collinear / occupancy, not this.

## Player-visible
Units crossing a bridge cut the ramp: they jump from far ground onto mid-deck (or skip the exit ramp) instead of keeping the 3-cell approach C++ inserts.
close_reason: optimize_ground_path_ex ALLOWED_STEPS=3 on layer change; isLinePassable on anchor layer.

title: [Select] LMB click-vs-box uses Euclidean length not per-axis DragTolerance
description:
## C++
`SelectionXlat.cpp:399-400` starts area-select only when `|dx| > TheMouse->m_dragTolerance` **or** `|dy| > TheMouse->m_dragTolerance`.
`MetaEvent.cpp:601-606` collapses LMB up to a point click only when **both** axes are `< m_dragTolerance`.
`Mouse::isClick` (`Mouse.cpp:381-383`) is the same per-axis test (plus `DragToleranceMS`).
A 4×4 px diagonal twitch is still a point click (both axes ≤ 5).

## Leftover (right)
`GameClient/src/message_stream/selection_xlat.rs:716-722` `handle_mouse_position`:
`if (delta_x > DRAG_TOLERANCE || delta_y > DRAG_TOLERANCE)`.
`is_click` (`:694-696`) also tests each axis, not Euclidean length.
`DRAG_TOLERANCE = 5` matches Mouse.ini / leftover default.

## Live (wrong)
`cnc_game_engine/mouse.rs:1377-1383` computes `drag_distance_screen` as `Vec2::length()` (Euclidean).
`is_point_click_drag` (`:515-517`) treats `length <= DragTolerance` as a click.
A 4×4 px diagonal is `√32 ≈ 5.66 > 5` so LMB **release box-selects** instead of staying a point click / context command.
The host already has the C++-correct helper `host_screen_drag_is_click(dx, dy)` (`:429-431`, used for RMB) and even asserts `host_screen_drag_is_click(5.0, 5.0)` is a click — LMB never calls it.

## Evidence
- C++ `SelectionXlat.cpp:399-400`, `MetaEvent.cpp:602-603`
- Leftover `selection_xlat.rs:722`
- Live `mouse.rs:515-517`, `:1377-1383`, `:1465`
- Not a refile of closed `hq-kmgkv` (that was 2px vs 5px threshold).
close_reason: LMB click-vs-box uses per-axis host_screen_drag_is_click; 4x4 diagonal stays a point click.

title: [Shadow] Airborne blob discs float at unit altitude

title: [Particle] Combat-mirror FX feed leftover manager Y-up
description:
## C++
`Coord3D` is Z-up. Gravity is `+Z` downward (`ParticleSys.cpp:2144-2152`). Wind is XY (`:467-547`). `isEmitAboveGroundOnly` compares `info->m_pos.z` to `TheTerrainLogic->getGroundHeight` (`:1985`).

FXList live dispatch already swizzles via `host_to_leftover_coord` (`host_fx_list_dispatch.rs:32-35`). Attached spawn uses `host_local_to_cpp` (`combat_particles.rs:1388-1391`).

## Live (wrong)
Combat preset/exhaust/backfill mirror does not swizzle:
- `mirror_spawn_to_client_manager` (`combat_particles.rs:1529-1556`) `create_preset_system_xyz(template, position.x, position.y, position.z)` raw host Y-up.
- `mirror_update_client_system_position` (`:1513-1517`) writes `Coord3D::new(position.x, position.y, position.z)`.
Feeders: `spawn_with_template` (`:250-263`), projectile exhaust sync (`world_tick/step.rs:877-886`), presentation backfill (`presentation_frame/apply.rs:987-1032`).

## Player-visible
Muzzle/exhaust/preset combat FX sit in the leftover manager with height on ground-Y. Gravity accelerates along host ground-Z (sideways). Wind gains a vertical component. Ground-align / emit-above-ground gates evaluate nonsense. FXList-fed systems in the same manager are correctly Z-up.

## Not a duplicate
hq-9f985 closed the FXList `doFXPos` swizzle only. Combat-mirror spawn/update is the remaining unswizzled feed into the same leftover manager.
close_reason: Combat-mirror leftover manager feed swizzles host Y-up to Z-up via host_local_to_cpp in spawn and position update.

title: [Particle] Object-attached leftover systems keep emitting in fog
description:
## C++
`ParticleSystem::update` object-attach (`ParticleSys.cpp:1880-1905`):
`isShrouded = (objectAttachedTo->getShroudedStatus(localPlayerIndex) >= OBJECTSHROUD_FOGGED)`.
Burst emit is skipped while `m_isShrouded` (`:1970`). Particles already in the air still fade.

## Leftover (right)
`ParticleSystem::resolve_attached_parent` leftover-registry branch (`GameClient/src/effects/particle_system.rs:1821-1827`) sets `is_shrouded` from `get_shrouded_status >= Fogged`. `begin_frame_emit` (`:1512-1517`) gates emission on `!is_shrouded`.

## Live (wrong)
Production never fills leftover OBJECT_REGISTRY. Attached systems resolve via `host_fx_object_pose` first (`particle_system.rs:1813-1819`) then `apply_host_fx_object_pose` (`:1863-1868`), which copies transform only.
`HostFxObjectPose` (`GameLogic/src/helpers/particles.rs:63-70`) has no shroud field. Main `publish_host_fx_object_ex` (`host_fx_list_dispatch.rs:106-125`) publishes pos/transform/player/radius only. `ParticleSystem::set_shrouded` has zero live callers.

## Player-visible
Vehicle exhaust, ParticleSysBone jets/smoke, damaged-building FIRE/SMOKE, OCL-attached and beacon-smoke keep bursting while the parent is fogged or black-shrouded.

## Not a duplicate

title: [FX] Death FXListDie never passes the killer as secondary
description:
## C++
`FXListDie::onDie` calls `FXList::doFXObj(deathFX, obj, source)` with the damage dealer as secondary (`FXListDie.cpp` / `FXList.cpp:794-804`). Tracer, RayEffect, and `Ricochet=Yes` ParticleSystem nuggets need that secondary.

title: [FX] Armor DamageFX dispatches leftover FXList twice

title: [EVA] SuperweaponReady ignores leftover hidden-by-script/science gate
description:
C++ path + behavior:
InGameUI.cpp:3513 `if (info && !info->m_hiddenByScript && !info->m_hiddenByScience)` wraps the entire ready-EVA block (3546-3609). Per-timer m_hiddenByScript is set by hideObjectSuperweaponDisplayByScript (InGameUI.cpp:666). m_hiddenByScience is set at timer creation (InGameUI.cpp:559) and never clears — a superweapon finished before its required science never announces. The global m_superweaponHiddenByScript (3620) gates drawing only, not EVA.

Leftover path + behavior:
GameClient gui/ingame_ui/impl_update.rs:326-331 skips timers with hidden_by_script || hidden_by_science BEFORE announce_superweapon_ready (393-395, 441-511). That leftover announce matches C++ own/ally/enemy SideSounds via leftover Eva::set_should_play. Global superweapon_hidden_by_script skip at :400 is after announce (draw-only), matching C++.

Live path + behavior:
try_eva_superweapon_ready_for_source / try_eva_superweapon_ready_kind (production_eva.rs:1168-1202) fire from world_tick/production.rs:263,405 and object_queries.rs:1851 on every ready edge. They check own/ally/enemy only — no script_superweapon_hidden_objects, no hidden_by_science. Host already stores the hide set (scripts_camera.rs:3788-3797) and leftover peek (eva_camera.rs:683-687) but uses it only for the HUD timer list (presentation_frame/build.rs:1316-1317; hq-74on4 was HUD, not EVA). Live TheEva::set_should_play still pulses leftover Eva::ingest_logic_events, so leftover Eva.ini SideSounds speak.

Evidence:
A mission that hides one superweapon timer (hideObjectSuperweaponDisplayByScript) still gets Superweapon ready EVA on live. C++ and leftover InGameUI stay silent. Same for a SW structure completed before its required science (m_hiddenByScience never clears).
close_reason: Live SuperweaponReady skips hidden-by-script/science timers (InGameUI.cpp:3513). Science latch never clears.

title: [Save] Countermeasures flare runtime never persisted
description:
## C++
`CountermeasuresBehavior.cpp:353-379` xfer v2 writes `m_counterMeasures` IDs, `m_availableCountermeasures`, `m_activeCountermeasures`, `m_divertedMissiles`, `m_incomingMissiles`, `m_reactionFrame`, `m_nextVolleyFrame`.

## Leftover
`countermeasures_behavior.rs:742-786` implements that v2 runtime table (count + IDs + the six counters/frames).

## Live
`host_countermeasures.rs` `HostCountermeasuresState` is the live flare registry (`available`, `active`, `incoming_missiles`, `diverted_missiles`, `reaction_frame`, `next_volley_frame`, `flare_ids`). Combat (`combat.rs`) uses it for missile diversion. `Main/src/save_load` never captures or restores the registry; `ensure()` rebuilds `full_load` on first post-load use.

## Player-visible
Save mid-defense: Raptor/Comanche/Aurora restore with a full flare load, pending volleys vanish, and already-fired missiles stop seeking flares.
close_reason: MSRT lifecycle-tail suffix persists HostCountermeasuresState (flare IDs + available/active/incoming/diverted + reaction/next-volley frames) and pending same-frame flare spawns. restore_state avoids ensure() rebuilding a full load after load.

title: [Save] CheckpointUpdate gate state never persisted
description:
## C++
`CheckpointUpdate::xfer` persists `m_enemyNear`, `m_allyNear`, bounding radius, and scan delay so an open/closed checkpoint gate survives save/load.

## Leftover
`checkpoint_update.rs:287-300` xfers those fields (v1 + update-module base).

## Live
`host_checkpoint_update.rs` `HostCheckpointUpdateData` (`enemy_near`, `ally_near`, `scan_delay`, `open`, `door_anim`) is the live gate. `save_load/snapshot` never persists it. Restore uses `Default` (`open: false`, `door_anim: None`).

## Player-visible
Save an open checkpoint: after load the gate snaps shut and pathing treats it as closed until the next scan.
close_reason: MSRT suffix persists HostCheckpointUpdateData (enemy_near/ally_near/scan_delay/open/door_anim/path_radius). Restore reapplies DOOR_1_OPENING/CLOSING so an open gate does not snap shut.

title: [Save] EnemyNearUpdate latch never persisted
description:
## C++
`EnemyNearUpdate::xfer` persists scan delay and the current `m_enemyNear` latch that drives the ENEMYNEAR model condition on walls/fences.

## Leftover
`enemy_near_update.rs:161-173` xfers version 1 + update-module base + `enemy_scan_delay` + `enemy_near`.

## Live
`host_enemy_near.rs` `HostEnemyNearData` (`enemy_near`, `scan_delay`) ticks live wall ENEMYNEAR. `save_load/snapshot` never writes or restores it, so load reconstructs default `enemy_near=false`.

## Player-visible
Save while enemies are at a wall: after load the wall drops ENEMYNEAR pose/condition until the next scan.
close_reason: MSRT suffix persists HostEnemyNearData (enemy_near/model_enemy_near/scan_delay). Restore reapplies ENEMYNEAR so a wall latch does not drop until the next scan.

title: [Guard] GuardingObject never follows a wandering guardee
description:
## C++
`AIGuardIdleState::update` (`AIGuard.cpp:717-736`) tracks `m_guardeePos`. If the guardee drifts more than 2 cells on either axis (`delta*delta > 4 * PATHFIND_CELL_SIZE_F^2`), it stores the new pos and returns STATE_FAILURE → `AIGuardReturnState`, whose onEnter (`:609-620`) sets the goal to `targetToGuard->getPosition()`.

## Leftover (right)
`guardee_moved_beyond_return_threshold` (`guard.rs:67-75`) is per-axis 2-cell. Idle update (`:1341-1348`) applies it and returns Failure → Return. Test `idle_follows_guardee_per_axis_two_cells_not_euclidean_four`.

## Live (wrong)
`AIState::GuardingObject` (`support_states.rs:3364-3377`) only re-approaches when the **guard unit** is farther than `inner` (mood vision) from the current anchor. No `m_guardeePos`, no per-axis 2-cell drift. hq-f6opa closed leftover-only (Euclidean→per-axis); live never received follow-guardee.

## Player-visible
A Ranger ordered to Guard a slowly moving Crusader stays put until the tank is a full inner-vision radius away, then walks the whole way, instead of shadowing after ~2 cells like C++.
close_reason: Live GuardingObject now tracks m_guardeePos and paths to the hero after a per-axis 2-cell drift (4*PATHFIND_CELL_SIZE_F^2), matching leftover/C++ AIGuardIdleState.

title: [Guard] Inner attack never switches to a new last attacker
description:
## C++
`AIGuardMachine` ctor (`AIGuard.cpp:162-167`) registers `hasAttackedMeAndICanReturnFire` on `AI_GUARD_INNER` plus RETURN/IDLE (not OUTER/GET_CRATE). While the inner attack on A is running, a new clearable last attacker transitions to `AI_GUARD_ATTACK_AGGRESSOR`.

## Leftover (right)
`define_guard_states` (`guard.rs:612-661`) attaches `has_attacked_me_and_i_can_return_fire` to Inner/Return/Idle and `&[]` to Outer/GetCrate/AttackAggressor.

## Live (wrong)
`try_guard_last_attacker` is called only from `GuardingArea` (`support_states.rs:3183`) and `GuardingObject` (`:3300`) — i.e. while not attacking. The `AIState::Attacking` peel (`:6763-6767`) only runs `tick_guard_chase_exits` (inner/outer/timer). hq-s6ntj added the interrupt on idle/return only.

## Player-visible
A unit guarding a point that is already shooting enemy A ignores a new shot from enemy B until A dies or the chase timer expires. C++ switches to B immediately.
close_reason: Live AIState::Attacking INNER now runs try_guard_last_attacker so a new last attacker interrupts the current inner victim, matching leftover has_attacked_me_and_i_can_return_fire on AI_GUARD_INNER.

title: [Guard] Idle/return acquire has no GuardEnemyScanRate cadence
description:
## C++
`AIGuardIdleState` (`AIGuard.cpp:655-658`, `:686-689`) seeds `m_nextEnemyScanTime = now + GameLogicRandomValue(0, m_guardEnemyScanRate)` and only looks for inner targets when `now >= m_nextEnemyScanTime`, then `+= m_guardEnemyScanRate`. Return (`:609-611`, `:629-637`) uses `m_guardEnemyReturnScanRate`. Defaults (`AI.cpp:893-894`): scan = LOGICFRAMES_PER_SECOND/2 (0.5s), return = 1s. Same cadence on AIGuardRetaliate and AITNGuard.

## Leftover (right)
Idle `classic_on_enter` (`guard.rs:1247-1250`) random offset; `classic_on_update` (`:1266-1272`) sleeps until `next_enemy_scan_time` then adds `get_guard_enemy_scan_rate()`. Return (`:1627-1630`, `:1665-1668`) uses `get_guard_enemy_return_scan_rate()`.

## Live (wrong)
`AIState::GuardingArea` / `GuardingObject` (`support_states.rs:3183-3363`) call `try_guard_last_attacker` + `scan_guard_inner_target` every tick. `tick_guard_retaliate_states` (`teams.rs:843+`) rescans every tick. No `GuardEnemyScanRate` / `GuardEnemyReturnScanRate` and no random initial offset.

hq-so2pd is the area trigger-change stamp only, not this scan-rate cadence.

## Player-visible
Guards acquire the instant something enters the ring instead of within the retail 0.5–1s window, and mass-selected guards all snap on the same frame.
close_reason: Live idle/return and retaliate inner acquire now wait leftover AIData GuardEnemyScanRate / GuardEnemyReturnScanRate after the first look, matching leftover next_enemy_scan_time cadence.

title: [Save] Failed load applies CHUNK_Campaign to the live match
description:
## C++
`GameState::loadGame` (`GameState.cpp:628-741`) xfers every chunk including `CHUNK_Campaign` inside one load. On xfer or loadPostProcess failure it calls `clearGameData(FALSE)` + `TheGameEngine->reset()` (`GameState.cpp:695-712`). Half-applied campaign state cannot survive in a running game.

## Leftover
`SaveGame/game_state.rs` `load_game` xfers all blocks inside the load. `cleanup_after_failed_load` (~790-797) notifies `clear_game_data` and resets the engine — same all-or-nothing.

## Live
`SaveFileManager::read_common_sav_chunks` (`save_file.rs:1393-1397`) calls `apply_campaign_manager_state` (`save_file.rs:360-364`) while walking chunks. That decode runs in `stage_saved_world_for_restore` (`host_authority.rs:1310-1312`) *before* `StagedWorldEffects::enter` / `RuntimeWorldStage::begin` (`host_authority.rs:1376-1377`). A later failure (missing map, `load_map` fail, snapshot restore fail, corrupt `CHUNK_GameLogic`) returns `Err`. `host_load_game_from_ui` (`host_authority.rs:1774-1781`) keeps the still-playable match and only leaves the Loading overlay.

## Player-visible
After a failed load (missing map, bad GameLogic payload), the preserved match's campaign identity, rank points, difficulty, and current mission come from the save that failed, not from the match the player is still in.
close_reason: CHUNK_Campaign is stashed in read_common_sav_chunks and applied only by commit_stashed_campaign_state after a successful staged restore. Failed decode/load_game/host_try_load_game_authority roll back to the pre-load campaign so the still-playable match keeps its identity, rank, and difficulty.

title: [OCL] Edge-near-source spawn uses hardcoded 0..500 map box
description:
## C++
`OCLSpecialPower::doSpecialPowerAtLocation` (`OCLSpecialPower.cpp:165-176`) CREATE_AT_EDGE_NEAR_SOURCE/NEAR_TARGET/FARTHEST_FROM_TARGET uses `TheTerrainLogic->findClosestEdgePoint` / `findFarthestEdgePoint`, which read the live map `getExtent()` boundary.

## Leftover
`GameEngine/GameLogic/src/object/special_powers/ocl_special_power.rs:260-272` calls `TheTerrainLogic::find_closest_edge_point` / `find_farthest_edge_point` (terrain.rs get_extent — active map boundary).

## Live
`plan_ocl_special_power` (`world_combat/infantry_weapons.rs:1062`) always passes `default_map_extents()` → `RESIDUAL_MAP_EXTENT_*` 0..500 (`host_deliver_payload.rs:212-215`). `execute_ocl_special_power` then creates the transport at `plan.creation_coord` (`infantry_weapons.rs:930-934`).

Default GameLogic world is 512×512 centered at origin (`game_logic/construct.rs:36-39` world_min=-256, world_max=256). Maps override extents. A CC at origin yields residual edge (0,0) — map center, not a map edge.

Dedicated Daisy/A10/Anthrax/Cluster flights already use `closest_map_edge_point` (`world_min`/`world_max`). execute_ocl still drives CrateDrop, NapalmStrike, and any other EDGE_* peel that is not on that skip list (`special_power_strikes.rs:152-163`, `helix_radar.rs:1294`).

## Player-visible
Crate Drop / Napalm Strike cargo planes spawn at the wrong map edge (often mid-map on the default 512 world). hq-iidqu fixed *which* point the edge is near (source vs caster-behind); this is the remaining wrong *extent* used to compute that edge.

## Not a duplicate
hq-iidqu closed spawn-behind-caster. Cluster Mines already uses live world extents. No closed bead covers the 0..500 residual box.
close_reason: Live plan_ocl_special_power uses leftover TerrainLogic get_extent() when the active boundary is real, else world_min/world_max. execute_ocl reseats cargo flight onto that rim instead of residual 0..500. Leftover ocl_special_power already called find_closest_edge_point/find_farthest_edge_point.

title: [Radar] RADAR_CREATE_EVENT invents HUD text C++ never shows
description:
## C++
`ScriptActions::doRadarCreateEvent` (`ScriptActions.cpp:2843-2845`) only calls `TheRadar->createEvent(pos, type)`. No InGameUI message, no audio.

## Leftover
Leftover `do_radar_create_event` (`scripting/executor/actions_world.rs:303-328`) calls leftover `RadarSystem::create_event` (event-only, matching C++) then the live handler.

## Live
`MissionScriptActionHandler::create_radar_event` queues `RadarScriptEventRequest`. Drain `queue_script_radar_event` (`world_scripts/production_eva.rs:518-593`) prefixes invented English HUD strings (`\"Construction event\"`, `\"Upgrade event\"`, `\"Radar event\"`, `\"Beacon pulse\"`, `\"Infiltration event\"`, `\"Battle plan event\"`, `\"Stealth discovered\"`, `\"Stealth neutralized\"`) and for several types also `host_create_radar_event` again. Retail never shows those strings.

## Evidence
C++ `ScriptActions.cpp:2843-2845`; leftover `actions_world.rs:317-319`; live `production_eva.rs:518-593` via `scripts_camera.rs:3577-3578`. Not hq-ly4qh (OBJECT/TEAM leftover-only) or hq-copm3 (`GUI:UnitReady`).
close_reason: RADAR_CREATE_EVENT drain is TheRadar->createEvent only; leftover already matched C++; no invented HUD/audio.

title: [Pathfind] Seed-line still walks allied-fixed and crushable enemies
description:
## C++
`examineCellsCallback` (AIPathfind.cpp:6026-6055) aborts the parent→goal seed line on `checkForMovement` fail, ANY `enemyFixed` (crushable included), or `allyFixedCount`.

## Leftover
`find_path_internal` `line_ok` (`find_path.rs`:223-243): `!check_for_movement` or `info.enemy_fixed || info.ally_fixed_count > 0` → false. Passed into crate `find_path_ex6` as `line_cell_ok`.

## Live
`find_path_via_crate` (`pathfinding.rs`:4901) `line_ok = extra_ref(c) < u32::MAX/8`. `extra()` only returns MAX/8 for uncrushable enemy-fixed (`:4873-4877`). Allied-fixed adds 3*COST_DIAGONAL and still seeds. Crushable enemy-fixed does not abort.

## Evidence
hq-7qvsn closed traffic cost on neighbor expand. Seed-line abort is a separate C++ callback.

Player-visible: the straight-line pre-seed commits through a parked allied tank or a crushable car; leftover aborts and A* starts from a different corridor.
close_reason: Live seed line aborts allied-fixed and crushable enemy-fixed via seed_line_occupancy_ok (leftover examineCellsCallback).

title: [Pathfind] Attack LOS skips leftover airborne and KINDOF gates
description:
## C++
`findAttackPath` only checks LOS when the victim is NULL or `!victim->isSignificantlyAboveTerrain()`. `isAttackViewBlockedByObstacle` early-outs unless `KINDOF_ATTACK_NEEDS_LINE_OF_SIGHT`, `TheAI->getAiData()->m_attackUsesLineOfSight`, then terrain LOS / transparent / slaver / container / victim-cell skips.

## Leftover
`is_attack_view_blocked_by_obstacle` (`attack_path.rs`:413-520): global LOS switch, `AttackNeedsLineOfSight` kind, flying victim → not blocked, LOS_TERRAIN, layer skip-3.

## Live
`find_attack_firing_position` calls `grid.is_attack_view_blocked_static(world, victim)` unconditionally in the quick-step and A* (`pathfinding.rs`:5260, 5353). The static helper (`:613-664`) is a Bresenham CELL_OBSTACLE walk with transparent/victim-cell skips only — no airborne victim, no KINDOF, no AI global.

## Evidence
hq-qvyaf / hq-5mxzk closed Chebyshev-4 and see-through. Remaining leftover gates were never wired.

Player-visible: units that do not need LOS still refuse firing cells behind a building; attackers mill under aircraft because the deck/structure cells count as blocked LOS.
close_reason: Live attack LOS now gates KINDOF AttackNeedsLineOfSight, isSignificantlyAboveTerrain airborne, skip-3, identity/slaver/container.

title: [Pathfind] findAttackPath skips leftover vehicle strip-back
description:
## C++
`Pathfinder::findAttackPath` success branch (AIPathfind.cpp:~10725-10760): if the seeker is `KINDOF_VEHICLE`, walk the parent chain ≤12 cells. `checkForMovement` with radius 0 / center=true unless `useLargeRadius`; idle occupants clear `blockedByAllies`. Last blocked cell retreats the goal to `lastBlocked->getParentCell()`.

## Leftover
`pathfind_complete/attack_path.rs` ~316-375: same chain walk from `came_from`, `cell_limit=12`, `pos_unit_at`/`object_is_idle`, last-blocked → parent.

## Live
`find_attack_firing_position` (`pathfinding.rs`:5416-5423) takes `found_cell.or(closest_cell)` and `find_path_ex_surfaces`s there. No parent-chain walk, no idle/ally-blocked retreat.

## Evidence
hq-f4q2o closed the spiral→leftover A* shape. Strip-back was not ported.

Player-visible: tanks pick a firing cell sitting on allied/enemy congestion; leftover backs them off one parent cell so they do not stack into the blob.
close_reason: Live findAttackPath vehicle strip-back walks parent chain <=12 with use_large radius and last-blocked parent retreat.

title: [Pathfind] findAttackPath A* drops leftover occupancy costs
description:
## C++
`examineNeighboringCells` with `attackDistance` (AIPathfind.cpp:6228-6300): enemyFixed skip; allyFixed +3*COST_DIAGONAL + blockedByAlly; allyMoving within 10 cells of start +3*COST_DIAGONAL; allyGoal → vehicle +3*COST_ORTHOGONAL else +COST_ORTHOGONAL; notZonePassable +100*COST_ORTHOGONAL.

## Leftover
`attack_path.rs` ~244-287: `check_for_movement` / `enemy_fixed` skip, `ally_fixed_count` +3DIAG, `ally_moving` near start, `ally_goal` vehicle/infantry split, pinched +ORTHO+DIAG, `!is_zone_passable` +100*ORTHO.

## Live
`find_attack_firing_position` neighbor loop (`pathfinding.rs`:5377-5412) adds only `is_pinched`. No ally/enemy/zone terms. `apply_hierarchical_zone_prune` (~5282) runs on the crate finder but the attack A* searches `self.grid` and never consults those flags.

## Evidence
hq-f4q2o / hq-7qvsn closed crate-path occupancy for `findPath`. Attack A* is a separate host loop.

Player-visible: attackers path straight through allied blobs and zone-blocked corridors leftover would detour.
close_reason: Live findAttackPath A* applies leftover occupancy: enemyFixed skip, allyFixed/Moving/Goal and zone/pinch costs.

title: [Hunt] Guard order never releases hunt LockedTemporarily weapon lock
description:
## C++
`AIHuntState::onExit` (`AIStates.cpp:7099-7111`) unconditionally `releaseWeaponLock(LOCKED_TEMPORARILY)` on any hunt exit. `GameLogicDispatch` `releaseWeaponLockForGroup` covers move/attack-move/enter/exit/evacuate/hack/attack — not guard — so hunt-state onExit is the release path when a hunting unit is re-tasked to Guard.

## Leftover (right)
`AIHuntState::classic_on_exit` (`GameLogic/src/ai/states/hunt.rs:333-341`) takes the hunt machine and `owner.release_weapon_lock(WeaponLockType::LockedTemporarily)`.

## Live (wrong)
Hunt out-of-ammo and map-clear exits do release (`ai_authority.rs:139-142`, `:222-225`). Stop goes through `Object::stop_attack` which also releases. Guard does not: `unit_command_guard_position` (`unit_commands.rs:450-452`), `unit_command_guard_object` (`:468-470`), and `unit_command_guard_full` (`:844-853`) only clear `hunting` and set Guarding*. Temp locks from manual weapon fire (`unit_commands.rs:1645`), missile-defender/laser, or command-button hunt stay held.

## Player-visible
A hunting unit locked onto a secondary/special weapon keeps that lock after a Guard click, so it keeps firing the locked weapon instead of auto-choosing like C++.
close_reason: Hunt then Guard releases LockedTemporarily: leftover AIHuntState::classic_on_exit already matches C++ AIHuntState::onExit; live unit_command_guard_position/object/full now release temp lock when leaving hunt/Patrolling (dispatch has no releaseWeaponLockForGroup).

title: [Save] OBJECT_STATUS_UNSELECTABLE never persisted
description:
## C++
`Object::xfer` v8+ writes `m_status` as named bits (`Object.cpp` status xfer). `OBJECT_STATUS_UNSELECTABLE` is one of those bits. `Object::isSelectable` (`Object.cpp:3011-3020`) returns false when that bit is set (unless KINDOF_ALWAYS_SELECTABLE).

## Leftover
`object_xfer.rs:225-271` `OBJECT_STATUS_XFER_NAMES` includes `"UNSELECTABLE"`. `xfer_named_bits` persists it with the rest of `m_status`.

## Live
Host `ObjectStatus.unselectable` (`host_types.rs:431-433`) and `is_selectable()` (`construct.rs:2306-2315`) implement the C++ gate. Sell, rebuild-hole workers, and script/UI paths set the bit. `snapshot_object_status` / `restore_object_status` never copy `status.unselectable`.

## Player-visible
Save mid-sell, mid-rebuild-hole worker, or after a script/UI unselectable latch: load makes the unit clickable again.
close_reason: ObjectStatusSnapshot now persists OBJECT_STATUS_UNSELECTABLE via snapshot_object_status/restore_object_status (serde default for older snaps). Sell/rebuild-hole/script unselectable latches survive save/load.

title: [Save] Object script_status bits reset after load
description:
## C++
`Object.cpp:4095-4099` xfers `m_scriptStatus` then `m_privateStatus` as unsigned bytes. Bits are `ObjectScriptStatusBits.h:14-18`: SCRIPT_DISABLED 0x01, SCRIPT_UNPOWERED 0x02, SCRIPT_UNSELLABLE 0x04, SCRIPT_UNSTEALTHED 0x08, SCRIPT_TARGETABLE 0x10. `setScriptStatus` applies DISABLED_SCRIPT_DISABLED / DISABLED_SCRIPT_UNDERPOWERED.

## Leftover
`GameLogic/src/object/object_xfer.rs:843-844` writes the same two bytes. `ObjectScriptStatusBit` matches C++. Live host already has the gameplay: `Object::set_script_disabled` / `set_script_unsellable` / `script_unstealthed`, `PLAYER_DISABLE_FACTORIES` (`world_tests/superweapons_and_plans.rs`), WB `objectEnabled`/`objectPowered`/`objectUnsellable`.

## Live
`save_load/snapshot/builder.rs:468-510` `snapshot_object_status` and `restore.rs:287-342` `restore_object_status` never read or write `disabled_script_disabled`, `disabled_script_underpowered`, `script_unsellable`, or `script_unstealthed`. Those fields exist on host `Object` / `ObjectStatus` (`host_types.rs:541-546`, `object/mod.rs:371`).

## Player-visible
After save/load: script-disabled factories become usable, unpowered buildings work, unsellable/captured buildings get a working Sell button, destalthed units can re-cloak, script-targetable units lose forced targeting.
close_reason: ObjectStatusSnapshot persists script_status bits: DISABLED_SCRIPT_DISABLED, DISABLED_SCRIPT_UNDERPOWERED, SCRIPT_UNSELLABLE, SCRIPT_UNSTEALTHED. Snapshot/restore copies them so script-disabled factories, unpowered buildings, unsellable, and destalthed units keep state after load.

title: [Save] OBJECT_STATUS_DEPLOYED never persisted
description:
## C++
`Object::xfer` named status bits include `OBJECT_STATUS_DEPLOYED`. DeployStyle units (Tomahawk, nuke cannon, missile humvee) must stay unpacked across save/load or they lose the deployed weapon/range state.

## Leftover
`object_xfer.rs:270` lists `"DEPLOYED"` in `OBJECT_STATUS_XFER_NAMES` and xfers it with `m_status`.

## Live
Host has `status.deployed` / `set_deployed` / `is_deployed` (`install.rs:301-308`) and DeployStyle pack/unpack (`world_scripts/unit_commands.rs`, `world_tick/crates.rs`). `ObjectStatusSnapshot` and `snapshot_object_status` omit `deployed`, so restore always leaves the default false.

## Player-visible
Save a deployed artillery/missile unit: after load it is packed (wrong weapon set / cannot fire until the player redeploys).
close_reason: ObjectStatusSnapshot persists OBJECT_STATUS_DEPLOYED. DeployStyle artillery/missile units stay unpacked across save/load instead of reverting to packed.

title: [LookAt] Edge scroll adds InGame/chat/diplomacy gates
description:
## C++
`LookAtXlat.cpp:267-291` (start/stop) and `:427-447` (FRAME_TICK offset) enable `SCROLL_SCREENEDGE` whenever input is enabled, the build is not windowed, and the cursor is inside the 3px `TheDisplay` band. `TheShell->isShellActive()` only skips RAW_KEY (`:155-156`). Chat/diplomacy never appear. Shell-map Menu therefore still edge-scrolls.

## Leftover (matches C++ gates)
`GameClient/src/message_stream/look_at_xlat.rs:339-365` — same input-enabled + `!windowed` + 3px band. No GameState, chat, or diplomacy check. (Leftover still wrongly sizes the band from tactical view, not Display — that leftover-wrong is not this bug.)

## Live (wrong)
`Main/src/cnc_game_engine/mouse.rs:2022-2028` `edge_allowed` additionally requires `GameState::InGame | Paused`, `!chat_panel.is_open()`, and `!diplomacy_panel.is_active()`. `update_camera` still runs on Menu via `camera_drain.rs:458` `host_tick_menu_client_residuals`, so the InGame gate is what kills shell-map edge pan. Open chat/diplomacy kills every edge, not just the window under the cursor (C++ WindowXlat).

## Evidence
- C++ LookAtXlat.cpp:155-156, 267-291, 427-447
- leftover look_at_xlat.rs:272-274 (shell keys only), 339-365
- live mouse.rs:2022-2028
- live camera_drain.rs:458 (Menu still calls update_camera)
close_reason: Live edge_allowed now matches C++ LookAtXlat.cpp:267-291: input-enabled + !windowed + 3px Display band. Removed extra InGame/Paused, chat, and diplomacy gates so score/diplomacy still edge-scroll when input is enabled. Leftover look_at_xlat.rs already had C++ gates.

title: [Audio] PLAY_SOUND_EFFECT live handler skips leftover TheAudio locality
description:
C++ path + behavior:
ScriptActions::doPlaySoundEffect (ScriptActions.cpp:329-334) and doPlaySoundEffectAt (:341-351) always build AudioEventRTS, setIsLogicalAudio(true), setPlayerIndex(ThePlayerList->getLocalPlayer()->getPlayerIndex()), then TheAudio->addAudioEvent. Positional form uses the leftover waypoint Coord3D. shouldPlayLocally (GameAudio.cpp:435-439) then honors ST_PLAYER/ALLIES/ENEMIES against that owner.

Leftover path + behavior:
GameClientScriptActionHandler::play_sound_effect / play_sound_effect_at (script_action_handler.rs:762-786) matches C++: leftover TheAudio.add_audio_event with set_is_logical_audio(true) and leftover local player index. Leftover AudioEventRts default player_index is -1 (audio_event_rts.rs:636). Leftover should_play_locally_for_players (game_audio.rs:199-200) returns false when the owner does not exist, so ST_PLAYER/ALLIES/ENEMIES without an index is AHSV_NotForLocal.

Live path + behavior:
initialize_scripts (add_object_selection.rs:1314-1324) overwrites leftover GameClientScriptActionHandler with MissionScriptActionHandler. Leftover executor do_play_sound_effect(_at) (actions_player_display_camera.rs:456-509) then only calls that handler. Live play_sound_effect / play_sound_effect_at (mission_scripts.rs:2000-2012) only note_audio_started + push_sound / push_sound_event. Drain (scripts_camera.rs:3093-3103 → subsystem_manager.rs:595-632) calls leftover TheAudio via leftover_world_sfx_event (assets/audio.rs:149-157) with no player_index, so leftover shouldPlayLocally culls restricted events and the drain falls through to the unused SoundEffectsTable rodio fallback. Same live handler already had to be taught leftover TheAudio for SPEECH_PLAY (hq-so6wb) and MUSIC_SET_TRACK (hq-ra6p); PLAY_SOUND_EFFECT(_AT) was left as the pre-fix UI-note path.

Evidence:
Campaign/skirmish PLAY_SOUND_EFFECT / PLAY_SOUND_EFFECT_AT that are Type: player/allies/enemies stay silent on leftover Miles/rodio (or play a 2D table fallback). Retail plays them as logical leftover TheAudio events owned by the local player. Leftover GameClient handler is the C++ port; live map-load overwrites it.
close_reason: Live PLAY_SOUND_EFFECT/_AT now forwards to leftover GameClientScriptActionHandler (set_is_logical_audio + local player_index + TheAudio.add_audio_event). Dropped unlocal drain push_sound / leftover_world_sfx_event second play. One logical local event matching C++ doPlaySoundEffect.

title: [SpecialAbility] Capture prep never aborts when the capturer is moving
description:
## C++
`SpecialAbilityUpdate::update` (`SpecialAbilityUpdate.cpp:209-220`): if `ai->isMoving() && isPowerCurrentlyInUse() && !m_facingInitiated`, infantry and Black Lotus capture call `onExit(false)`. Comment: "Capture is broken by movement just as if we had been given a direct command." `isPowerCurrentlyInUse` is true only after `m_withinStartAbilityRange` (arrived / unpacking / preparing), so approach walking is not aborted.

## Leftover
`GameEngine/GameLogic/src/object/behavior/special_ability_update.rs:1967-1976` ports the same gate for `SpecialInfantryCaptureBuilding` / `SpecialBlackLotusCaptureBuilding`.

## Live
`Main/src/game_logic/world_objects/support_states.rs` capture Preparing branch (`:4656-4686`) restarts infantry recharge and flashes, but never tests capturer `status.moving` / path. New player orders abort (hq-awn7q closed). Involuntary movement during the 6-20s prep bar does not.

## Player-visible
A ranger/rebel/Red Guard/Lotus mid-capture shoved by a tank or physics keeps capturing on live. Retail cancels; they must walk back and restart.
close_reason: Live capture Unpacking/Preparing now onExit when host_ai_is_moving (C++ SpecialAbilityUpdate.cpp:209-220). Approach without a channel still walks. Leftover already matched.

title: [SpecialAbility] MD laser persist never aborts when target becomes ally
description:
## C++
`SpecialAbilityUpdate::continuePreparation` (`SpecialAbilityUpdate.cpp:1142-1158`) for `SPECIAL_MISSILE_DEFENDER_LASER_GUIDED_MISSILES` (and disable-vehicle) aborts when the target is gone or `getRelationship(target) == ALLIES` ("captured by a colleague"), then re-`initLaser`s every persist tick.

## Leftover
`GameEngine/GameLogic/src/object/behavior/special_ability_update.rs:1053-1066` matches: `Relationship::Allies` returns false from `continue_preparation`, which ends the channel.

## Live
`Main/src/game_logic/world_combat/missile_defenders.rs:301-304` persist tick aborts only on dead / `KindOf::Structure` / stealthed-undetected. No ally check. After persist prep completes (`:341-358`) the MD keeps SECONDARY lock and `engage_target` on the now-allied vehicle.

## Player-visible
Laser-designate an enemy vehicle; a colleague hijacks/defects it. Retail cancels the beam. Live keeps painting and shooting the ally.

Wave 23 noted this as smaller while persist itself was aborting on `Attacking` (hq-5yicv, now closed). Persist now survives `aiAttackObject`, so the missing ally abort is player-visible.
close_reason: Live MD laser persist tick now aborts on Relationship::Allies (C++ continuePreparation 1142-1158). leftover_kill_special_objects drops the beam. Leftover already matched.

title: [Weapon] Live projectiles collide with the launcher container
description:
## C++
Weapon.cpp shouldProjectileCollideWith: after always-hit intended victim, never hit the launcher; if `launcher->getContainedBy() == collided`, ignore (garrison / bunker / transport fire must not detonate on the building you are inside). Also skip Flame/ParticleBeam vs OBJECT_STATUS_BURNED.

## Leftover
GeneralsRust/Code/GameEngine/GameLogic/src/weapon/weapon_template.rs:571-599 — intended hit; launcher id skip; `launcher.get_contained_by() == collided` skip; Flame|ParticleBeam + Burned skip.

## Live
GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/game_logic/combat.rs:1531-1578 intervening-structure intercept only skips shooter id and intended id. A projectile spawned from a garrisoned/bunkered/transported occupant is not the container, so the first XZ footprint test detonates on the host building. No Burned skip for flame/particle-beam. Airfield reserved-space skip exists (hq-ky1q8) but does not cover contained-by.

## Evidence
Rocket/missile occupants in a GarrisonContain / Overlord bunker / Combat Chinook waste the shot on their own structure. Not hq-nkpyd (GarrisonHitKill occupant clear) or hq-s8e65 (fire-goal pose).
close_reason: Live intervening-structure intercept skips launcher.contained_by (garrison/bunker/transport) and Flame/ParticleBeam vs BURNED; leftover weapon_template.rs already matched C++ shouldProjectileCollideWith.

title: [Weapon] Live attack approach always uses PRIMARY range
description:
## C++
Weapon.cpp:1977-2102 Weapon::computeApproachTarget is invoked on the *firing* Weapon after chooseBest. Standoff is that template’s getAttackRange*0.9 (plus radii). Contact weapons (`isContactWeapon`) return the target position. Min-range back-off only when `minAttackRange > PATHFIND_CELL_SIZE_F`, then (min+max)/2, airborne facing flip, angleOffset, clipToTerrainExtent, aircraft adjustTargetDestination.

## Leftover
GeneralsRust/Code/GameEngine/GameLogic/src/weapon/weapon_approach.rs:19-146 ports that method on the Weapon instance (this template’s range, contact → target pos, PATHFIND_CELL_SIZE_F min-range gate, airborne flip, dest adjust).

## Live
Two player-visible approach paths both ignore the chosen slot:
- world_tick/attack.rs:1927-1964 attack_approach_compute_path (AttackStateMachine APPROACH/CHASE, after choose_best_weapon_for_target at :454) reads `u.weapon` PRIMARY min/max only, then 0.9*PRIMARY (or (min+max)/2 if any min>0). No contact→target, no PATHFIND_CELL_SIZE_F gate, no dest adjust.
- world_tick/combat.rs:2347-2369 approach_pos_for_attack also peels PRIMARY range/name.

Humvee that just chose TOW still walks to gun range; rocket infantry / jets do the same. Not a refile of closed hq-gkl8 (that added the 2D residual helper); this is the remaining live-path slot/contact/cell-gate miss.

## Evidence
attack.rs:454 chooseBest then :499/:527/:561 approach; :1931-1939 PRIMARY-only range; leftover weapon_approach.rs vs C++ Weapon.cpp:1977-2102.
close_reason: Live attack_approach_compute_path and approach_pos_for_attack use selected/firing weapon range after chooseBest; contact walks to target; min-range back-off gated by PATHFIND_CELL_SIZE. Leftover weapon_approach.rs already matched C++ computeApproachTarget.

title: [Weapon] Live getAble range uses any slot not current weapon
description:
## C++
WeaponSet.cpp:621-647 getAbleToUseWeaponAgainstTarget loops slot 0..WEAPONSLOT_COUNT-1 but always tests `m_weapons[m_curWeapon]` (current slot only). `withinAttackRange` / Possible vs PossibleAfterMoving is therefore the current weapon's isWithinAttackRange, not “any of PRIMARY/SECONDARY can reach.”

## Leftover
GeneralsRust/Code/GameEngine/GameLogic/src/weapon/weapon_set_able.rs:121-136 — only `self.get_weapon_in_slot(self.current_weapon)` is range-tested (garrison FIREPOINT goal or is_within_attack_range). Matches C++ current-slot semantics.

## Live
GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/game_logic/world_tick/mood.rs:828-838,951-973 — unlocked units use `candidate_slots = [0, 1]` and `within` is true if *any* of those slots is in range. A Humvee/Jarmen/Comanche whose current PRIMARY is out of range but SECONDARY is in range gets Possible (in-range cursor) instead of C++/leftover PossibleAfterMoving.

## Evidence
Retail dual-range sets (Humvee gun vs TOW, Jarmen rifle vs snipe, Comanche chain vs Hellfire). Not hq-e6bkq (passenger/slave InvalidShot) or hq-nhr98 (bridge/contact isWithinAttackRange).
close_reason: Live getAble withinAttackRange tests selected_weapon_slot (m_curWeapon) only, not any of PRIMARY/SECONDARY. Leftover weapon_set_able.rs already matched C++ WeaponSet.cpp:621-647.

title: [Radar] Own CamoNetting buildings hidden by enemy stealth look
description:
## C++
`RadarObject::isTemporarilyHidden` (`Radar.cpp:118-125`) hides when the *local* drawable `getStealthLook() == STEALTHLOOK_INVISIBLE` or `isDrawableEffectivelyHidden`. Own CamoNetting / stealth structures get `STEALTHLOOK_VISIBLE_FRIENDLY` for the local player and still blip.

## Leftover
Leftover `RadarObject::is_temporarily_hidden` (`common/system/radar/mod.rs:772-786`) treats `hidden_by_stealth` as C++ `m_hiddenByStealth` / `STEALTHLOOK_INVISIBLE`. Own stealth (`is_enemy == false`) does not hide unless that flag is set.

## Live
CamoNetting tick writes `camo_stealth_look` with `observer_is_friendly: false` (`stealth_mines.rs:415-431`). `apply_local_stealth_look_and_heat_vision` then *skips* those structures (`stealth_mines.rs:1351-1353` when `stealth_breaks_on_damage`, which CamoNetting sets). `host_radar_insert_spec` (`radar_live.rs:399-402`) maps `HostCamoStealthLook::Invisible` onto `hidden_by_stealth`. Own stealthed Tunnel/Stinger therefore drop off the local radar.

## Evidence
C++ `Radar.cpp:118-125` + `StealthUpdate` local look; leftover `mod.rs:778-786`; live `stealth_mines.rs:415-431,1351-1353` + `radar_live.rs:399-402`. Not hq-u2yos (own/detected infantry blips) or hq-4yczp (Team vs Player hide).
close_reason: isTemporarilyHidden uses local drawable stealth look; own/ally CamoNetting is VISIBLE_FRIENDLY and still blips.

title: [Radar] addObject ignores custom indicator color
description:
## C++
`Radar::addObject` (`Radar.cpp:399-443`) sets blip color from `obj->getIndicatorColor()` when `useIndicatorColor` is true (no disguise/contain override). `Object::getIndicatorColor` returns `setCustomIndicatorColor` when set (`NAMED_CUSTOM_COLOR` / script).

## Leftover
`resolve_radar_object_color` (`Common/src/common/system/radar/objects.rs:51-78`) uses `spec.indicator_color` on the indicator path. Leftover `Object::get_indicator_color` (`object_queries.rs:985-992`) returns custom color first.

## Live
`GameLogic::host_radar_insert_spec` (`world_objects/radar_live.rs:404-420`) always stamps `indicator_color: owner_color` and never reads `Object.custom_indicator_color`. Live already drains `NAMED_CUSTOM_COLOR` onto that field (`scripts_camera.rs:1081-1082`; closed hq-q3o28), but TheRadar still paints house color.

## Evidence
C++ `Radar.cpp:436-438`; leftover `objects.rs:74-75`; live `radar_live.rs:418`. Not hq-q3o28 (script drain) or hq-koe9n (garrison apparent color).
close_reason: addObject indicator_color uses Object::getIndicatorColor (custom NAMED_CUSTOM_COLOR first).

title: [Radar] RadarUpdate extend fires on CC build not RadarUpgrade
description:
## C++
`RadarUpgrade::upgradeImplementation` (`RadarUpgrade.cpp:113-117`) is the only caller of `RadarUpdate::extendRadar`. America CC / GLA RadarVan grant via `GrantUpgradeCreate` at construction complete; China CC `RadarUpgrade` is `TriggeredBy Upgrade_ChinaRadar` so the dish extends on research, not on build.

## Leftover
`RadarUpgrade::apply_radar_upgrade` (`object/upgrade/radar_upgrade.rs:178-182`) calls leftover `RadarUpdate::extend_radar` only when the upgrade applies. Leftover `RadarUpdate` (`object/update/radar_update.rs:54-66`) stays Idle until that call.

## Live
`maybe_start_radar_extend` (`world_scripts/production_eva.rs:1218-1231`) runs from construction-complete (`world_tick/production.rs:321,484`) for any `is_legal_radar_provider` (any non-fake CommandCenter or RadarVan by name). China CC therefore starts `MODELCONDITION_RADAR_EXTENDING` at build, before `Upgrade_ChinaRadar`. No live call starts extend from the research-tag RadarUpgrade path.

## Evidence
C++ `RadarUpgrade.cpp:113-117`; leftover `radar_upgrade.rs:178-182`; live `production_eva.rs:1225-1230`. Not hq-zx8e6 (radar *online* research gate).
close_reason: extendRadar only from RadarUpgrade implementation (grant/mux apply), not construction-complete on every CC.

title: [Parking] Hangar door hold is still one bool, not per-stall m_holdOpen
description:
## C++
`ProductionUpdate::DoorInfo` has per-door `m_holdOpen` (`ProductionUpdate.h:227-233`). `ParkingPlaceBehavior::reserveSpace` / `releaseSpace` / `purgeDead` call `setHoldDoorOpen(ppi->m_door, true/false)` for that stall’s door only (`ParkingPlaceBehavior.cpp:349-351,402-416,143-144`). `setHoldDoorOpen` starts OPENING on that door when it is fully closed. AmericaAirfield authors `NumDoorAnimations = 4`.

## Leftover
`ProductionUpdateComplete::DoorInfo.hold_open` is per index (`production_update_complete.rs:333-341`). `set_hold_door_open(exit_door, hold_it)` writes only that door and starts its OPENING flags (`:487-513`). `ParkingPlaceBehavior::reserve_space` / `release_space` pass `spaces[idx].door` (`parking_place_behavior.rs:668-690,749-760`). Dual-world empty gate means leftover is unused on the live host, but the port matches C++.

## Live
`sync_airfield_hangar_doors` ORs every stall into one bool (`airfield.rs:1045-1056`) and calls `set_production_door_hold_open(hold, frame)`. That helper stores a single `production_door_hold_open` (`object/mod.rs:406-407`, `pose.rs:264-281`). If hold is true, `tick_one_production_door` freezes *every* door in WAITING_OPEN / CLOSING (`pose.rs:385-412`). First park starts one idle door via `pick_idle_production_door` (`pose.rs:194-204`), not the reserved stall index.

hq-hdke7 claimed a per-stall fix and closed. Current code is still the single bool.

## Player-visible
Parking one jet at an AmericaAirfield (4 hangar doors) either holds all doors that happen to be open, or opens door 1 instead of that stall’s door. Empty hangars never get their own hold/open/close timeline.
close_reason: Live hangar hold is now per-stall: Object.production_door_hold_opens[4] (door-0 alias kept). reserve/release/purge sync only that stall's door via set_production_door_hold_open_at; tick freezes only the held door. Leftover already matched C++ setHoldDoorOpen(ppi->m_door).

title: [Guard] Inner/retaliate acquire skips SameMapStatus off-map filter
description:
## C++
Both `AIGuardMachine::lookForInnerTarget` (`AIGuard.cpp:211,244`) and `AIGuardRetaliateMachine::lookForInnerTarget` (`AIGuardRetaliate.cpp:220,253`) append `PartitionFilterSameMapStatus(owner)` so an on-map guard cannot acquire an off-map object (and vice versa).

## Leftover (right)
`scan_guard_inner_target` (`guard.rs:174-176`) and `scan_guard_retaliate_inner_target` (`guard_retaliate.rs:92-94`): `if owner.is_off_map() != candidate.is_off_map() { return false; }`.

## Live (wrong)
`scan_guard_inner_target` (`support_states.rs:214-261`) and `scan_guard_retaliate_inner` (`teams.rs:308-350`) have no off-map / same-map-status check. Cargo planes, A10s, and HeadOffMap transports remain valid guard/retaliate victims.

## Player-visible
Area-guard and auto-retaliate units peel off to chase off-map strike aircraft that C++ would ignore.
close_reason: Live scan_guard_inner_target and scan_guard_retaliate_inner apply PartitionFilterSameMapStatus via host world_bounds (isOffMap playable extent). On-map guards skip off-map cargo/A10/HeadOffMap.

title: [Guard] Inner/retaliate acquire uses 3D distance not FROM_CENTER_2D
description:
## C++
`AIGuardMachine::lookForInnerTarget` (`AIGuard.cpp:276`) and `AIGuardRetaliateMachine::lookForInnerTarget` (`AIGuardRetaliate.cpp:269`) both call `ThePartitionManager->getClosestObject(..., FROM_CENTER_2D, filters)` — height is ignored.

## Leftover (right)
`scan_guard_inner_target` / `scan_guard_retaliate_inner_target` use `PartitionManager::get_closest_object_2d` (`GameLogic/src/helpers/object_queries.rs:532-560`) which scores `dx*dx + dy*dy` (leftover XY ground plane).

## Live (wrong)
`scan_guard_inner_target` (`support_states.rs:224`) and `scan_guard_retaliate_inner` (`world_tick/teams.rs:312`) use `Vec3::distance` (includes host Y-up height). Chase already uses XY (`host_guard_xy_dist_sq` / retaliate `dx/dz`). Hunt `find_closest_enemy` is already 2D xz (`mood.rs:178-181`).

## Player-visible
Guarding units prefer or miss victims by altitude (Comanches, cliff elevation). A high flyer just inside 2D inner ring is treated as out of range; a ground unit farther in XZ but same 3D distance can win.
close_reason: Inner/retaliate acquire uses host_guard_xy_dist_sq / XZ FROM_CENTER_2D. Height ignored; closer 2D flyer beats farther ground unit.

title: [Guard] Area-guard scan ignores trigger-area change stamp
description:
## C++
`AIGuardMachine::lookForInnerTarget` (`GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/AI/AIGuard.cpp:248-253`) when `getAreaToGuard()` is set: `checkFrame = TheGameLogic->getFrameObjectsChangedTriggerAreas() + TheAI->getAiData()->m_guardEnemyScanRate; if (TheGameLogic->getFrame() > checkFrame) return false;` Then scan uses the polygon bounding radius + `PartitionFilterPolygonTrigger`.

## Leftover (right)
`scan_guard_inner_target` (`GeneralsRust/Code/GameEngine/GameLogic/src/ai/guard.rs:148-158`) matches: if `changed != 0` and current frame > `changed + scan_rate`, return None. Then uses `area.get_radius()` / `area.get_center_point()`.

## Live (wrong)

title: [ScriptCond] HAS_FINISHED_AUDIO / MUSIC_TRACK_HAS_COMPLETED complete next frame and fail-open
description:
## C++
`evaluateAudioHasCompleted` (`ScriptConditions.cpp:1435-1437`) is `TheScriptEngine->isAudioComplete(name, true)`.
`ScriptEngine::isAudioComplete` (`ScriptEngine.cpp:7303-7332`): first query starts a TheAudio length timer (`getAudioLengthMS` / `MSEC_PER_LOGICFRAME`); true only after that frame. Empty name is not special-cased beyond the timer.
`evaluateMusicHasCompleted` (`ScriptConditions.cpp:2666-2667`) is `TheAudio->hasMusicTrackCompleted(track, N)`. Miles (`MilesAudioManager.cpp:1370-1385`) walks playing music streams and returns true only when that track's loop count `>= N`. Unplayed / missing tracks are **false**.

## Leftover
`ScriptEngine::is_audio_complete` (`named_trackers.rs:1031-1034` + `is_timed_audio_complete` `:992-1023`) matches C++: first query starts TheAudio length, then `current_frame >= completion_frame`.
Leftover `AudioCompletedCondition` / `MusicTrackCompletedCondition` (`conditions/leftover.rs:329-384`) call leftover ScriptEngine / handler. Default leftover handler `has_music_track_completed` is false (`engine/types.rs:353-355`).

## Live
Leftover evaluator `eval_has_finished_audio` / `eval_music_track_has_completed` (`eval_named.rs:1656-1698`) use the live handler.
`note_audio_started` (`mission_scripts.rs:1359-1363`) stamps `audio_complete_frame = now+1`. `is_audio_complete` (`:1437-1449`) returns **true** when the name is absent.
`note_music_started` (`:1366-1370`) stamps `music_complete_frame = now+1`. `has_music_track_completed` (`:1452-1464`) returns **true** when the track is absent and never asks TheAudio loop count.

## Player-visible
Scripts that wait for a SFX or "music track completed N times" fire on the next frame (or immediately if never queued). C++ waits for TheAudio length / Miles loop count. Speech already uses leftover TheAudio length (`hq-8apzx`); audio and music still do not.
close_reason: Live HAS_FINISHED_AUDIO waits leftover TheAudio getAudioLengthMS on the live frame clock (C++ isAudioComplete); MUSIC_TRACK_HAS_COMPLETED uses leftover TheAudio Miles loop count. Unplayed/missing stay false. ScriptEvaluator and leftover executor use the live handler first.

title: [Pathfind] findClosestPath rebuilds with thin host A*
description:
## C++
`Pathfinder::findClosestPath` (AIPathfind.cpp:8739-8926) walks A* tracking the closest valid destination (screen-dist + cost²). On success it `buildActualPath`s from that cell via the same `internalFindPath` machinery (layers, occupancy, dozerHack, tunneling, diameter).

## Leftover
`pathfind_complete/find_path.rs` `find_closest_path` (~371-619) does that search, then `request.to = to_pos; self.find_path_internal(request)` — crate `find_path_ex6` with layers/occupancy/dozerHack.

## Live
`PathfindingSystem::find_closest_path` (`pathfinding.rs`:6239-6420) finds the closest cell, then reconstructs with `self.grid.find_path(start, to_cell)` — the thin binary-blocked host A* (no crate A*, no layers, no occupancy extra, no dozerHack). Fail-open fallback is a straight `from → to_pos` line.

## Evidence
hq-9za5p closed the “allow_partial is not findClosestPath” gap by adding this closest-cell search. Reconstruction was left on the old thin A* (`hq-c23o` was closed after `find_path_via_crate` switched to crate A* — closest-path never did). Unreachable-goal fallbacks walk through buildings or ignore decks.

Player-visible: click inside a factory / across a river after exact A* fails → unit marches the thin path through walls or refuses a deck cell leftover would accept.
close_reason: find_closest_path rebuilds via crate find_path_via_crate (layers/occupancy/dozerHack); fail-open straight line removed

title: [Pathfind] snapClosestGoalPosition never runs on live arrival

title: [Pathfind] Live grid_to_world still emits Y=0
description:
## C++
Path node Z is terrain/layer height (`adjustCoordToCell` / `TerrainLogic::getLayerHeight`). Aircraft and downhill-only locos read that Z.

## Leftover
`GridCoord::to_world` (`pathfind_astar.rs`:143-147) sets `z = layer_world_height(x, y, layer)`. `world_pos_for_coord` (`line_passable.rs`:68-83) overwrites with `TheTerrainLogic::get_layer_height`. hq-ymmw closed after these leftover helpers sampled height.

Ground march ignores waypoint Y (`world_tick/movement.rs` `if !z_motive { target.y = current_pos.y }`), so infantry/tanks hide the bug. `z_motive` aircraft follow Y=0 and dive. `downhill_only_blocks_goal(current_pos.y, target_pos.y)` sees every waypoint as Y=0, so sleds treat every order as downhill.

title: [Pathfind] findClosest/findSafe skip leftover checkChangeLayers
description:
## C++
`examineNeighboringCells` calls `checkChangeLayers(parent)` (AIPathfind.cpp:6125+) before expanding XY neighbors. Same-XY connect-layer hops enqueue at parent cost so A* can step onto a bridge deck / wall from the ground cell under it. `findClosestPath` and `findSafePath` both run that neighbor loop.

## Leftover
`find_closest_path` (`find_path.rs`:547-557) and `find_safe_path` (`attack_path.rs`:757-766) enqueue `self.check_change_layers(cell)` at parent g. `pathfind_astar::find_path_with_start_layer` also calls `check_change_layers` each pop.

## Live
`find_closest_path` (`pathfinding.rs`:6362-6391) and `find_safe_path_from` (`pathfinding.rs`:6169-6198) expand only the 8 XY neighbors. No connect-layer hop. Closest/safe treat every non-goal cell as `start_layer` (`pathfinding.rs`:6317-6321 / 6105). Exact `find_path_via_crate` uses crate A* (which does hop); the closest/safe Dijkstras do not.

## Evidence
hq-54w0z closed “Live A* always starts/adjusts on LAYER_GROUND” for the crate path. Closest/safe search still cannot mark a deck cell as the closest/flee dest.

Player-visible: unit on the roadbed under a span, goal on the deck (or flee onto the span) — leftover closest/safe hops via connect-layer; live never considers the deck cell.
notes: Also live find_attack_firing_position (pathfinding.rs:5376+) never enqueues leftover/C++ checkChangeLayers. Attack A* is the same gap as closest/safe — include it in the fix.
close_reason: find_closest_path and find_safe_path_from enqueue checkChangeLayers hops at parent cost with (x,y,layer) search keys

title: [Locomotor] startMove/maintain never reset donut timer
description:
## C++
`Locomotor::startMove` (`Locomotor.cpp:761-765`) only resets `m_donutTimer = getFrame() + DONUT_TIME_DELAY_SECONDS * LOGICFRAMES_PER_SECOND` (2.5s). `AIInternalMoveToState` calls it on every new move (`AIStates.cpp:1604-1605`). `locoUpdate_maintainCurrentPosition` (`Locomotor.cpp:2420-2421`) also resets the donut timer and clears `IS_BRAKING` so a hold does not leave the next short order already expired. Wheels then (`:1405-1411`) force `IS_BRAKING` only after that window if `onPathDist < DONUT_DISTANCE` (~40wu).

## Leftover
`core_impl/maintain.rs:456-459` `start_move` resets `donut_timer`. `maintain.rs:107-110` `loco_update_maintain_current_position` resets `donut_timer` and `FLAG_IS_BRAKING`. Constructor (`locomotor.rs:94-95`) seeds `donut_timer = now + DONUT_TIME`.

## Live
`Object` construct (`construct.rs:826` / `:1703`) seeds `donut_timer: 0`. Grep of `Main/src/game_logic` shows the only writers are that ctor and `apply_cpp_approach_brake` (`physics_motion.rs:1258-1261`). No `startMove` on path install (`request_path` clears `is_braking` only, `physics.rs:1215`). `loco_maintain_current_position` (`physics.rs:647-655`) clears `is_braking` but **never** resets `donut_timer`. After any hold, or on the first short order (`on_path_dist < 40` and `logic_frame >= 0`), wheeled units immediately `IS_BRAKING` and pose-cheat. Closed hq-3ekn only added the expire check.

## Evidence
C++ `Locomotor.cpp:761-765`, `:2420-2421`, `AIStates.cpp:1604-1605`. Leftover `maintain.rs:107-110`, `:456-459`. Live `construct.rs:826`, `physics.rs:647-655`, `physics_motion.rs:1258-1261`.
close_reason: startMove/maintain reset donut_timer (MAX sentinel → frame+75); ctor and path install no longer expire the first short order

title: [Locomotor] Hover idle maintain scrubs to 0 not C++ brake force
description:
## C++
`Locomotor::maintainCurrentPositionHover` (`Locomotor.cpp:2527-2576`): `setTurning(TURN_NONE)`; if `physics->isMotive()`, compute `speedDelta = minSpeed - actualSpeed` (hover minSpeed is ~0). When `|speedDelta| > minSpeed`, apply **motive force along heading** of `mass * clamp(±accel, needed)` using `getMaxAcceleration` or `-getBraking()`. Then `handleBehaviorZ`. Helicopters bleed speed over frames; they do not teleport vel to 0.

## Leftover
`core_impl/maintain.rs:266-295` `maintain_current_position_hover` matches that accel/brake-to-minSpeed (returns acceleration, not an instant stop). Dispatcher `loco_update_maintain_current_position` (`:158-166`) requires constant calling for hover.

## Live
`Object::loco_maintain_current_position` (`physics.rs:671-678`): if `is_motive()` then **`scrub_velocity_2d(0.0)`** — instant lateral kill — then `handle_behavior_z`. `world_tick/movement.rs:771-780` idle hover/wings call this maintain. Closed hq-vvlrn is preferredHeight Y; closed hq-py0re is wings circle. Hover **stop** is leftover-right / live-wrong: Comanches/Helixes slam-stop instead of braking.

## Evidence
C++ `Locomotor.cpp:2527-2576`. Leftover `maintain.rs:268-295`. Live `physics.rs:671-675` `scrub_velocity_2d(0.0)`.
close_reason: Hover idle maintain applies C++ motive brake force along heading; no scrub_velocity_2d(0)

title: [Locomotor] Live approach-brake uses lead-point distance not distAlongPath
description:
## C++
`AIUpdate.cpp:2171-2221` `doLocomotor` calls `Path::computePointOnPath` and feeds **`info.distAlongPath + getPathExtraDistance()`** into `Locomotor::locoUpdate_moveTowardsPosition` (`Locomotor.cpp:929-1141`). That remaining-path length is what appearance movers use for `IS_BRAKING`, `braking_factor`, donut, and `calcSlowDownDist`. When actual 2D dist > onPath (and > 2× for non-projectiles) the dispatcher forces `IS_BRAKING` (`Locomotor.cpp:980-992`). Dispatcher also clears braking when `onPath > CELL && onPath > (maxSpeed/braking)*(maxSpeed)/2` (`:941-946`).

## Leftover
`GeneralsRust/Code/GameEngine/GameLogic/src/locomotor/core_impl/path_follow.rs:69-76` passes `active_path.distance_remaining()` (then max with actual 2D). `move_dispatch.rs:27-32` clears braking from max-speed stop distance; `:73-82` forces `IS_BRAKING` when `dist_2d > 2.0 * on_path_dist_to_goal`.

## Live
`world_tick/movement.rs:510` / `:541-544` calls `apply_cpp_approach_brake(dist, …)` where `dist = horiz(current, lead)`. The lead comes from `compute_point_on_path_for` (`pathfinding.rs:6493-6591`), which returns only a **Vec3 aim point** — never `distAlongPath`. So every waypoint-scale lead (~1 cell) is treated as “almost at dest”: tanks/trucks set `IS_BRAKING` mid-path, `braking_factor` explodes, pose-cheat snaps. Closed hq-9yz3f added the lead point; closed hq-iriyu added C++ brake *curves*. The **distance input** is still leftover-right / live-wrong.

## Evidence
C++ `AIUpdate.cpp:2185-2221` `onPathDistToGoal = info.distAlongPath`. Leftover `path.rs:115-116` `distance_remaining`. Live `movement.rs:541` `apply_cpp_approach_brake(dist, …)` with `dist` = lead range, not remaining path.
close_reason: Approach-brake uses distAlongPath from closest point plus dispatcher 2x raise; mid-path lead range no longer forces IS_BRAKING

description:
