title: Team common target keeps garrisoned and aircraft victims
description:
## C++
Team::getTeamTargetObject (Team.cpp:1493-1524) nulls and clears the target when:
- stealthed and not detected/disguised
- effectively dead
- getContainedBy() (entered a building or vehicle)
- KINDOF_AIRCRAFT (\"let team members acquire aircraft individually\")

## Live
host_team_common_target (world_tick/mood.rs:285-309) checks alive, stealthed+undetected+disguised, and able-to-attack. No contained_by check, no aircraft check, and it does not clear the stored id when rejected.

## Player-visible
An enemy that garrisons or boards a transport stays the whole AI team's shared target (they keep converging / fail to reacquire). An aircraft can become the shared target so the entire team chases a plane. Retail drops both so members acquire individually.
close_reason: host_team_common_target now rejects contained_by and KINDOF_AIRCRAFT and clears the stored team target id.

title: Ready-team anyIdle shortcut skips ProductionCondition script
description:
## C++
AIPlayer::checkReadyTeams (AIPlayer.cpp:2755-2761): if anyIdle && m_executeActions, it additionally requires TheScriptEngine->findScriptByName(m_productionCondition) to return a script WITH an action before forcing allIdle=true. With no/empty ProductionCondition the team still waits for allIdle (or the 60s timeout).

## Live
check_ready_teams (ai.rs:2960-2962): `if any_idle && execute_actions { all_idle = true; }` — no production_condition lookup.

## Player-visible
AI teams with ExecutesActionsOnCreate=Yes but no ProductionCondition script leave the rally as soon as ANY member is idle. Retail waits for the whole team to gather (up to 60s). Live attack waves arrive piecemeal / earlier.
close_reason: check_ready_teams anyIdle shortcut requires ProductionCondition script with an Action (AIPlayer.cpp:2755-2761).

title: GuardRetaliate inner scan rejects every structure
description:

title: Team common target ignores Easy difficulty and human players

title: Guard idle acquire uses outer vision not inner ring
description:

AIGuardMachine::lookForInnerTarget (AIGuard.cpp:246-256) scans at getStdGuardRange (OWNERTYPE|MOOD|GUARDINNER) — the inner ring only. Outer chase is a later state after an inner target is found.

Normal/FlyingUnitsOnly guards therefore open fire at full outer vision.

title: GuardingObject ignores FlyingUnitsOnly

title: GuardRetaliate chase never gives up while victim lives
description:
## C++
AIGuardRetaliate.cpp GuardRetaliateExitConditions::shouldExit (93-142): ATTACK_ExitIfExpiredDuration (m_attackGiveUpFrame = now + m_guardChaseUnitFrames, retail 4s) and ATTACK_ExitIfOutsideRadius (aggressor beyond m_radiusSqr; owner beyond stdGuardRange from center).
AttackAggressor onEnter sets give-up frame + radius. Inner/Outer states also leash (1.5x std / 0.67x(vision+std)+timer). After exit the machine RETURNS to the post.

tick_guard_retaliate (orders.rs:619-652) re-locks the victim while alive; no timer, radius, or owner leash.

A unit that retaliates when a friend is attacked chases that aggressor map-wide until it dies. Retail abandons after ~4s or when the chase leaves the guard ring and walks home.

title: Hunt scan never priority-compares or refreshes team common target
description:
## C++
AIHuntState::update (AIStates.cpp:7154-7193): when the team has m_attackCommonTarget:
- if teamVictim exists and no AttackPriorityInfo, use teamVictim
- else scan map-wide findClosestEnemy; if both teamVictim and a scanned victim exist and info is set, keep teamVictim only when its template priority >= the scanned victim's
- then setTeamTargetObject(victim) every hunt scan (can refresh or clear)

## Live
process_ai_behavior Patrolling (world_objects/ai_authority.rs:167-171) short-circuits to host_team_common_target with no priority comparison.
set_host_team_common_target is only written on AttackTarget apply (ai_authority.rs:715-716) and guard scans (support_states.rs:2979-2980), never refreshed or cleared by a hunt scan.
hq-5blr4 added the team-victim read path; the hunt-scan compare + write-back leg is still missing.

## Player-visible
An AI squad locked on a low-priority team victim (e.g. a dozer) ignores a higher-priority enemy that appears anywhere. Retail would retarget the whole team from the hunt scan. The team lock also never updates from hunt scans after the first engage.
close_reason: Hunt scan uses team victim only without AttackPriorityInfo; otherwise compares team vs scanned priority, then set_host_team_common_target every scan (refresh or clear).

title: Hunt never exits after map-clear unless unitsShouldHunt
description:
## C++
AIHuntState::update (AIStates.cpp:7201-7206): if the controlling player's getUnitsShouldHunt()==FALSE (default) and the hunt submachine is AI_IDLE with victim==NULL after a scan, return STATE_SUCCESS. That exits AI_HUNT to AI_IDLE and onExit (7099-7107) releases LOCKED_TEMPORARILY weapon locks.
Only ScriptActions::doPlayerHunt (Player.cpp:1979-1982 setUnitsShouldHunt(true)) keeps hunt alive with no victims; that path also retries findClosestEnemy without AttackPriorityInfo (AIStates.cpp:7169-7172).

## Live
process_ai_behavior Patrolling (world_objects/ai_authority.rs:164-182) only returns AttackTarget or None — never SetAIState Idle on an empty scan.
update_ai (world_tick/ai.rs:537-547) re-enters Patrolling whenever hunting && Idle && no target.
No Player.units_should_hunt field exists (only a comment at ai_authority.rs:166).
hq-mlutg closed the opposite bug (hunt dropped to Idle too soon). The stay-in-hunt latch is now unconditional, so the C++ unitsShouldHunt==FALSE exit leg has no live counterpart.

## Player-visible
After a player Hunt command clears the map, C++ units go idle and only auto-acquire inside vision. Live units stay in permanent map-wide hunt, so any later-built enemy anywhere is chased across the whole map. Scripted PLAYER_HUNT cannot stay-alive independently of a regular Hunt click.
close_reason: Patrolling hunt scan returns Idle and clears hunting + temp weapon lock when units_should_hunt is false and no victim. PLAYER_HUNT sets Player.units_should_hunt so scripted all-hunt stays alive.

title: [DemoTrap] Chem construction never applies Anthrax Gamma puddle
description:
## C++
Chem `GLADemoTrap` detonation weapon is `Chem_DemoTrapDetonationWeaponGamma` after `Chem_Upgrade_GLAAnthraxGamma` (else Beta). Gamma FireOCL is `OCL_PoisonFieldGammaMedium` / DeathType `POISONED_GAMMA`.

Comment says "gamma applied later if tags present" but no later pass exists. `create_object` (`create_destroy_die.rs:1325-1328`) uses that bind. Chem_ prefix still selects ChemBeta (250/25 + 100/50 + beta field). `place_demo_trap_named(..., has_gamma)` can set ChemGamma but production construction never calls it with player upgrades.

## Player-visible
Chem General demo traps keep the beta poison field and beta death after Anthrax Gamma is researched. Splash numbers match; death anim / puddle tier do not. Not hq-zclvx (dual-ring splash).

title: [ClusterMines] Bomb teleports over the click at 70wu instead of exiting the cargo plane
description:

`SUPERWEAPON_ClusterMines` DeliverPayload exits `ClusterMinesBomb` from `ChinaJetCargoPlane` at the plane pose when `isCloseEnoughToTarget` (DeliveryDistance **140**). `GenerateMinefieldBehavior::setMinefieldTarget` is the drop aim; the bomb object itself starts at the transport.

title: [Anthrax] Bomb teleports over the click at 70wu instead of exiting the plane at 140
description:
## C++
`DeliverPayloadAIUpdate::isCloseEnoughToTarget` (`DeliverPayloadAIUpdate.cpp:348-368`) uses 2D `DeliveryDistance` **140** (plus `PreOpenDistance` while inbound). DeliveringState exits the contained `AnthraxBomb` from the cargo plane at the plane pose + DropOffset (`:698-731`), then `SmartBombTargetHomingUpdate` steers the fall.

## Live
`HostAnthraxBombFlightData::in_delivery_band` (`host_anthrax_bomb_flight.rs:83-87`) is `dist < 5 || dist <= 140*0.5` (**70**). `update_anthrax_bomb_flights` (`special_power_flights.rs:62`) then `create_object` at `Vec3::new(target.x, 90.0, target.z)` with velocity `(0,-14,0)` — never at the plane.

## Player-visible
The bomb pops in over the click and falls straight down. It does not leave the GLA cargo plane. Plane still flies closer than retail (70 vs 140) before the fake drop. Not hq-iidqu (plane spawn behind CC) or hq-50g7z (plane parks after drop).
close_reason: HostAnthraxBombFlightData::in_delivery_band is C++ DeliveryDistance 140 (not *0.5). update_anthrax_bomb_flights create_object at plane pose + DropOffset; SmartBombTargetHomingUpdate steers. No teleport over the click at 70.

title: [Anthrax] Gamma science still drops base bomb + POISONED_BETA field
description:
## C++
`SUPERWEAPON_AnthraxBombGamma` DeliverPayload Payload=`AnthraxBombGamma`; FireOCL `OCL_PoisonFieldAnthraxGammaBomb`. Residual table: `FX_AnthraxGammaBomb` / `AnthraxGammaBombExplosion`. ## Live

title: AA missiles fly through buildings instead of detonating
description:
## C++
WeaponTemplate::shouldProjectileCollideWith (GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Object/Weapon.cpp:642-734): intended victim always collides. Default m_collideMask is STRUCTURES only (Weapon.cpp:273). Intervening structures therefore detonate the shot. The only airborne special case (679-699) is KINDOF_FS_AIRFIELD when ParkingPlaceBehavior::hasReservedSpace(intendedVictimID) — parked-plane shots must not hit the airfield invisible collision. Burned flame/particle-beam targets and sneaky-offset units are also skipped. Other buildings still collide.

## Live
CombatSystem::update_projectiles_with_relationships (GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/game_logic/combat.rs:1531-1566) intercepts intervening KindOf::Structure when projectile_collides_structures. Then: if the intended target is KindOf::Aircraft or airborne_target, continue skips EVERY structure. That is not the airfield reserved-space test. Wave 19 noted this as subsumed by the airfield special; it is broader.

## Player-visible
Patriot / Stinger / Quad Cannon / Comanche AA missiles aimed at jets fly through War Factories, Command Centers, and other buildings and only detonate on the aircraft (or miss). C++ detonates on the first structure in the path (except the plane own airfield pad).
close_reason: Live host: estimateWeaponTemplateDamage applies residual armor; Jarmen rifle-mode skips KILLPILOT cursor; AA projectiles detonate on intervening buildings (airfield reserved-space only).

title: estimateWeaponDamage skips armor so Pathfinder/Jarmen shoot tanks
description:
## C++
`WeaponTemplate::estimateWeaponTemplateDamage` (GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Object/Weapon.cpp:625-637) ends by calling `victimObj->estimateDamage`. `ActiveBody::estimateDamage` (ActiveBody.cpp:264-292) applies `m_curArmor.adjustDamage` after the SNIPER/UC and KILL_GARRISONED specials. TankArmor/StructureArmor SNIPER coefficient is 0% (`host_armor_residual.rs` documents the retail table). `ActionManager::canFireWeaponAtObject` (ActionManager.cpp:1960-1962) and `WeaponSet::getAbleToUseWeaponAgainstTarget` / `chooseBestWeaponForTarget` (WeaponSet.cpp:701-702, 845-856) refuse the shot when estimate is 0.

## Live
`estimate_weapon_template_damage` (GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/game_logic/weapon_bootstrap/estimate.rs:37-81) ports the shrubbery/empty-structure/disarm/deploy/kill-garrisoned specials from hq-pg1q1, then returns raw `primary_damage`. It never calls `apply_residual_armor` / leftover `estimate_damage`. `get_able_to_use_weapon_against_target` (world_tick/mood.rs:812-829) treats estimate > 0 as a legal shot. Unit test at weapon_bootstrap/tests.rs:1349-1353 even asserts occupied-structure SNIPER estimate > 0.

hq-pg1q1 (closed) only added the empty/UC specials. hq-bktz3 (closed) fixed leftover crate `estimate_damage`, not this live gate.

## Player-visible
Pathfinder and Jarmen Kell get an attack cursor on tanks, trucks, and finished buildings and will fire. C++ shows no cursor and will not auto-acquire those (0 after armor). Shots play muzzle FX and deal 0 HP (take_damage still applies armor). Dual-weapon units also pick by raw damage instead of post-armor estimate.
close_reason: Live host: estimateWeaponTemplateDamage applies residual armor; Jarmen rifle-mode skips KILLPILOT cursor; AA projectiles detonate on intervening buildings (airfield reserved-space only).

title: Jarmen rifle mode still gets vehicle attack cursor via KILLPILOT
description:
## C++
`WeaponSet::getAbleToUseWeaponAgainstTarget` (GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Object/WeaponSet.cpp:698-712) walks weapons and accepts the first with `estimateWeaponDamage != 0`. Kris 2003-08-22 special: if `weapon->getDamageType() == DAMAGE_KILLPILOT && source->isKindOf(KINDOF_HERO) && m_curWeapon == PRIMARY_WEAPON && specificSlot == -1`, skip that weapon. Comment: Jarmen Kell must not get a targeting cursor on enemy vehicles unless he is in snipe mode. `chooseBestWeaponForTarget` does NOT have this skip (hq-7djpu closed the mistaken live chooseBest skip).

Retail Jarmen WeaponSet SECONDARY is `GLAJarmenKellVehiclePilotSniperRifle` (DAMAGE_KILLPILOT, estimate 1 vs TankArmor). Rifle-mode PRIMARY estimate vs tanks is 0 after armor, so without the skip the secondary would still light the cursor.

## Live

No KILLPILOT + Hero + current-PRIMARY skip. AutoChooseSources NONE (hq-houcd) only stops `select_combat_weapon_slot` from auto-firing snipe; the cursor/able-to-attack gate still sees slot 1. `create_destroy_die.rs` installs `template.resolve_secondary_weapon()` from the Object.ini WeaponSet.

Selecting Jarmen Kell in rifle mode and hovering a tank/Humvee shows the attack cursor (and RMB issues an attack). C++ shows no attack until the player uses Snipe Vehicle (locks SECONDARY).

title: [Audio] Named-object TheAudio resolver drops host height so 3D sounds sit at sea level
description:
## C++
`doSoundPlayFromNamed` (`ScriptActions.cpp:2723-2733`) attaches `AudioEventRTS` to `pUnit->getID()`. Miles follows the object's full Coord3D (x, y_ground, z_height). ENABLE/DISABLE uses the drawable at that same pose.

## Live
Host objects are not leftover `TheGameLogic`. `GameLogicAudioEventOwnerResolver::resolve_object_position` (`GameLogic/src/helpers/audio.rs:67-73`) falls back to `host_script_query_object_by_id`. `HostScriptQueryObject` (`scripting/conditions/helpers.rs:56-61`) stores only ground `x`/`z` — no height. The resolver writes C++ `(x, y_ground, z_height)` as `(obj.x, obj.z, 0.0)`. Object-follow named sounds and leftover TheAudio 3D therefore sit at sea level, not the unit (aircraft, hilltop factories).

hq-zos07 close only claimed XZ→XY so sounds are not at origin. Height is still dropped.

## Player-visible
Scripted unit-attached SFX come from underground / sea level. On high terrain or from aircraft they are too quiet, wrongly panned, or culled by maxDistance while the unit is on screen.
close_reason: HostScriptQueryObject now stores host Y-up height; inject copies obj.position.y; TheAudio resolver writes C++ (x, y_ground, z_height) as (obj.x, obj.z, obj.y).

title: [EVA] BuildingLost/UnitLost uses faction Team, not isLocallyControlled
description:
## C++
`Object::onDie` (`Object.cpp:4595-4606`): only if `isLocallyControlled() && !selfInflicted`. STRUCTURE+MP_COUNT_FOR_VICTORY → `EVA_BuldingLost`; INFANTRY/VEHICLE → `EVA_UnitLost` + fake radar ping. `isLocallyControlled` is the object's controlling player == local player, not faction.

## Live
Stolen/sabotage EVA already uses `is_object_locally_controlled` (`eva_camera.rs:424-475`). Death does not: `try_eva_on_local_object_death` (`eva_camera.rs:376-387`) treats local as any `p.is_local && p.team == victim_team` (`Team` is USA/China/GLA, `host_types.rs:23-26`) and treats `killer == Some(victim_team)` as self-inflicted. Same-faction ally deaths fire UnitLost/BuildingLost; same-faction teamkills of your units are skipped as self-inflicted.

Not hq-8udzn (under-attack own/ally, already switched to owner_player_id + getRelationship). Not hq-4cv3 (MP_COUNT_FOR_VICTORY parse).

## Player-visible
USA 2v2 / same-faction ally: EVA says \"unit lost\" / \"building lost\" when the ally dies. Your own unit killed by that ally is silent. Retail only announces your own losses.
close_reason: try_eva_on_local_object_death uses is_object_locally_controlled; self-inflicted is last_damage_source == victim_id, not same-faction Team.

title: [Audio] SOUND_PLAY_NAMED plays twice — leftover TheAudio plus live drain
description:
## C++
ScriptActions.cpp:2723-2733 `doSoundPlayFromNamed`: one `AudioEventRTS(soundName, pUnit->getID())` + `setIsLogicalAudio(true)` + a single `TheAudio->addAudioEvent`. No second presentation enqueue.

## Live
Leftover `do_sound_play_named` (`GameLogic/src/scripting/executor/actions_world.rs:51-69`) always queues `HostScriptObjectSoundRequest::PlayNamed` then calls `MissionScriptActionHandler::sound_play_named` (`mission_scripts.rs:2622-2636`) which `TheAudio->add_audio_event`s (object id + logical). Same-frame `apply_host_object_sound_script_requests` (`move_ambient_audio.rs:207-226`) then `queue_audio_event`s the same name. `process_audio_events` (`scripts_camera.rs:238-266`) drains that into `AudioManagerSubsystem`, which `play_sound_through_the_audio_at` (`assets/audio.rs:170-177`) adds to the same leftover TheAudio again. Common TheAudio is updated every live frame (`host_update_the_audio`) and plays via rodio.

Not a refile of closed hq-zos07 (that was leftover-only / origin). After that fix stacked with TheAudio now actually playing, the extra live enqueue is a second copy.

## Player-visible
Campaign/script `SOUND_PLAY_NAMED` (cheer, explosion, unit-attached line) is heard twice — one object-attached 3D and one snapshot-position copy.
close_reason: SOUND_PLAY_NAMED is one TheAudio add: leftover no longer queues PlayNamed; live play_sound_from_named and apply_host PlayNamed do not enqueue a second presentation copy.

title: Guard Area is a vision circle, not the polygon trigger
description:
## C++
AIUpdateInterface::privateGuardArea (AIUpdate.cpp:4094-4116) stores the PolygonTrigger, sets m_locationToGuard to its center, and enters AI_GUARD.
AIGuardMachine::lookForInnerTarget (AIGuard.cpp:208-256): when getAreaToGuard() is set, PartitionFilterPolygonTrigger keeps only objects inside the polygon, visionRange = area->getRadius() (polygon bounding radius), pos = area center. Scan is also gated on trigger-area dirty + m_guardEnemyScanRate.

## Live
execute_guard_area (command_executor/attack.rs:295-315) is documented as \"area approximated as position + radius\". It issues GuardTarget::Position(center) and unit_command_set_guard_radius(radius.max(80)).
update_support_states GuardingArea (world_objects/support_states.rs:2874-2940) then ignores that radius whenever host_std_guard_ranges returns a mood-adjusted vision inner/outer, and iterates every object within acquire_radius of the anchor. No PolygonTrigger / point_in_trigger test.

hq-pffa4 restored the area-center anchor. hq-6hfe added the group Guard-Area command. Neither applies the polygon.

## Player-visible
TEAM_GUARD_AREA / Guard Area on an irregular or large map trigger does not match retail. Units engage enemies outside the polygon but inside vision of the center, and they never cover far corners of a large trigger whose bounding radius exceeds vision. Campaign \"guard this area\" squads hold a circle at the centroid instead of the authored shape.
close_reason: Live-host AI guard: polygon trigger, retaliate chase give-up, inner acquire, FlyingUnitsOnly object guard, RejectBuildings structure scan

title: Live try_to_recruit skips team priority, isActive, and isRecruitable
description:
## C++
Team::tryToRecruit (Team.cpp:2312-2376) walks every object and only steals a match when:
- template isEquivalentTo or a build-variation
- same controlling player
- source team isActive (do not steal from a team still building)
- source productionPriority < dest productionPriority
- team is recruitable (default team, or m_isAIRecruitable, or per-team m_isRecruitablitySet/m_isRecruitable)
- AIUpdateInterface::isRecruitable() is true
- not DISABLED_HELD
- within maxDist of team home (default team is a fallback even if farther)

## Live
Leftover GameLogic/src/team/team_members.rs:141-239 ports those filters, but dual_world_registry_unavailable() makes it return None on the live host.
Live AIPlayer::try_to_recruit_excluding (Main/src/ai.rs:4035-4071) only checks: same player/team, alive, not Structure, not contained_by, exact template_name, not already assigned, within max_dist. No isActive, no productionPriority, no team recruitable flags, no per-unit isRecruitable (Main Object has no such field), no build-variations.

hq-1g58t was closed claiming live skips !is_recruitable; current live try_to_recruit_excluding has no such test. hq-ei2qo/hq-amznw covered missing recruit and HELD steal.

## Player-visible
Skirmish AI steals units off higher-priority or still-building teams, and off teams/units marked not recruitable. Build-variation templates (e.g. AmericaTankCrusader vs a variation name) are never recruited, so those teams train new copies instead of grabbing idle matches.
close_reason: Live try_to_recruit_excluding now honors isActive, productionPriority, team recruitable flags, per-unit is_recruitable, DISABLED_HELD, and leftover isEquivalentTo/BuildVariations. Default-team fallback beyond maxDist matches Team.cpp:2361-2370.

title: [Locomotor] SmoothRelativeToHighestLayer uses ground height not bridge layer
description:
## C++
`handleBehaviorZ` `Z_SMOOTH_RELATIVE_TO_HIGHEST_LAYER` (`Locomotor.cpp:2248-2285`): if not already on a non-ground layer, `TheTerrainLogic->getHighestLayerForDestination` then `getLayerHeight` (bridges, clip=false). Lift force targets preferredHeight + that layer height so flyers ride over bridge decks.

## Live
`LocomotorBehaviorZ::SmoothRelativeToHighestLayer` is bound (`locomotor_bootstrap.rs:809-810`) but treated identically to `SurfaceRelativeHeight`. `update_movement` (`world_tick/movement.rs:206-214`) only special-cases `RelativeToGroundAndBuildings` for `ground_or_structure_height_at`; SmoothRelative gets `surface_ht_at` (`world_save.rs:614-624`) which is water-or-terrain ground. `handle_behavior_z` (`object/physics.rs:589-613`) never calls leftover `getHighestLayerForDestination`.

## Player-visible
Aircraft/locos authored with ZAxisBehavior = RELATIVE_TO_HIGHEST_LAYER clip through or fly under bridges instead of climbing to the deck.
close_reason: SmoothRelativeToHighestLayer queries leftover TheTerrainLogic getHighestLayerForDestination + getLayerHeight(clip=false). update_movement and apply_live_handle_behavior_z use that surface so flyers ride bridge decks.

title: [Physics] Vehicle-building crash still deals 100 Explosive not INI weapon
description:
## C++
`PhysicsBehavior::onCollide` (`PhysicsUpdate.cpp:1353-1373`): when a vehicle falls into an immobile other (`delta.z < 0` and height >= `m_defaultStructureRubbleHeight`), a structure fires `m_vehicleCrashesIntoBuildingWeaponTemplate` via `TheWeaponStore->createAndFireTempWeapon` then `destroyObject`. Non-building immobile fires the non-building template (no destroy). Templates default to VehicleCrashesIntoBuildingWeapon / VehicleCrashesIntoNonBuildingWeapon (OCL/FX).

## Live
`apply_vehicle_crash_into_immobile` (`GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/game_logic/world_tick/physics.rs:556-621`) gates the same way via `evaluate_vehicle_crash_into`, then does `const CRASH_DAMAGE: f32 = 100.0` as Explosive `take_damage_from_typed`. The INI weapon name is only queued as an audio event. Comment: \"Fail-closed vs full WeaponStore::createAndFireTempWeapon OCL/FX matrix\". Leftover `physics_collide::on_collide` can fire the INI weapon only if leftover OBJECT_REGISTRY has the pair; live host objects typically are not there. Closed hq-0736 was leftover-only.

## Player-visible
Cars/tanks falling into buildings take a flat 100 explosive instead of the authored crash weapon (explosion FX, OCL debris, guaranteed destroy). Non-building crashes also miss their weapon.
close_reason: apply_vehicle_crash_into_immobile fires VehicleCrashesIntoBuilding/NonBuilding via GameLogic::create_and_fire_temp_weapon then destroyObject for structures. Removed flat 100 Explosive.

title: [Locomotor] Formation move never applies group getSpeed desired speed
description:
## C++
`AIMoveToState::onEnter` (`AIStates.cpp:2035-2040`) when `getFormationID() != NO_FORMATION_ID`: `ai->setDesiredSpeed(group->getSpeed())`. Same for team/column follow (`AIStates.cpp:3258-3260`, `:4030-4046`, `:4280-4304`). `AIGroup::getSpeed` is the slowest healthy (better than REALLYDAMAGED) member. Locomotor then uses that desired speed instead of FAST_AS_POSSIBLE, so mixed formations stay together.

## Live
`CommandExecutor::group_speed` (`command_executor/group.rs:127-176`) matches C++ getSpeed and is unit-tested, but production never calls it. `execute_move_formation_to_position` (`command_executor/movement.rs:1037-1078`) paths each member at full `effective_max_speed()`. Live `update_movement` (`world_tick/movement.rs:406`) always uses `effective_max_speed()`; leftover `object/update.rs:260` multiplies `group_speed_factor` but that path is unused by host tick.

## Player-visible
Ctrl-G formation of Rangers + Humvee/Crusader shears apart: vehicles race ahead at full speed, infantry lag, the stamped formation dissolves while moving. Same for team/column waypoint follow.
close_reason: Formation/team/column moves stamp group_speed_factor from CommandExecutor::group_speed (AIGroup::getSpeed). apply_do_locomotor_blocked_speed applies that desired speed instead of FAST_AS_POSSIBLE.

title: [Physics] Live physics_get_mass still hull-only — loaded transports toss like empty
description:
## C++
`PhysicsBehavior::getMass` (`PhysicsUpdate.cpp:1073-1080`) is `m_mass + contain->getContainedItemsMass()`. `OpenContain::getContainedItemsMass` (`OpenContain.cpp:743-754`) sums each rider's `PhysicsBehavior::getMass()`. Used by applyForce, friction, bounce, fall damage, collide push, and locomotor lift (`handleBehaviorZ` lift * getMass).

## Live
`Object::physics_get_mass` (`GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/game_logic/object/physics.rs:354-357`) is `self.physics_mass.max(1.0e-4)` only. No walk of `occupants`. Leftover crate `mass_with_cargo` (`physics_update.rs:346-356`) is not called from the live host. Closed hq-lwl2d claimed this was wired; current live host still has hull-only getMass.

## Player-visible
Loaded Chinook/Humvee/Battle Bus/Overlord toss, bounce, and take falling damage as if empty. Shockwave flings a full transport the same distance as an empty hull.
close_reason: Live Object::physics_get_mass is hull + contained_items_mass. GameLogic::sync_contained_items_mass walks occupants (recursive getMass) each physics tick and after contain changes.

title: [ControlBar] Garrison/transport inventory missing occupant portraits
description:

GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameClient/GUI/ControlBar/ControlBarCommand.cpp:67-111 populateInvDataCallback and ControlBarStructureInventory.cpp:44-72 populateButtonProc walk each contained object, set GadgetButtonSetEnabledImage(template->getButtonImage()), draw calculateVeterancyOverlayForObject, bind m_containData.objectID, and enable the slot. title: [ControlBar] SCRIPT_DISABLED / UNMANNED hide as Restricted not Hidden
description:
## C++
GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameClient/GUI/ControlBar/ControlBarCommand.cpp:1020-1030
getCommandAvailability returns COMMAND_HIDDEN (entire command set gone) when OBJECT_STATUS_SCRIPT_DISABLED or OBJECT_STATUS_SCRIPT_UNPOWERED, and when DISABLED_UNMANNED. description:

title: [ControlBar] Presentation QueueUpgrade never CantAfford / affectedByUpgrade
description:

GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameClient/GUI/ControlBar/ControlBarCommand.cpp:1204-1264
PLAYER_UPGRADE and OBJECT_UPGRADE are separate. OBJECT_UPGRADE returns CANT_AFFORD (keeps color) if the object already has the upgrade, it is in queue, or affectedByUpgrade() is false. PLAYER_UPGRADE checks player complete / in-production only. Missing science or cannot afford is RESTRICTED (gray).

title: [ControlBar] NEED_SPECIAL_POWER_SCIENCE hide uses empty leftover PlayerList
description:
## C++
GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameClient/GUI/ControlBar/ControlBarCommand.cpp:329-343
populateCommand hides NEED_SPECIAL_POWER_SCIENCE buttons when power->getRequiredScience() != SCIENCE_INVALID and the local player does not have that science. Spectre / Leaflet / Ambush / etc. stay off the Command Center strip until purchased.

On the live host leftover PlayerList starts empty (player/list.rs:14-18) and is only filled in leftover tests — start_game never adds live GameLogic players. Empty local player returns early without hiding. sync_sciences_from_presentation updates leftover science_state (purchase UI) only; it is not consulted here. title: [Pathfind] Occupancy stamp is Chebyshev selection_radius, not getRadiusAndCenter
description:
## C++
`Pathfinder::updatePos` / `updateGoal` (`AIPathfind.cpp:9921-10025`, `:9701-9797`) stamp a square from `getRadiusAndCenter` (`:9670-9696`): diameter = 2*boundingCircle, bump mid-size to 2 cells, `iRadius = floor(d/cell+0.3)`, odd → center-in-cell, then `iRadius/=2`, **MAX_RADIUS=2**. Infantry with circle < 10wu get radius 0 / center true → **one cell** (`i` from `x` to `x+1`).

## Live
`update_dynamic_obstacles_ignoring` (`pathfinding.rs:2141-2190`) stamps
`radius_cells = ceil(selection_radius / grid_size)` (structures max with 1) as inclusive Chebyshev `-r..=r`. `radius_and_center` exists (`:2540-2561`) and is used for A* diameter / aircraft **goal** stamps, not pos/goal occupancy.

Authored units set `selection_radius` from `bounding_circle_radius()` (`object/construct.rs:68-72`). Infantry r≈5–8, cell=10 → `ceil=1` → **3×3 cells**. C++ stamps 1.

## Player-visible
Every ranger/red-guard blob occupies a 3-cell-wide corridor. Non-crushers (dozers, humvees, other vehicles) take wide detours around idle infantry that C++ treats as a single cell. Group-move stacking and crush-through corridors look wrong.
close_reason: Live update_dynamic_obstacles pos/goal stamps getRadiusAndCenter square (MAX_RADIUS=2). Infantry circle<cell is one cell, not Chebyshev 3x3.

title: [Pathfind] Landing dest is single-cell — ignores aircraft radius and Obstacle
description:
## C++
`Pathfinder::checkForLanding` (`AIPathfind.cpp:5228-5247`) rejects Cliff/Water/Impassable at the candidate, then `checkDestination(NULL, cellX, cellY, layer, iRadius, center)` (`:4900-4964`). `iRadius`/`center` come from `getRadiusAndCenter` of the landing aircraft (`:5255-5257`, `:9670-9696`). The footprint scan refuses CELL_OBSTACLE, IS_IMPASSABLE (Obstacle / BridgeImpassable / Impassable), any ground UNIT_GOAL, and off-map cells. `adjustToLandingDestination` (`:5253-5321`) spirals that check (MAX 400). ChinookAIUpdate.cpp:239 is the caller.

## Live
`PathfindingGrid::check_for_landing` (`pathfinding.rs:2432-2451`) tests **one cell**: Cliff/Water/Impassable, other `goalAircraft`, any ground goal, and a fixed occupant. No `getRadiusAndCenter` footprint. Does not reject CELL_OBSTACLE or CELL_BRIDGE_IMPASSABLE as terrain.

`adjust_to_landing_destination` (`:2455-2508`, wrapper `:3431-3446`) never takes unit radius. `adjust_landing_destination_for` (`:3450-3461`) used by `tick_chinook_ai` (`special_power_flights.rs:1928-1934`) only sets `query_seeker_id`.

Leftover `pathfind_complete/hierarchical.rs:54-92` already scans `radius` via `is_destination_valid`. Live host does not call it.

## Player-visible
Two Chinooks/Comanches land overlapping (center cells free, hulls collide). Aircraft accept LZ cells that are building/obstacle/bridge-rail as long as the single center is not Water/Cliff/Impassable.
close_reason: Live check_for_landing/adjust_landing_destination_for use getRadiusAndCenter footprint; checkDestination(NULL) refuses Obstacle/Impassable/BridgeImpassable/UNIT_GOAL/off-map.

title: [Pathfind] Live yield still shoves 20wu — leftover getMoveAwayFromPath unused
description:
## C++
`AIUpdateInterface::privateMoveAwayFromUnit` (`AIUpdate.cpp:3187-3238`) requires the incoming unit's path, then `Pathfinder::getMoveAwayFromPath` (`AIPathfind.cpp:10171-10338`) A*s to a cell whose clearance box does not overlap the avoided path segments (`LineInRegion` vs optimized nodes). Destination must pass `checkDestination`. The resulting path is installed and `AI_MOVE_OUT_OF_THE_WAY` runs 10s.

`Pathfinder::moveAllies` (`AIPathfind.cpp:10088-10164`) then calls `aiMoveAwayFromUnit` on idle allies occupying the new route.

## Live
`Object::ai_move_away_from_unit` (`physics_motion.rs:17-58`) still does `dest = pos + dir * (2 * PATHFIND_CELL_SIZE)` and a `velocity += 0.5` nudge. Comment: "No full pathfinder".

`world_tick/movement.rs:104-123` (moveAllies) and `world_tick/physics.rs:363-364` (collision) call that shove. `move_away_destination` is never turned into a path (only `is_safe_path` / repulsors use `find_safe_path`).

Leftover crate already has `get_move_away_from_path_result` (`pathfind_complete/classify.rs:263+`). **Zero Main callers.** Closed `hq-x3x4t` claimed live wired this; that close was leftover-only.

## Player-visible
Idle friends told to yield twitch ~20wu (often into water/buildings/each other) instead of walking a legal cell off the incoming route. Tanks still ram parked allies.
close_reason: Live PathfindingSystem::get_move_away_from_path A*s to a legal cell (box vs avoided path segments, checkDestination). moveAllies + collision install that path; no dest=pos+dir*20wu shove.

title: [FX] RayEffect never instantiates the template drawable
description:
## C++
`W3DGameClient::createRayEffectByTemplate` (`GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngineDevice/Source/W3DDevice/GameClient/W3DGameClient.cpp:122-143`) calls `TheThingFactory->newDrawable(tmpl)`, places the drawable at the ray midpoint, then `TheRayEffects->addRayEffect(draw, start, end)`.
The authored template (Paladin point-defense, Tesla, Particle Cannon, scripted lasers) carries `LaserUpdate` + `W3DLaserDraw` (Inner/OuterBeamWidth, colors, textures, MaxIntensityLifetime, FadeLifetime). The beam is that drawable, not a generic sprite.

`FXList.cpp:246-262` RayEffectFXNugget only calls `createRayEffectByTemplate`.

## Live
`create_ray_effect_by_template` (`GeneralsRust/Code/GameEngine/GameClient/src/effects/ray_effect_system.rs:93-125`) never creates a ThingFactory drawable. It allocates a synthetic `drawable_id` and stores endpoints.
`fx_list_ray_lifetime_frames` (`ray_effect_system.rs:34-36`) ignores the template and always returns (15, 3) frames.
`RayEffectFXNugget::do_fx_pos` (`fx_list.rs:1323-1338`) also `RayEffectManager::spawn`s a leftover generic config; Main present never draws that manager.
`ParticleRenderer::render_tracer_and_ray_fx` (`particle_renderer.rs:1344-1358`) draws every live ray as one additive billboard with hardcoded color `[0.85, 0.95, 1.0]` and width `0.4 * alpha`.

## Player-visible
FXList rays (Paladin point defense, Tesla arcs, Particle Cannon, scripted lasers) look like thin generic cyan streaks that always last 18 frames, instead of the authored laser mesh/width/color/texture and LaserUpdate lifetime.

Distinct from closed hq-y16zq (nuggets never submitted — submit now happens; the submitted primitive is still not the template drawable).
close_reason: C++ live-host FX/shadow parity on player path. See local://wave21-fix-16.md

title: [Shadow] Main present never submits volumetric stencil volumes
description:
## C++
`DoShadows` (`W3DShadow.cpp:43-69`) on the stencil pass calls `W3DVolumetricShadowManager::renderShadows`: Carmack reverse (z-fail INCR/DECR) then `renderStencilShadows` fills a `0x7fa0a0a0` quad where stencil != 0. Default `addShadow` type is `SHADOW_VOLUME`. Tanks, buildings, and most vehicles cast sun-extruded silhouette volumes that darken the ground and neighboring geometry.

## Live
Leftover `W3DVolumetricShadowManager::submit_stencil_pass` (`GeneralsRust/Code/GameEngine/GameEngineDevice/src/w3d/shadow_system.rs:1043-1054`) is still an empty comment: "In a full wgpu implementation this would: 1. Begin render pass... 3. For each shadow volume, draw indexed triangles... 4. draw shadow-darkening quad".
Main is the sole present path (`enqueue_client_effect_draw` in `forward_render.rs:305-468`). It draws particles, tracers/rays, weather, projected-decal quads, and heat-haze. It never calls leftover `DoShadows` / `render_shadows` / `submit_stencil_pass` / `shadow_overlay`.
`shadow_pass.rs` comments claim volumetric volumes write stencil then a `0x7fa0a0a0` fill; the file only collects projected decals + occlusion overlay structs. `collect_occlusion_overlays` is unused by Main (occlusion uses `occlusion_bridge` instead).

## Player-visible
Units, vehicles, and buildings still cast no sun-side volumetric stencil shadows. Only the untextured projected-decal quads (see sibling bead) can appear under them.

Remaining after closed hq-ln3m, whose close claimed leftover CPU silhouette/volume construction. CPU volumes still never reach the live wgpu present path.
close_reason: C++ live-host FX/shadow parity on player path. See local://wave21-fix-16.md

title: [Shadow] Projected/decal shadows are untextured flat XY quads
description:
## C++
`W3DProjectedShadowManager::queueDecal` (`GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngineDevice/Source/W3DDevice/GameClient/Shadow/W3DProjectedShadow.cpp:787-920+`) walks the heightmap under the object's oriented decal box, lifts bridge layers by `BRIDGE_OFFSET_FACTOR`, writes `SHADOW_DECAL_VERTEX` (xyz + diffuse + uv) using the authored `ShadowTexture` / `m_ShadowName`, and `flushDecals` draws modulate / alpha / additive by `ShadowType`.

## Live
`ProjectedShadowManager::collect_render_items` (`GeneralsRust/Code/GameEngine/GameClient/src/radius_decal.rs:162-184`) emits `DecalRenderItem { position, size, rotation, color }` only — `shadow_name` / texture is dropped.
`ParticleRenderer::render_decals` (`particle_renderer.rs:1484-1581`) builds a single axis-aligned-then-rotated XY quad at `z + 0.01` with no UVs, then binds `self.default_bind_group` for every decal. No heightmap sample, no ShadowTexture, no modulate-vs-alpha-vs-additive by ShadowType.

Main `enqueue_client_effect_draw` (`forward_render.rs:426-449`) flushes these items as the live unit/radius shadow path.

## Player-visible
Unit blob/decal shadows and radius rings are flat colored squares hovering at a constant Z, all using the default particle texture. Authored ShadowTexture (infantry vs tank vs building blobs) never appears, and shadows do not drape over hills, ramps, or bridges.

Distinct from closed hq-fmsy (decals never submitted — they now submit; the submitted mesh/texture is still not C++ queueDecal).
close_reason: C++ live-host FX/shadow parity on player path. See local://wave21-fix-16.md

title: [Save] Live CHUNK_ParticleSystem is NullSnapshot — mid-flight explosions vanish
description:
## C++
ParticleSystemManager::xfer (ParticleSys.cpp:3232-3323) writes uniqueSystemID, systemCount, then each saveable ParticleSystem (template name + ParticleSystem::xfer). isDestroyed / !isSaveable systems write an empty name and skip. GameState::init registers CHUNK_ParticleSystem (GameState.cpp:303). After load, in-flight explosions, smoke, fire, and attached FX continue.

title: [Production] Factory spawn jitters UnitCreatePoint by selection radius
description:
## C++
QueueProductionExitUpdate::exitObjectViaDoor (QueueProductionExitUpdate.cpp:66-85) and DefaultProductionExitUpdate::exitObjectViaDoor (DefaultProductionExitUpdate.cpp:60-72) place the new unit at the exact transformed UnitCreatePoint (Queue snaps Z only when not AllowAirborneCreation; Default always snaps Z to layer height). Anti-stack for Red Guards is a **doubled natural-rally waypoint** (Queue cpp:129-131), not a spawn-position offset.

## Live
GENERALS_GAMEWORLD_PRODUCTION_AUTHORITY defaults **off** (gameworld_shadow/tick/authority.rs:234-241), so the playable host uses the non-sole path. host_apply_production_spawn_ready_completions (world_tick/production.rs:1467-1591) then does spawn_pos += jitter_dir * selection_radius (sin/cos of spawn coords) whenever !sole && !parked_jet, after UnitCreatePoint was already applied. Comment at production.rs:1463-1466 calls this "host stacking jitter residual". Sole-tick (env opt-in) skips it.

## Player-visible
Rangers, Red Guards, tanks, and collectors pop ~4–8wu beside the factory door instead of at the authored UnitCreatePoint, then walk the rally path. C++ units emerge from the door; live units appear offset in a hash-based ring around it. Red Guard de-stack still also doubles the natural rally, so the jitter is extra invented motion.
close_reason: Live host_apply_production_spawn_ready_completions no longer offsets UnitCreatePoint by selection_radius. C++ Queue/Default exitObjectViaDoor place at the exact transformed create point; anti-stack is the doubled natural-rally waypoint. Parked jets and sole-tick GW pose unchanged. Leftover queue_production_exit already matched C++.

title: [Production] One-shot supply collector skips ExitInterface
description:
## C++
SpawnBehavior::createSpawn (SpawnBehavior.cpp:585-705) always uses parent->getObjectExitInterface()->reserveDoorForExit + exitObjectViaDoor. On a Supply Center / Stash that interface is SupplyCenterProductionExitUpdate::exitObjectViaDoor (SupplyCenterProductionExitUpdate.cpp:41-128): place at transformed UnitCreatePoint, snap Z to ground, set producer orientation, walk natural rally (raw INI point, no 2-cell offset) then custom rally, forceWanting on SupplyTruckAI, then GrantTemporaryStealth when the producer is OBJECT_STATUS_STEALTHED and (isTemporaryGrant || !CAN_STEALTH). Retail GLA stash authors GrantTemporaryStealth=20000ms→600f on this exit module. Distinct from paid ProductionUpdate completions (hq-pw7hn, closed) and dock deposit grant (hq-53bo, closed).

## Live
spawn_supply_center_one_shot_collector (create_destroy_die.rs:222-321), called from on_supply_center_build_complete and create_object, never records host_production_spawn_ready_log and never calls grant_supply_center_exit_temporary_stealth. It create_object_for_player at the **center position** (not UnitCreatePoint), path_approach_with_state to natural_rally_point_with_path_offset (C++ supply exit does not offset), then force_supply_center_collector_wanting only. production.rs:1676-1682 comments claim the shared spawn-ready path covers one-shot SpawnBehavior; this function never enters that path.

## Player-visible
The free starter Chinook / Supply Truck / Worker that appears when a Supply Center or GLA Stash finishes construction pops out of the building's origin (clipping the model) instead of the authored door, ignores a custom rally, and — from a stealthed GLA Stash (Camo Netting / Stealth General) — walks out fully visible for the 20s cloak window. C++ cloaks and exits that first collector through the same door as a paid one.
close_reason: One-shot SpawnBehavior starter collector now uses ExitInterface: UnitCreatePoint + Z-snap, host_production_spawn_ready_log + ApplySpawnReadyCompletions (raw natural rally, no 2-cell offset, custom rally, forceWanting), then GrantTemporaryStealth when the producer is STEALTHED.

title: [Save] Load failure never shows GUI:ErrorLoadingGame
description:
## C++
GameState::loadGame (GameState.cpp:695-712) on xfer or loadPostProcess failure: clearGameData, reset engine, then MessageBoxOk(TheGameText->fetch(\"GUI:Error\"), format(GUI:ErrorLoadingGame, filepath)). The player always gets a modal when a .sav is corrupt or unreadable.

## Live
host_save_game_authority already surfaces GUI:GameSaveComplete / GUI:ErrorSavingGame (hq-j0ifi). host_load_game_from_ui (host_authority.rs:1709-1716) on Err only logs \"Load failed\" and returns Err(err) — no MessageBoxOk, no TheInGameUI::message, no GUI:ErrorLoadingGame. host_load_game_authority (host_authority.rs:1403-1430) likewise returns a String error with no UI.

## Player-visible
A missing, truncated, or non-host CHUNK_GameLogic save fails silently from the player's point of view (or only a console/log line). C++ always pops GUI:Error / GUI:ErrorLoadingGame with the filepath. Not hq-j0ifi (save-complete / save-error only).
close_reason: Load failure shows MessageBoxOk(GUI:Error, format(GUI:ErrorLoadingGame, filepath)) via surface_load_game_ui_feedback on host_load_game_authority, same path as save-error UI.

title: [Save] Live CHUNK_TeamFactory is NullSnapshot — team OnCreate/OnDestroyed re-fire after load
description:
## C++
TeamFactory::xfer (Team.cpp:409-525) writes uniqueTeamID + each TeamPrototype snapshot. Team::xfer v1 (Team.cpp:2547-2674) persists m_created, m_active, m_seeEnemy / m_prevSeeEnemy, m_wasIdle, m_destroyThreshold, m_curUnits, waypoint, generic-script attempt flags, recruitability. After the first Team::updateState (Team.cpp:1783-1810) m_created is cleared so OnCreate does not run again; OnDestroyed latches destroyThreshold=-1. GameState::init registers CHUNK_TeamFactory (GameState.cpp:293).

## Live
write_common_sav_chunks_with_payload (save_file.rs:1189) writes CHUNK_TeamFactory as NullSnapshot v1. restore_all_teams (restore.rs:618-627) is a no-op: \"Teams are derived from players/objects\". Leftover Team::xfer already matches C++ (GameLogic/src/team/snapshot.rs:114-214) but is never applied on the live .sav path.

After load_map, leftover Team::set_active (team_identity.rs:225-228) sets created=true. Leftover Team::update_state (team_state.rs:188-210) then fires script_on_create and recomputes destroy_threshold from the current live census (wave20 hq-9ex2t wired that census). see_enemy / prev_see_enemy / was_idle reset so OnEnemySighted / OnIdle can also edge-fire.

Not a duplicate of closed hq-33j5 (leftover CHUNK_TeamFactory format on leftover GameState). Live host does not call leftover TheGameState.

## Player-visible
Campaign team OnCreate scripts (Hunt, AttackMove, Guard, spawn waves) run a second time after load. OnDestroyed objectives/cutscenes can fire again because the team is already below the recomputed threshold. Enemy-sighted / all-clear hooks can retrigger on the first post-load tick.
close_reason: Live CHUNK_TeamFactory writes TeamFactory persist (created/active/see_enemy/destroy_threshold/generic scripts/recruitability). Restore applies leftover Team::restore_save_script_state so OnCreate/OnDestroyed do not re-fire after load.

title: [Save] Live CHUNK_Players is NullSnapshot — science hide/disable and team-relation overrides reset

title: Host construct still hardcodes AutoAcquireEnemiesWhenIdle = 0
description:
## C++
AIUpdateModuleData::m_autoAcquireEnemiesWhenIdle defaults to 0 (AIUpdate.cpp:64). INI AutoAcquireEnemiesWhenIdle is a bitfield YES/STEALTHED/NO/NOTWHILEATTACKING/ATTACK_BUILDINGS (AIUpdate.h:91-110).
getNextMoodTarget (AIUpdate.cpp:4485-4489) requires AAS_Idle when calledDuringIdle. Retail combat units author AutoAcquireEnemiesWhenIdle = Yes so idle Crusaders/Rangers/Humvees shoot enemies that enter weapon range.

## Live
leftover crate parses the bitfield onto AIUpdateModuleData (ai_update_interface.rs:393-395).
Host Object::new leftover_auto_acquire_idle_bits (object/construct.rs:3-6) ignores the template name and always returns 0. leftover_auto_acquire_idle_yes is therefore always false.
create_object_with_owner (world_objects/create_destroy_die.rs:1165) calls Object::new_with_logic_frame and never stamps leftover module bits.
tick_mood_auto_acquire (world_tick/teams.rs:20-24) requires auto_acquire_when_idle.
get_next_mood_target (world_tick/mood.rs:377-378) returns None when called_during_idle && (auto_idle & AUTO_ACQUIRE_IDLE) == 0.

hq-b2e1t was closed as fixed, but the construct stub is still a hard 0 and create_object never copies leftover INI. The mood gate is live; the INI source is not.

## Player-visible
Idle player and AI combat units do not auto-acquire. Enemies walk into Crusader/Ranger/Humvee/Patriot range and are not fired on until the player (or Hunt/Attack-Move, which force-sets auto_acquire_when_idle) issues an order.
close_reason: Object construct stamps AutoAcquireEnemiesWhenIdle from leftover ThingFactory AIUpdate module data, else authored ThingTemplate INI parse. Mood idle gate now sees YES bits for combat units.

title: CommandButtonHunt special-power and weapon hunt never arm on live host
description:
## C++
CommandButtonHuntUpdate.cpp:140-151 `update` switches on the armed button:
- GUI_COMMAND_SPECIAL_POWER → huntSpecialPower (177-201): when idle and the SpecialAbilityUpdate is not active, scanClosestTarget then doCommandButtonAtObject. Used by Black Lotus capture/hack/steal, Jarmen Kell snipe, Tank Hunter TNT, Ranger/Red Guard capture, etc.
- GUI_COMMAND_FIRE_WEAPON / SWITCH_WEAPON → huntWeapon (160-172): if idle, aiHunt, then setWeaponLock(slot, LOCKED_TEMPORARILY) so seek-and-destroy uses that weapon (flashbang / Pathfinder / etc.).
- GUICOMMANDMODE_HIJACK_VEHICLE / CONVERT_TO_CARBOMB / SABOTAGE_BUILDING → huntEnter (206-222).

ScriptActions::doTeamHuntWithCommandButton / OnCreate TEAM_HUNT_WITH_COMMAND_BUTTON call setCommandButton then update.

Leftover GameEngine/GameLogic/src/object/update/command_button_hunt_update.rs:239-246 ports all three branches, but dual_world_registry_unavailable() (OBJECT_REGISTRY empty on the live host) makes hunt_special_power / hunt_enter / scan_closest_target return Forever/None.

## Live
host_command_button_hunt.rs:27-31 only HostCommandButtonHuntMode::{HijackVehicle, ConvertToCarBomb, SabotageBuilding}.
hunt_mode_from_button_name (112-126) returns None unless the button name contains carbomb/hijack/sabotage.

description:

close_reason: is_gps_scrambler_disguise_name no longer treats hijacker as canDisguise. C++ StealthUpdate.cpp:184-185 skips only DisguisesAsTeam (Bomb Truck). Destalthed GLA Hijacker now receives GPS receiveGrant like retail.

title: [Mines] EMP pads deal 100 HE — no NeutronBlast unmanned
description:

title: [Capture] Human capture ignores shroud/fog

title: [Crush] Overlap crush aims with velocity, not facing
description:

## Live

title: [Mines] DISARM cannot defuse demo traps — only detonation
description:

title: [Capture] Command_CaptureBuilding always enabled — no upgrade/cooldown/in-use gray
description:

title: [DemoTrap] Detonation is instant — no 1s warning FX/weapon

title: [Hijack] Mixed selection lets Rebel/non-hijacker steal the vehicle
description:
## C++
`ActionManager::canHijackVehicle` / `canConvertObjectToCarBomb` require **that unit’s** `isHijackedVehicleCrateCollide` / `isCarBombCrateCollide`. Mixed RMB `MSG_ENTER` (CommandXlat.cpp:1856-1889): only the terrorist/hijacker collide converts; a Rebel in the same selection does not steal the car.

Completion (`support_states.rs:4409-4499`, `4913-4994`) never checks hijacker/terrorist (Sabotage *does* check saboteur at 4509-4513).

Select Hijacker+Rebel, RMB enemy tank → Rebel can steal it and ride-hide if the tank has EjectPilotDie. Select Terrorist+Rebel, RMB a civilian car → Rebel converts it and is consumed. Not hq-ofk4z (RMB used to attack instead).
close_reason: execute_hijack and execute_convert_carbomb now require hijacker/terrorist; completion path rejects the rest.

title: [Crush] First crush of a car always becomes TOTAL wreck
description:
## C++
`PhysicsBehavior` overlap crush (GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Object/Update/PhysicsUpdate.cpp) applies HUGE crush damage only. It does not write body crush flags. `CrushDie::onDie` (CrushDie.cpp:151-180) then runs `crushLocationCheck` against the previous flags (usually both false) and writes FRONT / BACK / TOTAL + model bits.

## Live
`Object::check_for_overlap_collision` (GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/game_logic/object/physics_motion.rs:340-358) writes `front_crushed` / `back_crushed` **before** `take_damage`. Destroy then `fire_crush_die_from_crusher` (death.rs:513-543) calls `crush_location_check` with those flags already set. CrushDie.cpp:81-109: if the other end is the remaining candidate and the first flag is already true, the result is TOTAL. Flags and FRONTCRUSHED/BACKCRUSHED are overwritten.

## Player-visible
Civilian cars / crushable vehicles never show the half-crushed wreck. First tank pass always flattens both ends. Not hq-u41xk (CrushDie never recomputed — that path now runs, but after physics already stamped a flag).
close_reason: Physics no longer stamps crush flags; CrushDie writes FRONT/BACK on first pass.

title: [Harvest] Worker mine-clear never dumps carried boxes
