Upgrade-gated specials stay clickable without the upgrade. Empty Humvee/Chinook Evacuate stays enabled. A packing/unpacking Hacker still shows Hack Internet enabled. Units that must be stopped (e.g. some specials) stay enabled while moving. Single-use buttons stay enabled after use.
close_reason: Presentation availability honors NEED_UPGRADE MUST_BE_STOPPED Evacuate-empty HackInternet packing and single-use

title: Live AI tick auto-queues units from every Barracks including the player's
description:
## C++
AIUpdate / AIGuard / AIAttack never enqueue production. Computer production is AIPlayer / AISkirmishPlayer build lists, never the human player's factories.

## Live
GameLogic::update_ai second pass (world_tick/ai.rs:570-616) every 600 frames walks every constructed Structure whose template_name contains Barracks / WarFactory / ArmsDealer, resolves the owning player by team only (no is_local / AI-player filter), and AIDecisionSystem::select_production_unit (ai_decisions.rs:367-433) + enqueue_production queues USA_Ranger / USA_Humvee / etc. whenever supplies exceed a phase threshold.

## Player-visible
A human Barracks/WarFactory silently queues Rangers/Humvees (and faction equivalents) about every 10 seconds whenever the player has enough money, spending cash the player did not order.
close_reason: update_ai production pass skips local-player factories (C++ AIPlayer only)

title: Jets out of special-reload ammo keep attack-moving instead of RTB
description:
## C++
AIAttackMoveToState::update (AIStates.cpp:3581-3586): if JetAIUpdate::isOutOfSpecialReloadAmmo(), return STATE_SUCCESS so the jet leaves attack-move and returns to base to reload (Raptor/MiG ReturnToBase clips).

## Live
is_out_of_special_reload_ammo exists (object/rtb.rs:282-285) but process_ai_behavior AttackMoving (world_objects/ai_authority.rs:24-62) and unit_command_attack_move_to_ex never consult it. Empty-clip jets stay AttackMoving / keep the destination path.

## Player-visible
Raptors/MiGs ordered to attack-move keep flying the order after their missile clips are empty instead of breaking off to the airfield to rearm.
close_reason: Fixed in live GeneralsRust/Code/Main with TDD tests

title: Idle auto-acquire ignores AutoAcquireEnemiesWhenIdle INI bits
description:
## C++
AIUpdateModuleData::m_autoAcquireEnemiesWhenIdle defaults to 0 (AIUpdate.cpp:64). INI AutoAcquireEnemiesWhenIdle is a bitfield: YES / STEALTHED / NO / NOTWHILEATTACKING / ATTACK_BUILDINGS (AIUpdate.h:91-110).
getNextMoodTarget (AIUpdate.cpp:4471-4619): idle acquire requires AAS_Idle; stealthed idle blocked unless canAutoAcquireWhileStealthed (AAS_Idle_Stealthed or special-power grant, :4459-4463); isAttacking + AAS_Idle_Not_While_Attacking returns NULL; AAS_Idle_Attack_Buildings sets AI::ATTACK_BUILDINGS.

## Live
Object construct hardcodes auto_acquire_when_idle: true (object/construct.rs:887, :1692) with no INI bitfield copy from leftover AIUpdateModuleData (AUTO_ACQUIRE_IDLE_* in GameEngine ai_update_interface.rs:75-79).
get_next_mood_target (world_tick/mood.rs:373-379) treats auto_acquire as a bool; stealthed idle always returns None. Flags passed to find_closest_enemy are only CAN_ATTACK (+ WITHIN_ATTACK_RANGE|UNFOGGED for humans) — never ATTACK_BUILDINGS (mood.rs:442-454). NOTWHILEATTACKING is not implemented.

## Player-visible
Units authored without AutoAcquireEnemiesWhenIdle = YES still auto-fire when idle. Stealthed Pathfinders / Jarmen Kell / stealth tanks with STEALTHED never auto-fire while cloaked. Dozers/workers with ATTACK_BUILDINGS never idle-acquire civilian buildings. Units with NOTWHILEATTACKING retarget mid-burst.
close_reason: Fixed in live GeneralsRust/Code/Main with TDD tests

title: Guard Flying Units Only matches KindOf Aircraft not isFlying
description:
## C++
AIGuardMachine::lookForInnerTarget (AIGuard.cpp:259-263) on GUARDMODE_GUARD_FLYING_UNITS_ONLY adds PartitionFilterIsFlying — airborne / above-terrain objects, not KindOf.

## Live
update_support_states guard acquire (world_objects/support_states.rs:2438-2484) treats FlyingUnitsOnly as cand.is_kind_of(KindOf::Aircraft) || object_type == Aircraft. Grounded jets/helis qualify; airborne infantry, paratroopers, and other flying non-Aircraft do not.

## Player-visible
Command_GuardFlyingUnitsOnly (and the Guard Flying button) engages parked aircraft on the ground and ignores flying infantry / parachutes that retail would treat as flying targets.
close_reason: FlyingUnitsOnly uses is_above_terrain/airborne_target not KindOf Aircraft

title: Guard chase ignores inner radius and outer chase timer
description:
## C++
AIGuardMachine (AIGuard.cpp:162-167) is INNER → OUTER → GET_CRATE → RETURN → IDLE, plus ATTACK_AGGRESSOR.
AIGuardInnerState::onEnter (AIGuard.cpp:392-397) wraps AIAttackState with ExitConditions ATTACK_ExitIfOutsideRadius | ATTACK_ExitIfNoUnitFound at getStdGuardRange (inner).
AIGuardOuterState::onEnter (AIGuard.cpp:487-518): GUARDMODE_GUARD_WITHOUT_PURSUIT immediately SUCCESS (no outer chase). Otherwise ExitIfExpiredDuration (m_guardChaseUnitFrames) + ExitIfOutsideRadius + ExitIfNoUnitFound.
AIGuardAttackAggressorState (AIGuard.cpp:807-813) same inner radius + chase-timer exits. Parent state stays AI_GUARD.

## Live
update_support_states GuardingArea/GuardingObject (world_objects/support_states.rs:2412-2549) acquires then engage_target_decision_aware / attack_target, which set AIState::Attacking and leave Guard.
try_guard_last_attacker (support_states.rs:2241-2271) consumes last_damage_source and engages with no radius or timer.
Once Attacking, process_ai_behavior (ai_authority.rs:102-136) has no ExitIfOutsideRadius / guardChaseUnitFrames. WithoutPursuit only shrinks acquire_radius before engage; after Attacking the unit chases anywhere. stop_attack restores GuardingArea only after the target dies.

## Player-visible
Guard / Guard Without Pursuit units chase enemies across the map until the target dies, then walk back. Retail breaks off at the inner circle (Without Pursuit never leaves it) or after the authored chase timer.
close_reason: Live-host Guard chase now matches C++ ExitConditions: INNER ExitIfOutsideRadius (WithoutPursuit never enters OUTER), OUTER leftover GuardChaseUnitsDuration + outer radius (timer resets while target is inside inner), AGGRESSOR inner+timer. Player Attack/new Guard clears chase phase; stop_attack still returns to Guard.

title: AI Alert/Aggressive mood never converts Move into AttackMove
description:
## C++
AIUpdateInterface::getMoodMatrixActionAdjustment (AIUpdate.cpp:4347-4425): AI-controlled Alert/Aggressive MM_Action_Move returns MAA_Action_To_AttackMove.
AIMoveToState::update (AIStates.cpp:2063-2065) applies it: if m_isMoveTo && (adjustment & MAA_Action_To_AttackMove) then aiAttackMoveToPosition. Same for waypoint follow (AIStates.cpp:4101-4105).
Player-controlled units always MAA_Action_Ok (mood does not rewrite player Move).

## Live
get_mood_matrix_action_adjustment (world_tick/mood.rs:500-542) computes ACTION_TO_ATTACK_MOVE for Alert/Aggressive Move, but no live move/path command applies that bit. Grep of world_tick/movement.rs and unit_commands move paths finds no ACTION_TO_ATTACK_MOVE / MoodMatrixAction::Move consumer. AI script/team Move stays AIState::Moving; process_ai_behavior Moving returns None (ai_authority.rs:141-143).

## Player-visible
Skirmish/campaign AI teams set to Alert or Aggressive walk past enemies on Move / waypoint orders instead of converting those orders into attack-move and engaging along the path.
close_reason: path_approach_with_state applies ACTION_TO_ATTACK_MOVE so Alert/Aggressive AI Move becomes AttackMoving

title: Attack-move engagement abandons destination and keeps walking
description:
## C++
AIUpdateInterface::privateAttackMoveToPosition (AIUpdate.cpp:3558-3578) sets AI_ATTACK_MOVE_TO.
AIAttackMoveToState::update (AIStates.cpp:3572-3658) keeps the parent state. While the nested AIAttackMoveStateMachine is not idle it calls setLocomotorGoalNone() and clears MODELCONDITION_MOVING (3588-3601), then after the nested attack idles it getNextMoodTarget and either re-enters AI_ATTACK_OBJECT or repaths AIMoveToState toward the original goal. Jet out-of-ammo returns STATE_SUCCESS to reload (3581-3586). After a kill the unit resumes the attack-move.

## Live
unit_command_attack_move_to_ex (world_scripts/unit_commands.rs:382-434) sets AttackMoving + is_attack_path and leaves the destination path installed.
process_ai_behavior AttackMoving (world_objects/ai_authority.rs:24-62) issues AICommand::AttackTarget.
apply_engagement_decision_aware (ai_authority.rs:576-612) and Object::attack_target (object/attack.rs:532-557) flip AIState to Attacking (Hunt/Patrolling is the only exception). Destination/path is not cleared and update_movement (world_tick/movement.rs:283+) integrates any target_position regardless of AI state — no setLocomotorGoalNone.
Object::stop_attack (object/attack.rs:630-659) after the kill returns Idle (no guard/hunt), so the parent AttackMoving order is gone.

## Player-visible
A+click attack-move: tanks keep rolling past the enemy while shooting. After the first kill they do not resume the original destination as attack-move (they sit Idle or wander as a plain move) and will not stop-and-fight along the remaining path the way retail does.
close_reason: Live attack-move keeps AI_ATTACK_MOVE_TO: engage no longer peels to Attacking, dest walk halts (setLocomotorGoalNone) while nested victim is held, stop_attack restores requested dest and resumes AttackMoving.

title: [FX] TerrainScorch overlay ignores map flip bits — z-fights on flipped cells
description:
## C++
`BaseHeightMapRenderObjClass::updateScorches` (GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngineDevice/Source/W3DDevice/GameClient/BaseHeightMap.cpp:1965-1992) indexes each scorch cell with `m_map->getFlipState(xNdx, yNdx)` (`WorldHeightMap.cpp:541-547`) and emits the flipped triangle pair when the blend/cliff flip bit is set so the scorch mesh matches the terrain diagonal.

## Live
`TerrainScorchBuffer::update_scorches` (GeneralsRust/Code/GameEngine/GameClient/src/terrain/scorch_mesh.rs:231) does call `height.flip_state(x_ndx, y_ndx)`, but the live `ScorchHeightSource` impl for `HeightMap` (scorch_mesh.rs:86-88) is a stub that always returns `false`.
`TerrainBackground` (terrain_background.rs:400-403) already stores real C++ flip bits, but scorch bake never reads them.

## Player-visible
Explosion / death TerrainScorch marks sit on the wrong diagonal on flipped blend/cliff cells. Marks z-fight, hover, or leave a hole on those tiles while C++ scorches hug the terrain.
close_reason: Scorch bake reads HeightMap cliff/blend flip bits for triangle winding

title: [Production] Unit complete invents GUI:UnitReady radar text C++ never shows
description:
## C++
ProductionUpdate::update unit completion (ProductionUpdate.cpp:790-841) plays template getVoiceCreated(), then first-of-batch getPerUnitSound(\"VoiceCreate\"), setProducer, exitObjectViaDoor, onUnitCreated, and CreateModule onBuildComplete. There is no TheInGameUI->message and no radar text for a finished unit. The only production completion message is upgrades: UPGRADE:UpgradeComplete + RADAR_EVENT_UPGRADE (cpp:888-898). Repo-wide search of GeneralsMD/Code finds no UnitReady / GUI:UnitReady string.

## Live
notify_unit_production_complete (world_scripts/production_eva.rs:1425-1428), called from host_apply_production_spawn_ready_completions after every successful spawn, does `localize(\"GUI:UnitReady\", \"Unit ready: {template_name}\")` and queue_radar_message_at(..., RadarKind::Generic) for the local team. Distinct from closed hq-zbm8u (invented UnitReady **SFX** on the presentation mapper).

## Player-visible
Every completed unit (Ranger, Red Guard pair, jet, collector, …) flashes a radar notification \"Unit ready: AmericaInfantryRanger\" (or the raw template name if the string is missing). C++ only voices VoiceCreated/VoiceCreate; the command bar/queue emptying is the only visual cue.
close_reason: Unit complete no longer queues invented GUI:UnitReady radar text (C++ VoiceCreated only)

title: [Production] Supply-center exit never grants GrantTemporaryStealth
description:
## C++
SupplyCenterProductionExitUpdate::exitObjectViaDoor (SupplyCenterProductionExitUpdate.cpp:114-126) after the ordinary rally/Wanting handoff: if `m_grantTemporaryStealthFrames` is authored and the **producer** is OBJECT_STATUS_STEALTHED, grant on the new unit's default StealthUpdate only when `isTemporaryGrant() || !CAN_STEALTH` so GPS/innate stealth wins. Retail GLA Supply Stash authors GrantTemporaryStealth = 20000 ms → 600 frames on this exit module (same duration as the dock module). Distinct from SupplyCenterDockUpdate::action (deposit-time grant; that path is hq-53bo, closed).

## Live
ProductionExitMetadata (thing.rs:581-601) has no grant_temporary_stealth_frames field. spawn_templates.rs:1866-1874 parses SupplyCenter UnitCreate/NaturalRally only and drops GrantTemporaryStealth. host_apply_production_spawn_ready_completions (world_tick/production.rs:1665-1671) only calls force_supply_center_collector_wanting — never apply_grant_stealth / receiveGrant. Leftover crate supply_center_production_exit_behavior.rs:190-207 implements the C++ grant; that crate is not on the live spawn path. Dock grant in support_states.rs:6909-6934 is deposit-only.

## Player-visible
A Worker/Chinook/Supply Truck trained from a stealthed GLA Supply Stash (Camo Netting or Stealth General) walks out fully visible for the full 20s cloak window. C++ cloaks the new collector as it exits so it can reach the nearest warehouse unseen.
close_reason: SupplyCenterProductionExitUpdate GrantTemporaryStealth now parses to production_exit_metadata (20000ms→600f). host_apply_production_spawn_ready_completions grants after Wanting when producer is STEALTHED and (isTemporaryGrant || !CAN_STEALTH).

title: [Production] Dozer build starts at building center, not ACTION dock
description:
## C++
DozerActionDoActionState::update (DozerAIUpdate.cpp:482-507): BUILD first selects DOZER_DOCK_POINT_ACTION, aiMoveToPosition, then waits until the dozer AI is **idle** (arrived) before DOZER_DO_BUILD_AT_DOCK. Only that subtask increments construction percent and internalChangeHealth (cpp:514-526). Arrival itself is measured against the dock goal, not the building centre: PickActionPos uses MIN_ACTION_TOLERANCE 70 plus bounding-sphere slop 15 against the dock point (cpp:318-325). Driving to the site does not add HP.

## Live
world_tick/production.rs:83-95 counts a targeting can_construct() dozer as actively building when `pos.distance(build_pos) <= DOZER_MIN_ACTION_TOLERANCE` (70) from the **structure centre**. No ACTION-dock goal, no idle-at-dock gate, no DOZER_DO_BUILD_AT_DOCK subtask. resume_construction (rebuild_dozer.rs:976-982) paths toward dozer_repair_approach_position but update_construction does not wait for that arrival. builder_id exclusive dock is implemented; the start-progress gate is not.

## Player-visible
A barracks/war-factory/CC HP bar and construction percent begin climbing as soon as the assigned dozer is within 70wu of the building centre — while it is still walking onto the footprint. C++ waits until the dozer has parked at the ACTION dock. Large footprints start (and can finish) noticeably early.
close_reason: Live update_construction starts HP/percent only when the exclusive dozer is idle at stored ACTION dock (dozer_repair_approach_position / m_dockPoint[BUILD][ACTION]), not within 70wu of the structure centre. newTask BUILD and resume_construction seed the dock; DO_BUILD_AT_DOCK equivalent is arrived + distance-to-dock (DozerAIUpdate.cpp:482-526).

title: ExecuteRailedTransport always InvalidCommand — ferry never transits
description:
## C++
`RailedTransportAIUpdate::privateExecuteRailedTransport` (`GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Object/Update/AIUpdate/RailedTransportAIUpdate.cpp:272-304`):
- Walks behavior modules for `RailedTransportDockUpdateInterface`.
- Returns if missing or `isLoadingOrUnloading()`.
- Cycles `m_currentPath` across `PathPrefixName` StartNN/EndNN waypoint pairs (`loadWaypointData` `:71-104`).
- `aiFollowWaypointPath` then `setInTransit(TRUE)` which closes the dock.

`update` (`:166-228`) auto-loads those waypoints and, when `m_currentPath` is unset, `pickAndMoveToInitialLocation` so the ferry parks at the nearest End waypoint before anyone can load.

`AIGroup::groupExecuteRailedTransport` is the player button (`Command_ExecuteRailedTransport`).

## Live
`CommandExecutor::execute_railed_transport` (`GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/command_executor/transport.rs:24-37`) is a hard `CommandResult::InvalidCommand`. Comment admits Main keeps railed dock/contain metadata but not `PathPrefixName`, waypoint pairs, transit state, or the loading interface.

`spawn_templates.rs` never stores `PathPrefixName` on the live template. `bd search PathPrefixName` in Main `game_logic` is empty.

The control bar still queues `CommandType::ExecuteRailedTransport` (`control_bar_bridge.rs`, `button_map.rs`).

## Player-visible
Clicking Execute Railed Transport on AutoFerry / China+GLA ferries does nothing. The ferry never auto-slides to its station, never closes the dock, never rides `FerryStart01`/`FerryEnd01`. Retail runs the rail route and locks boarding while in transit.
close_reason: Live ExecuteRailedTransport follows PathPrefixName StartNN/EndNN chains, closes dock in transit, and auto-parks at nearest End. Leftover crate module already matched C++ but is dual-world gated.

title: OpenContain exit walk never ignores collisions for 1s
description:
## C++
`OpenContain::exitObjectViaDoor` (`OpenContain.cpp:915-1028`) after placing the rider on ExitStart:
- `ai->ignoreObstacle(NULL)`
- `ai->setIgnoreCollisionTime(LOGICFRAMES_PER_SECOND)` so stacked exits do not immediately block each other
- If the container is an idle `KINDOF_VEHICLE`, temporarily `removeUnitFromPathfindMap` / `updatePos` so riders can path through the hull
- `adjustToPossibleDestination` then `aiFollowPath([end, end, rally?])`

Same ignore-collision window is in `exitObjectInAHurry` (`:1099-1102`).

## Live
`GameLogic::walk_unit_via_open_contain_exit` (`drones_and_garrison.rs:1276-1358`) snaps to ExitStart/End (or garrison burst), sets `destination` + `AIState::Moving`. It never writes `ignore_collisions_until_frame`, `ignore_collisions_with`, or `can_path_through_units`, and never punches the idle hull out of the pathfind map.

`execute_exit` (`transport.rs:215-562`) and `evacuate_container_now` both go through this walk after the closed hq-pj6v9 ring-teleport fix.

## Player-visible
Unloading a full Humvee / Troop Crawler / Battle Bus, infantry spawn on top of each other and immediately collide with the hull and siblings. They stall inside or pile on the door instead of walking the ExitStart→ExitEnd corridor. Retail lets them overlap for one second and path through the parked transport.
close_reason: OpenContain exit walk sets ignore_collisions_until_frame for 1 logic second.

title: Enter from a current container yanks occupant without walk-exit
description:
## C++
`OpenContain::addToContain` (`OpenContain.cpp:302-312`) refuses a rider that already `getContainedBy() != NULL`. Enclosing garrison `addOrRemoveObjFromWorld(rider, false)` so the occupant is not even in the world to walk to a second building.

`OpenContain::onCollide` (`:758-815`) only `addToContain`s after kicking *other players'* riders. It never silently unhooks the arriver from a previous container.

Transfer is Exit (walk via `exitObjectViaDoor`) then a new Enter.

## Live
`CommandExecutor::execute_enter` (`transport.rs:147-161`) if the selected unit is `Docked`/`Garrisoned`/in a tunnel and `previous_container != target_id`:
```
unit_command_remove_occupant(previous_container, unit_id)
```
`unit_command_remove_occupant` (`unit_commands.rs:1169-1190`) only `container.remove_occupant` — drops the id from the roster. It does not `set_contained_by(None)`, does not walk ExitStart/End, does not clear HELD/Garrisoned, does not play exit audio.

Then the unit is pathed `AIState::Entering` toward the new target.

## Player-visible
Selecting a garrison portrait (or a loaded Humvee rider) and ordering Enter on another bunker/transport teleports them out of the first container — no burst/left/right walk, no ExitStart corridor. They can vanish from building A and appear walking toward B. Retail keeps them inside A until a real Exit.
close_reason: Enter from a current container no longer yanks the occupant; requires a real Exit.

title: Railed Evacuate dumps via generic exit, not dock unloadAll
description:
## C++
`RailedTransportAIUpdate::privateEvacuate` (`RailedTransportAIUpdate.cpp:308-337`):
- Refuse if no railed dock, `m_inTransit`, or `isLoadingOrUnloading()`.
- Otherwise `RailedTransportDockUpdateInterface::unloadAll()` — the pull/push dock animation, not OpenContain walk.

`RailedTransportContain::isSpecificRiderFreeToExit` is FALSE while the dock is closed (in transit). `exitObjectViaDoor` goes through `unloadSingleObject`.

## Live
`execute_evacuate` (`command_executor/transport.rs:565-630`) treats any `can_contain()` ground object as a generic container and calls `execute_exit`. That path walks `contained_units()` through `unit_command_exit_via_open_contain` / garrison door — no in-transit lock, no `unloadAll`.

`unit_command_dock_at_railed_transport` (`unit_commands.rs:1132-1148`) only sets `AIState::Docking` on the *rider*. The ferry's own Evacuate never reaches leftover `RailedTransportContain` (hq-nnzy closed leftover only).

## Player-visible
Evacuate on a loaded AutoFerry pops infantry out beside the hull (OpenContain ExitStart/End or a drop) instead of the station dock push. A moving ferry can dump mid-route. Retail keeps doors shut in transit and unloads only at the dock.
close_reason: Railed Evacuate uses dock unloadAll and refuses in-transit dumps.

title: Battleship bombardment fires as Artillery Barrage instead of FireWeaponPower
description:
## C++
FireWeaponPower.cpp:104-128 `doSpecialPowerAtLocation`: after the base trigger, `reloadAllAmmo(TRUE)` then `ai->aiAttackPosition(loc, maxShotsToFire)` and every turret `setTurretTargetPosition(i, loc)`. SPECIAL_BATTLESHIP_BOMBARDMENT is the battleship firing its own guns at the click.

## Live
command_executor/special_power.rs:703-706 unhandled location powers fall through to `queue_special_power_strike`. special_power_strikes/superweapon_kind.rs:59-61 maps BattleshipBombardment to HostSuperweaponKind::ArtilleryBarrage (same delayed multi-shell scatter as China Artillery Barrage). activate_fire_weapon_power exists on Object but is never called from execute_special_power.

## Player-visible
Campaign/skirmish Battleship Bombardment does not shoot the ship's batteries at the target. The player instead gets a China-style artillery barrage (delayed shells raining from the sky, 240s superweapon timer residual) from the battleship click.
close_reason: Live execute_special_power routes SPECIAL_BATTLESHIP_BOMBARDMENT to FireWeaponPower (activate_fire_weapon_power: leftover doSpecialPowerAtLocation when dual-world object exists, else host reloadAllAmmo + aiAttackPosition + setTurretTargetPosition). Unmapped from HostSuperweaponKind::ArtilleryBarrage so the click no longer queues China multi-shell scatter / 240s SuperweaponArtilleryBarrage.

title: Microwave Disable Building special-power command is hard-rejected
description:
## C++
SpecialAbilityMicrowaveDisableBuilding is a real SpecialAbility/SpecialAbilityUpdate (UpdateModuleStartsAttack, StartAbilityRange 150). Its Enum is SPECIAL_HACKER_DISABLE_BUILDING (no separate C++ SpecialPowerType). Clicking the command runs SpecialAbilityUpdate::initiateIntentToDoSpecialPower + the disable-building channel (walk/unpack/DISABLED_HACKED), same family as China Hacker.

## Live
command_executor/special_power.rs:269-274: if power_type == MicrowaveDisableBuilding { return InvalidCommand; } before any caster loop. command_system/special_power.rs maps SpecialAbilityMicrowaveDisableBuilding onto that distinct variant. The HackerDisableBuilding typed channel is never used.

## Player-visible
Clicking the Microwave Tank's Disable Building special-power button does nothing (command rejected). Retail walks the tank into StartAbilityRange 150 and starts the disable channel.
close_reason: Removed MicrowaveDisableBuilding hard-reject. Command now uses the existing HackerDisableBuilding SpecialAbilityUpdate channel (walk/unpack/DISABLED_HACKED), matching C++ SPECIAL_HACKER_DISABLE_BUILDING. Parser admits SpecialAbilityMicrowaveDisableBuilding with its own timings/charge key; leftover already mapped the enum.

title: Helix NapalmBomb drops from anywhere instead of flying to StartAbilityRange 3
description:
## C++
SpecialAbilityUpdate.cpp:388-449 waits until `isWithinStartAbilityRange` (retail StartAbilityRange = 3), approaches, then triggerAbilityEffect SPECIAL_HELIX_NAPALM_BOMB (1240/1295-1299) `createSpecialObject()` — the NapalmBomb falls from the Helix over the target. UpdateModuleStartsAttack means `markSpecialPowerTriggered` / recharge happens at startPreparation in range, not on the map click.

## Live
command_executor/special_power.rs:664-672 calls `activate_helix_napalm_bomb` immediately. Helix is not in consume_at_prep so :310-316 burns ReloadTime (10000ms) on click. helix_radar.rs:630-675 spawns the falling bomb from the Helix's current position toward the click with no StartAbilityRange 3 gate and no approach order.

## Player-visible
Helix Napalm/Nuke Bomb is a map-wide artillery drop: click a distant spot and the bomb leaves the Helix immediately. Retail requires the Helix to fly almost on top of the target (range 3) before the bomb is created, and the cooldown does not start until that preparation.
close_reason: Live host Helix Napalm/Nuke now flies to leftover StartAbilityRange 3 (bounding-sphere 2D) then startPreparation consume + createSpecialObject drop. Click no longer burns ReloadTime or spawns the bomb from map-wide range.

title: [FX] Live smudge present is world-space decals, not backbuffer heat-haze
description:
## C++
`W3DSmudgeManager::render` (GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngineDevice/Source/W3DDevice/GameClient/W3DSmudge.cpp:282-533) runs after particles (`W3DParticleSys.cpp:357-361`). It samples the current render target / backbuffer, projects each smudge to view space, builds a 5-vertex screen-aligned quad (4 corners + center), offsets the center UV by `smudge->m_offset`, and draws with the back-buffer texture so the scene warps (jet exhaust, napalm, explosion heat haze). Hardware test requires render-to-texture.

`W3DParticleSys.cpp:142-172` converts SMUD* particles into those smudges (never sprites).

## Live
SMUD* systems now feed `TheSmudgeManager` (`feed_system_heat_smudges`, particle_renderer.rs:319-365). The live present path then draws them as world-space decals:
- `SmudgeManager::collect_decal_render_items` (smudge.rs:177-187) emits `DecalRenderItem { position, size, color=[1,1,1,opacity] }`.
- Main `enqueue_client_effect_draw` (forward_render.rs:424-436) calls `ParticleRenderer::render_decals` (particle_renderer.rs:1319-1416) which builds XY world quads at `z+0.01` with the default particle texture. No backbuffer sample, no screen-space UV warp.

TerrainVisual `upload_smudge_mesh` (overlay_gpu.rs:698-770) builds a ground-projected 5-vertex mesh with baked peach color `[1.0, 0.85, 0.7]` and draws it with `road_texture_bind_group` — still not a backbuffer distortion pass.

Distinct from closed hq-phlb / hq-ctgyu / hq-ptkc (those added feed + decal stand-in / leftover 5-vertex overlay). The live present path still does not warp the scene.

## Player-visible
Jet afterburners, napalm, and explosion SMUD* systems never warp the scene. Player sees flat world-space quads (and/or a peach road-textured ground overlay) instead of heat-haze distortion.
close_reason: SMUD present is screen-space 5-vertex heat-haze quads, not world decals

title: Ambulance CleanupArea consumes cooldown and never drives to the click
description:
## C++
CleanupAreaPower.cpp:63-81 `doSpecialPowerAtLocation` never calls `SpecialPowerModule::doSpecialPowerAtLocation`. It only finds CleanupHazardUpdate and `setCleanupAreaParameters(loc, m_cleanupMoveRange)`. CleanupHazardUpdate.cpp:274-290 then `aiMoveToPosition(pos, CMD_FROM_AI)` and the ambulance drives to the click, scanning/spraying AmbulanceCleanHazardWeapon until the area is clean. No `triggerSpecialPower` / `startPowerRecharge` / EVA / initiate.

## Live
command_executor/special_power.rs:310-316 consumes the special-power charge on click (CleanupArea is not in consume_at_prep). Then :695-702 `activate_cleanup_area`. heroes_and_plans.rs:1233-1264 rejects if the caster is farther than HOST_CLEANUP_MAX_MOVE_DISTANCE (300), otherwise fires a CleanupStreamProjectile or instantly `apply_cleanup_area_at` (radius-50 field/mine clear). The ambulance never receives a move-to-area order.

## Player-visible
Clicking ambulance Detox/Cleanup Area: (1) the button goes on cooldown (retail never recharges this power); (2) clicks beyond 300 units fail; (3) hazards/mines vanish instantly (or after a short stream) instead of the ambulance driving there and spraying until clean.
close_reason: Live CleanupArea no longer consumes charge or rejects >300. C++ CleanupAreaPower.cpp:63-81 never calls SpecialPowerModule::doSpecialPowerAtLocation; setCleanupAreaParameters stores m_pos/m_moveRange and aiMoveToPosition. Host activate_cleanup_area now issues unit_command_move_to and update_cleanup_area_orders sprays only after the drive (idle/arrive), matching CleanupHazardUpdate.cpp:274-290 + fireWhenReady idle/busy gate.

title: [Particles] Main present path never runs terrain visible-box cull
description:
## C++
`W3DParticleSystemManager::doParticles` (GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngineDevice/Source/W3DDevice/GameClient/W3DParticleSys.cpp:104-226) takes `TheTerrainRenderObject->getMaximumVisibleBox(frustum, &bbox, TRUE)` (terrain-and-sky tight volume) and skips any particle whose position is outside that AABB expanded by particle size. That culls off-screen particles and particles that have fallen under the ground. Only then does it fill the 512-slot `MAX_POINTS_PER_GROUP` point/streak/volume buffers.

## Live
`GameClient::Display::draw` (GeneralsRust/Code/GameEngine/GameClient/src/display/display.rs:1067-1085) does call `cull_particles_to_visible_box` (particle_manager.rs:1318-1343). The live host never runs that path: `GameClient::update` host presentation (impl_update.rs:55-72) says "No draw_display — Main RenderPipeline is sole present path".
Main `ForwardPass::enqueue_client_effect_draw` (GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/graphics/render_pipeline/forward_render.rs:345-362) calls `ParticleRenderer::render_particles` / `collect_system_particles` (particle_renderer.rs:1424-1479) which only skips `lifetime_left == 0 || is_culled`. `is_culled` stays false because Display::draw never ran. The 512 `MAX_PARTICLES_PER_BATCH` cap (particle_renderer.rs:25, 128-130) then counts underground/off-screen particles first.

Distinct from closed hq-9tp3 (cull was added only on Display::draw).

## Player-visible
Smoke, fire, and debris keep drawing underground and far off-camera. During heavy FX, the 512-per-system cap can drop on-screen particles because off-screen ones fill the batch first. C++ hides those.
close_reason: Main present path runs terrain visible-box particle cull before batch

title: Save/load drops objectless drawables (PUC beams, lock-on, ropes, prison visuals)
description:
## C++
GameClient::xfer (GameClient.cpp:1401-1518) writes objectID = INVALID_ID for drawables with no Object, then on load TheThingFactory->newDrawable(template) and xferSnapshot. shouldSaveDrawable (1227-1240) only skips DRAWABLE_STATUS_NO_SAVE when there is no object. ParticleUplinkCannonUpdate, JetAIUpdate lock-on, ChinookAIUpdate ropes, PrisonBehavior prisoner visuals, and FXList tracers are saved/restored this way.

## Live
ClientDrawableStateSnapshot.has_stable_source_identity (client_drawable.rs:70-74) requires object_id != 0. Capture/import therefore discards standalone records. persist_v18.drawable_xfer and client_drawable_visuals iterate only game_logic.host_objects() (persist_v18.rs:356-404, builder.rs:1008-1037). CHUNK_GameClient is a null placeholder so leftover GameClient TOC/archive (which does create objectless drawables) never runs.

## Player-visible
Save mid Particle Cannon beam, jet lock-on reticle, Chinook rappel ropes, or prison-camp prisoner models: after load those visuals are gone until the logic recreates them (often never, because the drawable IDs the update modules hold are stale).
close_reason: Wired leftover GameClient::xfer into CHUNK_GameClient (C++ objectID=INVALID_ID + newDrawable). TheGameClient DRAWABLE_STATE objectless PUC/lock-on/ropes import/export rematch saved DrawableIDs. has_stable_source_identity now accepts objectless template+model identity; capture/import keep standalone records.

title: Save/load stubs Drawable::xfer visuals — icons, tint, opacity, scale reset

description:

title: Save/load empties Diplomacy briefing history (CHUNK_GameClient briefing)

title: [Stealth] Detected heat-vision overlay never fades between detector pulses
description:
## C++
Detector first-spot and `setStealthLook(VISIBLE_DETECTED / VISIBLE_FRIENDLY_DETECTED)` set `m_secondMaterialPassOpacity = 1.0` (`StealthDetectorUpdate.cpp:284-290`, `Drawable.cpp:2574-2595`). Every subsequent `Drawable::draw` (`Drawable.cpp:2615-2622`) multiplies that opacity by `MATERIAL_PASS_OPACITY_FADE_SCALAR` (0.8) until the next DetectionRate refresh (typically 15–27 frames). The heat-vision overlay therefore pulses: full on scan, then fades to nearly gone (`0.8^15 ≈ 0.035`) before the next ping.

## Live
`Object::apply_detected_heat_vision_second_pass` (`object/stealth.rs:353-361`) and `apply_local_stealth_look_and_heat_vision` (`stealth_mines.rs:1291-1309`) hold `camo_heat_vision_opacity` at 1.0 for the whole DETECTED window. Presentation `unit_render_inputs` (`presentation_frame/queries.rs:375-383`) recomputes `stealth_second_material_pass_opacity(...)` as a hard 1.0 whenever `stealthed && detected` (mines/disguise excluded). There is no 0.8/frame decay.

## Player-visible
A detected Pathfinder, Burton, Rebel, or other stealth unit stays locked in a solid heat-vision overlay until detection expires. Retail heat-vision strobes with each detector ping instead of remaining a constant second-material wash.
close_reason: Detected heat-vision now pulses like C++: detector/setStealthLook arm camo_heat_vision_opacity=1.0, Drawable::draw 0.8/frame fade until the next DetectionRate, presentation reads the residual instead of a hard 1.0.

title: [Stealth] Disguised bomb trucks get STEALTHLOOK_INVISIBLE so enemy radar hides them
description:
## C++
`StealthUpdate::calcStealthedStatusForPlayer` (`GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Object/Update/StealthUpdate.cpp:487-495`) special-cases `canDisguise()`: non-allies of a disguised unit get `STEALTHLOOK_DISGUISED_ENEMY`; allies get `STEALTHLOOK_NONE`. `Drawable::setStealthLook` (`Drawable.cpp:2582-2585`) leaves `m_hiddenByStealth = false` for `DISGUISED_ENEMY`. `Radar.cpp` then draws the blip in the disguise player's color after `changeVisualDisguise` remove/add (`StealthUpdate.cpp:1090-1092`).

## Live
`GameLogic::apply_local_stealth_look_and_heat_vision` (`GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/game_logic/world_scripts/stealth_mines.rs:1290`) always calls `camo_netting_stealth_look(stealthed, detected, friendly)` which has no disguise branch. A stealthed+undetected bomb truck seen by an enemy therefore writes `HostCamoStealthLook::Invisible` (`host_upgrades.rs:1577-1595`). `host_radar_insert_spec` (`world_objects/radar_live.rs:328-331`) copies that look into `RadarObject.hidden_by_stealth`. `RadarObject::is_temporarily_hidden` (`GameEngine/Common/src/common/system/radar/mod.rs:774-776`) returns true on `hidden_by_stealth` *before* the `is_disguised` exception, so the enemy blip is dropped.

Presentation mesh stay visible (`local_viewer_hides_stealthed` skips `can_disguise_as_team`), so the player sees a Crusader-shaped truck with no radar blip.

## Player-visible
A bomb truck disguised as an enemy/neutral vehicle is fully visible on the battlefield as the disguise model but never appears on the enemy (or local-vs-enemy) radar. Retail shows a disguise-team-colored blip and never treats disguise as cloak-invisible.
close_reason: apply_local_stealth_look now uses calc_stealthed_status_for_player: canDisguise + disguised + non-ally writes STEALTHLOOK_DISGUISED_ENEMY (allies/undisguised NONE). Radar hidden_by_stealth only matches Invisible so disguise-colored blips stay.

title: [Stealth] Bomb truck reveal never restores upgrade payload subobjects
description:
## C++
`StealthUpdate::changeVisualDisguise` reveal halfpoint (`GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Object/Update/StealthUpdate.cpp:1052-1057`) calls `self->forceRefreshSubObjectUpgradeStatus()` after swapping back to the true bomb-truck drawable. That rebuilds W3D subobjects driven by payload upgrades (BioBomb / HighExplosiveBomb barrels, etc.) that were lost when the disguise drawable replaced the original.

## Live
`Object::tick_disguise_transition` reveal halfpoint (`object/stealth.rs:126-134`) only clears `disguised` / `disguise_as_*` and does not refresh upgrade subobjects. `host_bomb_truck_disguise.rs` honesty: "Not full academy stats / subobject upgrade restore on disguise". No live caller of `forceRefreshSubObjectUpgradeStatus` exists on the disguise path.

## Player-visible
After a Bio or High-Explosive bomb truck finishes its disguise-reveal transition, the true truck mesh comes back without the payload barrels/tanks that retail restores. The unit still has the upgrade mechanically but looks like an unupgraded truck until rebuilt or upgraded again.
close_reason: Live tick_disguise_transition reveal halfpoint now calls Object::force_refresh_sub_object_upgrade_status (C++ StealthUpdate.cpp:1052-1057). Re-applies Bio/HE Bombload (and Helix BombWing) from applied_upgrades onto host sub_object_visibility; presentation merges those directives after INI ConditionState when not disguised. Instant reveal and leftover object/update disguise path also refresh.

title: [Stealth] Detector IR ping/particles play through black shroud
description:
## C++
`StealthDetectorUpdate::update` (`GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Object/Update/StealthDetectorUpdate.cpp:338-397`) plays IR ping / loud ping audio and IR/IRBright/IRBeacon particles only when `self->getShroudedStatus(localPlayer) <= OBJECTSHROUD_PARTIAL_CLEAR` *and* the detector is not stealthed-to-the-local-player (`:341-343`). Detectors in black shroud or fog-only cells stay silent.

## Live
`detector_ir_fx_visible_to_local` (`GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/game_logic/world_scripts/stealth_mines.rs:1217-1225`) comment claims the C++ shroud-clear gate but only tests `stealthed && !locally_controlled`. `play_detector_ir_scan_fx` (`:1160-1214`) then always queues `IRPing`/`IRPingLoud` plus `IRDetectPing`/`IRDetectPingBright`/`IRLenzflare` for every due DetectionRate scan. No `get_shroud_manager` / `ObjectShroudStatus` check. (Closed hq-j02p8 added the IR cues; closed leftover hq-w5mw was the inverse leftover-crate gate.)

## Player-visible
A Pathfinder, Sentry Drone, Listening Outpost, or Troop Crawler scanning in unrevealed black shroud still clicks IR ping and flashes IR lens-flare/grid for the local player. Retail detectors are silent and have no IR FX until the unit is at least partially clear in FOW.
close_reason: Detector IR ping/particles now require get_host_object_shroud_status <= PartialClear (plus existing stealthed-to-local gate). Black shroud and fog-only detectors stay silent.

title: [Stealth] GPS Scrambler grant never flashAsSelected the cloaked units
description:
## C++
`GrantStealthBehavior::grantStealthToObject` (`GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Object/Behavior/GrantStealthBehavior.cpp:159-179`) calls `stealth->receiveGrant()` then `draw->flashAsSelected()` so every legal ally that just received `CAN_STEALTH|STEALTHED` flashes the house-color selection envelope. GPS Scrambler (`GPSScrambler_InvisibleMarker` GrantStealth grow pulse) uses this path.

## Live
`GameLogic` GPS grant (`world_combat/gps_and_fields.rs:101-106` and the matching special-power flight path) only calls `Object::apply_grant_stealth()` (`object/stealth.rs:267-283`). That helper sets innate/STEALTHED/CAN_STEALTH and never calls `flash_as_selected` (`object/install.rs:612-615`). `host_gps_scrambler.rs` honesty already records "Not full particle / flashAsSelected drawable path".

## Player-visible
Casting GPS Scrambler cloaks legal allies with no white/house-color flash. Retail pulses every unit that actually received the grant so the player can see who went stealth in the growing radius.
close_reason: GPS grant now flashAsSelected after receiveGrant. activate_gps_scrambler and update_gps_scrambler_grow call Object::flash_as_selected (selection_flash_remaining=4) after apply_grant_stealth, matching GrantStealthBehavior.cpp:173-178. Leftover grant_stealth_to_object already flashed. Honesty comment updated.

title: [ScriptAct] NAMED/TEAM HUNT GUARD STOP leftover-only on live host
description:
## C++
ScriptActions::doNamedHunt (ScriptActions.cpp:1966-1979) / doTeamHunt (:1985-1998) issue aiHunt / groupHunt CMD_FROM_SCRIPT. doNamedGuard (:1861-1876) / doTeamGuard (:1882-1899) aiGuardPosition at current pos. doNamedStop (:4519-4531) / doTeamStop (:4537+) aiIdle. All resolve live ScriptEngine named units / teams.

## Live
Move/attack leftover actions queue HostScriptMoveAttackRequest and live host drains them (scripts_camera.rs:650+). Hunt/guard/stop do not: actions_victory_team.rs:204-265 TEAM_HUNT/GUARD and :813-957 NAMED_HUNT/GUARD/STOP look up leftover TeamFactory / NamedObjectTracker / TheGameLogic::find_object_by_id and issue leftover AI commands. Empty leftover registry → silent Success no-op. No request_host_* drain exists for hunt/guard/idle.

## Player-visible
Campaign scripts that put a named hero or team on Hunt, Guard-in-place, or Stop leave the live units standing or continuing their last move/attack. Retail they immediately hunt, hold, or idle.
close_reason: Live leftover NAMED/TEAM HUNT, GUARD, and STOP already match C++ ScriptActions (aiHunt/groupHunt, aiGuardPosition at current pos, aiIdle/groupIdle) and queue HostScriptHuntGuardRequest / HostScriptIdleRequest when OBJECT_REGISTRY is empty. GameLogic::update drains apply_host_hunt_guard_script_requests onto unit_command_patrol / unit_command_guard_position and apply_host_idle_script_requests onto unit_command_stop (TEAM_STOP_AND_DISBAND remaps members to the default host team).

title: [ScriptAct] NAMED/TEAM KILL DELETE DAMAGE leftover-only on live host
description:
## C++
ScriptActions::doNamedDelete (ScriptActions.cpp:2330-2337) TheGameLogic->destroyObject. doNamedKill (:2483-2490) Object::kill(). doTeamDelete (:2343-2351) Team::deleteTeam. doTeamKill (:2496-2504) Team::killTeam(). doNamedDamage / doDamageTeamMembers apply unresistable script damage to the live objects.

title: [ScriptCond] TEAM_ATTACKED / TEAM_DISCOVERED leftover members only
description:
## C++
evaluateTeamAttackedByType / evaluateTeamAttackedByPlayer walk live Team members' last DamageInfo. evaluateTeamDiscovered walks live members and tests partition shroud CLEAR|PARTIAL_CLEAR for the querying player (ScriptConditions.cpp team-attacked / team-discovered cases).

title: [ScriptCond] BRIDGE_REPAIRED / BRIDGE_BROKEN leftover-only on live host
description:
## C++
ScriptConditions::evaluateBridgeBroken (ScriptConditions.cpp:242-252) / evaluateBridgeRepaired (:258-268) return false unless TheTerrainLogic->anyBridgesDamageStatesChanged(), then resolve the named bridge Object and call isBridgeBroken / isBridgeRepaired on that live object.

title: [Locomotor] Host binding rejects Fixed/building-relative Z modes
description:
## C++
`handleBehaviorZ` (`Locomotor.cpp:2223-2246`):
- `Z_FIXED_SURFACE_RELATIVE_HEIGHT` / `Z_FIXED_ABSOLUTE_HEIGHT`: hard-snap Z to preferredHeight (+ surface), ignore physics.
- `Z_RELATIVE_TO_GROUND_AND_BUILDINGS`: snap to preferred + `PartitionManager::getGroundOrStructureHeight` so flyers ride over buildings.

## Live
`host_locomotor_binding_from_template` (`locomotor_bootstrap.rs:803-809`) returns `None` for those three `SourceLocomotorBehaviorZ` values (comment: host has no distinct mode). `Object::handle_behavior_z` (`object/physics.rs:553-601`) only implements NoZ / SeaLevel / SurfaceRelative / SmoothHighest / AbsoluteHeight. Leftover `behavior_z.rs:91-116` implements the missing snaps.

## Player-visible
Any unit whose INI ZAxisBehavior is FIXED_* or FIXED_RELATIVE_TO_GROUND_AND_BUILDINGS never binds that loco (falls back / keeps prior set). Helicopters and building-relative flyers clip through structures instead of lifting over rooftops.
close_reason: Host locomotor binding maps FIXED_SURFACE_RELATIVE_HEIGHT / FIXED_ABSOLUTE_HEIGHT / FIXED_RELATIVE_TO_GROUND_AND_BUILDINGS (C++ Locomotor.cpp:2223-2246). handle_behavior_z hard-snaps preferredHeight (+ surface); building-relative uses leftover PartitionManager::getGroundOrStructureHeight plus live structure scan.

title: [Locomotor] Live waypoint/stop uses 5.0/2.0 not CloseEnoughDist
description:
## C++
`LocomotorTemplate` default `m_closeEnoughDist = 1.0` (`Locomotor.cpp:321`). Arrival is `closeEnoughDist` (optionally 3D). Path follow uses that plus `computePointOnPath`, not a 5-unit hop.

## Live
`GameLogic::update_movement` (`world_tick/movement.rs:288`) advances the waypoint when horizontal distance < `5.0`, and (`:518`) treats dest as reached at `< 2.0`. No `close_enough_dist` field is stored on the live object (`entity_lifecycle_motion_state.rs:2` notes Main lacks closeEnoughDist). Distinct from closed pathfind hq-9yz3f (computePointOnPath hops).

## Player-visible
Units stop 2–5 world units short of the click / skip the last cell of a path. Infantry never pack onto the exact tile; vehicles look like they give up early next to buildings and rally points.
close_reason: Live march waypoint/stop uses 1.0 CloseEnoughDist (C++ LocomotorTemplate default)

title: [Locomotor] AllowAirborneMotiveForce never gates live 2D march
description:
## C++
`locoUpdate_moveTowardsPosition` (`Locomotor.cpp:1005-1056`): if height above surface > `-(3*3)*gravity` (~4.5wu), `treatAsAirborne`. 2D appearance movers run only when `getAllowMotiveForceWhileAirborne() || !treatAsAirborne`. Template default is false (`:312`). Infantry walking off a cliff stop applying walk force and fall.

## Live
`HostLocomotorBinding` (`locomotor_bootstrap.rs:811-898`) never copies `allow_motive_force_while_airborne`. Live `update_movement` always writes heading * speed into XZ velocity (`world_tick/movement.rs:488-513`) with no airborne gate. Leftover `move_dispatch.rs:153-172` implements the C++ allow_2d test and is unused.

## Player-visible
Ground units walk horizontally through the air after driving/walking off a cliff, ramp, or explosion hop. Retail they lose motive and drop.
close_reason: update_movement already gates 2D march when airborne unless allow_motive_force_while_airborne

title: [ScriptCond] BUILT_BY_PLAYER / HAS_OBJECT_COMPARISON / LOST_OBJECT_TYPE count leftover 0
description:
## C++
evaluateBuiltByPlayer (ScriptConditions.cpp:857-896) counts live Player objects of that ThingTemplate (false if findTemplate fails). evaluatePlayerHasObjectComparison counts live objects and compares to N. evaluatePlayerLostObjectType (:2671-2698) recounts ignoreDead=TRUE and returns true when the count dropped vs ScriptEngine::getObjectCount.

## Live
eval_named.rs:1034-1040 BUILT_BY_PLAYER fail-closes False when dual_world_registry_unavailable(). eval_basic.rs:1148-1214 HAS_OBJECT_COMPARISON and :1070-1112 LOST_OBJECT_TYPE call leftover Player::count_objects_by_thing_template. Host census (scripts_camera.rs merge_host_player_census_into_snapshot) only stores money/power/building_count/has_any_objects — no per-template counts. Leftover player object lists stay empty on the live host.

title: [ScriptCond] BUILDING_ENTERED_BY_PLAYER leftover-only on live host

title: [Locomotor] Live march never skips stunned units
description:

The leftover `Object::update_movement` (`object/update.rs:119-122`) does `if shock_stun_frames > 0 { return; }` but the host tick never calls it. title: [ScriptCond] UNIT/TEAM OBJECT_STATUS stuck false on live host
description:

title: [Locomotor] Legs/climber never apply angleCoeff turn-slow on live march
description:
## C++
`moveTowardsPositionLegs` (`Locomotor.cpp:1638-1646`) and `moveTowardsPositionClimb` (`:1760-1767`) set `goalSpeed = (1 - angleCoeff) * desiredSpeed` where `angleCoeff = min(1, |relAngle| / (PI/4))`. Infantry and climbers slow (to a stop at 45°+) while turning.

## Live

LegsTwo / Climber keep full `effective_max_speed()` while yawing. `Object::update_movement` (`object/update.rs:236-239`) has the legs/climber case but is not the live tick path.

## Player-visible
Rangers, Red Guard, Burton, and cliff climbers slide sideways at full run speed through 90° turns instead of planting and slowing like retail infantry.
close_reason: Live GameLogic::update_movement applies C++ legs/climber angleCoeff (relAngle/(PI/4) clamp) on march; treads keeps near-goal 0.6.

title: [ScriptCond] NAMED/TEAM REACHED_WAYPOINTS_END never true on live host
description:
## C++
ScriptConditions::evaluateNamedReachedWaypointsEnd (ScriptConditions.cpp:1301-1322) looks up the named Object, reads AIUpdateInterface::getCompletedWaypoint(), and returns true if that waypoint's pathLabel1/2/3 equals the scripted path name. evaluateTeamReachedWaypointsEnd (:1328-1366) does the same over live Team members and returns true if any AI member completed that path.

## Live

TEAM path (eval_basic.rs:1555-1616) has no host fallback — leftover TeamFactory members + leftover AI get_completed_waypoint_id (default AIUpdateInterface returns None). Live host never records completed waypoint path labels on the snapshot.

## Player-visible
Campaign/skirmish scripts that wait for a named hero or team to finish a waypoint path (escort, retreat, arrival) never fire. Follow-up actions (dialogue, spawn, victory) stay dead after the unit visibly reaches the last waypoint.
close_reason: Live host stamps completed waypoint path labels on follow-path end; inject_host_script_query_snapshot fills HostScriptQueryObject.waypoint_labels; leftover NAMED/TEAM REACHED_WAYPOINTS_END read those labels when OBJECT_REGISTRY is empty.

title: [Locomotor] Live march yaws around hull center — TurnPivotOffset unused
description:
## C++
`Locomotor::rotateTowardsPosition` (`Locomotor.cpp:901-907`) always calls `rotateObjAroundLocoPivot` (`:2113-2187`). When `TurnPivotOffset != 0` (combat bikes seed `-0.60` rear axle), the hull is rotated around that offset point via a Z-pre-rotate of the transform — the center translates while the rear wheel stays put. Wheels (`:1451-1454`) and treads (`:1164`) both use this path.

## Live
`GameLogic::update_movement` (`world_tick/movement.rs:475-486`) does `set_orientation(current + clamped delta)` around the object's center. `Object::rotate_obj_around_loco_pivot` (`object/physics.rs:427-490`) exists and binding writes `turn_pivot_offset` (`locomotor_bootstrap.rs:929`, combat-bike seed `:1144`), but the live march never calls it. `Object::update_movement` (`object/update.rs:199-200`) does call it and is unused by the host tick.

## Player-visible
Combat bikes and other pivoted vehicles spin in place around their midpoint instead of swinging the nose around the rear wheel. Turns look like tank-on-a-pin, not rear-wheel steering.
close_reason: Live GameLogic::update_movement now yaws via Object::rotate_towards_position → rotate_obj_around_loco_pivot (C++ Locomotor.cpp:901-907, 2113-2187). TurnPivotOffset != 0 translates the hull around the rear axle (host Ry matching set_orientation); march integrates from the post-pivot pose. Combat bikes no longer spin about hull center.

title: Crush point uses velocity not unit facing
description:
## C++
PhysicsUpdate.cpp:1488 checkForOverlapCollision builds the crush-point ray from crusherMe->getUnitDirectionVector2D() (facing), not velocity. past-point (dot < 0) and perp-shortest of front/center/back therefore follow the hull heading. CrushDie.cpp:25-121 crushLocationCheck also uses victim facing + crusher position.

## Live
object/physics_motion.rs:300-323 select_crush_target_by_perp_residual / past_crush_point_residual use movement.velocity when |v|^2 > 1e-8, else the vector from victim to crusher. A sliding or reverse-moving tank (velocity not parallel to yaw) picks the wrong TOTAL/FRONT/BACK point.

## Player-visible
Cars and crushable wrecks show the wrong FRONTCRUSHED/BACKCRUSHED model (and crush SFX) when a tank hits them while turning, reversing, or being shoved. Infantry squish still kills, but vehicle wreck art does not match retail.
close_reason: Live crush ray uses unit facing (PhysicsUpdate.cpp:1488 getUnitDirectionVector2D / unit_direction_xz), not velocity. CrushDie crushLocationCheck uses victim facing. Duplicate of hq-jpktw.

title: Placed mines never scoot; they arm on the final spot
description:
## C++
GenerateMinefieldBehavior.cpp:204-210 placeMineAt calls LandMineInterface::setScootParms(producerPos, dest). MinefieldBehavior.cpp:543-597 starts the mine at the producer (building/bomb), integrates scoot vel/accel (including gravity/fall time), and onCollide :360-362 returns while m_scootFramesLeft > 0 so the pad cannot detonate mid-slide.

close_reason: Live HostMineData now ports leftover/C++ setScootParms: China pads spawn at producer/bomb, integrate vel/accel (Y-up gravity), and stay inert until scoot_frames_left hits 0.

title: Land-mine splash never chain-dets neighboring pads

title: Mine/demo splash is Unresistable not weapon type
description:
## C++

notes: 2026-10-28 audit: current production detonation code now routes LandMine profiles through DamageType::LandMine and Demo/TNT through DamageType::Explosive at GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/game_logic/world_scripts/stealth_mines.rs:3640-3651 and :3845-3857; both pass HostDeathType::from_host_damage_type into apply_residual_damage_owned_with_effects. This matches CPP MinefieldBehavior.cpp:254-257 / DemoTrapUpdate.cpp:247 firing the authored temporary weapon and the cited StructureMineWeapon / DemoTrap weapon types. Not closed: no executed public regression yet drives actual mine/demo detonation against StructureArmor and observes the resulting HP/death type. Attempted `cargo test --locked --manifest-path GeneralsRust/Code/Main/Cargo.toml --test weapon_damage_default`; it did not reach tests because that unrelated existing target fails to compile at tests/weapon_damage_default.rs:223,225 (Object::ai_state and attack_substate are methods, not fields). Generic weapon test cannot substitute for the mine route.

title: Dozer DISARM never silent-clears demo traps
description:
## C++
Weapon.cpp:2509-2534 DAMAGE_DISARM: after LandMineInterface::disarm, a second gate is
  (!found && KINDOF_MINE) || KINDOF_BOOBY_TRAP || KINDOF_DEMOTRAP
because && binds tighter than ||. A dozer DISARM shot on GLADemoTrap therefore TheGameLogic->destroyObject(victim) with no attemptDamage. DemoTrapUpdate.cpp:181-191 also skips KINDOF_DOZER while DAMAGE_DISARM + OBJECT_STATUS_IS_ATTACKING, so the trap does not proximity-detonate during the clear.

## Live

`HostSpecialPowerStrikeRegistry::set_beam_override_destination` (GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/game_logic/special_power_strikes/registry_fields.rs:989-1015) is the residual that flips `manual_target_mode` and drives the beam — it is only called from tests, never from the live override command. title: [Superweapon] Particle Cannon beam never aborts on brownout/EMP/hack
description:
## C++
`ParticleUplinkCannonUpdate::update` (GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Object/Update/ParticleUplinkCannonUpdate.cpp:403-413): while the beam is live (`m_startAttackFrame != 0` and `m_startDecayFrame > now`), DISABLED_UNDERPOWERED / EMP / SUBDUED / HACKED force `m_startDecayFrame = now` — the laser dies immediately (then WidthGrow decay tail).

## Live
`HostParticleBeamField` tick / registry (GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/game_logic/special_power_strikes/registry_fields.rs and fields.rs) has no underpowered/EMP/hack abort. Beam duration is `PARTICLE_BEAM_DURATION_FRAMES` (particle_uplink.rs:5-6) regardless of the source PUC becoming disabled.

Per-object special-power *countdown* freezes while `is_disabled()` (object/update.rs:43-46), but an already-firing beam is a separate residual and keeps pulsing.

## Player-visible
EMP, hack, or low-power on a firing Particle Uplink Cannon leaves the orbital laser annihilating for the full ~3.5s. Retail cuts the beam the moment the building loses power.
close_reason: Live HostParticleBeamField aborts on UNDERPOWERED/EMP/SUBDUED/HACKED: m_startDecayFrame=now, pulses stop, WidthGrow tail, orbital/connector laser objects expire.

title: Script science conditions miss host rank-up (acquired / can-purchase / purchase-points)

Rank-up addSkillPoints grants rank sciences via addScience, so evaluateScienceAcquired (ScriptConditions.cpp:1543-1553) is an edge trigger on that list (ScriptEngine::isScienceAcquired :7464-7483, removeFromList=TRUE). evaluateCanPurchaseScience (:1559-1568) and evaluateSciencePurchasePoints (:1575-1582, leftover points >= N) read the same Player SPP/science vec the HUD uses.

## Live

Host UI purchase does sync via attempt_to_purchase_science → sync_host_science_to_crate_player (Main game_logic/player.rs:1128-1156, residual wave109:1060-1083 leftover add_science). title: Script conditions PLAYER_HAS_COMPARISON_UNIT_TYPE/KIND_IN_TRIGGER_AREA count 0 on live host
description:

ScriptConditions::evaluatePlayerHasUnitTypeInArea (GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/ScriptEngine/ScriptConditions.cpp:420-497) and evaluatePlayerHasUnitKindInArea walk the player's live Team member lists, test isInside(trigger) and template/kindof, and compare the real count. Used heavily for zone-clear / hold-this-area / sneak-N-units-in objectives.

## Live
eval_player_has_comparison_unit_type_in_trigger_area / eval_player_has_comparison_unit_kind_in_trigger_area (scripting/executor/eval_skirmish.rs:954-1066) use leftover Player::get_all_objects (player/core.rs:285-287 owned_objects) then find_object_by_id.
