title: [Water] Script water-rise never applies C++ DAMAGE_WATER amount — live chips 25 HP once
description:
## Why
C++ `WATER_CHANGE_HEIGHT` instant-kills everything whose XY is now underwater (`damageAmount = 999999.9`). Over-time floods apply the scripted `damageAmount` once per second (and on the final snap) as `DAMAGE_WATER` / `DEATH_NORMAL`. Live leftover crate raises the water table but empty-gates the damage scan; the host then chips 25 HP once on a dry→wet edge and skips boats/aircraft by name.

## C++
`GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Map/TerrainLogic.cpp`
- `setWaterHeight` (`:2272-2389`): if `damageAmount > 0 && height > previousHeight`, partition-scan the water AABB and `attemptDamage` every object with `isUnderwater(x,y)` — no aircraft/boat skip. Type `DAMAGE_WATER`, death `DEATH_NORMAL`, source `INVALID_ID`.
- `WATER_CHANGE_HEIGHT` script uses `999999.9` (leftover `actions_world.rs:1060` matches).
- `changeWaterHeightOverTime` + `update` (`:1003-1097`): damage once per `LOGICFRAMES_PER_SECOND` while rising, always on final snap.

## Leftover
`GameLogic/src/scripting/executor/actions_world.rs:1046-1086` dispatches both script actions into crate `TerrainLogic`.
`terrain.rs:1889-1929` `apply_water_rise_damage` Wave 341 empty-gates when `OBJECT_REGISTRY` is empty (live host path).
`terrain.rs:3343-3384` `update_dynamic_water` cadence matches C++ but still routes through the empty-gated scan.

Live tick *does* run leftover scripts + leftover `TerrainLogic::update` (`Main/src/game_logic/world_tick/step.rs:172-174`, `world_scripts/scripts_camera.rs:321-336`).

## Live host
`world_tick/step.rs:175-178` then `refresh_surface_cells_and_water_edge_damage(25.0)` every frame.
`world_tick/physics.rs:113-217`:
- 25 HP once on dry→wet (not script `damageAmount`, not once-per-second while submerged).
- Skips `KindOf::Aircraft` / `Projectile` and template names containing boat/ship/hover/amphib/carrier/destroyer/battleship.
- Comment at `:176` claims "Full setWaterHeight scripts call apply_water_rise_damage directly" — leftover never calls the *host* method.

## Player-visible
Dam-break / flood scripts (Three Gorges, etc.): C++ units in the lake die immediately (or take the authored per-second flood damage). Live units take 25 HP once when the water first covers them and keep fighting; hover/boats are exempt even if C++ would hit them.

## Not a duplicate
Closed hq-tdxnb (water never reached host `is_underwater`) and hq-ku3nn (sub-frame `changeWater` no-op) are height-table bugs. Closed hq-4n9bl waveguide start-enabled is dam *trigger* wiring. This is the *kill amount* after the table rises.
close_reason: Leftover empty-registry water damage now queues DAMAGE_WATER for host (instant 999999.9 / scripted over-time). Host apply_water_rise_damage no longer skips boats/aircraft or chips invented 25 HP.

title: [Terrain] Live bridge rubble never restamps deck impassable or splat-kills occupants
description:
## Why
When a span goes `BODY_RUBBLE`, C++ closes that pathfind layer and splat-kills / drops every occupant. Live restamps decks from leftover `cur_damage_state`, but leftover `update_damage_state` only sees crate `OBJECT_REGISTRY` objects — empty on the live host — so the deck stays `CELL_CLEAR` and units keep standing on a collapsed bridge.

## C++
`TerrainLogic.cpp` `Bridge::updateDamageState` (`:852-909`):
- Read body-module damage state.
- On enter `BODY_RUBBLE`: `pathfinder()->changeBridgeState(layer, false)` and every `objectInteractsWithBridgeLayer(..., considerBridgeHealth=false)` takes `DAMAGE_FALLING` / `DEATH_SPLATTED` / `HUGE_DAMAGE_AMOUNT`.
- On leave rubble: re-enable unless `BridgeBehavior::isScaffoldPresent()`.

`BridgeBehavior.cpp:822-930` `onDie` → `handleObjectsOnBridgeOnDie`: ground-layer occupants in the deck polygon get `physics->setAllowToFall(true)` or `kill()`.

## Leftover
`GameLogic/src/terrain_bridge.rs:19-116` ports rubble close + splat, but `splat_units_on_bridge` walks `OBJECT_REGISTRY.get_all_object_ids()` (empty live).
`bridge_behavior.rs:1010-1017` `handle_objects_on_bridge_on_die` Wave 301 empty-gates.
`terrain.rs:3386-3394` `update_bridge_damage_states` only flips `bridge_damage_states_changed` when leftover objects exist.

## Live host
`Main/src/game_logic/world_save.rs:1388-1393` restamps only when leftover `bridge_damage_states_changed()`.
`stamp_live_bridge_decks_and_zones` (`:591-605`) uses leftover `info.cur_damage_state == Rubble` to pick `CELL_BRIDGE_IMPASSABLE`.
Live host objects are not crate registry objects, so leftover state never becomes rubble from a live kill.
No live `handle_objects_on_bridge` / falling splat on span death.

## Player-visible
Destroying a bridge: C++ deck becomes impassable and tanks/infantry on it fall/splat. Live units keep driving and standing on the wreck as if the span were still up.

## Not a duplicate
Closed hq-6htk fixed leftover crate `update_damage_state` math; close_reason is leftover-only. Closed hq-5s9pt / hq-ao9p are initial deck classify. Live occupants + live restamp still miss the rubble transition.
close_reason: C++ live host: waveguide WaveGuide1 dest+WET+Water/Flooded+stop; water damage rise-only; leftover restamp live Water cells; GenericBridge spawn; deck Z snap; rubble restamp+splat; 4-corner water wins; no slope>4 Impassable

title: [Replay] playbackFile NewGame/ClearGameData never start or tear down the live game
description:
## C++
`RecorderClass::playbackFile` (Recorder.cpp:1123-1134) appends `MSG_NEW_GAME` with `GAME_REPLAY` + difficulty + rankPoints + maxFPS to **TheMessageStream** (not CommandList). `GameLogicDispatch.cpp:396-421` `MSG_NEW_GAME` calls `prepareNewGame` + `startNewGame`. `stopPlayback` (Recorder.cpp:447) appends `MSG_CLEAR_GAME_DATA` to TheMessageStream; dispatch `:428-440` calls `TheGameLogic->clearGameData()`. Startup-from-shell also `clearGameData()` directly when `isInGame()`.

## Leftover
`Recorder::playback_file` / `stop_playback` (`common/recorder.rs:1892-2112`) send `NewGame` / `ClearGameData` through the single `command_sink`. Leftover `GameLogicDispatch` (`game_logic_dispatch.rs`) is a generic priority queue, not the C++ switch — it never starts/clears a game.

## Live
`record_tap.rs` `install_host_replay_bridges` sets `command_sink` to `TheCommandList`. `apply_replay_messages_to_host` then **ignores** `NewGame | ClearGameData`. Only the boot `shell.rs` startup path temporarily points the sink at TheMessageStream. Replay menu (`GameClient` callbacks `replay_menu.rs:178-205`) just calls `playback_file` and hides the parent. `tap_host_new_game_for_recorder` also hardcodes difficulty=1 / rank=0 / maxFPS=30 (C++ skirmish writes the real FPS limit as arg 3).

## Player-visible
Clicking Play on a .rep hides the Replay menu but does not start `GAME_REPLAY` (wrong/no map, no seed, no observer). End-of-replay never returns to the shell. The only working entry is the one-shot `--replay` boot path.
close_reason: RecorderClass::playbackFile/stopPlayback (Recorder.cpp:1123-1134, 447) now append MSG_NEW_GAME / MSG_CLEAR_GAME_DATA to TheMessageStream. send_clear_game_data + playback_file use append_game_message_to_the_message_stream; live record_tap sink/apply_replay_messages_to_host also post those types so Menu NewGame drain / clearGameData can start and tear down GAME_REPLAY. tap_host_new_game_for_recorder writes live difficulty/rank/maxFPS.

title: [Replay] Live tap records only a handful of orders so builds/specials/teams never play back
description:
## C++
`RecorderClass::updateRecord` (Recorder.cpp:488-492) writes every `TheCommandList` message in `(MSG_BEGIN_NETWORK_MESSAGES, MSG_END_NETWORK_MESSAGES)`. That range includes dozer construct/line/cancel, sell, queue/cancel unit+upgrade, purchase science, special powers, weapons, evacuate/combat drop, rally, cheer, beacons, create/select/add team 0-9, area-select, etc. (MessageStream.h:462-584). Playback `appendNextCommand` puts those back on `TheCommandList`; `GameLogicDispatch` executes them.

## Leftover
`common/recorder.rs` `replay_type_id` / `decode_replay_type_id` already encode/decode the C++ 1000-base IDs for those types (`CreateTeamSlot`, `DozerConstruct`, `DoSpecialPower*`, `QueueUnitCreate`, …). File format is not the bottleneck.

## Live
`command_system/record_tap.rs` `game_command_to_message` / `game_message_to_host_command` only map move/attack-move/force-attack/stop/scatter/guard/waypoint/CreateSelectedGroup/enter/dock/repair/heal/resume/salvage/retaliation/self-destruct. Everything else `return None` — never appended to `TheCommandList`, never written, and on playback never restored to `GameLogic.command_queue`. `CommandType` has no create/select/add-team variants at all.

## Player-visible
A recorded skirmish/MP game is missing most of the match: factories never produce, dozers never place buildings, generals powers never fire, Ctrl+1-0 teams never form, upgrades/science/beacons/evac/combat-drop never happen. Watching LastReplay looks like only a subset of move/attack clicks.
close_reason: RecorderClass::updateRecord (Recorder.cpp:488-492) live tap now maps dozer construct/line/cancel, sell, queue/cancel unit+upgrade, purchase science, special powers, weapons, evacuate, combat drop, rally, cheer, beacons, formation, switch weapons. tap_host_team_slot_for_recorder writes MSG_CREATE/SELECT/ADD_TEAM* (SelectionXlat.cpp:1047) from hotkeys; playback apply_replay_messages_to_host restores leftover Player squads and host control groups.

Trucks stay 0 (SupplyTruckAIUpdate.h:196). WorkerShoes remains separate.

title: [Shroud] Live object FOW uses VisionRange circle not PartitionData COI mix
description:
## C++
`PartitionData::getShroudedStatus` (`PartitionManager.cpp:1582-1688`) walks the object's COI cells: all shrouded → SHROUDED; all shrouded+fogged → FOGGED then:
- Neutral mobile → SHROUDED (no fog ghost)
- Enemy non-immobile, never-seen faction buildings, or `KINDOF_MINE` → SHROUDED
- Seen immobile enemy buildings stay FOGGED (ghost silhouette)
- All clear → CLEAR; mixed cells → PARTIAL_CLEAR
- `m_everSeenByPlayer` records first CLEAR/PARTIAL so later fog can show the building ghost

Object visibility is **cell shroud of the footprint**, not VisionRange.

## Leftover
`GameLogic/src/object/partition_data.rs:43-105` ports the COI mix (closed hq-wwc4s). `object/vision.rs:107-120` `Object::get_shrouded_status` uses AlwaysVisible + PartitionData.

## Live host
`world_objects/spawn_templates.rs:3554-3584` `update_main_crate_vision` marks objects seen with a 2D **VisionRange** circle (`mark_host_object_seen`). `presentation_frame/build.rs:18-30` then maps `can_see_object` / `has_explored_object` → Clear/Fogged/Shrouded and **never emits PartialClear** from COI. Main objects are not leftover GameLogic objects, so leftover PartitionData is unused.

Distinct from closed hq-wwc4s (leftover stub, now implemented).

## Player-visible
Enemies appear/disappear by sight radius, not cell fog. Units stay visible on fogged ground (or hidden on revealed ground). Mines and moving neutrals linger as fog ghosts. Seen enemy buildings never freeze as fog silhouettes. Large buildings that straddle shroud/clear never go PARTIAL_CLEAR.
close_reason: Live object FOW uses PartitionData COI mix, not VisionRange circle.

title: [Prop] Sold speaker towers keep pulsing
description:

title: [Radar] LeftHUD radar stays black; blips never refresh stealth or position
description:
## C++
`PartitionManager` pushes every cell shroud change to `TheRadar->setShroudLevel` (`PartitionManager.cpp:1263-1328`) and `refreshShroudForLocalPlayer` (`:3000-3013`). `W3DRadar::draw` composites terrain → object overlay → shroud texture (`W3DRadar.cpp:1389-1398`). `renderObjectList` skips objects with `getShroudedStatus > OBJECTSHROUD_PARTIAL_CLEAR` (`:636-638`). `RadarObject::isTemporarilyHidden` (`Radar.cpp:118-125`) queries live `STEALTHLOOK_INVISIBLE` each draw. Main never calls `refresh_shroud_for_local_player` and never `register_radar_object_provider`. `radar_live.rs:253-277` stamps `world_pos` / `is_stealth` / `stealth_revealed` once at spawn. `RadarSystem::update` therefore leaves the grid all-Shrouded and cannot refresh host objects.

Distinct from closed hq-9rr (WGPU minimap FOW texture from PresentationFrame) and hq-u2yos (detector data at insert).

## Player-visible
ControlBar LeftHUD radar (`w3d_gadget_draw/hud.rs` blips + shroud texture) stays fully black with **zero blips** (grid stuck Shrouded; blip gate requires Clear). If a script/observer switch refreshes once, the grid then freezes stale and blips stay pinned at spawn — cloaked units remain visible, movers do not move.
close_reason: Radar blips restamp pose/stealth each tick; shroud grid copied to TheRadar for local player.

title: [Player] Team relationship overrides never consulted
description:
## C++
`Player::getRelationship(const Team*)` (`Player.cpp:542-571`) returns a team-id override from `m_teamRelations` first, else the controlling player's `m_playerRelations` entry, else NEUTRAL.
`Team::getRelationship` (`Team.cpp:1447-1474`) checks that team's team override, then player override, then `getControllingPlayer()->getRelationship(that)`.
Scripts `PLAYER_SET_OVERRIDE_RELATION_TO_TEAM` / `TEAM_SET_OVERRIDE_RELATION_TO_{TEAM,PLAYER}` write those maps so one named team can be allied while the rest of that player stays enemy (civilians, reinforcements, captured squads).

`GameEngine/Common/src/common/rts/team.rs:1088-1131` implements `Team::getRelationship`.
`scripting/executor/actions_player.rs:283-350` and `dispatch.rs` apply override scripts onto leftover Team/Player maps.

## Live host
`player_relationship` (`world_objects/object_queries.rs:311-345`) uses only `map_side.relations` (player-to-player) plus skirmish `alliance_team`. No team-id override map.
`Player` has no `team_relations`. Live `world_tick/teams.rs` is mood/guard/attitude, not C++ Team instances.
Main `world_scripts/` has no `PlayerSetOverrideRelationToTeam` / `TeamSetOverrideRelation*` executor (enum only in `core.rs`).

## Player-visible
Map scripts that ally or enemy a single team (civilian convoy, scripted reinforcement, captured squad) never change live combat, repair, or auto-acquire. Those units keep the owning player's map/alliance relationship.

Distinct from closed hq-226vh / hq-q9dxa (unlisted default Neutral; map playerAllies/playerEnemies now applied) and hq-w58c (look/shroud used Team instead of Player::getRelationship).
close_reason: Live object_relationship consults Player::team_relations (and leftover Player::override_relationship_for_team) before player-to-player map, matching C++ Player::getRelationship(const Team*) Player.cpp:542-554. Host set_team_relationship_override + Object.team_instance_name make PLAYER_SET_OVERRIDE_RELATION_TO_TEAM observable.

title: [Player] Map/skirmish handicap never multiplies live cost/time
description:
## C++
`ThingTemplate::calcCostToBuild` (`ThingTemplate.cpp:1508-1516`) multiplies `getBuildCost() * factionModifier * player->getHandicap()->getHandicap(BUILDCOST, this)`.
`calcTimeToBuild` (`:1524-1527`) first multiplies authored frames by `getHandicap(BUILDTIME, this)` before PlayerTemplate time percent and energy.

title: [Science] Script hide/disable never gates live purchase

title: [Microwave] Building disable is instant, not SUBDUAL_BUILDING to maxHealth
description:

`MicrowaveTankBuildingDisabler` fires SUBDUAL_BUILDING (`PrimaryDamage` 50, `DelayBetweenShots` 100ms, `AttackRange` 200) at the attacked structure. `ActiveBody.cpp:471-487,1292-1294` accumulates until `currentSubdual >= maxHealth`, then `DISABLED_SUBDUED` (`:1256-1262`) and passengers idle. `SubdualDamageHelper.cpp:32-50` heals back (`SubdualDamageHealRate` / `HealAmount` on the building ActiveBody). title: [ECM] Missile jam deals 100 Unresistable HP not projectileNowJammed
description:
## C++
`DAMAGE_SUBDUAL_MISSILE` is subdual (`Damage.h:59,99`). `ActiveBody.cpp:471-487` never subtracts HP; when `isSubdued()` (`maxHealth <= subdual`) `onSubdualChange` (`:1280-1286`) calls `ProjectileUpdateInterface::projectileNowJammed`. `MissileAIUpdate.cpp:777-809` sets `MODELCONDITION_JAMMED`, scatters goal by `DistanceScatterWhenJammed` (default 75, `MissileAIUpdate.cpp:56`), clears tracking, `aiMoveToPosition` to the scattered ground point. title: [ECM] Infantry and aircraft jammed; C++ only vehicles plus missiles
description:

ECM tank weapons: `ECMTankVehicleDisabler` (ground vehicles, SUBDUAL_VEHICLE, AttackRange 200) and `ECMTankMissileJammer` FireWeaponUpdate pulse (`PrimaryDamageRadius` 150, SUBDUAL_MISSILE, RadiusDamageAffects ENEMIES NEUTRALS). Infantry, aircraft, and structures are not vehicle-disabler targets.

title: [ECM] Instant weapons_jammed aura, not SUBDUAL_VEHICLE accumulate
description:
## C++
`ECMTankVehicleDisabler` is a targeted weapon (`AttackRange` 200, `PrimaryDamage` 24, `DelayBetweenShots` 100ms, `DamageType` SUBDUAL_VEHICLE). `ActiveBody.cpp:471-487` `IsSubdualDamage` adds to `m_currentSubdualDamage` (no HP). `isSubdued()` (`:1292-1294`) is `maxHealth <= currentSubdual`. Then `onSubdualChange` (`:1250-1267`) sets `DISABLED_SUBDUED` (vehicles cannot fire). `SubdualDamageHelper.cpp:32-50` heals `SubdualDamageHealAmount` every `SubdualDamageHealRate` (ChinaTankECM: cap 600, heal 50 / 500ms) so disable lingers after the beam stops.

title: [Crush] Locomotor blockedBy always is_ally=false so tanks plow own infantry
description:
## C++
`AIUpdateInterface::blockedBy` (`AIUpdate.cpp:1289-1290`): `if (obj->canCrushOrSquish(other, TEST_CRUSH_OR_SQUISH)) return FALSE; // just run over them.` `canCrushOrSquish` is false for ALLIES, unmanned, and crusher_level==0, so a tank is still blocked by friendly infantry and must stop / scoot.

## Leftover
Crate `can_crush_or_squish` matches C++ (ally + unmanned + levels + SquishCollide). Not on the live host path.

## Live
`Object::ai_blocked_by` (`object/physics.rs:170-172`) calls `self.can_crush_only(other, false)` — `is_ally` is hardcoded false. Own and allied infantry with `crushable_level < crusher_level` are treated as crush-through (not blocking) even though physics will refuse the crush when `same_team`.

## Player-visible
Friendly tanks plow into your own infantry instead of stopping. They do not crush (same-team physics gate) so they bounce/grind through the blob instead of waiting or scooting.
close_reason: Live Object::ai_blocked_by now takes is_ally and calls can_crush_only(other, is_ally) matching AIUpdate.cpp:1289 canCrushOrSquish (ALLIES false). try_physics_collide passes crush_relationship_is_allies (object_relationship, Object.cpp:1096) into ai_process_collision. Own tanks stop/scoot instead of plow. Test: own_tank_is_blocked_by_own_infantry.

title: [Crush] Allied-player tanks crush friends — physics uses Team== not ALLIES
description:
## C++
`Object::canCrushOrSquish` (`Object.cpp:1096-1101`) returns false when `getRelationship(otherObj) == ALLIES` — "Friends don't let friends crush friends." Order is the crusher's view of the victim (Player relationship, including diplomatic allies). `PhysicsBehavior::checkForOverlapCollision` (`PhysicsUpdate.cpp:1435`) and `SquishCollide::onCollide` (`SquishCollide.cpp:72-73`) both use that gate (`other->getRelationship(getObject()) != ALLIES`).

## Leftover
`object_combat.rs:1037-1040` `can_crush_or_squish` uses `relationship_to(other) == Allies`. Unused by the live host.

## Live
`world_tick/physics.rs:331` `same_team = a_team == b_team` (faction `Team` enum) is passed as `is_ally` into `check_for_overlap_collision` / `can_crush_only`. Host already has `object_relationship` (`object_queries.rs:349`) that implements Player ALLIES (map relationship + `alliance_team`). Crush never calls it.

## Player-visible
Allied USA+China (or any cross-faction alliance) tanks run over each other's infantry and crushable cars. Retail never does. Same-faction enemies would fail to crush (opposite error).
close_reason: Live try_physics_collide no longer uses Team== as is_ally. crush_relationship_is_allies uses GameLogic::object_relationship (Player ALLIES / alliance_team) into apply_overlap_crush_check / check_for_overlap_collision, matching Object.cpp:1096 and PhysicsUpdate.cpp:1435. Diplomatic allies do not crush. Test: allied_player_tank_does_not_crush_friends.

title: [Pathfind] Crush-through occupancy never checks ALLIES
description:
## C++
`Pathfinder::checkForMovement` (`AIPathfind.cpp:5037-5066`): if `obj->getRelationship(unit) == ALLIES`, increment `allyFixedCount` (never `enemyFixed`). Only non-allies consult `canCrushOrSquish(..., TEST_CRUSH_OR_SQUISH)` to decide crush-through.

## Leftover
`pathfind_complete/check_movement.rs:428-449` ports the ALLIES vs `can_crush_or_squish` split. Unused by Main.

## Live
`pathfinding.rs:880-887` treats any other-player occupancy bit (`fixed & !bit`) as `enemy_fixed`, then crush-through when `crusher_level > max(crushable_level)`. No relationship / ALLIES test. Same-player occupancy is only a soft cost.

## Player-visible
Tanks A* through allied other-player infantry and cars (then crush them via the same_team physics hole). Retail plans around allies.
close_reason: Live occupancy_cost / crate A* extra / occupancy_blocks_line treat friend = seeker_bit | player_ally_masks (AIPathfind.cpp:5037-5066). Allies increment soft cost, never enemyFixed crush-through. GameLogic::refresh_pathfind_ally_masks stamps masks each logic frame. Test: occupancy_allies_are_not_crush_through.

title: [Crush] Crushable cars take infantry instant-squish, skip front/back crush
description:
## C++
Two modules:
- `SquishCollide::onCollide` (infantry with the module): 1.0 victim geom + velocity-toward + HUGE crush. Ally-safe via crusher relationship.
- `PhysicsBehavior::checkForOverlapCollision` (`PhysicsUpdate.cpp:1466-1743`) `TEST_CRUSH_ONLY`: 0-damage first overlap, then front/back/center crush *points* (`majorRadius/2` along victim facing). Cars/props die only after the crusher passes the chosen point (two-stage crushed model).

## Leftover
`physics_crush.rs:28-143` is crush-points only (no infantry instant-squish). Correct leftover, unused by Main.

## Live
`physics_motion.rs:164-232`: after `can_crush_only` (which already requires `crusher_level > crushable_level`), any infantry **or** `crushable_level < crusher_level` takes the SquishCollide instant-HUGE path and returns. That predicate is identical to `can_crush_only`, so crushable cars never reach the crush-point code below. Front/back crush, 0-damage first hit, and `CrushDie` two-stage models are skipped. Crushee facing also uses `(cos, +sin)` while the crusher uses `(cos, -sin)`.

## Player-visible
Overlord/BattleBus vs civilian cars: car pops as a total-crush instead of front-then-back smashed wreck. Infantry path is closer to retail SquishCollide (already closed geom/skip beads).
close_reason: Live check_for_overlap_collision instant-squish is Infantry-only (SquishCollide). Cars/props use crush-point path (PhysicsUpdate.cpp:1466-1743). Crushee facing uses unit_direction_xz (cos,-sin) like the crusher. Test: crushable_car_uses_front_back_not_instant_squish.

title: [ScriptEngine] Live update skips all side and sequential scripts when crate OBJECT_REGISTRY is empty
description:
## C++
`ScriptEngine::update` (`ScriptEngine.cpp:5554-5581`) always walks every side's root scripts and active non-subroutine groups, then `evaluateAndProgressAllSequentialScripts()`. Empty object tables do not abort the walk. TRUE/COUNTER/FLAG/TIMER scripts still fire.

## Leftover
`engine/update.rs` `execute_side_scripts_from_active_lists` (`:189-191`) and `evaluate_and_progress_all_sequential_scripts` (`:619-622`) both `return Ok(())` when `OBJECT_REGISTRY.is_empty()`. Comment cites a Menu hang (`hq-9e2w`) and claims host objects cannot resolve here.

## Live
`world_scripts/scripts_camera.rs:321-340` is the only walker (`TheScriptEngine->UPDATE()`). `MissionScriptRuntime::note_logic_frame` no longer evaluates (hq-fxq1). Main never registers host objects into leftover `OBJECT_REGISTRY`. Host named-unit inject (`inject_host_named_unit_map_into_crate_tracker`) never runs because the walk returns first.

## Player-visible
Campaign/skirmish map scripts never fire: TRUE intros, counters/flags/timers, camera/music, spawn, victory. Sequential team/unit scripts never progress. Distinct from closed hq-b28s (update not called) and hq-b8mr (conditions evaluate false).
close_reason: ScriptEngine::update (ScriptEngine.cpp:5554-5581) now walks every side ScriptList and evaluateAndProgressAllSequentialScripts even when leftover OBJECT_REGISTRY is empty. execute_side_scripts_from_active_lists / evaluate_and_progress_all_sequential_scripts no longer fail-closed; sides walk MAX_PLAYER_COUNT like TheSidesList. Tests: empty_object_registry_still_runs_true_side_scripts, empty_object_registry_still_progresses_sequential_scripts.

title: [Locomotor] Live march ignores wheeled turnFactor so trucks spin in place
description:
## C++
`moveTowardsPositionWheels` (Locomotor.cpp:1437-1454): `turnFactor = |actualSpeed| / minTurnSpeed` (clamped 1), then `turnAmount = turnFactor * maxTurnRate`. Stationary trucks cannot yaw. `rotateObjAroundLocoPivot` (2113-2189) also uses turn_pivot_offset (0 while braking). Wheels cap desiredSpeed to minTurnSpeed on turns > PI/20.

## Leftover
hq-glk4v closed leftover `Locomotor.wheeled_turn_factor` + `step_angle`. Leftover crate is not called from the live host tick.

## Live
`GameLogic::update_movement` (`world_tick/movement.rs:305-316`) does `max_turn = obj.effective_turn_rate() * dt` then clamps yaw. No turnFactor, no minTurnSpeed cap, no `rotate_obj_around_loco_pivot` (that helper exists on Object but is unused by the live tick). `Object::update_movement` has wheel minTurnSpeed residual but has zero GameLogic callers.

## Player-visible
Humvees/trucks/technicals spin in place when given a new heading, then lurch forward. Retail arcs.
close_reason: Live GameLogic::update_movement and Object::rotate_towards_position apply wheeled turnFactor = |speed|/minTurnSpeed (clamped 1) and PI/20 speed cap, matching C++ Locomotor::moveTowardsPositionWheels Locomotor.cpp:1437-1454. Stationary trucks no longer yaw.

title: [Locomotor] Live never sets or applies ULTRA_ACCURATE
description:
## C++
`Locomotor::getMaxTurnRate` (Locomotor.cpp:796-798) multiplies turn by 2 when ULTRA_ACCURATE. `setPhysicsOptions` (911-925) adds EXTRA_FRIC 0.5. `moveTowardsPositionOther` (2344-2361) slides into place without rotating when within `goalSpeed * m_ultraAccurateSlideIntoPlaceFactor`. Callers set the flag: JetAIUpdate takeoff/landing (JetAIUpdate.cpp:259-260,615-616,725-726), Chinook takeoff/landing + MoveToBldg (ChinookAIUpdate.cpp:224-225,697-698), POWTruck pickup/return (POWTruckAIUpdate.cpp:149-150,292-293,319-320), ParachuteContain (ParachuteContain.cpp:315-316), Slaved panic (SlavedUpdate.cpp:672-673), SpectreGunship, DeliverPayload, RailedTransport.

## Leftover
GameLogic locomotor has `set_ultra_accurate`, turn*2, extra 0.5 friction, and slide-into-place (`move_ground.rs:491-530`). Jet/Chinook/POW leftover AI call it. Dual-world empty: leftover is not the live tick.

## Live
`Main/src/game_logic/world_tick/movement.rs` never reads `obj.ultra_accurate`. `effective_turn_rate` (physics.rs:831-848) has no *2. `set_locomotor_physics_options` extra-friction only runs if the flag is already true, and the only live writes are save/restore + a test (`ultra_accurate = true` never happens on jet/chinook/POW/parachute paths).

## Player-visible
Jets/chinooks overshoot pads; POW trucks miss prison docks; parachutes and slaved units do not get monster turning or slide-in. Precision landings fail.
close_reason: Object::effective_turn_rate *2 when ultra_accurate (Locomotor.cpp:796-798); set_ultra_accurate + extra friction; slide-into-place in update_movement; flag set on jet takeoff, heli takeoff/landing, dozer/worker Constructing/Repairing.

title: [Cave] First occupant never captures the cave network; Ranger capture kicks
description:
## C++
Caves are a distributed garrison (`CaveContain.cpp:254-336`):
- `onContaining` → `recalcApparentControllingPlayer`. Count==1 defects **all** caves on that `CaveIndex` to the rider's default team (`changeTeamOnAllConnectedCaves` + `Object::defect`). Count==0 restores `m_originalTeam`.
- `isKickOutOnCapture()` is FALSE (`CaveContain.h:83`). Ranger/Hacker capture of a cave does **not** dump occupants.
- Last occupant leaving (`onRemoving` count==0) un-captures every connected cave.

## Leftover
`cave_contain.rs` `recalc_apparent_controlling_player` / `change_team_on_all_connected_caves` / `is_kick_out_on_capture=false` match C++. Player does not run this crate.

## Live
No CaveSystem, so first enter cannot defect a connected network.
- Enter (`support_states.rs:2707-2734`) is local `add_occupant` only; no `changeTeamOnAllConnectedCaves`.
- `on_capture_kick_passengers` (`rebuild_dozer.rs:251-257`) comment says caves do not kick, but the skip is **tunnel templates only** — `is_cave_contain()` is not checked. Ranger capture of a Cave-kind structure ejects occupants.
- `on_capture_tunnel_network_residual` (`rebuild_dozer.rs:51-72`) returns unless `is_tunnel_network_style_container()`. Caves never re-home.

Distinct from closed `hq-haqz0` (GLA TunnelContain onCapture re-home).

## Player-visible
Infantry entering a civilian cave does not flip the whole cave network to their team. Capturing a cave dumps occupants at the door instead of keeping them inside.
close_reason: First occupant defects all caves on CaveIndex; last empty restores original team; Ranger capture does not kick cave occupants.

title: [Cave] Destroying a cave ejects occupants instead of CaveSystem cave-in
description:
## C++
`CaveContain::onDie` (`CaveContain.cpp:197-211`) overrides OpenContain — **no eject**:
- skip if die-mux inapplicable or UNDER_CONSTRUCTION
- `TheCaveSystem->unregisterCave` then `myTracker->onTunnelDestroyed`
`TunnelTracker::onTunnelDestroyed` (`TunnelTracker.cpp:187-220`): last entrance of that CaveIndex `destroyObject`s the shared pool (cave-in kill); otherwise remaps `ContainedBy` to a remaining cave.
`onRemoving` (`CaveContain.cpp:131-167`) places the occupant at **this** cave's position, un-HELDs, unhides drawable. Evacuate/exit at any connected cave of the same index.

## Leftover
`cave_contain.rs` `on_die` unregisters + `on_tunnel_destroyed_id`; `on_removing` places at owner. Crate `TunnelTracker` last-count cave-in kills. Player does not run this crate.

## Live
`destroy_list_bounty.rs:239-312` special-cases only `is_tunnel_network_style_container()` — Cave kind falls through to OpenContain-style eject-at-rubble (`:312+`).
Enter never calls `HostTunnelNetworkRegistry::record_enter` for caves, so there is no CaveIndex shared pool to keep or cave-in.
Evacuate cannot exit a different cave of the same index.

Distinct from closed `hq-v1804` / `hq-54vqz` (GLA TunnelContain last-tunnel cave-in).

## Player-visible
Destroying one cave of a network spills occupants alive at the rubble instead of keeping them in the remaining caves (or burying them if it was the last cave of that index).
close_reason: CaveContain onDie cave-in: last CaveIndex entrance kills shared pool; remaining remaps ContainedBy. No OpenContain eject.

title: [Cave] Live host has no CaveSystem — CaveIndex and SET_CAVE_INDEX never group caves
description:
## C++
`CaveContain` stores passengers in `TheCaveSystem` by `CaveIndex` (`CaveContain.cpp:43-47,170-192`).
- INI `CaveIndex` (`CaveContain.h:37`) defaults to 0; `onCreate` copies it (`CaveContain.cpp:215-218`).
- `onBuildComplete` (`CaveContain.cpp:221-233`) `registerNewCave` then `onTunnelCreated`.
- `tryToSetCaveIndex` (`CaveContain.cpp:236-249`) switches networks when both indices are empty (`CaveSystem::canSwitchIndexToIndex`).
- Script `SET_CAVE_INDEX` (`ScriptActions.cpp:5063-5075`) looks up `CaveInterface` and calls `tryToSetCaveIndex`.
Enter cave A, evacuate at cave B of the same index — same shared `TunnelTracker` pool.

## Leftover
`cave_contain.rs` + `cave_system.rs` implement index, register, and `try_to_set_cave_index`. Leftover executor `do_set_cave_index` (`actions_world.rs:1091-1112`) calls crate contain. Crate factories wire `TheCaveSystem`. Player does not run this crate.

## Live
`Main/src/game_logic` is Tunnel-only (`host_tunnel_network.rs:23-24` fail-closed: "Not CaveSystem multi-index").
- `spawn_templates.rs:1023-1027` maps `CaveContain` → `ContainModuleKind::Cave` + `ContainMax` only — **no `CaveIndex` field**.
- Enter (`support_states.rs:2719-2734`) shares the pool only for `is_tunnel_network_style_container()`, not `is_cave_contain()`.
- `SET_CAVE_INDEX` is a residual name (`host_script_map_team_player_residual.rs:302`) / enum (`core.rs:487`). Live host never calls `try_to_set_cave_index`.
Closed `hq-fh5b` fixed leftover CreateInterface register, not this live host path.

## Player-visible
Civilian/GLA cave maps: enter A cannot exit B. Campaign `SET_CAVE_INDEX` does nothing. Distinct CaveIndex networks collapse to independent local occupant lists (or nothing shared).
close_reason: Live CaveSystem indexes: INI CaveIndex, register on create, SET_CAVE_INDEX leftover queues to host try_set_cave_index. Same index shares pool.

title: [Select] Shift-drag keeps enemy/building in a mixed group
description:

`MetaEvent.cpp:571-596` inserts `MSG_MOUSE_LEFT_CLICK` **after** raw-up. Raw-up only ends the drag hint / alternate blank deselect (`SelectionXlat.cpp:905-950`). Point membership is resolved in `MSG_MOUSE_LEFT_CLICK` (`:575-830`) so the clicked unit stays selected.

title: [ControlBar] Generals-power buttons ignore NEED_SPECIAL_POWER_SCIENCE hide
description:
## C++
`ControlBar::populateCommand` (`ControlBarCommand.cpp:329-343`): NEED_SPECIAL_POWER_SCIENCE buttons hide (`winHide(TRUE)`) when `power->getRequiredScience() != SCIENCE_INVALID` and the local player does not own that science. Rank 1/3/8 ScienceVec is only used to copy the best owned icon/text (`:348-368` prefix scan, break at first unowned). Hide is never based on ScienceVec[0].

`getCommandAvailability` ScienceVec loop (`:1219-1261`) is only inside GUI_COMMAND_PLAYER_UPGRADE / GUI_COMMAND_OBJECT_UPGRADE.

## Leftover crate
`impl_buttons.rs:338-352` `apply_need_special_power_science`: if RequiredScience is SCIENCE_INVALID, falls back to `cmd.sciences_ids.first()` and hides when that science is unowned. Rank-progression ScienceVec (icon-only in C++) can vanish the button.

`impl_science.rs:1498-1506` `refresh_button_states` then applies `command_button_science_vec_owned` (`.all()` on every ScienceVec id) to **every** available command, not just upgrades. A Paladin/A10 button whose ScienceVec lists rank1+rank3+rank8 is Restricted until the player owns the whole chain. C++ keeps it clickable after the first required science.

If crate `logic_player_list` has no local player, the hide function returns early and the leftover path fail-opens.

## Live host
`unit_command_buttons` (`apply.rs:1393-1410`) always pushes `Command_ArtilleryBarrage` / `Command_Ambush` / `Command_SneakAttack` / `Command_LeafletDrop` / `Command_SpectreGunship` / `Command_CarpetBomb` as `enabled: true` from the Command Center name. No NEED_SPECIAL_POWER_SCIENCE / hasScience check. `button_map.rs` only maps names; `command_executor/leftover.rs` does not gate execute.

When OBJECT_REGISTRY misses (typical host), leftover `get_command_availability` fail-opens to Available (`impl_command_context.rs:236-243`).

## Player-visible
Selecting a Command Center shows A10 / Artillery / Ambush / Leaflet before those sciences are purchased, and leftover ControlBar grays rank-chained special-power buttons the player should still be able to fire.
acceptance_criteria: NEED_SPECIAL_POWER_SCIENCE command buttons hide unless the player owns the SpecialPowerTemplate RequiredScience. ScienceVec is only for upgrade icons and PLAYER/OBJECT_UPGRADE Restricted, never an ALL-owned gate on specials.
close_reason: Live+crate NEED_SPECIAL_POWER_SCIENCE hide uses SpecialPowerTemplate::getRequiredScience only (ControlBarCommand.cpp:329-343). apply_need_special_power_science no longer falls back to ScienceVec[0]; SCIENCE_INVALID does not hide. Rank 1/3/8 icon scan kept. Main host_need_special_power_science_owned uses required_science, not ScienceVec.

title: [ControlBar] Disabled selection wipes entire command strip
description:
## C++
`ControlBar::getCommandAvailability` (`ControlBarCommand.cpp:1048-1078`): if the object is disabled, only SELL / EVACUATE / EXIT_CONTAINER / BEACON_DELETE / SET_RALLY_POINT / STOP / SWITCH_WEAPON stay evaluable. Everything else is COMMAND_RESTRICTED (or COMMAND_HIDDEN if the forceDisabledEvaluation recurse would hide). Sell/stop/rally remain on an EMP'd or underpowered building.

`IGNORES_UNDERPOWERED` (`:1051-1058`) clears disabled only when UNDERPOWERED is the sole flag (`getDisabledFlags().count() == 1`).

## Leftover crate
`impl_command_context.rs:268-287` keeps Sell/Evacuate/Exit/DoStop/SwitchWeapons but omits BEACON_DELETE and SET_RALLY_POINT. IGNORES_UNDERPOWERED clears disabled whenever UNDERPOWERED is set and the object is not unmanned/subdued — EMP+unpowered still enables those buttons.

Standalone leftover `commands.rs:600-666` `get_command_availability` is a dead stub (no callers): `is_disabled()` grays every button including Sell.

## Live host
`PresentationFrame::unit_command_buttons` (`apply.rs:1176-1186`) returns an empty list unless `!disabled || under_construction`. HUD `apply_presentation_unit_commands` therefore shows no Sell / Stop / Rally / Evacuate on any disabled building. `command_executor/leftover.rs` and `button_map.rs` never restore those exceptions.

## Player-visible
EMP, hack, or low-power on a completed structure blanks the command strip. C++ still offers Sell, Stop, Rally, Evacuate, and Switch Weapon.
acceptance_criteria: EMP/hack/underpowered completed structure still shows Sell, Stop, Rally, Evacuate, Switch Weapon (and Beacon Delete). Other commands Restricted, not missing.
close_reason: C++ getCommandAvailability:1048-1078: disabled objects keep Sell/Evacuate/Exit/RemoveBeacon/SetRallyPoint/Stop/SwitchWeapons evaluable. IGNORES_UNDERPOWERED clears only when DISABLED_UNDERPOWERED count==1. Live apply.rs command-strip usable closures no longer drop disabled completed structures; apply_host_disabled_command_strip restricts other buttons.

title: [CIA] Intel is a static FOW ping and destalths instead of sharing enemy vision
description:
## C++
`SpyVisionSpecialPower.cpp:64-102`: disabled skip, duration = BaseDuration + containCount*BonusDurationPerCaptured capped at MaxDuration, `SpyVisionUpdate::activateSpyVision`. `SpyVisionUpdate.cpp:170-185` `doActivationWork` walks every enemy player and `Player::setUnitsVisionSpied` (`Player.cpp:3900-3907` → `Object::setVisionSpied` `:5222-5253`) so those units become **moving lookers** via `handlePartitionCellMaintenance`. Does **not** mark DETECTED / destalth. CommunicationsDownload uses the same no-target SpyVision family (`ActionManager.cpp:1897-1898`).

title: [Defector] Buildings and unfinished units can be defected
description:
## C++
`ActionManager.cpp:1696-1710` `SPECIAL_DEFECTOR`: buildings do not defect (`KINDOF_STRUCTURE`); only `ENEMIES`; then `canMakeObjectDefector` (`:936-965`) rejects dead/shrouded. `Object::defect` (`Object.cpp:6111-6132`) also returns if contained, `UNDER_CONSTRUCTION`, or `SOLD`.

Clicking an enemy Command Center, war factory, or hole-rebuild instantly converts it (free capture, including ImmuneToCapture / under-construction). Retail Defector only converts living enemy units, never buildings.
close_reason: activate_defector now rejects KINDOF_STRUCTURE, non-ENEMIES, contained_by, UNDER_CONSTRUCTION, SOLD per ActionManager.cpp:1696-1710 and Object.cpp:6111-6132 Object::defect. Returns false so execute_special_power does not consume.

title: [SP] Location click of CashHack/Defector spends the charge
description:
## C++
`CashHackSpecialPower.cpp:76-82` and `DefectorSpecialPower.cpp:69-76` override `doSpecialPowerAtLocation` to return after the disabled check — they do **not** call `SpecialPowerModule::doSpecialPowerAtLocation`, so no `triggerSpecialPower` / `startPowerRecharge`. ActionManager also rejects location use for these object-only powers.

## Leftover
`object/special_powers/cash_hack_special_power.rs:162-164` and `defector_special_power.rs:157-162` match the location no-op. Unused (empty registry).

## Live host

Ground-clicking CashHack or Defector starts the 4-minute (or DetectionTime) recharge and plays the fired path with no steal/defect. Retail location click does nothing and leaves the power ready.

C++ CashHackSpecialPower.cpp:76-82 and DefectorSpecialPower.cpp:69-76 doSpecialPowerAtLocation return after disabled check (no triggerSpecialPower/startPowerRecharge). Consume only after activate_cash_hack Some(_) / activate_defector true. Ground click continues with charge ready.

title: [GPS] Scrambler cloaks any vehicle/infantry without StealthUpdate
description:
## C++
`GrantStealthBehavior.cpp:159-179` `grantStealthToObject`: skip self, require INI KindOf (VEHICLE|INFANTRY), then **only if** `obj->getStealth()` call `receiveGrant()`. Units without a StealthUpdate module stay visible. `ThingTemplate.cpp:384-409` ImmuneToGPS / CandidateForGPS only decides whether a **default** StealthUpdate is inherited at parse — aircraft/boats/structures never get the module.

## Leftover
`special_power_module/gps_scrambler_power.rs` is an unused leftover **radar-jam** design (not GrantStealth). Not the live path.

## Live host
`world_combat/gps_and_fields.rs:18-98` `activate_gps_scrambler` grants every same-team VEHICLE|INFANTRY via `apply_grant_stealth` (`object/stealth.rs:266-281`) which force-sets `innate_stealth` + STEALTHED with no StealthUpdate requirement. Distinct from in-progress `hq-nk7w4` (grant never re-cloaks after first attack) and from sibling ALLOW_ALLIES vs same-team.

## Player-visible
GPS Scrambler cloaks Crusaders, Rangers, dozers — the whole army in the pulse. Retail only grants stealth to units that already have a StealthUpdate (Hijacker, Jarmen, inherited stealth candidates).
close_reason: is_legal_gps_scrambler_target now requires has_stealth_module (host innate_stealth). activate_gps_scrambler and update_gps_scrambler_grow skip apply_grant_stealth unless getStealth analog exists. C++ GrantStealthBehavior.cpp:170-179 grantStealthToObject only receiveGrant() if obj->getStealth(). Paladins/Rangers stay visible.

title: [CashHack] Superweapon steals from any clicked object
description:
## C++
`ActionManager.cpp:1652-1672` `SPECIAL_CASH_HACK` only returns true when target is `KINDOF_STRUCTURE` + `ENEMIES` + `KINDOF_CAPTURABLE` + not `KINDOF_REBUILD_HOLE` + not `OBJECT_STATUS_UNDER_CONSTRUCTION` + `KINDOF_CASH_GENERATOR`. `CashHackSpecialPower.cpp:76-82` location fire is a no-op (no base trigger). `:106-153` object fire: disabled skip, steal `min(findAmountToSteal(), victim money)`, ScoreKeeper, GUI:AddCash/+20z green, GUI:LoseCash/+30z red.

## Leftover
`GameEngine/GameLogic/src/object/special_powers/cash_hack_special_power.rs:169-291` ports steal/score/floats but uses leftover `TheGameLogic::find_object_by_id` (empty `OBJECT_REGISTRY` → unused). `special_power_module/cash_hack_power.rs` is a divergent unused design.

## Live host
`command_executor/special_power.rs:405-414` `SpecialPowerType::CashHack` accepts any `PowerTarget::Object` and calls `activate_cash_hack` with no KindOf/relationship/construction gate. `world_scripts/helix_radar.rs:1214-1303` steals from the victim object's controlling player via `steal_cash_between_players` (any living player). Distinct from closed `hq-4vpdu` (module-present gate) and from Black Lotus `StealCashHack` walk-to residual.

## Player-visible
China Command Center CashHack can drain any clicked unit or building (tanks, barracks, own-team if targeted), including under-construction and non-cash structures. Retail only steals from finished enemy supply/cash generators.
close_reason: activate_cash_hack now uses is_legal_superweapon_cash_hack_victim matching ActionManager.cpp:1652-1672 SPECIAL_CASH_HACK (STRUCTURE+ENEMIES+CAPTURABLE+CASH_GENERATOR, not REBUILD_HOLE/UNDER_CONSTRUCTION/SOLD). Invalid returns None (no audio, no last_stolen success). Empty coffers returns Some(0) and still fires. Executor continues without consume on None.

title: [Select] Classic empty LMB drag clears the army
description:

`SelectionXlat.cpp:575-597` `MSG_MOUSE_LEFT_CLICK`: empty region `break`s — no deselect. Classic empty LMB never clears. Only alternate-mouse blank LMB-up (`:930-937`) or classic RMB click (`:1018-1022`) calls `deselectAll`.

title: [SpySat] Ping never destalths units in the scan
description:
## C++
`SpySatellitePing` carries `StealthDetectorUpdate` (DetectionRate 500ms; DetectionRange 0 → VisionRange 300). While the ping lives, units in that radius are DETECTED so stealthed heroes/fighters/mines can be seen and shot.

## Leftover
Unused `special_power_module/` / crate SpyVision path. Not the live host.

## Live
`activate_spy_satellite` (`helix_radar.rs:1385-1387`) only stamps `stealth_detector_applied: true` on the bookkeeping struct. `spawn_spy_satellite_ping` never installs a detector or walks nearby stealthed objects. Distinct from CIA Intelligence (`setUnitsVisionSpied`) and from hq-nk7w4 (GPS grant recloak).

## Player-visible
Firing Spy Satellite reveals fog but Jarmen / Stealth Fighters / hijackers / mines under the ping stay stealthed and untargetable. Retail scan is the classic stealth-bust.
close_reason: SpySat ping destalths in scan via StealthDetectorUpdate

title: [Pathfind] assign_unit_path still hardcodes is_crusher=false
description:
## C++
Pathfinder::validMovementPosition (AIPathfind.cpp:4840-4842): if (isCrusher && toCell->isObstacleFence()) return true. isCrusher = obj->getCrusherLevel() > 0 (AIPathfind.cpp:8170). Crushers also walk CELL_RUBBLE. classifyFence stamps fence bits from ThingTemplate::getFenceWidth().

## Leftover
pathfind.rs PathfindCell::is_impassable (954-960) treats Obstacle as always impassable — leftover A* never applies the fence/crusher exception. leftover Path::optimize_ground_path hardcodes is_crusher=false (pathfind.rs:468-471). leftover complete AStarPathfinder::is_passable does implement the fence exception.

## Live host
Closed hq-epdcu fixed world_tick/movement.rs move_object_with_pathfinding (now passes crusher_level>0). The player click / assign path still does not:
- world_save.rs:812 compute_assigned_unit_path always passes is_crusher=false into find_path_ex_surfaces.
- pathfinding.rs:2208 find_path_ex hardcodes false; find_path → find_path_ex.
- PendingHostPath has no crusher field (pathfinding.rs:32-39), so queued moves cannot crush.
- request_object_path / assign_unit_attack_path / find_attack_firing_position all go through find_path (false).

## Player-visible
Overlords and tanks ordered to move or attack still treat fences and rubble as solid and path around (or halt) instead of crushing through.
close_reason: assign_unit_path / PendingHostPath / compute_assigned_unit_path / request_object_path / find_attack_firing_position pass real crusher_level>0. find_path_ex_surfaces ORs seeker crusher_level so find_path also crushes.

title: [Pathfind] Attack/requestPath still fail-open through walls
description:
## C++
AIInternalMoveToState::computePath (AIStates.cpp:1577-1585) never installs a straight-line fallback through blocked cells. A null path leaves the unit halted (AIStates.cpp:1771-1778). findAttackPath similarly returns NULL.

## Leftover
GameEngine/GameLogic/src/ai/pathfind.rs:1599-1603 Pathfinder::find_path_astar returns a two-node start→goal Path when A* fails. Free find_path (1728-1776) then samples a terrain-height straight line. Distinct from closed hq-3plv (move_object_with_pathfinding).

## Live host
- world_tick/attack.rs request_object_path: find_path(...).unwrap_or_else(|| vec![destination]) — comment says fail-closed but installs a 1-point dest that later becomes a two-point march.
- pathfinding.rs find_attack_firing_position:1868-1870 and 1918-1920 .or_else(|| Some(vec![from, test/goal])).
- world_tick/combat.rs:2332-2338: if assign_unit_attack_path fails, sets target_position = approach with an empty path (direct march).
move_object_with_pathfinding was fixed (closed hq-3plv); attack/chase paths were not.

## Player-visible
Units chasing or attack-moving through a sealed base walk through walls/buildings instead of stopping.
close_reason: request_object_path no longer unwrap_or dest. find_attack_firing_position no longer or_else start-goal. combat chase no longer sets target_position on A* miss.

title: [AIPlayer] Ready teams never setActive; host dumps all combat units
description:
## C++
`AIPlayer::checkReadyTeams` (AIPlayer.cpp:2729-2803) activates a ready `TeamInQueue` by `Team::setActive()` (OnCreate / production-condition actions — typically AttackMove / Hunt scripts) or `joinTeam()` for reinforcements, then `clearTeamFlags()` on skirmish. `selectTeamToBuild` (1630) only queues `TeamPrototype`s that pass `evaluateProductionCondition` / maxInstances / not-already-queued, after `selectTeamToReinforce`. There is no all-army raid latch.

## Leftover
`impl_runtime.rs:104` `check_ready_teams` calls `set_active`, `join_team_reinforcement`, `clear_team_flags`. `impl_dozer.rs:873` `select_team_to_build` walks player team prototypes + random hi-pri + reinforce-first. Dual-world empty / crate Player missing → unused on host.

## Live
`Main/src/ai.rs:1949` `check_ready_teams` only flips `activated` / `sent_to_start_location` on the host queue. No `Team::setActive`, no OnCreate, no `joinTeam`, no `clearTeamFlags`. `select_team_to_build` (2406) invents `USA_RangerSquad` / `China_TankSquad` / `GLA_TechnicalSquad` by personality phase. `evaluate_attack_opportunities` / `launch_attack` (2829-2997) then AttackMoves **every** `can_attack && is_mobile` unit at the enemy base when a strength ratio is met.

## Player-visible
Scripted attack teams never run their OnCreate. The AI instead sends dozers/harvesters-if-armed and the whole army in one 60s-gated raid, then idles until the latch clears. No auto-reinforce of existing teams.

Not a duplicate of closed hq-58em (update **order** now matches) or hq-94qyo (ready-queue idle/60s gate exists; activation still missing).
close_reason: Ready teams setActive + OnCreate AttackMove members only; no all-army dump

title: [AIPlayer] Live builds first affordable pad; C++ only priority+power
description:
## C++
`AISkirmishPlayer::processBaseBuilding` (AISkirmishPlayer.cpp:75-290) walks the build list. Priority entries are chosen first. Power (`KINDOF_FS_POWER` && !CASH_GENERATOR) can override when underpowered. Automatic entries hit `canMakeUnit(dozer, bldgPlan)` while `bldgPlan` is still NULL, so `CANMAKE_NO_PREREQ` continues and **automatic pads are never selected**. Scripts drive the base via `buildSpecificAIBuilding` → `markPriorityBuild` (AISkirmishPlayer.cpp:391-436).

## Leftover
`skirmish_player.rs:660` documents and keeps the NULL `bldgPlan` gate; `build_specific_ai_building` (`skirmish_player.rs:213`) stamps `mark_priority_build` on an existing list entry. Dual-world empty → no-op.

## Live
`Main/src/ai.rs:1186` `process_building_queue` picks the first `!is_built && is_buildable && object_id.is_none() && affordable` entry. No `automaticBuild` / `priorityBuild` flags. No script `buildSpecificAIBuilding` stamp. `setup_base_layout` seeds a hardcoded CC/SC/PP/WF/airfield list, so the AI dozer walks the whole list on StructureSeconds.

## Player-visible
Skirmish AI builds Strategy Center / Airfield / Palace on a timer instead of waiting for scripted priority. C++ AI stays on CC + scripted next-building + emergency power.

Not a duplicate of closed hq-5912 (leftover NULL-gate parity) or hq-n57lt (map SidesList consume when authored).
close_reason: processBaseBuilding priority+power only; automatic pads never selected

title: [AIPlayer] Live auto-fires first ready special, not script-named SW
description:
## C++
`ScriptActions::doSkirmishFireSpecialPowerAtMostCost` (ScriptActions.cpp:4142-4211) fires only the **named** SpecialPower from the map script. It walks that player's objects for a ready module of that template, calls `Player::computeSuperweaponTarget` with `max(50, radiusCursorRadius)`, then for `SPECIAL_SNEAK_ATTACK` legalizes via `calcClosestConstructionZoneLocation` before `doSpecialPowerAtLocation(..., COMMAND_FIRED_BY_SCRIPT)`. `AIPlayer::update` never auto-fires specials.

## Leftover
`actions_skirmish.rs:185` matches the named-power walk + sneak legalize, but Wave 284 empty `OBJECT_REGISTRY` returns Success no-op. Crate `compute_superweapon_target` / `AISkirmishPlayer::compute_superweapon_target` (impl_build.rs:583, skirmish_player.rs:566) are unused on the host path.

## Live
`Main/src/ai.rs:452` `try_fire_ready_special_powers` runs every `AIPlayer::update`. It collects **every** ready `special_power_modules` entry (A10, SpySat, Frenzy, Leaflet, EmergencyRepair, ClusterMines, …) and fires the first one at the value-grid / cluster-mines approach. No script name filter. Sneak uses `!sneak` scoring but never `calcClosestConstructionZoneLocation`. Command is a player `DoSpecialPower`, not `COMMAND_FIRED_BY_SCRIPT`.

## Player-visible
Skirmish AI dumps A10 / spy / frenzy / repair / mines as soon as they are ready, instead of waiting for `SKIRMISH_FIRE_SPECIAL_POWER_AT_MOST_COST SuperweaponParticleUplinkCannon` (etc.). GLA sneak tunnels can land on illegal pads.

Not a duplicate of closed hq-n6ugd (radiusCursor now applied) or hq-o12q0 (cluster-mines approach-path exists; NukeDrop maps to NUKE_SPECIAL_CLUSTER_MINES).
close_reason: AIPlayer::update never auto-fires; named script SW only

title: [Pathfind] Crush-through units never reach live A* — tanks detour around cars
description:
## C++
`Pathfinder::checkForMovement` (AIPathfind.cpp:5037-5066) + `examineNeighboringCells` (:6241-6244): occupying `UNIT_PRESENT_FIXED` units set `enemyFixed` only when `!obj->canCrushOrSquish(unit, TEST_CRUSH_OR_SQUISH)`. A* then `continue`s that neighbor. Crushers therefore plan through idle cars/infantry and squash them.

## Leftover
`pathfind_complete/check_movement.rs:411-450` ports `can_crush_or_squish`. `find_path.rs` uses it for line-seed abort (`line_ok`) and ally cost (`ally_extra`) but the A* neighbor walk never skips on `enemy_fixed`. Live host never calls leftover `PathfindingSystem::find_path`.

## Live
`world_tick/movement.rs:58-65` → `PathfindingSystem::find_path_ex_surfaces` → `find_path_via_crate` extra closure (`pathfinding.rs:1678-1720`). Other-player `occ_fixed_mask` returns `u32::MAX/8` with no `is_crusher` / `canCrushOrSquish`. `update_dynamic_obstacles` stamps parked vehicles and infantry as fixed.

## Player-visible
Overlords and tanks halt or snake around idle cars and infantry instead of driving through and crushing them.

## Evidence
AIPathfind.cpp:5037-5066, 6241-6244; check_movement.rs:411-450; pathfinding.rs:1678-1720, 1089-1146; movement.rs:58-65.
Closed fence/rubble crusher beads (hq-epdcu, hq-yqr7q) do not cover occupying units.
close_reason: Live crate A* extra cost uses canCrushOrSquish: enemy_fixed occupancy is not MAX/8 when seeker crusher_level > occupant crushable_level. Crushers plan through idle cars/infantry.

title: [XP] C4/TNT special objects never sink kill XP to the planter
description:
## C++
`SpecialAbilityUpdate::createSpecialObject` (`SpecialAbilityUpdate.cpp:1636-1642`) sets `xpTracker->setExperienceSink(getObject()->getID())` on RemoteC4 / TimedC4 / TNT so the charge's `scoreTheKill` / `addExperiencePoints` forwards to the planter. `ExperienceTracker::addExperiencePoints` (`ExperienceTracker.cpp:126-135`) forwards `experienceGain * m_experienceScalar` to the sink.

## Leftover Rust
`special_ability_update.rs:1552-1553` ports `set_experience_sink(owner_id)` on the created special object. Leftover never runs (`OBJECT_REGISTRY` empty).

## Live host
`place_mine_kind` (`stealth_mines.rs:1426-1443`) sets `producer_id` but never `experience_sink`. `note_producer` only sinks `KindOf::Projectile`. Detonate (`detonate_mine_internal:2030-2068`) attributes damage to `mine_id` and `mark_object_for_destruction(vid, Some(mine_team))`; `let _ = producer` is unused. Charges have `weapon = None` and are untrainable.

## Player-visible
Burton / Tank Hunter C4 and TNT kills never level the hero. Rank points may also miss if the charge has no `owner_player_id`.
close_reason: C4/TNT place_mine_kind now setExperienceSink(planter) and detonate scoreTheKill forwards XP via award_experience sink.

title: [Veterancy] Level-up never sets WEAPONSET or WEAPONBONUSCONDITION flags
description:
## C++
`Object::onVeterancyLevelChanged` (`Object.cpp:3064-3124`) on every rank change: `updateUpgradeModules`, `giveUpgrade(findVeterancyUpgrade)`, `BodyModule::onVeterancyLevelChanged`, then exclusive `setWeaponSetFlag(WEAPONSET_VETERAN/ELITE/HERO)` and `setWeaponBonusCondition(WEAPONBONUSCONDITION_VETERAN/ELITE/HERO)`. Those flags select authored WeaponTemplateSets and stamp `MODELCONDITION_WEAPONSET_*`. ActiveBody then applies `HealthBonus` and ARMORSET flags.

## Leftover Rust

## Live host
`Object::apply_veterancy_bonuses` (`object/update.rs:583-617`) only scales HP / `weapon.damage` / `weapon.reload_time` and `set_veterancy_armor_set_flags`. `set_weapon_set_flag` (`object/record.rs:596-614`) accepts only PLAYER_UPGRADE / MINE_CLEARING / CARBOMB / VEHICLE_HIJACK — no VETERAN/ELITE/HERO. Wave 506 presentation residual stamps model bits with `playable_claim = false`.

## Player-visible
Promoted units keep the rookie WeaponSet. Authored veteran/elite/hero weapons and WEAPONSET model conditions never switch; GameData WeaponBonus conditions never stack with garrison/horde/battle-plan at fire time.
close_reason: apply_veterancy_bonuses sets exclusive WEAPONSET_VETERAN/ELITE/HERO and WEAPONBONUSCONDITION flags plus model bits.

title: [JetAI] Empty jets bleed HP in place instead of circling last airfield
description:
## C++
JetOrHeliReturnForLandingState (JetAIUpdate.cpp:1508-1546) if getPP(producer) is null, nukes producer and findSuitableAirfield. Failure goes to RETURN_TO_DEAD_AIRFIELD (396-416) which flies to the remembered producer location, then CIRCLING_DEAD_AIRFIELD (315-386): setLocomotorGoalNone, play VoiceLowFuel, and only then apply OutOfAmmoDamagePerSecond * SECONDS_PER_LOGICFRAME * maxHealth as DAMAGE_UNRESISTABLE. Rechecks for a new airfield once per second.

## Leftover
jet_ai_update.rs ports ReturnToDeadAirfield (1331-1339) and CirclingDeadAirfield (1341-1385) including VoiceLowFuel on enter (859-863) and the damage drip. JetAIUpdate::update / handle_command Wave 309-return when OBJECT_REGISTRY is empty, so leftover never ticks on host-only play.

## Live
tick_out_of_ammo_jet_damage (world_tick/airfield.rs:31-51) calls try_return_to_base_rearm; on failure immediately apply_out_of_ammo_damage_frame (object/rtb.rs:253-279) at a hardcoded 10%/sec. No fly-to-last-airfield, no circling hover, no VoiceLowFuel.

## Player-visible
When the home airfield is sold/destroyed, empty Raptors/Auroras/Stealths start dying on the spot instead of circling the wreck and calling low-fuel.
close_reason: Empty jets fly to remembered producer location then CIRCLING_DEAD_AIRFIELD (VoiceLowFuel + OutOfAmmoDamage). No bleed-in-place.

title: [JetAI] Parked rearm is instant — heal tick dumps full clips
description:
## C++
JetOrHeliReloadAmmoState (JetAIUpdate.cpp:1423-1483) computes reload time as max over weapon slots of clipReloadTime * (clipSize-remaining) / clipSize (min 1 frame). Each update setClipPercentFull(progress) so the ammo bar fills over that time, then succeeds when every clip is full.

## Leftover
jet_ai_update.rs ReloadAmmo state ports the biased duration + progressive fill. Wave 309 empty-registry gate: leftover never ticks on the live host.

## Live
try_return_to_base_rearm (airfield.rs:1381-1402) can wait airfield_rearm_clip_reload_frames (full ClipReload of empty weapons, not remaining-biased, not progressive). Same-frame tick_airfield_parking_heal (airfield.rs:1461-1463) then rearm_return_to_base_weapons() the instant a jet is contained_by an airfield, wiping the timer. Aurora honesty ClipReload is 5000ms; Stealth 8000ms.

## Player-visible
Landed jets refill missiles/bombs the frame they dock. No reload wait, no filling ammo bar. Aurora/Stealth/Raptor can sortie again immediately.
close_reason: Parked rearm is remaining-biased ClipReload * needed/clipSize with setClipPercentFull on heal tick. No instant full-clip dump.

title: [Cam] Edge, RMB, and key scroll stack instead of exclusive types
description:
## C++
`LookAtXlat.cpp` `m_scrollType` is exclusive (`SCROLL_RMB` / `SCROLL_KEY` / `SCROLL_SCREENEDGE`). `MSG_FRAME_TICK` switches on one type. Arrow keys are ignored while RMB/edge scrolling (`:174-175`). Edge start only when `!m_isScrolling` (`:286-291`).

## Leftover

title: [Spawn] Tunnel Network never free-spawns its two RPG troopers
description:
## C++
`SpawnBehavior::update` (`SpawnBehavior.cpp:176-247`) first-init queues `SpawnNumber` replacement times due immediately, then `createSpawn` (`:580-727`) when `shouldTryToSpawn` (`:802-823`) is true (not UNDER_CONSTRUCTION / SOLD / RECONSTRUCTING+OneShot / Neutral).

`createSpawn` requires an ExitInterface, `ThingFactory::newObject` on the parent's team, `Player::onUnitCreated`, `setProducer`, SlavedUpdate `onEnslave`, then `exitObjectViaDoor` (or budding).

GLA Tunnel Network (`FactionBuilding.ini` SpawnBehavior): `SpawnNumber = 2`, `SpawnTemplateName = GLAInfantryTunnelDefender`, `OneShot = Yes`. Completing a tunnel (or map-placing a finished one) immediately creates two free RPG troopers at the exit.

## Leftover Rust
`GameEngine/GameLogic/src/object/behavior/spawn_behavior.rs` `create_spawn` / `should_try_to_spawn` ports the C++ create half (exit door, orphan reclaim, budding, `on_unit_created_id`). Wave 346: when `OBJECT_REGISTRY` is empty the live host path is used and `create_spawn` returns `Ok(false)` — leftover crate never runs.

## Live host
`host_tunnel_network.rs` only stores honesty constants (`TUNNEL_NETWORK_SPAWN_NUMBER = 2`, `TUNNEL_NETWORK_SPAWN_TEMPLATE`, `TUNNEL_NETWORK_SPAWN_ONE_SHOT`). No call site creates those objects.

`create_destroy_die.rs` `apply_create_modules_on_build_complete` / `spawn_supply_center_one_shot_collector` handles SupplyCenter/Stash ModuleTag_12 only. Angry Mob and Stinger have separate residuals. Tunnel completion never calls a SpawnBehavior create path.

## Player-visible result
A finished GLA Tunnel Network has no free RPG troopers. C++ gives two `GLAInfantryTunnelDefender` (and general variants) on the first eligible update after UNDER_CONSTRUCTION clears. The player must buy troopers that retail hands out with the building.
close_reason: Tunnel Network OneShot now create_object()s 2 GLAInfantryTunnelDefender world objects via apply_spawn_behavior_on_build_complete (create_destroy_die.rs + host_tunnel_network.rs latch).

## C++
`GarrisonContain::isImmuneToClearBuildingAttacks` returns INI `ImmuneToClearBuildingAttacks` (default false; retail faction bunkers Yes). `ActiveBody::estimateDamage` / `DAMAGE_KILL_GARRISONED` (`ActiveBody.cpp:272-278, 421-454`) and projectile `GarrisonHitKill` only kill occupants when the container `isGarrisonable()` and `!isImmuneToClearBuildingAttacks()`. Immune bunkers take no occupant clears from microwave / toxin / flashbang / flame.

## Leftover
`garrison_contain.rs:is_immune_to_clear_building_attacks` reads the module flag. Player never hits this crate.

## Live host
`spawn_templates.rs` GarrisonContain parse does not keep `ImmuneToClearBuildingAttacks`. `apply_kill_garrisoned_to_target` (`missile_defenders.rs:1951-2014`) and `apply_garrison_hit_kill` (`weapon_bootstrap/projectile_flight.rs:416-469`) kill occupants on any garrisonable container with no immune gate.

## Player-visible
Microwave Tank / Dragon flame / Ranger flashbang / toxin clearers wipe infantry out of China bunkers and other ImmuneToClear buildings. In retail those occupants survive until the bunker itself is destroyed.
close_reason: parse ImmuneToClearBuildingAttacks; gate apply_kill_garrisoned_to_target + apply_garrison_hit_kill

title: [Dozer] Repair order accepts holes, bridges, shroud, and second dozers
description:
## C++
`ActionManager::canRepairObject` (`ActionManager.cpp:359-422`) rejects: enemies, dead, KINDOF_BRIDGE / KINDOF_BRIDGE_TOWER, UNDER_CONSTRUCTION (dozer or target), KINDOF_REBUILD_HOLE, non-dozer, non-structure, full health, shrouded, contained dozer.

`DozerAIUpdate::privateRepair` (`DozerAIUpdate.cpp:1782-1797`) also refuses if `getSoleHealingBenefactor()` is another unit. `InGameUI` right-click (`InGameUI.cpp:4322-4327`) repeats that sole-benefactor gate for the player command.

## Leftover Rust
Crate Dozer/Worker repair leftover was fixed to sole-benefactor (`hq-8yfw0`, closed). GameEngine leftover is not the live command path.

## Live host
`command_executor/leftover.rs` `execute_repair` (`:506-565`) only requires: target alive + Structure + damaged + not under construction; dozer `can_repair()` + not contained + `repair_relationship_is_not_enemy`. Comment at `:513` admits fail-closed vs sole-benefactor / scaffolding.

Missing vs C++:
- No KINDOF_REBUILD_HOLE / `is_rebuild_hole` reject (holes are spawned as Structure with HP, `rebuild_dozer.rs:1421-1465`)
- No KINDOF_BRIDGE / BRIDGE_TOWER reject
- No shroud check
- No sole-benefactor reject at command issue (`dozer_new_task_repair` only parks BUILD)

## Player-visible
A dozer can be ordered onto a GLA rebuild hole and heal it instead of leaving the hole to rebuild. Two dozers can both be sent to the same damaged building. Bridges and fogged buildings accept the repair order.
close_reason: leftover.rs execute_repair: reject rebuild holes, bridges, shroud, sole-benefactor second dozer

title: [Build] Line-build walls scaffold at 20-unit stretch instead of instant majorRadius tiles
description:
## C++
`BuildAssistant::buildObjectNow` (`BuildAssistant.cpp:346-357`) uses `ai->construct` only when the constructor is a dozer **and** `isLineBuildTemplate(what) == FALSE`. Line-build templates (KINDOF_LINEBUILD) take the else arm (`:358-418`): `newObject` with UNDER_CONSTRUCTION, then immediate `onStructureCreated` + `onStructureConstructionComplete` so each segment finishes in the same frame.

`buildObjectLineNow` (`:430-452`) tiles with `majorRadius * 2.0`, `TheGlobalData->m_maxLineBuildObjects` (retail 50), and `buildTiledLocations` (`:1090-1191`) which marches along the normalized start→end vector by that spacing and **stops at the first illegal tile**.

`InGameUI::handleBuildPlacements` (`InGameUI.cpp:1489-1560`) previews with the same `buildTiledLocations` helper.

## Leftover Rust
`Common/src/common/system/build_assistant.rs` `build_object_line_now` / `build_tiled_locations` (`:535-702`) match C++ spacing and stop-on-illegal, but `build_object_now` is a backend hook. Live tick explicitly skips crate `BuildAssistant::update` (`world_tick/step.rs:969-974`). Empty-registry leftover is not what the player runs.

## Live host
`command_executor/construct.rs` `execute_dozer_line` (`:151-192`):
- Hardcoded `spacing = 20.0`, max **32** (not `MAX_LINE_BUILD_OBJECTS=50`)
- Interpolates `t = i/(count-1)` from start **to end** (last segment always at the cursor, spacing stretches)
- Calls `execute_dozer_construct` → `execute_build` per tile (UNDER_CONSTRUCTION + dozer assigned; first success still continues, dozer ends on the last tile)
- Does **not** stop at first illegal location; each tile is attempted independently
- No `isLineBuildTemplate` instant-complete branch

`place_icons.rs` `tile_line_build_icons` (`:219-288`) uses AABB max-min as object size, max 50, stretch interpolation, and marks every extra icon `illegal = false`.

## Player-visible
China/GLA walls do not pop in complete along a majorRadius grid. Segments appear as scaffolds, only the last one gets the dozer, spacing is wrong, lines continue through rocks/cliffs, and the drag preview never tints illegal tiles red.
close_reason: construct.rs execute_dozer_line + place_icons.rs: majorRadius*2 tiles, max 50, stop-on-illegal, same-frame complete

title: [TurretAI] Patriot Gattling SC fire without finished turret aim
description:
## C++
`TurretAIAimTurretState::update` (`TurretAI.cpp:1146-1175`) returns SUCCESS only when yaw+pitch aligned **and** `isWithinAttackRange`. FIRE is `AIAttackFireWeaponState` with `outOfWeaponRangeObject → AIM` (`:67-77`). `isTryingToAimAtTarget` (`:474`) keeps the body attack SM from discharging while the barrel is still traversing. FiresWhileTurning (`:684`) only keeps `TurretMoveLoop` during the 3-frame post-shot sweep — it does **not** skip aim.

## Leftover
`turret.rs:841-845` wrongly treats `fires_while_turning` as skip-aim (`can_fire_at_target` without alignment). Unused (empty registry).

## Live host
`try_base_defense_residual_fire` (`world_combat/strategy_center.rs:379-632`) auto-fires Patriot/Gattling/Stinger/Tunnel as soon as the weapon is ready. Comment: "not full AutoAcquire LOS / turret pitch". No `tick_turret_aim` / alignment gate. `try_strategy_center_bombardment_turret_fire` (`:13-337`) likewise fires then **snaps** `turret_angle_deg`/`turret_pitch_deg` via `strategy_center_turret_aim_at` (`:317-325`). Generic SM (`tick_turret_aim`) is a separate slow turn that the snap overwrites.

## Player-visible
Patriots launch while the launcher is still at the spawn -90°/45° pose (or mid-crawl). Strategy Center bombardment gun pops onto the target instead of traversing. Leftover skip-aim is not live, but live residual fire is the same observable: shots without a finished turn.
close_reason: Patriot/Gattling/SC residual fire gated on tick_turret_aim Success. SC no longer snaps. Bombardment enableTurret(true). files: world_combat/strategy_center.rs world_combat/heroes_and_plans.rs

title: [TurretAI] TurretTurnRate never applied so barrels crawl at 17 deg/s
description:
## C++
`TurretAIData::buildFieldParse` (`TurretAI.cpp:216-217`) parses `TurretTurnRate` / `TurretPitchRate` via `INI::parseAngularVelocityReal` (deg/s → rad/logic-frame). Retail: Crusader/Humvee **180** deg/s, Technical **240**, Tomahawk/Strategy Center **60**, Nuke Cannon **80**. `friend_turnTowardsAngle` (`:368-405`) steps `getTurnRate() * rateModifier` per frame. Recenter/idle-scan use rate **0.5**.

## Leftover
`ai_update_interface.rs:533-548` parses both rates correctly. Unused when `OBJECT_REGISTRY` is empty.

## Live host
`object/mod.rs:132-134` `default_turret_turn_rate() = 0.01` rad/frame (~**17 deg/s**). Spawn never copies INI or the host honesty constants (`USA_TANK_TURRET_TURN_RATE`, `HUMVEE_TURRET_TURN_RATE`, … — test-only). `Object::turn_turret_towards_angle_rad` (`weapons.rs:655-681`) and pitch (`:687-706`) both use `turret_turn_rate_rad`. Pitch extra `pitch_rate` is seeded from that same default.

## Player-visible
A 180° tank traverse takes ~10s instead of ~1s. Patriots/Humvees crawl onto target; shots wait (or residual fire launches off-axis). Recenter after combat is similarly slow.
close_reason: Spawn copies TurretTurnRate (INI or honesty: Crusader/Humvee 180, Technical 240, Tomahawk/SC 60, Nuke 80) via parseAngularVelocityReal. files: object/turret_spawn.rs object/construct.rs

title: [TurretAI] Idle-scan invented for tanks Humvee Patriot
description:
## C++
`TurretAIData` defaults `m_minIdleScanAngle = m_maxIdleScanAngle = 0` and intervals **9999999** (`TurretAI.cpp:170-175`). `TurretAIIdleScanState::onEnter` (`:1338-1343`) returns SUCCESS immediately when both angles are 0 — **no rotation**. Only units that author `Min/MaxIdleScanAngle` (Strategy Center 0–60°, Tomahawk 0–45°) wander while idle. Crusader/Paladin/Humvee/Patriot typically have no scan block.

## Leftover
`turret.rs` ports the 0/0 early-out. Empty-registry no-op.

## Live host
`seed_host_turret_extra` (`world_tick/attack.rs:93-130`) name-matches `tank|humvee|patriot|cannon|gattling|missiledefender|scorpion|overlord` and **invents** `max_idle_scan_angle = 45°`, intervals **15–30** frames. Generic SM Idle (`:886-928`) then IdleScan-turns every half-second. Strategy Center **also** has `tick_strategy_center_turret_idle_scan` (`world_combat/heroes_and_plans.rs:19`) from `world_tick/ai.rs:23`, so SC is double-stepped.

## Player-visible
Idle Crusader/Humvee/Patriot turrets constantly hunt left/right. Retail they sit still until a target. Strategy Center scan is faster/jerky vs retail 500–1000 ms random.
close_reason: Removed invented 45deg idle-scan for tank/humvee/patriot. Scan only when Min/MaxIdleScanAngle authored. SC generic SM skipped. files: world_tick/attack.rs object/turret_spawn.rs

title: [TurretAI] Every object spawns turret-enabled at Strategy Center -90/45
description:
## C++
`TurretAI::TurretAI` (`TurretAI.cpp:248-285`) is constructed only when `AIUpdateModuleData` has a `Turret`/`AltTurret` block (`AIUpdate.cpp:271-275`). Ctor sets `m_angle`/`m_pitch` to `NaturalTurretAngle`/`NaturalTurretPitch` (defaults **0/0**). `m_enabled = !m_initiallyDisabled`. Strategy Center is the special case: `NaturalTurretAngle = -90`, `NaturalTurretPitch = 45`, `InitiallyDisabled = Yes` until Bombardment `enableTurret(true)`.

## Leftover
`GameLogic/src/ai/turret.rs` ports natural pose + `InitiallyDisabled`. Dual-world `OBJECT_REGISTRY.is_empty()` no-ops most methods, so leftover is not what the player runs.

## Live host
`object/construct.rs:748-761` (and the clone ctor `:1448-1461`) on **every** `Object`:
- `turret_angle_deg = STRATEGY_CENTER_NATURAL_TURRET_ANGLE_DEG` (**-90**)
- `turret_pitch_deg = STRATEGY_CENTER_NATURAL_TURRET_PITCH_DEG` (**45**)
- `turret_natural_angle_deg/pitch = 0`
- `turret_enabled = true`
`world_tick/step.rs:743` then `tick_all_turret_state_machines` for every enabled object.

## Player-visible
Crusader/Humvee/Patriot/Tomahawk spawn with the turret cocked 90° left and 45° up. Infantry/dozers also run a turret SM. Strategy Center gun scans/aims even without Bombardment (`InitiallyDisabled` ignored).
close_reason: TurretAI only on units with Turret/AltTurret; Object::new uses turret_spawn_for_template. SC -90/45 InitiallyDisabled. files: object/turret_spawn.rs object/construct.rs object/mod.rs

title: [Fire] Buildings never catch fire — only tree-named props ignite
description:
## C++
`FlammableUpdate::onDamage` (`FlammableUpdate.cpp:78-100`) on **any** object that has the module: DAMAGE_FLAME / DAMAGE_PARTICLE_BEAM subtracts `actualDamageDealt` from `m_flameDamageLimit` and `tryToIgnite()` (`:170-197`) sets OBJECT_STATUS_AFLAME, `body->setAflame(TRUE)`, MODELCONDITION_AFLAME, starts BurningSound, and wakes `FireSpreadUpdate`. Retail buildings (oil derrick FlameDamageLimit 20 / AflameDamage 25, black market, Particle Uplink, etc.) all use this module.

## Leftover Rust
`GameEngine/GameLogic/src/object/behavior/flammable_update.rs` ports on_damage / try_to_ignite, but Wave 379 `dual_world_registry_unavailable()` (OBJECT_REGISTRY empty) no-ops `do_aflame_damage` / `update_simple`. `try_to_ignite` never starts FireSpreadUpdate or burning sound. `object/update/flammable_update.rs` is a more complete unused twin.

## Live host
`install_fire_spread_if_needed` (`object/install.rs:266-274`) only attaches `HostFireSpreadData::for_template` when `is_fire_spread_template` (`host_fire_spread.rs:245-253`) matches dogwood/tree/shrubbery name heuristics. `damage.rs:389-400` `apply_flame_damage` is a no-op unless `object.fire_spread` is Some. Oil-derrick / black-market / PUC aflame constants exist as honesty peels and are never installed.

## Player-visible result
Flame weapons still chip building HP, but oil derricks, markets, PUC, and other flammable structures never ignite, never take 25 HP / 500ms aflame DoT, never play the fire loop, and never look aflame. Only some trees catch fire.
close_reason: install_fire_spread for_template now attaches FlammableUpdate for oil derrick / black market / PUC (not just tree-name heuristics). Flame hits on those buildings call apply_flame_damage → tryToIgnite + AFLAME visuals/DoT.

title: [Spawn] Tunnel Network never OneShot-spawns RPG troopers
description:
## C++
`SpawnBehavior::update` / `createSpawn` (`SpawnBehavior.cpp:176-248`, `:580-726`) on GLA Tunnel Network: INI `SpawnNumber=2`, `OneShot=Yes`, `SpawnTemplateName=GLAInfantryTunnelDefender`. After construction, two RPG troopers exit via the building ExitInterface and are independent infantry (not residual slots).

## Live host
`host_tunnel_network.rs` stores `TUNNEL_NETWORK_SPAWN_NUMBER=2`, `TUNNEL_NETWORK_SPAWN_TEMPLATE`, `TUNNEL_NETWORK_SPAWN_ONE_SHOT=true` as honesty constants only (`honesty_*` pack). `create_destroy_die.rs` has `spawn_supply_center_one_shot_collector` for SupplyCenter ModuleTag_12; there is no Tunnel Network equivalent. A finished Tunnel Network is just the building + residual TunnelNetworkGun. C++ walks two free RPG troopers out the door. Live: no free army, no exit animation, GLA opening is short two infantry.
