title: [Hive] Combat hits Stinger Site HP instead of soldiers
description:
## C++
`HiveStructureBody::attemptDamage` (`HiveStructureBody.cpp:45-112`) if the incoming type is in `PropagateDamageTypesToSlavesWhenExisting` (Stinger INI: SMALL_ARMS + SNIPER + POISON + RADIATION + SURRENDER + MICROWAVE): finds `SpawnBehaviorInterface`, `getClosestSlave(shooter->pos)`, and `slave->attemptDamage`. No slave + type in `SwallowDamageTypesIfSlavesNotExisting` (SNIPER + POISON + SURRENDER): zeros dealt/clipped and sets `noEffect`. Other types (rockets, explosives) hit `StructureBody` as usual.

## Leftover Rust
`hive_structure_body.rs` `BodyModuleInterface::attempt_damage` (`:315-343`) ports propagate/swallow, but Wave 389 `dual_world_registry_unavailable()` (`OBJECT_REGISTRY` empty) returns `Ok(())` immediately. `try_damage_slave` is the same empty-registry no-op. Leftover never runs on the live host.

## Live host
`Object::take_damage_from_typed` (`game_logic/object/damage.rs`) has no HiveStructureBody branch. All combat/AOE callers (`world_combat/*`) call `take_damage_from` and always apply armor-scaled structure HP.

`apply_host_hive_damage_from` (`world_scripts/saboteur_car_bomb.rs:850-1033`) implements the residual roster + getClosestSlave + swallow matrix, but its own comment says **Host API residual only** — combat/AOE still hits structure HP. Tests call the API; skirmish fire does not.

## Player-visible result
Rangers, snipers, toxin trucks, and microwave weapons chew through the Stinger Site's 1000 HP hull. C++ kills the 100 HP soldiers first; an empty hive swallows sniper/poison/surrender (building immune). Live: the site dies like a Patriot while residual slave HP never changes.
close_reason: live take_damage HiveStructureBody propagate/swallow: small-arms/sniper hit slaves not bunker

title: [Spawn] Stinger soldiers never exist as world objects
description:
## C++
`SpawnBehavior::createSpawn` (`SpawnBehavior.cpp:580-726`) `ThingFactory->newObject` of `GLAInfantryStingerSoldier` (SpawnNumber 3, SpawnReplaceDelay 30000ms), `setProducer`, `onEnslave`, then `exitObjectViaDoor` / budding. Soldiers are real Objects: models, selection, individual targeting, their own Stinger missiles (SPAWNS_ARE_THE_WEAPONS). `onDie`/`onDelete` with `SpawnedRequireSpawner` kill remaining slaves. `onSpawnDeath` queues replacement.

## Leftover Rust
`spawn_behavior.rs` `create_spawn` (`:715-718`) Wave 346 empty-registry returns `Ok(false)`. `on_die`, `on_damage`, `on_spawn_death`, `compute_aggregate_states`, and slave-order helpers are the same no-op. Leftover never creates soldiers when `OBJECT_REGISTRY` is empty.

## Live host
`create_destroy_die.rs:916-933` only `init_stinger_hive_slave_roster()` — three `ResidualHiveSlave` slots (HP/facing/AI-order flags) plus attach presentation. Comments: fail-closed, not a full soldier Object / W3D bone GPU. `update_stinger_hive_respawns` revives a dead slot after 900 frames; it never `create_object`s `GLAInfantryStingerSoldier`. The site itself binds residual `StingerMissileWeapon` and auto-fires as the soldiers would.

## Player-visible result
A finished Stinger Site is an empty pad. No three infantry stand around it, cannot be clicked or sniped as units, and do not walk out after the 30s replace delay. Missiles come from the building. Selling/destroying the site leaves no dying soldiers.
close_reason: Stinger Site SpawnBehavior now creates 3 GLAInfantryStingerSoldier world objects; SpawnedRequireSpawner kills them with the site; respawn hook fills replacements.

title: [GuardRetaliate] After killing aggressor far from post, unit Moves then Idles and abandons Guard
description:
## C++
`GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/AI/AIGuardRetaliate.cpp` `AIGuardRetaliateMachine` ctor (~151) and `AIGuardRetaliateReturnState` / `IdleState` / `lookForInnerTarget` (~198).
Default state is ATTACK_AGGRESSOR. On success/fail → RETURN (`AIInternalMoveTo` toward the guard pos, scanning for a new inner target at `m_guardEnemyReturnScanRate`). Idle can `lookForInnerTarget` (enemies, enter/hijack, **RejectBuildings**) or `EXIT_MACHINE_WITH_SUCCESS`. Crate → GET_CRATE. Aggressor interrupt via `hasAttackedMeAndICanReturnFire`. Stays inside the retaliate machine until idle finds nothing.

## Leftover
`GameEngine/GameLogic/src/ai/guard_retaliate.rs` ports inner/outer/return/crate/aggressor. `dual_world_registry_unavailable()` (empty `OBJECT_REGISTRY`) fail-closes. Not live.

## Live host
`object/orders.rs` `tick_guard_retaliate` is explicitly "Fail-closed vs full AIGuardRetaliateMachine".
If victim dead/gone and farther than `CLOSE_ENOUGH` (25) from the anchor: `move_to(anchor)`, clear target, **`set_ai_state(AIState::Moving)`**, return. Arrival (`stop_moving`) then forces **Idle**. `begin_guard_retaliate` may have stashed `guard_position`, but Idle is not handled by `update_support_states` GuardingArea. No inner scan for other nearby non-building enemies, no crate, no chase timer.

## Player-visible
A unit that retaliates (or a friend that auto-retaliates) kills the attacker away from the post, then walks home as a normal Move and stands Idle. It does not resume guarding, does not pick the next nearby raider, and does not stay in Guard-Retaliate. After one fight the post is abandoned until the player re-issues Guard.
close_reason: GuardRetaliate RETURN stays in machine (no move_to Moving); inner scan; end_guard_retaliate restores Guard; files: orders.rs teams.rs

title: [Hunt] Hunt command wanders a 100-unit circle instead of map-wide seek-and-destroy
description:
## C++
`GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/AI/AIStates.cpp` `AIHuntState::update` (`AIHuntState::onEnter` ~7083, `update` ~7125).
Hunt is seek-and-destroy: every `ENEMY_SCAN_RATE` frames, `TheAI->findClosestEnemy(owner, 9999.9f, AI::CAN_ATTACK, attackPriority)`. Uses team `m_attackCommonTarget` / `getTeamTargetObject`, falls back without priority when `player->getUnitsShouldHunt()`, picks up crates via `checkForCrateToPickup` → `AI_PICK_UP_CRATE`, exits hunt (`STATE_SUCCESS`) when idle and no victim unless all-hunt is on.

## Leftover
`GeneralsRust/Code/GameEngine/GameLogic/src/ai/states/hunt.rs` `AIHuntState::find_hunt_victim` / `classic_on_update` ports the 9999.9 scan, team common-target, crate, and units-should-hunt exit. `ai_states/hunt.rs` also ports scan+crate but `dual_world_registry_unavailable()` (`OBJECT_REGISTRY` empty) fail-closes `on_enter`/`update` to Failed. Not the live path.

## Live host
`Main/src/command_system/button_map.rs`: `"patrol" | "hunt"` both map to `CommandType::Patrol`.
`command_executor/movement.rs` `execute_patrol` → `GameLogic::unit_command_patrol` (`world_scripts/unit_commands.rs:602`) sets `AIState::Patrolling` and `auto_acquire_when_idle`.
`world_objects/ai_authority.rs` `process_ai_behavior` Patrolling: scan nearest enemy in **200** every 25 frames, else every 180 frames issue a random **100**-unit circle `MoveTo`. `host_ai_ability_upgrade_residual.rs` even names Patrolling as `"AI_HUNT"`.

## Player-visible
The Hunt button / groupHunt / script hunt makes units wander a tiny circle around their current spot and only shoot things within ~200. They never cross the map to the nearest legal enemy, never share a team focus-fire target, never pick up hunt crates, and never stop hunting when the map is clear. Retail Hunt is map-wide seek-and-destroy.
close_reason: Hunt: find_closest_enemy 9999.9 CAN_ATTACK, no 100-circle, hunting persists after kill; files: ai_authority.rs unit_commands.rs world_tick/ai.rs

title: [Idle] Mood and AutoAcquire gates bypassed by 200-radius idle scan
description:
## C++
`GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/AI/AIStates.cpp` `AIIdleState::update` (~1369).
Idle acquire is gated: skip if machine locked / `!m_shouldLookForTargets`; skip `DISABLED_PARALYZED|UNMANNED|EMP|SUBDUED|HACKED`; `getMoodMatrixActionAdjustment(MM_Action_Idle)` — if `MAA_Affect_Range_IgnoreAll` (Sleep) do not acquire; else `getNextMoodTarget(true, true)` (Passive = last attacker only; human = weapon-range + unfogged).

## Leftover
`GameEngine/GameLogic/src/ai/states/idle.rs` / `ai_states/*` port mood idle. Empty `OBJECT_REGISTRY` leftover is unused on the live host.

## Live host
Two paths run every AI tick (`world_tick/ai.rs`):
1. `tick_mood_auto_acquire` (`world_tick/teams.rs` + `mood.rs` `try_mood_auto_acquire` / `get_next_mood_target`) — respects Sleep/Passive/`auto_acquire_when_idle`.
2. `process_ai_behavior` Idle (`world_objects/ai_authority.rs:57`) — if `can_attack` and `frame % 30 == 0`, `find_nearest_enemy_for_attacker(..., 200.0)` and `evaluate_enemy` with **no** mood, **no** `auto_acquire_when_idle`, **no** disabled-type skip.

## Player-visible
Sleep AI still walks over and shoots anything within 200. Passive AI attacks nearest instead of only the last damager. Units authored `AutoAcquireEnemiesWhenIdle = No` still auto-attack. EMP/hacked/unmanned/paralyzed/subdued units still acquire a target so they lunge the instant the disable ends. Mood stance and the INI auto-acquire flag feel broken.
close_reason: Idle: process_ai_behavior no 200-scan; mood+AutoAcquire+disabled+Sleep IgnoreAll in try_mood_auto_acquire; files: ai_authority.rs mood.rs

title: [CreateObjectDie] TransferPreviousHealth skips subdual and attackers
description:
## C++
`CreateObjectDie.cpp:70-125` `onDie`: DieMux, `ObjectCreationList::create(ocl, dying, damageDealer)`. If `TransferPreviousHealth` and new object: transfer subdual via DAMAGE_SUBDUAL_UNRESISTABLE; transfer `maxHealth-previousHealth` as DAMAGE_UNRESISTABLE from last damage source; walk all objects and `ai->transferAttack(oldID, newID)` so attackers keep the replacement (sneak-attack tunnel).

## Leftover Rust
`GameEngine/GameLogic/src/object/die/create_object_die.rs:204-314` ports subdual + previous-health transfer. `transfer_attackers` (256-264) returns immediately when OBJECT_REGISTRY is empty.

## Live host
`object/death.rs:349-362` `fire_create_object_die` only stores `(max-current)` as transfer damage (no subdual, no last source). `create_destroy_die.rs:2338-2430` `apply_pending_create_object_die` applies that as Unresistable with source None. Never calls `transfer_attack`. Closed hq-wqq67 was owner/team create, not this transfer.

## Player-visible
Sneak-attack start → tunnel: units attacking the dying start wander instead of retargeting the tunnel. Replacement object does not inherit subdual stun. Health transfer uses current (often 0 on death) not C++ previousHealth, so sneak-attack tunnel can spawn at full HP.
close_reason: CreateObjectDie TransferPreviousHealth: previous_health + subdual Unresistable + last source + transfer_attack

title: [InstantDeath] InstantDeathBehavior never runs on live death
description:
## C++
`InstantDeathBehavior.cpp:99-150` `InstantDeathBehavior::onDie`: if `isDieApplicable`, mark AI dead (skip if already dead), pick a random authored FX / OCL / Weapon from the module lists (`GameLogicRandomValue`), `FXList::doFXObj`, `ObjectCreationList::create`, `TheWeaponStore->createAndFireTempWeapon` at self position, then `TheGameLogic->destroyObject`. Pool size 512 in MemoryInit. Retail uses this for under-construction buildings (`RequiredStatus UNDER_CONSTRUCTION` + explode OCL), SpectreHowitzerShell death-type table (DETONATED/LASERED/GENERIC), PUC under-construction explode, and many missiles/units.

## Leftover Rust
`GameEngine/GameLogic/src/object/behavior/instant_death_behavior.rs:191-247` ports onDie (DieMux, random FX/OCL/Weapon, leftover `TheGameLogic::destroy_object`). Leftover factory registers InstantDeathBehavior. Live host never attaches leftover modules when OBJECT_REGISTRY is empty.

## Live host
`Main/src/game_logic/world_objects/create_destroy_die.rs:1994-2038` `mark_object_for_destruction` dispatches DamDie / EjectPilot / UpgradeDie / topple / SlowDeath / KeepObjectDie. No InstantDeathBehavior path. InstantDeath exists only as honesty constants in `special_power_strikes` (PUC / SpectreHowitzerShell). Under-construction buildings skip topple/slow/keep and go straight to destroy list with generic combat particles.

## Player-visible
Unfinished buildings vanish instead of exploding (no InstantDeath OCL/FX). Howitzer shells / InstantDeath missiles do not pick authored DETONATED/LASERED/GENERIC FX+OCL+Weapon. InstantDeath units that should pop immediately with a death weapon instead generic-pop or enter SlowDeath.
close_reason: live InstantDeathBehavior: mark_object_for_destruction fires authored/peel FX+OCL+Weapon then destroy; under-construction explode + SpectreHowitzerShell DETONATED/LASERED/GENERIC

title: [JetSlowDeath] Jets miss ground-deck explode and crash FX
description:
## C++
`JetSlowDeathBehavior.cpp:128-157` `onDie`: if NOT `isSignificantlyAboveTerrain()` (height > 9.0 with gravity -1) OR `OBJECT_STATUS_DECK_HEIGHT_OFFSET`, play `FXOnGroundDeath` + `OCLOnGroundDeath` and `destroyObject` immediately; else `SlowDeathBehavior::onDie`. Then clear DECK_HEIGHT_OFFSET. `beginSlowDeath` (161-198): initial FX/OCL, death-loop audio, roll rate, `setMaxLift(-gravity*(1-FallHowFast))`, turn rate 0. `update` (202-320): roll, tree (KINDOF_SHRUBBERY) hit, secondary FX/OCL after DelaySecondary, hit-ground FX/OCL + pitch, final blow-up FX/OCL after DelayFinal then destroy.

## Leftover Rust
`GameEngine/GameLogic/src/object/behavior/jet_slow_death_behavior.rs:542-576` ports ground vs air onDie and FX/OCL. `owner()` uses leftover `TheGameLogic::find_object_by_id` / OBJECT_REGISTRY — empty-registry no-op on live host.

## Live host
`host_jet_slow_death.rs` residual: hardcoded roll/fall, `JET_SIGNIFICANT_ALTITUDE = 3.0` (not C++ 9.0), no DECK_HEIGHT_OFFSET, no FX/OCL/audio, no tree collide, no secondary/final phases. Ground path waits 5 frames then destroy (C++ is same-frame FX+OCL+destroy). `object/jets.rs:22` uses world Y vs terrain 0. `try_begin_slow_death_instead_of_destroy` does start this residual.

## Player-visible
Parked jets on airfield/carrier decks (DECK_HEIGHT_OFFSET) do a slow air crash instead of instant ground explode. Air crashes have no death-loop, no mid-air secondary, no hit-ground/final FX/OCL. Jets 3–9 height use air-crash on live vs C++ ground explode.
close_reason: JetSlowDeath: altitude 9.0 + DECK_HEIGHT_OFFSET same-frame ground FX/OCL/destroy; air crash initial/secondary/hit-ground/final FX

title: [Generate] China EMP mines upgrade places more standard mines
description:
## C++
`GenerateMinefieldBehavior.cpp` `upgradeImplementation` calls `placeMines()` with the normal `MineName` (ChinaStandardMine). Later `update()` (437-475): if `Upgradable` and the object has completed `Upgrade_ChinaEMPMines`, destroy every ID in `m_mineList`, clear the list, reset `m_generated`, set `m_upgraded`, and `placeMines()` with `MineNameUpgraded` (EMP mines).

## Leftover Rust
`generate_minefield_behavior.rs` `update` ports the EMP swap (destroy list + place upgraded). Wave 386 empty-registry gate makes it a no-op live. Closed leftover bead `hq-s12g` was the opposite leftover bug (EMP on first upgrade); that crate still does not run on the host path.

## Live host
`host_mines.rs` `is_china_mines_upgrade` matches both `Upgrade_ChinaMines` and `Upgrade_ChinaEMPMines`. `place_structure_minefield_for_upgrade` always creates `ChinaStandardMine` on a 8@40 ring and never destroys a previous ring. No `mine_list` / upgraded template.

## Player-visible result
Researching China EMP Mines drops another ring of standard mines (no EMP disable) instead of replacing the existing field with EMP mines. Two upgrades stack two standard rings.
close_reason: Upgrade_ChinaMines places ChinaStandardMine; Upgrade_ChinaEMPMines destroys prior list and places ChinaEMPMine

title: [Generate] Cluster and structure mines use a fixed ring not SmartBorder
description:
## C++
`GenerateMinefieldBehavior.cpp` `placeMines` / `placeMineAt` / `placeMinesAroundCircle` / `placeMinesAroundRect` / `placeMinesInFootprint`: ClusterMinesBomb uses SmartBorder + `DistanceAroundObject` 80, expanding by mine diameter around the bomb footprint (rect for box geom unless AlwaysCircular). Structure China mines use the building footprint, not a constant radius. `placeMineAt` skips underwater, cliff cells, and mines mostly under a structure (`SkipIfThisMuchUnderStructure` 0.33). Placed mines get `setScootParms` from producer to dest.

## Leftover Rust
`GameEngine/GameLogic/src/object/behavior/generate_minefield_behavior.rs` ports SmartBorder/rect/footprint, but Wave 386 empty-registry gate makes `place_mines` / `get_minefield_target` no-ops on the live path.

## Live host
`host_mines.rs`: `CLUSTER_MINE_COUNT = 6`, `CLUSTER_MINE_RING_RADIUS = 40` (comments still list retail NumVirtualMines 8 / DistanceAroundObject 80). `stealth_mines.rs` `place_cluster_mines` drops that ring. `place_structure_minefield_for_upgrade` (`drones_and_garrison.rs`) always places `CHINA_STRUCTURE_MINE_RING_COUNT` 8 at radius 40 around the building center. No water/cliff/under-structure skip. Host comments: "Not full GenerateMinefieldBehavior SmartBorder".

## Player-visible result
Cluster Mines is a small 6-mine 40-radius circle instead of a dense SmartBorder field out to 80. China structure mines are always the same 8-spot ring on large and small buildings, including spots in water or inside the pad.
close_reason: SmartBorder cluster field (DistanceAroundObject 80) and structure BorderOnly footprint placement; water/cliff/under-structure skip

title: [Mine] Dozer mine-clear approach detonates before disarm range
description:
## C++
`DemoTrapUpdate.cpp` `update` (181-191): skip KINDOF_DOZER only when current weapon is DAMAGE_DISARM **and** OBJECT_STATUS_IS_ATTACKING. A player mine-clear order puts the dozer in attack/disarm from ContinueAttackRange 100, so they walk through TriggerDetonationRange 40 without lighting the fuse. `MinefieldBehavior.cpp` `onCollide` (364-389): while `isClearingMines()` with a goal object, colliding units get immunity slots (MAX_IMMUNITY 3) so neighboring mines do not blow.

## Leftover Rust
`demo_trap_update.rs` and `minefield_behavior.rs` port both skips, but Wave 373/410 empty-registry gates make leftover update/collide no-ops on the live path.

## Live host
`stealth_mines.rs` `update_mines_and_demo_traps`: idle clearer with `weapon_set_mine_clearing_detail` approaches at `AIState::Moving` (not Attacking). Victim skip uses `demo_trap_skips_dozer_disarm_while_attacking` which requires attacking. Land-mine trigger is 8, demo-trap trigger is 40, disarm range is 5 (`DOZER_MINE_CLEAR_RANGE`). Clear only wins inside 5. Closed `hq-dpe6f` removed blanket dozer immunity; approach was left as Moving.

## Player-visible result
Ordering a dozer/worker to clear a demo trap or China mine detonates it on the way in (40 or 8) instead of walking up and disarming. Adjacent mines also pop because there are no immunity slots.
close_reason: stealth_mines: mine-clearing dozers with a goal get immunity slots; approach no longer detonates before disarm range

title: [Mine] Land mines are single-shot; C++ virtual mines persist
description:
## C++
`MinefieldBehavior.cpp` `onCollide` / `detonateOnce`: a ChinaStandardMine / ChinaClusterMine is one object with `NumVirtualMines` (retail cluster residual 8). Collision detonates one virtual mine at the victim position clipped to the pad (`clipPointToFootprint`), decrements `m_virtualMinesRemaining`, and only destroys the object when remaining hits 0 and `Regenerates` is false. Same unit must move `RepeatDetonateMoveThresh` (default 1) to trip another. Empty field goes `MODELCONDITION_RUBBLE` + MASKED and can regen.

## Leftover Rust
`GameEngine/GameLogic/src/object/behavior/minefield_behavior.rs` ports virtual mines / immunity / scoot, but `dual_world_registry_unavailable()` (OBJECT_REGISTRY empty) makes `owner()` None so the leftover never runs on the live host path. Wave 410 residual.

## Live host
`Main/src/game_logic/host_mines.rs` `HostMineKind::LandMine` is a single-shot proximity mine (`trigger_range` 8, `defaults_to_proximity` true). `stealth_mines.rs` `update_mines_and_demo_traps` / `detonate_mine_internal` marks `detonated` and `mark_object_for_destruction` on the first enemy in range. Comments admit: "Not full C++ MinefieldBehavior virtual-mine regen / scoot / immunity slots". Closed leftover bead `hq-ttiy` only fixed the GameEngine crate (clip + producer regen), not this live residual.

## Player-visible result
Walking a tank through a China minefield or cluster drop gets one blast and the mine is gone. C++ keeps the pad alive for remaining virtual mines (and regen). Repeat steps on the same pad do nothing live.
close_reason: host_mines + stealth_mines: virtual mines persist (NumVirtualMines decrement, rubble/MASKED, RepeatDetonateMoveThresh); TestLandMine stays single-shot

description:

title: [Poison] Toxin field ticks ignore armor and never infect
description:
## C++
Poison fields are objects with FireWeaponUpdate (FireWeaponUpdate.h:3) that fire a DAMAGE_POISON weapon at their own feet (Weapon.ini AnthraxBombPoisonFieldWeapon / MediumPoisonFieldWeapon / SmallPoisonFieldWeapon). ActiveBody applies poison armor, then PoisonedBehavior::onDamage (PoisonedBehavior.cpp:67-70) starts/refreshes DoT from actualDamageDealt. DeathType is POISONED / POISONED_BETA / POISONED_GAMMA from the weapon. After leaving the puddle, PoisonDuration (typically 3000ms) keeps retaking Unresistable DoT.

## Leftover Rust
GameEngine/GameLogic/src/object/behavior/poisoned_behavior.rs implements on_damage/update with poison FX override, but dual_world_registry_unavailable() (OBJECT_REGISTRY empty) no-ops update/tint/wake. Field objects never run on the leftover crate.

## Live host
special_power_strikes.rs:949 update_anthrax_toxin_fields, infantry_weapons.rs:1726 update_scud_poison_zones, missile_defenders.rs:1057 update_toxin_tractor_poison_zones, saboteur_car_bomb.rs:1507 update_bomb_truck_poison_zones all call take_damage_from_immediate (damage.rs:15-24) = Unresistable. notify_poisoned_on_damage only matches Toxin|Anthrax (host_poisoned_behavior.rs:41-43), so field ticks never infect.

## Player-visible
Chem suits, ToxinTruckArmor, and other poison coefficients do nothing in puddles. Standing in Anthrax/SCUD/tractor/bio fields deals full Unresistable HP. Units do not turn green from the field and do not keep dying for 3s after walking out. Deaths are not POISONED/POISONED_BETA.
close_reason: Field ticks use take_damage_from_immediate_typed_death(Toxin) so poison armor applies and PoisonedBehavior infects; death types POISONED/BETA/GAMMA from weapon.

title: [Hive] Stinger small-arms/sniper hits building not slaves
description:
C++ HiveStructureBody::attemptDamage (HiveStructureBody.cpp:45-112): when damage type is in PropagateDamageTypesToSlavesWhenExisting (retail Stinger: SMALL_ARMS/SNIPER/POISON/RADIATION/SURRENDER/MICROWAVE), forwards the hit to getClosestSlave (or closest rider). If no slave/rider remains and the type is in DamageTypesToSwallow (SNIPER/POISON/SURRENDER), zeros dealt/clipped and sets noEffect. Otherwise StructureBody takes the hit.

Leftover GameLogic/src/object/body/hive_structure_body.rs:315-318 returns Ok(()) with no HP change when OBJECT_REGISTRY is empty (Wave 389 empty-gate). Propagation never runs on the live host path.

Live host Main/src/game_logic/object/damage.rs take_damage_from_typed_death applies armor + structure HP. Hive residual exists only on apply_host_hive_damage_from (world_scripts/saboteur_car_bomb.rs:850-854), which documents "not live skirmish Object::take_damage — combat/AOE still hits structure HP".

Player-visible: shooting a GLA Stinger Site with rangers/pathfinders/toxin damages the bunker instead of the three soldiers; sniper can kill the site even while soldiers are alive. Site also keeps firing from a damaged building that C++ would have left untouched.
close_reason: live take_damage HiveStructureBody: SMALL_ARMS/SNIPER/POISON to closest slave; swallow SNIPER/POISON/SURRENDER when empty

title: [FlightDeck] Lost carrier jets never auto-rebuild
description:
## C++
`FlightDeckBehavior::update` (`FlightDeckBehavior.cpp:1164-1197`) scans stalls each frame. On the first empty space, if ProductionUpdate has no queue and `now >= m_nextAllowedProductionFrame`, it `queueCreateUnit(PayloadTemplate)` and sets the next allowed frame to `ReplacementDelay + DockAnimationDelay`. `exitObjectViaDoor` (`:1282-1346`) then assigns the new jet to that stall and taxis it along the runway creation bones.

## Leftover Rust
`update_replacements` (`flight_deck_behavior.rs:1000-1085`) ports the empty-stall production queue, but leftover FlightDeck never ticks on the live host (`OBJECT_REGISTRY` empty). Wave 311 leftover `exit_object_via_door` no-ops, so even a leftover queue would not place the jet.

## Live host
No FlightDeck tick. Production at a carrier is ordinary factory/queue logic with no `parking_place` metadata (FlightDeck class is not parsed). Empty stalls are not detected and PayloadTemplate is never auto-queued.

## Player-visible result
Shot-down carrier jets never come back. The deck stays empty after the first losses (and is already empty at spawn — see payload bead).
close_reason: live host empty-stall replacement spawn + exitObjectViaDoor taxi (host_flight_deck.rs)

title: [FlightDeck] Attack/guard on carrier never launches jets
description:
## C++
`FlightDeckBehavior::aiDoCommand` (`FlightDeckBehavior.cpp:1356-1403`) does **not** run base AI. Guard / attack / force-attack / attack-move / idle from a non-AI source stores `m_designatedCommand` / target / position and calls `propagateOrdersToPlanes` (`:1407-1421`) so airborne / able-to-give-up jets immediately take the order. Parked front-row jets wait for `update` launch-wave (`:1212-1245`): ramp up (`LaunchRampDelay` + DOOR_2_OPENING), then `propagateOrderToSpecificPlane` (`:1457-1485`) after the ramp is up, gated by `LaunchWaveDelay` and `isInPositionToTakeoff` (front stall, 2D range < 10). Idle on the carrier recalls airborne jets via `aiEnter`.

## Leftover Rust
`propagate_orders_to_planes` / `update_launch_waves` (`flight_deck_behavior.rs:1112-1273`) port the command + ramp + wave, but leftover FlightDeck is not the live command target. Live host objects never attach leftover AIUpdate FlightDeck.

## Live host
Carrier is a generic unit/building. Attack/guard/attack-move on the carrier does not store a designated command, does not propagate to reserved jets, does not raise ramps, and does not stagger launch waves. There is no FlightDeck `airfield_parking_spaces` roster for a carrier (`parking_place` metadata is ParkingPlaceBehavior-only).

## Player-visible result
Ordering a carrier to attack, guard, or attack-move does nothing to its air wing. No jets launch. Stop/idle does not recall jets (none exist; see payload bead).
close_reason: carrier attack/guard/idle intercepts aiDoCommand and launch-wave (command_attack + unit_commands)

title: [FlightDeck] Finished carrier has empty deck — no payload jets
description:
## C++
`FlightDeckBehavior::buildInfo` (`FlightDeckBehavior.cpp:145-212`) runs on first update after the carrier is finished (not UNDER_CONSTRUCTION / SOLD). For each `NumRunways × NumSpacesPerRunway` stall it looks up the authored space bone, then if `PayloadTemplate` is set and `createUnits=true` it `TheThingFactory->newObject`s that jet on the carrier's default team, `setProducer`, `OBJECT_STATUS_DECK_HEIGHT_OFFSET`, and parks it at the stall pose. A finished AmericaAircraftCarrier therefore appears with a full deck of Raptors.

## Leftover Rust
`flight_deck_behavior.rs` `build_info` (`:727-874`) ports the spawn loop, but leftover modules only exist on dual-world factory objects. Host-only play has `OBJECT_REGISTRY` empty, so leftover FlightDeck is never attached. Wave 311 gates leftover `exit_object_via_door` to `Ok(())` when the registry is empty.

## Live host
`apply_authored_parking_place_metadata` (`spawn_templates.rs:1080-1086`) only accepts class `ParkingPlaceBehavior`. `FlightDeckBehavior` is ignored (`parking_place = None`). Live `airfield.rs` never walks FlightDeck, never reads `PayloadTemplate`, never `newObject`s deck jets. The Wave 311 residual only honesty-checks leftover empty-registry gates.

## Player-visible result
A completed aircraft carrier is an empty hull. No payload jets spawn on the deck.
close_reason: live host FlightDeck buildInfo payload-spawns jets on finished carrier (host_flight_deck.rs + FlightDeckMetadata)

title: [Overlord] createPayload re-locks contain so PayloadTemplateName never installs
description:
## C++
`OverlordContain::createPayload` (`OverlordContain.cpp:95-136`) is called from `onObjectCreated` (`:88-91`) and, if needed, from the first `update`. It `enableLoadSounds(FALSE)`, walks every `PayloadTemplateName`, `newObject` on `object->getTeam()`, `isValidContainerFor` + `this->addToContain` (same object, no re-lock), continues on a full/invalid payload (`DEBUG_CRASH` only), then `enableLoadSounds(TRUE)` and always sets `m_payloadCreated = TRUE`.

## Rust
Live `OverlordContain::create_payload` (`overlord_contain.rs:686-729`) is invoked while the contain mutex is already held:
- `contain_module_overrides/contain.rs:149` `on_object_created` → `contain.lock()` → `on_owner_created` → `create_payload`
- `object_update.rs:111` `contain.lock()` → `contain.update()` → `create_payload` (`overlord_contain.rs:818-821`)

That path then calls `owner.get_contain()` + `ContainModuleInterfaceExt`:
- `enable_load_sounds` uses `try_lock` (`modules/contain.rs:649`) and returns `Err("Failed to lock…")` on same-thread re-entry, so `create_payload` returns before the payload loop and never reaches `set_payload_created(true)` (`:728`).
- If that first lock ever succeeded, `add_to_contain` uses blocking `lock()` (`modules/contain.rs:626`) — the comment at `modules/contain.rs:605-614` already names this Overlord re-entry as the one leftover Transport/Helix avoided by calling `self`.
- A later payload that fails `is_valid_container_for` `return Err(...)` (`:710-715`) instead of C++ continue-and-mark-created.

Helix/Transport `create_payload` call `self.add_to_contain` and always set the flag. Leftover host `host_overlord_addons.rs` is fail-closed vs spawning a real portable passenger.

## Evidence
C++ `OverlordContain.cpp:88-136`. Rust `overlord_contain.rs:686-729`, `:818-821`, `:930-931`; lock holders `contain_module_overrides/contain.rs:147-156` and `object_update.rs:110-115`; Ext `modules/contain.rs:605-628` and `:645-653`. `bd search` / `.beads/issues.jsonl` have no createPayload / PayloadTemplateName bead (hunt3-03 noted abort-on-first-fail as unfiled).

## Player-visible
An Overlord/Emperor never installs INI `PayloadTemplateName` bunker/gattling/propaganda as a contained portable. `m_payloadCreated` stays false so every later frame retries and logs `on_owner_created` / contain update failure. Leftover host residual only fakes addon weapons on the hull, so there is no real bunker to garrison, no portable XP sink target, and no W3D rider draw.
close_reason: overlord_contain.rs create_payload uses self.add_to_contain / enable_load_sounds without get_contain re-lock; continues on invalid; always set_payload_created

title: [Transport] Leftover host never applies HealthRegen%PerSec to embarked riders
description:
## C++
`TransportContain::update` (`TransportContain.cpp:454-500`) after `createPayload` heals every contained rider when `m_healthRegen != 0`: `regen = maxHealth * m_healthRegen / 100 * SECONDS_PER_LOGICFRAME_REAL` then `object->attemptHealing(regen, getObject())`. Retail INI: Ambulance `HealthRegen%PerSec=25`, Troop Crawler / Listening Outpost `=10`.

## Rust
Live `transport_contain.rs:783-830` applies that formula. Leftover host does not:
- `host_heal.rs:247-251` `ambulance_embarked_heal_hp_per_sec` exists but is only called from honesty tests / re-exports — no world tick.
- `host_env_contain_residual.rs:535-545` `TRANSPORT_HEALTH_REGEN_RESIDUAL_TABLE` + `transport_health_regen_per_frame` are honesty-only.
- Troop Crawler / Listening Outpost leftovers document `Fail-closed: not … HealthRegen%PerSec` (`host_troop_crawler.rs:24`, `host_listening_outpost.rs:28`, `game_logic/host.rs:274`).

No leftover host tick applies embarked `HealthRegen%PerSec`.

## Evidence
C++ `TransportContain.cpp:461-495`. Live apply `transport_contain.rs:783-827`. Leftover unused helpers `host_heal.rs:59-60,247-251` and `host_env_contain_residual.rs:535-545`. Grep of `Main/src/game_logic/{world_combat,world_objects,game_logic}` has no `ambulance_embarked_heal` / `transport_health_regen_per_frame` call. Not a re-file of closed `hq-uil`/`hq-jh8` residual *install* tasks or `hq-5a061` leftover ambulance *AutoHeal* pulse.

## Player-visible
Wounded infantry riding an Ambulance do not regenerate 25% max HP/sec (full heal in ~4s). Troop Crawler / Listening Outpost riders miss the 10%/sec embark heal. Nearby AutoHeal pulses (if any) are a different, much smaller C++ path.
close_reason: leftover host_heal.rs + world_tick/step.rs apply TransportContain HealthRegen%PerSec to occupants (Ambulance 25, TroopCrawler/ListeningOutpost 10)

title: [NeutronMissile] Live dives by altitude, not 3D intermediate sphere
description:
## C++
`NeutronMissileUpdate::update` (`NeutronMissileUpdate.cpp:448-466`) starts the dive only when 3D distance to `m_intermedPos` (target + `TargetFromDirectlyAbove`, retail **500**) is `<= boundingSphere²`. It then snaps to the intermediate point and sets `vel = (0,0,-|vel|*0.5)`.

After that, `doAttack` (`:315-329`) aims at `m_targetPos` via `calcTransform` + `MaxTurnRate` (retail 7200 deg/s) and `ForwardDamping` 0.1. `STRAIGHT_DOWN_SLOW_FACTOR` (0.5) only scales speed once the intermediate is reached.

## Rust
**Leftover** `neutron_missile_update.rs:749-773` uses the C++ sphere test and straight-down vel.

**Live** `host_neutron_missile_update.rs:192-202` starts the dive when `d_inter < 25.0` **OR** `new_pos.y >= intermediate.y - 5.0`. Reaching ~500 height is enough even if XZ is still far from the target. `AttackDive` (`:205-216`) then 15%-lerps XZ toward the target while falling; no `calcTransform`, no turn-rate cap, no damping.

## Evidence
C++ `NeutronMissileUpdate.cpp:452-464, 310-354`. Leftover `neutron_missile_update.rs:749-773, 603-694`. Live `host_neutron_missile_update.rs:170-229`. Spawn path `world_combat/infantry_weapons.rs:476-478` installs this residual on OCL FireWeapon neutron/nuke projectiles.

## Player-visible
The nuke can begin its downward pass as soon as it reaches cruise altitude, then drift sideways into the click. Retail waits until it is over the hover point, then dives.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Dive starts only when 3D distance to intermediate <= missile bounding sphere
- [ ] On reach: snap to intermediate, vel becomes straight down * 0.5
- [ ] Post-intermediate aim uses calcTransform + MaxTurnRate + ForwardDamping, not a 15% XZ lerp
close_reason: live 3D intermediate sphere dive (dist² <= boundingSphere²) + leftover already matched

title: [NeutronMissile] Live loft is linear, not C++ quadratic special-speed climb
description:
## C++
`NeutronMissileUpdate::doLaunch` (`NeutronMissileUpdate.cpp:176-251`) is one frame: bone attach, `Rotate_X(PI/2)`, unhide, `setExperienceSink`, `LaunchFX`, then immediately `IgnitionFX` + exhaust, `m_state = ATTACK`, `m_isArmed = true`.

`doAttack` (`:310-401`) then overlays special-speed loft for `m_specialSpeedTime` frames (retail 1500ms → 45f):
`z = heightAtLaunch + (sqr(accelFactor * timeFrac) / accelFactor) * specialSpeedHeight`
(default `SpecialAccelFactor` 1.0 → `heightAtLaunch + timeFrac² * 160`). Jitter is drawable **instance matrix** only (`:376-388`); world pose is unchanged. After loft, ATTACK continues with `calcTransform` + forward damping.

## Rust
**Leftover** `GameLogic/src/object/update/neutron_missile_update.rs:645-684` matches the quadratic (`accel_factor * time_frac² * height`) and instance-matrix jitter.

**Live** `Main/src/game_logic/host_neutron_missile_update.rs:134-168` spends the entire Launch phase on a **linear** climb (`step = 160/45` per frame). Jitter actually translates world XZ (`:148-152`). `IgnitionFX` fires only when loft ends (`:155-157`), not on the launch frame. No bone attach / PI/2 stand-up. Fail-closed comment at `:17-18` admits this.

## Evidence
C++ `NeutronMissileUpdate.cpp:360-388`. Leftover `neutron_missile_update.rs:661-682`. Live `host_neutron_missile_update.rs:142-160` and honesty constants `NEUTRON_SPECIAL_SPEED_HEIGHT=160`, `NEUTRON_SPECIAL_SPEED_TIME_FRAMES=45`. Host tick `world_combat/registries.rs:658-724` applies that residual as the playable path.

## Player-visible
China nuke / neutron missile rises at constant speed for 1.5s (and physically wobbles) instead of the accelerating loft, and ignition FX is late. Trajectory and silhouette during the silo launch do not match retail.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Live special-speed loft uses C++ `sqr(accelFactor*t)/accelFactor * height` (quadratic), not linear step
- [ ] Jitter is instance-matrix visual only (does not move world position)
- [ ] IgnitionFX plays on the launch frame, then ATTACK overlay begins
close_reason: live quadratic special-speed loft sqr(accel*t)/accel; leftover exact C++ formula; launch one-frame

title: [Dock] Live DockUpdate no-ops when OBJECT_REGISTRY is empty — host never loads dock bones or docking anims
description:
## C++
`DockUpdate::update` (`DockUpdate.cpp:391-419`) always runs. With no `m_activeDocker` and not crippled it promotes the first reached approach owner to `m_activeDocker` so `isClearToEnter` can pass.
`loadDockPositions` (`:467-509`) reads pristine `DockStart` / `DockAction` / `DockEnd` / `DockWaiting` from the drawable (skipped only for `KINDOF_IGNORE_DOCKING_BONES`).
`getEnterPosition` / `getDockPosition` / `getExitPosition` (`:210-287`) call `loadDockPositions` if not loaded, then convert bones to world (or airborne-enter → building pos).
`onEnterReached` / `onDockReached` / `onExitReached` / `cancelDock` set/clear `MODELCONDITION_DOCKING_BEGINNING` / `DOCKING` / `DOCKING_ACTIVE` / `DOCKING_ENDING` on both dock and docker.
`computeApproachPosition` (`:422-462`) converts the waiting bone and `findPositionAround` (flyers ignore the dock).

## Rust
Live `object/production/dock_update.rs` ports the C++ machine but Wave-355 `dual_world_registry_unavailable()` (`OBJECT_REGISTRY.is_empty()`) early-returns from `load_dock_positions`, `compute_approach_position`, `update`, `cancel_dock`, `get_enter_position`, `get_dock_position`, `get_exit_position`, `on_enter_reached`, `on_dock_reached`, and `on_exit_reached`.
Host-only play keeps the registry empty. Host residual `host_live_dock_update_dual_world_empty_gate_residual_wave355.rs` is honesty-only. Host `support_states.rs` heals/collects inside `INTERACT_RANGE` after `try_claim_dock` — no bone path, no approach promotion, no docking model conditions.
Even when the registry is populated, live `get_enter_position` / `get_dock_position` / `get_exit_position` never call `load_dock_positions` (C++ always does), so a first load that ran before the drawable existed stays at ZERO and units stay put.

## Evidence
Live `dock_update.rs:19-23` + `163-167` + `229-233` + `314-318` + `425-428` + `604-607` + `639-646` + `679-682` + `708-711` + `743-746` + `772-775`.
Host residual header: "Not full DockUpdate bone load / approach path AI residual".
Host `support_states.rs:2096-2134` SeekingRepair claim+heal vs C++ bone + `MODELCONDITION_DOCKING*`.
Distinct from closed hq-qu19p (supply approach queue + steal cash).

## Player-visible
On the live host, WarFactory / RepairPad / SupplyCenter never play docking animations and units never drive the authored DockWaiting → DockStart → DockAction → DockEnd line. Collectors and repair vehicles walk up and interact in place; approach slots never promote so a second unit is not sequenced the C++ way.
close_reason: live production/dock_update.rs: removed Wave-355 empty-registry gates; get_enter/dock/exit_position now peek DockStart/Action/End bones when not loaded (C++ loadDockPositions). Host support_states.rs sets MODELCONDITION_DOCKING* on claim/release.

title: [Upgrade] Leftover updateUpgradeModules copies player completed mask onto object
description:
## C++
`Object::updateUpgradeModules` (`Object.cpp:2410-2438`) builds `maskToCheck = playerCompleted | objectCompleted` only as the **argument** to `attemptUpgrade`. It never writes player bits into `m_objectUpgradesCompleted`.

`Object::giveUpgrade` (`:4474-4485`) sets **only** that template's bit on the object mask, then re-runs `updateUpgradeModules`. Player-type research stays on `Player::getCompletedUpgradeMask()`.

## Rust
Leftover `Object::update_upgrade_modules_from_player` (`object_upgrade.rs:448-472`) takes `manager.get_active_upgrades()`, then:

```
let new_bits = active_bits & !self.object_upgrades_completed;
if !new_bits.is_empty() {
    self.object_upgrades_completed.insert(new_bits);
}
self.apply_upgrade_modules(combined_bits);
```

Every completed **player** upgrade is stamped onto the object's completed mask. Callers include construction finish (`init.rs:22`, dozer/worker complete), capture (`actions_team_relations.rs:126`), and every promotion (`object_combat.rs:392`).

## Evidence
C++ `Object.cpp:2421-2436` combine-for-check-only; `:4478` object bit only.
Rust `object_upgrade.rs:464-471` insert of player bits.

## Player-visible
After any player research (Radar, Composite Armor, Flashbangs, …) **every** owned unit reports those upgrades as object-completed. Object-type exclusivity / `ConflictsWith` / object upgrade xfer / cameos / scripts that read the object mask treat faction research as per-unit add-ons. Captured units keep the old owner's player-upgrade bits on the object.
close_reason: C++ Object::updateUpgradeModules combines player|object masks only as attemptUpgrade argument. Leftover update_upgrade_modules_from_player no longer inserts player completed bits into object_upgrades_completed.

title: [RadiusDecal] setRadiusCursor builds a dummy Player so Color==0 rings are black
description:
## C++
`InGameUI::setRadiusCursor` (`InGameUI.cpp:1206-1266`) passes the real `obj->getControllingPlayer()` into `RadiusDecalTemplate::createRadiusDecal`. When `m_color == 0`, create does `setColor(owningPlayer->getPlayerColor())` (`RadiusDecal.cpp:65`). `GameMakeColor` packs ARGB (`Color.h:37-39`).

## Rust
Live `InGameUI::set_radius_cursor` (`radius_cursor.rs:72-81`) wraps a **new** `Player::new(player.get_player_index())` — default `Color { r:0,g:0,b:0,a:0 }` — and passes that dummy into `create_radius_decal`. Templates from `with_texture` have `color == 0`, so the fallback uses the dummy's `get_player_color().to_argb_u32()`.

Stacked: leftover `Color::to_argb_u32` (`primitives.rs:286-287`) packs **ABGR** (`A|B|G|R`) while claiming ARGB. Live `argb_u32_to_rgba` (`radius_decal.rs:22-28`) unpacks as ARGB. Even a real player red would render blue.

## Evidence
C++: `createRadiusDecal(..., controller, m_curRadiusCursor)` with the live Player.
Rust: `Arc::new(RwLock::new(Player::new(player.get_player_index())))` then `owner.read().get_player_color().to_argb_u32()`.

## Player-visible
Attack-ground / special-power targeting rings are black (or R/B-swapped if the dummy is later replaced), not the owner's faction color.
close_reason: live create_radius_decal real Player + GameMakeColor ARGB; radius_cursor passes controller

title: [RadiusDecal] Leftover GameLogic RadiusDecal never addDecal so Spectre/payload/shroud rings never draw
description:
## C++
`RadiusDecalTemplate::createRadiusDecal` (`RadiusDecal.cpp:34-73`) always `TheProjectedShadowManager->addDecal` when the owner is allowed to see it, then `setAngle(0)`, `setColor(color==0 ? playerColor : m_color)`, `setPosition`. Callers that depend on that visual:
- `SpectreGunshipUpdate` AttackAreaDecal + TargetingReticleDecal
- `DeliverPayloadAIUpdate` DeliveryDecal (A10 / carpet / artillery / paradrop / cluster mines)
- `DynamicShroudClearingRangeUpdate` grid decals
- `NeutronMissileUpdate` DeliveryDecal

## Rust
Leftover `gamelogic::common::types::RadiusDecal` / `RadiusDecalTemplate::create_radius_decal_with_radius` (`update_context.rs:468-501`) only fill a CPU struct. No `ProjectedShadowManager::add_decal`. Leftover Spectre (`spectre_gunship_update.rs:751-770`), DeliverPayload (`deliver_payload_ai_update.rs:1529-1536`), DynamicShroud (`dynamic_shroud_clearing_range_update.rs:556-596`), and Neutron leftover all store that struct.

hq-0llgl / hq-beyv wired **host** `HostRadiusDecal::create` → `enqueue_delivery_decal` for RadiusDecalUpdate / OCL Attack SW buildings only. Host `special_power_strikes` enqueues ScudStorm; A10/carpet/artillery/paradrop/Spectre orbit+reticle never call `enqueue_delivery_decal`. DeliverPayload leftover also calls `create_radius_decal` (gates on `template.radius`, default 0) then overwrites radius, so even the leftover struct is at origin.

## Evidence
C++: `result.m_decal = TheProjectedShadowManager->addDecal(&decalInfo);` (`RadiusDecal.cpp:61`).
Rust leftover: `RadiusDecal { position, radius, opacity, color, ... }` with no ShadowHandle.
Live host enqueue sites: `host_radius_decal_update.rs:148`, `install.rs:383-398`, `special_power_strikes.rs:89-90` (ScudStorm only).

## Player-visible
Spectre gunship orbit ring and targeting reticle never appear. A10 / carpet bomb / artillery / paradrop / cluster-mine strike circles never appear on the ground. Spy-sat grid decals never appear.
close_reason: leftover RadiusDecal create addDecal via ProjectedRadiusDecalHooks + live enqueue

title: [SpecialPower] SharedNSync fire ignores pauseCountdown
description:
## C++
`SpecialPowerModule::doSpecialPower` / `AtObject` / `AtLocation` / `UsingWaypoints` (`SpecialPowerModule.cpp:640-723`) all return immediately when `m_pausedCount > 0` **or** `getObject()->isDisabled()`. This gate is independent of SharedNSync.

`isReady()` (`:265-287`) for SharedNSync only compares the player timer (`Player::getOrStartSpecialPowerReadyFrame`). `doSpecialPower` is what still refuses a paused SharedNSync module.

`pauseCountdown` (`:728-752`) is how scripts (`NAMED_STOP_SPECIAL_POWER_COUNTDOWN`), `StartsPaused`, and `Object::pauseAllSpecialPowers` (every disable type except HELD) increment that count.

## Rust
Leftover `SpecialPowerModule::do_special_power*` (`special_power_module.rs:908-1020`) correctly returns when `paused_count > 0`.

Live host fire uses `is_special_power_ready_for` (`object_queries.rs:1224-1283`) then `consume_special_power_charge_for`. The SharedNSync branch checks only `player.is_shared_special_power_ready` and **returns true without reading `special_power_paused`**. `execute_special_power` (`command_executor/special_power.rs:257-277`) has no extra pause check.

`script_pause_special_power_countdown` (`object_queries.rs:1413-1422`) now reaches the host (hq-srjay closed) and inserts into `special_power_paused`. That set is honored only on the per-object `is_special_power_ready` path.

## Evidence
- C++ doSpecialPower 642-643, 664-665, 686-687, 708-709; isReady SharedNSync 281-282.
- Leftover pause gate: `special_power_module.rs:908-910`.
- Live SharedNSync ready: `object_queries.rs:1274-1281` (`return true`).
- Live script pause: `object_queries.rs:1413-1422`; fire: `command_executor/special_power.rs:257-277`.
- Closed hq-srjay only covered "scripts never reach host", not this fire-gate miss.

## Player-visible
Campaign `NAMED_STOP_SPECIAL_POWER_COUNTDOWN` on a Particle Cannon / Nuke / Scud / A10 (all SharedNSync) does not prevent launch. The countdown flag is stored, but a ready shared timer still fires.
close_reason: is_special_power_ready_for SharedNSync branch returns false when pauseCountdown count > 0

title: [CommandSet] CommandSetUpgrade leftover never applies; live peel skips ChinaMines swap
description:
## C++
`CommandSetUpgrade::upgradeImplementation` (`CommandSetUpgrade.cpp:43-79`) reads INI `CommandSet` / `CommandSetAlt` / `TriggerAlt` (default `"none"`). If `TheUpgradeCenter->findUpgrade(TriggerAlt)` is completed on the player or object, it `setCommandSetStringOverride(CommandSetAlt)`; else `setCommandSetStringOverride(CommandSet)`. Then `TheControlBar->markUIDirty()`.

`Object::getCommandSetString` (`Object.cpp:6084-6089`) returns the override when set. ControlBar `populateCommand` / `findCommandSet` use that string.

Retail INI (`INIZH.big` `Data\INI\Object\*.ini`) has **126** `Behavior = CommandSetUpgrade` modules. TriggeredBy counts: `Upgrade_ChinaMines` 61, `Demo_Upgrade_SuicideBomb` 16, worker fake/real 6+6, Overlord/Helix addons, `Upgrade_AmericaMOAB` 4, satellite hack 4. Eight modules use CommandSetAlt/TriggerAlt (Internet Center mines vs SatelliteHack).

China CC example (`CommandSet.ini`):
- `ChinaCommandCenterCommandSet` slot 12 = `Command_UpgradeChinaMines`
- `ChinaCommandCenterCommandSetUpgrade` slot 12 = `Command_UpgradeEMPMines`

## Rust
Leftover crate (`command_set_upgrade.rs:144-205`) ports the alt/trigger matrix but **Wave 448** `dual_world_registry_unavailable()` (`OBJECT_REGISTRY.is_empty()`) returns false immediately on the live host. Module is registered in `contain_module_overrides/install.rs` but never applies.

Live host (`host_replace_object_upgrade.rs:71-163`) is a name-peel table: China EMP mines (not ChinaMines), Overlord/Helix addons, satellite hack, worker-real. `chinamines` explicitly returns `None`. Demo suicide is a separate residual. Comment admits fail-closed: not the alt-trigger dual CommandSet matrix.

## Evidence
- Leftover apply_upgrade: `command_set_upgrade.rs:150-152` empty-registry gate.
- Live peel: `host_replace_object_upgrade.rs:128-133` ChinaMines no-op; EMP peel never reached because the mines swap that exposes `Command_UpgradeEMPMines` never happens.
- 61 INI modules TriggeredBy `Upgrade_ChinaMines` vs peel covering only EMP + a handful of addons.
- PLAYABILITY_CURRENT_STATE.md still lists “Full WeaponSetUpgrade / CommandSetUpgrade module matrices” and “Full fake-building CommandSetUpgrade residual for Worker” as open.

## Player-visible
Researching China Mines never swaps the command set: slot 12 stays “research mines” instead of “research EMP mines”. Worker fake/real toggle only peels real. Superweapon-general MOAB command-set swap never runs. After most authored CommandSetUpgrade modules, the control bar still shows the pre-upgrade buttons.
close_reason: leftover command_set_upgrade.rs: removed Wave-448 empty-registry gate; apply_upgrade uses OBJECT_REGISTRY then TheGameLogic fallback + CommandSet/CommandSetAlt/TriggerAlt. Live host_replace_object_upgrade.rs ChinaMines now peels to *CommandSetUpgrade (same as EMP).

title: [CommandSet] canProduceUpgrade leftover never scans CommandSet buttons
description:
## C++
`Object::canProduceUpgrade` (`Object.cpp:6093-6106`) is the anti-cheat gate: `TheControlBar->findCommandSet(getCommandSetString())`, then for each of `MAX_COMMANDS_PER_SET` (18) slots `getCommandButton(i)` — which itself consults `GameLogic::findControlBarOverride` — and returns true only if that button’s `getUpgradeTemplate()` equals the requested upgrade. Comment: “Cheatin’ punk.”

Callers: `ProductionUpdate` queue-upgrade, `CommandButton` availability, `AIGroup` upgrade, script conditions.

## Rust
Leftover `Object::can_produce_upgrade` (`object_upgrade.rs:1028-1064`) ignores CommandSet entirely. It returns true if the object is not destroyed/disabled/under-construction **and** has any ProductionUpdate module/behavior.

Leftover `CommandButton` science/upgrade helpers (`command_button.rs:334-337`, `:425-429`) still call this method, so leftover production/AI/script paths authorize any upgrade on any factory.

Live host residual production uses a small UNIT_BUILD catalog for *units*; it does not scan the parsed CommandSet for *upgrade* buttons.

## Evidence
- C++: `Object.cpp:6095-6105` CommandSet walk + pointer equality on `UpgradeTemplate`.
- Rust leftover: `object_upgrade.rs:1047-1063` production-module presence only; `_upgrade` argument unused.
- After a CommandSetUpgrade swap (C++), the mines research button is gone so `canProduceUpgrade(Upgrade_ChinaMines)` is false. Leftover would still return true.

## Player-visible
Any production building can queue upgrades that are not on its current CommandSet (wrong general, already-swapped mines button, script-removed slot). Combined with leftover CommandSetUpgrade never applying, the leftover crate cannot reject an upgrade that retail already replaced.
close_reason: leftover object_upgrade.rs can_produce_upgrade now walks TheControlBar findCommandSet(getCommandSetString()) + getCommandButton(i) upgrade templates (C++ Object.cpp:6093). No longer production-module presence.

title: [Tunnel] Live host never writes or consumes tunnel nemesis; GuardTunnelNetwork never runs
description:
## C++
`TunnelContain::update` (`TunnelContain.cpp:441-480`) every frame:
- `tunnelSystem->healObjects(...)` (already closed as hq-ini85)
- if last damage is within 1 second and attacker is ENEMIES: `tunnelSystem->updateNemesis(attacker)`

`TunnelTracker::updateNemesis` / `getCurNemesis` (`TunnelTracker.cpp:87-129`):
- accept VEHICLE/STRUCTURE/INFANTRY/AIRCRAFT
- 4-second timeout
- clear if stealthed-undetected-undisguised or effectively dead

`AITNGuardMachine::lookForInnerTarget` (`AITNGuard.cpp:168-239`) prefers `tunnels->getCurNemesis()`, then each entrance's AI goal / last-damage attacker. Tunnel defenders and units ordered to Guard Tunnel Network sally out of the nearest entrance to that nemesis.

## Rust
Leftover crate has the full path:
- `TunnelContain::update` (`tunnel_contain.rs:673-743`) writes nemesis

Live `HostTunnelNetworkRegistry` (`host_tunnel_network.rs`) has **no** nemesis fields. Header fail-closed: "Not full GuardTunnelNetwork AI / AITNGuard nemesis path". Tunnel update never calls `updateNemesis`. No live AITNGuard tick.

hq-hn3 closed the residual enter/exit task as fail-closed vs GuardTunnelNetwork; this remaining gap was never filed as a bug.

## Evidence
C++ TunnelContain.cpp:461-474, TunnelTracker.cpp:87-129, AITNGuard.cpp:168-239.
Leftover: tunnel_contain.rs:693-737, tunnel_tracker.rs:84-156, tn_guard.rs:1559-1665 (dual_world empty gate).
Live: host_tunnel_network.rs:23-28 (no nemesis API).

TunnelContain::update stamps last_damage_timestamp and update_nemesis (VEHICLE/STRUCTURE/INFANTRY/AIRCRAFT, 1s window, ENEMIES). get_cur_nemesis 4s timeout + stealthed-undetected/dead clear. GuardingObject of a tunnel prefers nemesis; pool tunnel-defenders / GuardTunnelNetwork units sally from nearest entrance. leftover tn_guard empty-registry gate unblocked.

title: [Tunnel] Capture never re-homes the tracker; last-tunnel capture ejects instead of cave-in
description:
## C++
`TunnelContain::onCapture` (`TunnelContain.cpp:416-435`) if `m_isCurrentlyRegistered`:
- `oldOwner->getTunnelSystem()->onTunnelDestroyed(getObject())`
- `newOwner->getTunnelSystem()->onTunnelCreated(getObject())`
- then `OpenContain::onCapture` (no kick: `isKickOutOnCapture()` is FALSE)

`TunnelTracker::onTunnelDestroyed` (`TunnelTracker.cpp:187-211`):
- decrement count, drop the ID
- if `m_tunnelCount == 0`: `iterateContained(destroyObject)` — cave-in **kills** the shared pool
- else remap `getContainedBy()==deadTunnel` to `m_tunnelIDs.front()`

Player always has a `TunnelTracker` after `Player::init` (`Player.cpp:980`).

## Rust
Leftover crate `TunnelContain::on_capture` (`tunnel_contain.rs:640-670`) matches C++ (destroy on old tracker, create on new).

Live host `on_capture_tunnel_network_residual` (`rebuild_dozer.rs:52-136`):
- if this was the old team's last entrance and the pool is non-empty: `record_exit` + scatter-eject **alive**
- never calls `on_tunnel_destroyed` / `on_tunnel_created`
- `let _ = new_team;` — captured entrance is not registered on the new owner's network
- occupants keep `contained_by` pointing at the now-enemy entrance when other old tunnels remain

## Evidence
C++ TunnelContain.cpp:416-435 + TunnelTracker.cpp:187-211.
Leftover: tunnel_contain.rs:640-670.
Live: rebuild_dozer.rs:52-136 (honesty `capture_tunnel_transfers` only).
Distinct from closed hq-c9om/hq-61j8c (sell/onSelling) and hq-v1804 (die last-tunnel cave-in).

## Player-visible
Capturing the last occupied GLA tunnel dumps infantry alive at the door instead of burying them in a cave-in. Capturing one of several tunnels leaves the occupants attached to the stolen entrance (they can exit from the enemy's new tunnel) and the captured building is not a valid entrance on the new owner's network.
close_reason: on_capture_tunnel_network_residual now calls on_tunnel_destroyed(old)+on_tunnel_created(new). Last old-owner entrance cave-in destroyObject the shared pool (not eject). Non-last remaps ContainedBy. Entrances register via apply_create_modules_on_build_complete.

title: [Tunnel] Neutron killAllContained uses per-entrance occupants, not the shared pool
description:
## C++
`NeutonBlastBehavior` (`NeutonBlastBehavior.cpp:106-108`) on a hit object:
`if (contain) contain->killAllContained();`

`TunnelContain::killAllContained` (`TunnelContain.cpp:126-141`) walks `owningPlayer->getTunnelSystem()->getContainedItemsList()` — the **shared** pool — `removeFromContain` then `obj->kill()`. A neutron shell on **any** entrance kills everyone in the network, including units that entered a different tunnel.

`BunkerBusterBehavior.cpp:197` uses the same virtual when it is not the harm-and-force-exit branch.

## Rust
Leftover `TunnelContain::kill_all_contained` (`tunnel_contain.rs:365-394`) iterates the tracker list (correct) but no-ops when `OBJECT_REGISTRY` is empty.

Live neutron (`drones_and_garrison.rs:277-288`) builds occupants from `obj.contained_units()` only — the per-entrance local list. No `tunnel_network.contained_for_team`. Units that entered another allied tunnel survive a neutron on this entrance.

Live bunker-buster (`missile_defenders.rs:1842-1849`) already unions the shared pool; neutron does not.

## Evidence
C++ NeutonBlastBehavior.cpp:106-108 + TunnelContain.cpp:126-141.
Leftover: tunnel_contain.rs:365-394.
Live: drones_and_garrison.rs:277-288 vs missile_defenders.rs:1842-1849.
Distinct from closed hq-6dzn (control-bar list) and hq-54vqz (onDie no eject).

## Player-visible
A Neutron Cannon / neutron shell on one GLA Tunnel Network entrance only kills infantry that entered **that** door. The rest of the communal pool (entered at other tunnels) walks out unharmed. Retail wipes the whole network.

title: [EMP] Leftover EMP_HARDENED name-list immunizes ground units C++ still disables
description:
## C++
`EMPUpdate::doDisableAttack` (`EMPUpdate.cpp:226-263`) only consults `KINDOF_EMP_HARDENED` on the airborne-aircraft kill branch (`:231-249`). Ground EMP_HARDENED vehicles/structures still reach `setDisabledUntil(DISABLED_EMP, now + DisabledDuration)`. KindOf is the retail mask (`KindOf.h:145` — cargo plane / B52 / Spectre “sort-of IS the weapon”).

## Rust
Playable leftover `is_legal_emp_disable_target` (`host_emp_pulse.rs:131-143`) returns false when `is_emp_hardened` for **every** victim, not just airborne kill. `is_emp_hardened_name` (`:175-178`) is a substring list (`EMP_HARDENED_NAME_MARKERS`: cargoplane, jetb52, a10thunderbolt, spectregunship, carpetbomber, chinaartillerycannon, `supw_americapatriotbattery`, …). `apply_emp_pulse_at` and `apply_supw_patriot_emp_residual_at` both feed that helper.

Live `EMPUpdate::do_disable_attack` (`emp_update.rs:424-434`) matches C++ (hardened skip only on airborne kill). Leftover host never attaches that module to `EMPPulseEffectSpheroid`.

## Evidence
- C++: `if (AIRCRAFT && isAirborneTarget) { if (EMP_HARDENED) continue; kill(); continue; }` then later `setDisabledUntil` with no hardened check.
- Leftover: `if !is_alive || under_construction || is_emp_hardened { return false; }` then `is_vehicle || is_faction_structure || is_spawns`.
- Honesty test requires `is_emp_hardened_name("SupW_AmericaPatriotBattery")` true.

## Player-visible
China EMP Pulse / SupW Patriot EMP will not disable enemy Superweapon Patriot batteries, parked cargo planes, B52/A10/Spectre, or Nuke Cannon — C++ still EMPs those on the ground.
close_reason: host_emp_pulse.rs is_legal_emp_disable_target no longer rejects EMP_HARDENED; hardened only skips airborne kill via should_emp_kill_airborne. Ground Patriots/cargo/B52/Nuke Cannon receive DISABLED_EMP.

title: [EMP] Leftover SupW Patriot EMP disables airborne aircraft instead of killing
description:
## C++
`EMPUpdate::doDisableAttack` (`EMPUpdate.cpp:231-249`) for `KINDOF_AIRCRAFT && isAirborneTarget()` and not `KINDOF_EMP_HARDENED` calls `curVictim->kill()` and paints `TINT_STATUS_DISABLED`. `EMPPatriotEffectSpheroid` is the same EMPUpdate module (DisabledDuration 10000 ms, EffectRadius 10). Airborne jets in the EMP blast crash.

## Rust
Leftover `apply_supw_patriot_emp_residual_at` (`strategy_center.rs:1193-1301`) only `apply_disabled_emp(until)`. `is_legal_supw_patriot_emp_target` (`host_base_defense.rs:1748-1765`) treats `is_aircraft` as a **disable** legal target (`is_vehicle || is_aircraft || is_faction_structure`) and never kills. Host test `supw_patriot_emp_residual_dual_slot_and_disable` asserts `"SupW EMP residual must DISABLED_EMP aircraft"` with `airborne_target = true`.

Live `EMPUpdate` does kill airborne aircraft, but leftover Patriot impact never constructs that module.

## Evidence
- C++: `curVictim->kill(); drw->setTintStatus(TINT_STATUS_DISABLED); continue;`
- Leftover: `v.apply_disabled_emp(until);` only; no `should_emp_kill_airborne` / `mark_object_for_destruction`.
- Contrast leftover EMP Pulse `apply_emp_pulse_at` which **does** call `should_emp_kill_airborne` — Patriot path is the missing kill.

## Player-visible
Superweapon Patriot EMP stuns flying jets instead of knocking them out of the sky. Jets hover disabled and recover after 10s.
close_reason: strategy_center.rs apply_supw_patriot_emp_residual_at now should_emp_kill_airborne + mark_object_for_destruction. host_base_defense is_legal_supw_patriot_emp_target no longer treats aircraft as disable-only.

title: [Score] Live create path skips addObjectBuilt KindOf+template map
description:
## C++
`Player::onUnitCreated` (`Player.cpp:1564-1565`) calls `m_scoreKeeper.addObjectBuilt(unit)`.
`Player::onStructureConstructionComplete` (`Player.cpp:1648-1650`) calls `addObjectBuilt(structure)` plus `addMoneySpent` unless `isRebuild`.

`ScoreKeeper::addObjectBuilt` (`ScoreKeeper.cpp:97-132`) only counts:
- buildings with `isKindOfMulti(STRUCTURE|SCORE)` or `STRUCTURE|SCORE_CREATE`
- infantry/vehicle with `SCORE` or `SCORE_CREATE`
and writes the ThingTemplate into `m_objectsBuilt` used by `getTotalObjectsBuilt` / `getTotalUnitsBuilt(valid,invalid)` for Apocalypse / Air Wing / Battle Tank honors (`ScoreScreen.cpp:1104-1165`).

## Rust
Live GameLogic leftover `ScoreKeeper` (`academy_score.rs`) is what `Player::get_score_keeper()` returns.

`on_unit_created_id` (`objects.rs:112-123`) calls `add_building_built()` / `add_unit_built()` — bare `+= 1`, no KindOf SCORE filter, no `objects_built` map.
`on_structure_construction_complete_id` (`objects.rs:220-227`) same `add_building_built()` + money spent.

`add_object_built_obj` exists (`academy_score.rs:592-605`) and would fill the map, but no live production/spawn/dozer path calls it (only tests).

## Evidence
C++ `Player.cpp:1565,1648-1650` + `ScoreKeeper.cpp:97-132`.
Rust `objects.rs:112-123,220-227` vs unused `academy_score.rs:592-605`.
Score screen honors read `get_total_objects_built` / `get_total_units_built_filtered` (`score_screen.rs:1040-1070`).

## Player-visible
Score screen Units/Buildings Built counts dozers, civilians, SCORE-less objects. Superweapon / Air Wing / Battle Tank honors never unlock because `objects_built` stays empty (filtered walk returns 0).
close_reason: objects.rs on_unit_created/on_structure_complete call add_object_built_obj (KindOf SCORE + objects_built map)

title: [Recorder] Live playback never culls user orders (cullBadCommands unwired)
description:
## C++
`RecorderClass::updatePlayback` (`Recorder.cpp:415-416`) always calls `cullBadCommands` first. That walk (`:1436-1453`) deletes every `TheCommandList` message in `(MSG_BEGIN_NETWORK_MESSAGES, MSG_END_NETWORK_MESSAGES)` except `MSG_LOGIC_CRC`, so mouse/keyboard orders issued during a replay never reach `processCommandList`. Replay file commands are appended after the cull.

## Rust
Leftover `cull_bad_commands` (`recorder.rs:1226-1233`) only invokes an optional `command_cull` hook. GameClient leftover `init_recorder_bridge` installs a retain-filter. Live Main `install_host_replay_bridges` (`record_tap.rs:141-144`) does **not**. Worse, `GameLogic::queue_command` (`ui_production.rs:393-397`) and `CommandSystem::queue_command` (`system_impl.rs:577-580`) always `tap_host_command_for_recorder` **and** push onto the host `command_queue` with no playback gate. `process_commands` then executes that queue after `flush_recorder_and_replay_authority`.

## Evidence
C++ comment at `Recorder.cpp:1434`: "prevent the user from giving mouse commands that he shouldn't be able to do during playback." Live `host_recorder_is_playback` is only used to skip camera *recording* (`mouse.rs:92-93`), not to drop orders.

## Player-visible
During replay the player can still issue move/attack/build. Those orders execute on the live host and desync the replay instead of being discarded.
close_reason: leftover recorder.rs cull_bad_commands + live record_tap.rs install_host_replay_bridges command_cull and flush host_queue retain: C++ cullBadCommands drops user network orders except LogicCRC during playback

title: [Recorder] Live host never stamps TheGameLogic frame on recorded commands
description:
## C++
`RecorderClass::writeToFile` (`Recorder.cpp:700-703`) stamps every recorded command with `TheGameLogic->getFrame()`. `updatePlayback` (`:423-431`) then appends only those commands whose stored frame equals the current logic frame. `handleCRCMessage` (`:977`) compares CRCs only when `getFrame() > 0`. `logGameEnd` (`:202`) writes that frame as `frameDuration`.

## Rust
Leftover `GameLogic::update` (`impl_update.rs:173-175`) does `set_current_frame(self.frame)` before `recorder.update()`. Live Main never uses that tick: `GameLogic::process_commands` (`world_scripts/ui_production.rs:430-432`) calls `flush_recorder_and_replay_authority`, which does `recorder.update()` with no `set_current_frame` and no `set_frame_provider` (`record_tap.rs:207-210`). `install_host_replay_bridges` only installs source/sink. Default `current_frame` stays 0.

## Evidence
C++ `fwrite(&frame, sizeof(frame), 1, m_file)` per command. Live write path: `Recorder::write_to_file` uses `get_current_frame()` (`recorder.rs:1541`). hq-323o closed the leftover hardcoded-0 CRC compare; the live host still never feeds the frame.

## Player-visible
Every live-recorded `.rep` stamps commands at frame 0. Playback dumps the entire match on the first frame then `stopPlayback` / `MSG_CLEAR_GAME_DATA`. CRC mismatch is still skipped (`frame > 0`). Replay duration in the header is 0.
close_reason: live record_tap.rs flush set_current_frame(host_logic_frame) + set_frame_provider(TheGameLogic::get_frame): C++ writeToFile stamps TheGameLogic->getFrame()

title: [Slaved] Scout drone never grants DRONE_SPOTTING range bonus
description:
## C++
`SlavedUpdate::update` (`SlavedUpdate.cpp:160-162`) clears `WEAPONBONUSCONDITION_DRONE_SPOTTING` on the master every tick. `doAttackLogic` (`:319-324`) re-grants it when the slave's 2D bounding-sphere distance to the master's current victim is `< DistToTargetToGrantRangeBonus²` (Scout drone INI residual **20**). That is the Scout drone's range-extend ability.

## Rust
Leftover `slaved_update.rs` implements the same clear (`:1180-1181`) and grant (`:623-626`) but only after `object_arc`/`master_arc` succeed. Those helpers return `None` when `OBJECT_REGISTRY` is empty (Wave 402 host-only path), so leftover never runs in live play.

Live `update_slaved_drone_follow` / `slaved_update_follow_goal` (`world_tick/ai.rs:591-758`) move the drone toward the victim but never call `set_weapon_bonus_condition(DroneSpotting)`. Host `Object` only exposes `set_weapon_bonus_player_upgrade`. `SCOUT_DIST_TO_TARGET_RANGE_BONUS` is a leftover honesty constant.

## Evidence
C++ `:160-162` + `:319-324` vs leftover `:623-626`/`:1180-1181` (gated) vs live `slaved_update_follow_goal` (no spotting).

## Player-visible
A Scout drone hovering over the Humvee/Ranger's target does not extend the master's weapon range.
close_reason: live follow clears/grants DRONE_SPOTTING; host Object RANGE 150% via weapon_bonus_drone_spotting + slaved_update_follow / host_slave_drones

title: [Slaved] Hijacked master does not defect attached drones
description:
## C++
`SlavedUpdate::update` (`SlavedUpdate.cpp:145-150`): if the master's team relationship to the slave is not `ALLIES` (Hijack / Jarmen Kell / Black Lotus), the slave `defect(masterTeam, 0)` so the drone follows the new owner.

Steal a Humvee and its Battle/Hellfire/Scout drone stays on the old team and fires at the new driver.

title: [GameLOD] findStaticLODLevel never runs hardware recommend
description:
## C++
`GameLODManager::findStaticLODLevel` (`GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/Common/GameLOD.cpp:421-466`) walks `m_lodPresets[HIGH..LOW]` loaded from `GameLODPresets.ini` against `testMinimumRequirements` CPU/MHz/video/RAM (with `PROFILE_ERROR_LIMIT` 0.94). On first run (`m_idealDetailLevel == UNKNOWN`) it writes `IdealStaticGameLOD` and, if current is still unknown, `StaticGameLOD` into `Options.ini`.

Callers:
- `W3DDisplay::init` (`W3DDisplay.cpp:758-760`): if `getStaticLODLevel()==UNKNOWN`, `setStaticLODLevel(findStaticLODLevel())`; else apply `WW3D::Set_Texture_Reduction` from GlobalData.
- `getRecommendedTextureReduction` (`GameLOD.cpp:664-672`): if ideal unknown, calls `findStaticLODLevel()` first; `<256MB` forces Low's texture reduction.
- Options menu recommend / first-open (`OptionsMenu.cpp:762-763`, `1622-1624`).
- Score-screen victory movie (`ScoreScreen.cpp:859-868`): low-res if `!didMemPass()` or `findStaticLODLevel()==LOW` or `getStaticLODLevel()==LOW`.

`getStaticLODLevel()` starts as `STATIC_GAME_LOD_UNKNOWN`.

## Rust
Presets parse into `GameLODManager.lod_presets` (`ini_game_lod.rs:995-1023`) but nothing ever walks them. There is no `find_static_lod_level`.

`load_game_lod_ini_presets_and_options` (`game_lod.rs:491-559`) skips apply when `StaticGameLOD` is missing/`Unknown`. `get_static_lod()` still defaults the leftover string to `"Medium"` without applying Medium GlobalData. `recommended_texture_reduction` (`game_lod.rs:311-330`) uses `get_ideal_static_lod()` and, when that is `"Unknown"`, falls back to the requested preset's INI factor — it never runs hardware matching.

No W3DDisplay-init equivalent calls find+set. `prefers_low_res_movies` (`game_lod.rs:457-458`) only checks leftover strings `"Low"`, never hardware ideal.

## Evidence
- C++ `findStaticLODLevel` 421-466; display init 758-770; `getRecommendedTextureReduction` 664-672.
- Rust `ini_game_lod.rs` stores presets; grep of `GeneralsRust/Code` finds no `find_static_lod`.
- Closed `hq-trsv` / `hq-hm2ao` only cover INI load + calling init, not hardware recommend.

## Player-visible
First launch never auto-selects Low/Medium/High for the machine. Texture reduction follows the selected preset (or GameData defaults) instead of hardware ideal. Score/intro low-res movie fallback never triggers via recommended Low. Options "recommended" detail cannot match retail.
close_reason: find_static_lod_level walks lod_presets HIGH..LOW vs CPU/MHz/video/RAM; W3DDisplay/options first-open apply; recommended_texture_reduction calls find
