## Player-visible
Overlapping a barracks/war factory shows a red ghost (if illegal) but no red faction footprint on the existing building. Retail paints the blocker so you can see what you are hitting.
close_reason: ui_production.rs bibs blocking objects via TerrainVisual addFactionBib on LBC_OBJECTS_IN_THE_WAY

title: [Build] Placement ignores stealth and busy-ally gates
description:
## C++
`isLocationLegalToBuild` preview (`InGameUI.cpp:1454-1462`) passes `IGNORE_STEALTHED` so unseen stealthed units do not redden the ghost. Confirm-place uses `FAIL_STEALTHED_WITHOUT_FEEDBACK` (`BuildAssistant.h:98-99`, `isLocationClearOfObjects` `:662-678`): click fails without bib feedback.

Patch 1.01 (`BuildAssistant.cpp:681-688`): allied units with `OBJECT_STATUS_IS_USING_ABILITY` or `ai->isBusy()` return `LBC_OBJECTS_IN_THE_WAY` so a building cannot be dropped on a hacking Black Lotus to cancel the hack.

## Leftover Rust
`FoundationValidator::validate_placement` (`construction.rs:299-317`) implements IGNORE_STEALTHED / FAIL_STEALTHED but only when `OBJECT_REGISTRY` is non-empty. Empty-registry skips object probes (`:299-300`). Leftover is not the live host legal-build path.

## Live host
`legal_build_code_at_for_builder` (`ui_production.rs:541-564`) treats every living Enemy / Immobile / Disabled / Structure as a blocker. No stealth / DETECTED / DISGUISED test. No USING_ABILITY / isBusy ally test.

`move_objects_for_construction` (`:732-734`) **skips** `status.using_ability` (will not scoot them) but placement still succeeds, so the building drops on top of the busy ally.

## Player-visible
Hovering a stealthed rebel/Jarmen Kell reddens the place ghost (stealth leak). Clicking to place on a hacking Black Lotus succeeds — the 1.01 exploit C++ closed.
close_reason: legal_build preview IGNORE_STEALTHED, confirm FAIL_STEALTHED, busy-ally USING_ABILITY/isBusy blocks

title: [Weapon] Live stream name peels PRIMARY seed only, ignores store ProjectileStreamName
description:
## C++
`Weapon.cpp` `fireWeaponTemplate` (1116) always calls `firingWeapon->newProjectileFired`. That uses **this** template's `m_projectileStreamName` (INI `ProjectileStreamName`) and creates/reuses a per-weapon stream object. Secondary/tertiary stream weapons get their own ribbon.

## Leftover Rust
Store/template parse `ProjectileStreamName` (`weapon_template.rs` / `ini_template_loader.rs:1012-1013`). `new_projectile_fired` uses `self.template.projectile_stream_name`. Empty-registry leftover never runs.

## Live host
`weapon_bootstrap/damage_kinds.rs` `host_projectile_stream_name_for_weapon_name` (34-55) is **seed-only** (flame/dragon → DragonTankFlameStream, toxin spray/stream → ToxinStream, microwave, cleanup). It never reads `wt.projectile_stream_name` from the live WeaponStore. `world_tick/step.rs` (836-847) always peels `thing.template.primary_weapon_name`, even when the shot came from secondary/tertiary. Closed hq-jay8 only wired leftover `new_projectile_fired`.

## Player-visible
Authored streams that are not in the seed (Aurora/comet-style ProjectileStreamName, any non-primary slot stream) never appear. A unit whose PRIMARY is a gun and whose stream weapon is another slot draws nothing, or the wrong ribbon.
close_reason: damage_kinds reads store ProjectileStreamName; step uses firing/historic slot not PRIMARY-only seed

title: [Weapon] ShareWeaponReloadTime copies last_fire_time not the firing slot next-shot frame
description:
## C++
`Weapon.cpp` `privateFireWeapon` (2655-2665): if `sourceObj->isReloadTimeShared()`, every slot gets `setPossibleNextShotFrame(m_whenWeCanFireAgain)` and `BETWEEN_FIRING_SHOTS`, where `m_whenWeCanFireAgain` is **now + the firing weapon's DelayBetweenShots**. `reloadWithBonus` (1898-1909) does the same with `RELOADING_CLIP` and the firing weapon's ClipReloadTime. Parsed on WeaponSet (`WeaponSet.cpp:135` ShareWeaponReloadTime).

## Leftover Rust
`weapon_instance.rs` `propagate_shared_timing` / `reload_with_bonus` copy the firing weapon's `when_we_can_fire_again` + status. Empty-registry leftover is not live.

## Live host
`object/weapons.rs` `sync_shared_weapon_reload` (588-607) only copies the **max last_fire_time** across slots 0/1/2. Ready checks then use each slot's own `live_reload_interval` (DelayBetweenShots or that slot's ClipReloadTime). Closed hq-y55ip wired the copy; it did not match C++ shared next-shot frame/status.

## Player-visible
Comanche (ShareWeaponReloadTime Yes): after the chaingun fires, rocket pods wait their own long delay (retail waits the gun's short delay). After rocket-pod fire, the gun is ready on the gun interval (retail waits the rocket delay). Multi-weapon jets desync clip cadence vs retail.
close_reason: sync_shared_weapon_reload copies firing-slot next-shot via last_fire back-compute; reload_aim helpers

title: [Weapon] Live scatter offset is pairing-deterministic so repeat shots land in the same miss
description:
## C++
`Weapon.cpp` `fireWeaponTemplate` (979-989): each shot rolls `GameLogicRandomValueReal(0, scatterRadius)` and `GameLogicRandomValueReal(0, 2*PI)` independently from the global logic RNG. Successive shells vs the same infantry/building land in different places.

## Leftover Rust
Leftover `fire_weapon_template` uses `get_game_logic_random_value_real`. Empty `OBJECT_REGISTRY` leftover fire is not the live path.

## Live host
`Main/src/game_logic/combat.rs` (971-980) seeds `scatter_aim_offset` with `shooter_id * const + target_id * const` — **no frame**. `weapon_bootstrap/scatter.rs` `scatter_aim_offset` (213-221) is a pure ADC function of that seed. Same shooter+target therefore produces the identical XZ offset every shot. (`scatter_seed_for_shot` includes frame but drain does not call it.)

## Player-visible
Crusader / Inferno / Tomahawk / Fire Base / Strategy Center vs the same infantry always miss (or hit) the same offset. Retail walks the miss cone around the target.
close_reason: combat drain uses scatter_aim_offset_logic GameLogicRandomValueReal per shot, not pairing seed

title: [Weapon] Live projectile streams never break on retarget or skim vehicle roofs
description:
## C++
`ProjectileStreamUpdate.cpp` `addProjectile` (61-108): when the victim object or victim position changes, insert `INVALID_ID` into the circular `m_projectileIDs` ring so `getAllPoints` writes a (0,0,0) hole and the ribbon breaks. `getAllPoints` (131-183): for a live projectile owned by a `KINDOF_VEHICLE`, if the point is within 1.5× major radius of the owner, raise Z to `geometry.maxHeightAbovePosition + pos.z + 0.5` so the stream skims the hull instead of clipping through it. `Weapon.cpp` `newProjectileFired` (2388-2414) creates/reuses that stream Thing from the firing template's `ProjectileStreamName`.

## Leftover Rust
`GameLogic/src/object/behavior/projectile_stream_update.rs` `add_projectile` (111-133) and `get_all_points` (140-187) port the hole + vehicle-roof skim. `weapon_instance.rs` `new_projectile_fired` (882-971) creates the stream Thing via `TheThingFactory`. With empty `OBJECT_REGISTRY` the factory/lookup path no-ops, so leftover never draws.

## Live host
`Main/src/game_logic/host_projectile_stream.rs` `add_point` (34-49) only `push`es positions (cap 20) and overwrites `target_id`/`target_pos` — no INVALID hole on retarget. No vehicle-roof Z raise. `world_tick/step.rs` (832-861) feeds current projectile positions every frame. Presentation packs those points as a continuous polyline (`presentation_frame/build.rs` + `laser_segment_upload.rs`).

## Player-visible
Dragon Tank / Toxin Tractor / microwave / cleanup streams stay one connected ribbon when the unit switches targets (retail breaks the trail). Flame/toxin also clips through the vehicle hull instead of riding the roof.
close_reason: host_projectile_stream + step: INVALID hole on retarget, vehicle roof skim, laser pack skips holes

title: [Weapon] Live scatter aims at structure origin not geometry center
description:
## C++
`Weapon.cpp` `fireWeaponTemplate` (960-967): when applying ScatterRadius / ScatterRadiusVsInfantry, if the victim is `KINDOF_STRUCTURE`, `getGeometryInfo().getCenterPosition` so the random disk is around the building volume, not the ground stamp. Then Z is snapped to the victim's pathfind layer.

## Leftover Rust
Leftover fire template has the structure-center branch; empty-registry leftover is not live.

## Live host
`Main/src/game_logic/combat.rs` (933-981) takes `obj.get_position()` (ground origin) then adds `scatter_aim_offset` / ScatterTarget table. Table path may snap Y to `ground_height` when `ground_height_from_terrain`; there is no geometry-center lift for structures.

## Player-visible
Artillery / tank / missile scatter vs buildings clusters around the footprint origin (often a corner/feet). Retail walks the miss cone around the building center, so more shells clip the volume instead of hitting dirt beside the door.
close_reason: combat scatter aims KINDOF_STRUCTURE at geometry center then snaps Y to ground

title: [TurretAI] Sweep FirePitch RecenterTime FiresWhileTurning INI unused
description:
## C++
`TurretAIData` INI (`TurretAI.cpp:212-237`): `TurretFireAngleSweep`/`TurretSweepSpeedModifier` per slot, `AllowsPitch`, `FirePitch`, `MinPhysicalPitch`, `GroundUnitPitch`, `RecenterTime`, `FiresWhileTurning`, `InitiallyDisabled`. Sweep enables 3 frames after `notifyFired` (`:697-702`). RecenterTime default `2*LOGICFRAMES_PER_SECOND` (60); Humvee authors **5000 ms → 150** frames. FiresWhileTurning keeps rotate/pitch sound across the fire/sweep window (`:683-688`).

## Leftover
`ai_update_interface.rs:533-673` parses every field. Unused when `OBJECT_REGISTRY` is empty.

## Live host
`set_turret_fire_angle_sweep` / `set_turret_pitch_params` / `set_turret_idle_scan_params` (`attack.rs:718-762`) exist but have **zero spawn callers**. Seed only hardcodes FirePitch for names containing `strategycenter` (45°) or `tomahawk` (70°). `fire_angle_sweep` stays `[0,0,0]` so the closed hq-3bka9 mechanism never runs in a match. `turret_recenter_frames` stays 60 for everyone (`HUMVEE_TURRET_RECENTER_FRAMES` unused). No `fires_while_turning` field — `TurretMoveLoop` drops the instant `turret_rotating` is false.

## Player-visible
Gattling/QuadCannon never waggle after bursts. Nuke Cannon/Inferno never use authored pitch. Humvee recenters after 2s instead of 5s. Rotate loop stutters between shots on FiresWhileTurning units.
close_reason: Spawn applies Sweep/FirePitch/RecenterTime/FiresWhileTurning from INI or honesty (Humvee 150f, SC/Tomahawk FirePitch, Gattling sweep). files: object/turret_spawn.rs world_tick/attack.rs

title: [Fire] Tree-to-tree spread is a fixed 1.5s 2D check, not random 3D
description:
## C++
`FireSpreadUpdate::calcNextSpreadDelay` (`FireSpreadUpdate.cpp:149-155`) `GameLogicRandomValue(MinSpreadDelay, MaxSpreadDelay)` (trees 1000–2000ms → 30–60f), min 1. `update` (`:123`) `getClosestObject(..., FROM_CENTER_3D, PartitionFilterFlammable)` so height (cliffs / bridges) counts.

## Leftover Rust
`fire_spread_update.rs` `calc_next_spread_delay` uses `game_logic_random_value` and Center3D. Wave 447 empty-registry `update_simple` Forever-sleeps on the live path.

## Live host
`HostFireSpreadData::calc_next_spread_delay` (`host_fire_spread.rs:174-179`) is the midpoint of min/max (always 45f / 1.5s). `update_fire_spread` (`infantry_weapons.rs:1452-1456`) uses `sqrt(dx*dx + dz*dz)` — Y ignored.

## Player-visible result
A row of trees ignites in lockstep every 1.5s. Trees on a cliff vs the valley floor can catch (or miss) as if they were on the same plane.
close_reason: calc_next_spread_delay uses GameLogicRandomValue(min,max) min 1. update_fire_spread closest flammable uses FROM_CENTER_3D (dx,dy,dz) not planar xz.

title: [Fire] AFLAME/SMOLDERING model and auto-aflame particles never apply
description:
## C++
`tryToIgnite` (`FlammableUpdate.cpp:175-177`) `setStatus(AFLAME)`, `body->setAflame(TRUE)`, `setModelConditionState(MODELCONDITION_AFLAME)`. Burned timer (`:122-123`) adds MODELCONDITION_SMOLDERING while still aflame. `ActiveBody::updateBodyParticleSystems` (`ActiveBody.cpp:1108-1175`) when OBJECT_STATUS_AFLAME upgrades fire/smoke bones (small→medium, smoke→fire, countModifier 2) and attaches `m_autoAflameParticleSystem`.

## Leftover Rust
`behavior/flammable_update.rs` sets AFLAME status + model condition on ignite (best-effort if the object is in a registry) but Wave 379 empty-registry never ticks, never sets SMOLDERING on the live path.

## Live host
`update_fire_spread` only `apply_status_bits_upgrade_masks(&["AFLAME"])` / `BURNED` (`infantry_weapons.rs:1466-1474`). That writes `object_status_bits` and does **not** set model bits. `refresh_model_condition_bits` (`object/pose.rs:636-888`) rebuilds from body/motion and never stamps AFLAME/SMOLDERING from status. Presentation Wave 511/524 stamps those bits from **death type**, not live burning. No `setAflame` / auto-aflame particle bones.

## Player-visible result
A burning tree keeps its normal mesh and normal damage-smoke particles. C++ swaps to the AFLAME model and bigger fire bones for the whole burn, then SMOLDERING while still aflame.
close_reason: refresh_model_condition_bits stamps AFLAME/SMOLDERING from status + fire_spread. apply_flammable_visuals sets AFLAME/BURNED bits + body_aflame. spawn_auto_aflame_particles attaches AutoAflame on ignite.

title: [Fire] Burning loop never plays
description:
## C++
`FlammableUpdate::tryToIgnite` calls `startBurningSound` (`FlammableUpdate.cpp:217-223`): `AudioEventRTS(m_burningSoundName, objId)` + `TheAudio->addAudioEvent`. `stopBurningSound` (`:227-233`) removes the handle when aflame ends or the module dies. Retail trees use `GenericFireMediumLoop`.

## Leftover Rust
`object/update/flammable_update.rs` `start_burning_sound` plays if `ctx.audio` is set. Registered leftover `behavior/flammable_update.rs` `try_to_ignite` never starts the loop; `update_simple` Wave 379 empty-registry no-op.

## Live host
`TREE_BURNING_SOUND = "GenericFireMediumLoop"` is an honesty constant in `host_fire_spread.rs:39`. `try_to_ignite` / `tick_flammable` / `update_fire_spread` never queue it. No `addAudioEvent` / fire-loop start on ignite.

## Player-visible result
Burning trees and (if ignition is added) buildings are silent. C++ loops GenericFireMediumLoop for the whole AflameDuration.
close_reason: tryToIgnite / first aflame tick queues looping GenericFireMediumLoop (AudioEventRequest.looping). stop_fire_spread_burning_sound on aflame_end.

title: [Fire] FlameDamageExpiration never resets — spaced hits always ignite
description:
## C++
`FlammableUpdate::onDamage` (`FlammableUpdate.cpp:82-88`): if `now - FlameDamageExpiration > m_lastFlameDamageDealt` (default 2s / 60f), reset `m_flameDamageLimit` to the authored limit, then subtract this hit. Spaced-out small flame ticks do not accumulate across the expiration window.

## Leftover Rust
`behavior/flammable_update.rs` `on_damage` and `update/flammable_update.rs` both port the expiration reset. Leftover never runs on the live host (OBJECT_REGISTRY empty).

## Live host
`HostFireSpreadData::apply_flame_damage` (`host_fire_spread.rs:160-171`) only `flame_damage_accum += amount` with no last-dealt timestamp and no reset. `damage.rs:389-400` feeds every Flame/ParticleBeam hit into that accum.

## Player-visible result
A tree that takes 1 flame damage, waits three seconds, then another 1 damage ignites (limit 2). In C++ the threshold would have reset and it would still need two hits inside two seconds.
close_reason: apply_flame_damage matches FlammableUpdate.cpp:82-88: if now-expiration > lastDealt reset remaining limit to authored, then subtract. Spaced hits no longer accumulate across the 2s window.

title: [Fire] Aflame always becomes permanently Burned; no SMOLDERING-while-aflame
description:
## C++
`FlammableUpdate::tryToIgnite` (`FlammableUpdate.cpp:192-194`): `m_burnedEndFrame = burnedDelay ? now+delay : 0` (0 = never burned). `update` (`:119-143`): at burned_end independently sets OBJECT_STATUS_BURNED + MODELCONDITION_SMOLDERING **while still AFLAME**. At aflame_end: if already BURNED stay FS_BURNED (never re-ignite); else return FS_NORMAL and can catch fire again.

## Leftover Rust
`behavior/flammable_update.rs` `update_simple` ports the independent timers, but Wave 379 empty-registry Forever-sleeps so it never runs live.

## Live host
`HostFireSpreadData::try_to_ignite` (`host_fire_spread.rs:145-146`) always sets `burned_end_frame = now + burned_delay.max(aflame_duration)`. `tick_flammable` (`:199-201`) on aflame_end **always** `state = Burned` / `became_burned` — never returns to Normal, never applies SMOLDERING while still AFLAME. Trees (BurnedDelay 75f, AflameDuration 105f) skip the 30-frame smoldering-while-burning window.

## Player-visible result
Burning trees jump straight to permanently burned when the flame timer ends. Objects that should go out and be re-ignitable stay charcoal forever. No smoldering model while still on fire.
close_reason: tryToIgnite burned_end = burnedDelay ? now+delay : 0. tick_flammable sets SMOLDERING/BURNED status while still AFLAME; at aflame_end stay Burned if already burned else return Normal (re-ignitable).

title: [Fire] Spreading trees never spawn OCL BurningEmbers
description:
## C++
`FireSpreadUpdate::update` (`FireSpreadUpdate.cpp:93-134`) while OBJECT_STATUS_AFLAME always `ObjectCreationList::create(d->m_oclEmbers, getObject(), NULL)` (retail `OCL_BurningEmbers`) before the closest-flammable ignite.

## Leftover Rust
`GameEngine/GameLogic/src/object/update/fire_spread_update.rs` `update` / `update_simple` can create the OCL, but Wave 447 empty-registry gate makes `update_simple` return Forever on the live path. Closed `hq-f0s1` only covers this leftover crate.

## Live host
`update_fire_spread` / `apply_fire_spread_tick_event` (`world_combat/infantry_weapons.rs:1369-1445`) set `spawn_embers` then `let _ = TREE_OCL_EMBERS` — honesty name only, fail-closed, no OCL objects.

## Player-visible result
Forest fires have no ember spray / ember objects when they tick-spread. Trees may still ignite neighbors, but the C++ ember FX is missing.
close_reason: FireSpreadUpdate tick now ObjectCreationList::create(OCL_BurningEmbers) via spawn_fire_spread_embers (parsed OCL or BurningEmbers object + combat particle ocl_list_name). infantry_weapons no longer let _ = TREE_OCL_EMBERS.

title: [AIGuard] EnterGuard/HijackGuard unused so Hijackers shoot instead of boarding
description:
## C++
`ThingTemplate` `EnterGuard` / `HijackGuard` (`ThingTemplate.cpp` parse, `isEnterGuard`/`isHijackGuard`).
`AIGuardMachine::lookForInnerTarget` (`AIGuard.cpp` ~221) and `AIGuardInnerState::onEnter` (~364): if EnterGuard, filter `PartitionFilterPossibleToEnter` (HijackGuard: enemies + `PossibleToHijack`; else neutrals) and run `AIEnterState` instead of `AIAttackState`. Same in `AIGuardRetaliate` (~229, ~345). Hijacker / Terrorist / similar INI set these flags so Guard means "board/hijack anything in the circle", not shoot it.

## Leftover
`GameEngine/Common/src/common/thing/thing_template.rs` parses `EnterGuard`/`HijackGuard`. `ai/guard.rs` `scan_guard_inner_target` + `AIGuardInnerState::classic_on_enter` enter/hijack. Empty-registry leftover unused.

## Live host
Main `ThingTemplate` has **no** `enter_guard`/`hijack_guard` field (no parse in `Main/src/assets`). `support_states.rs` Guard always `get_able_to_attack_specific_object` + `engage_target_decision_aware` → `attack_target` (guns). No enter/hijack branch.

## Player-visible
Order a GLA Hijacker or Terrorist to Guard a parking lot: they shoot the vehicles instead of hijacking / converting to carbomb. Retail Guard on those templates is a boarding hunt inside the circle.
close_reason: EnterGuard/HijackGuard on ThingTemplate+INI; Guard boards not shoots; files: thing.rs spawn_templates.rs support_states.rs

title: [AIStates] Hunt/Guard/Attack-Move never pick up crates they created
description:
## C++
Crate pickup is wired into every combat-wander state, not just idle:
- `AIGuardIdleState::update` (`AIGuard.cpp` ~704) → `AI_GUARD_GET_CRATE`
- `AIGuardRetaliateIdleState::update` (`AIGuardRetaliate.cpp` ~idle crate branch)
- `AIHuntState::update` (`AIStates.cpp` ~7139) → `AI_PICK_UP_CRATE`
- `AIAttackMoveToState::update` (`AIStates.cpp` ~3607) → `AI_PICK_UP_CRATE`
- `AIIdleState::update` (`AIStates.cpp` ~1399) → `aiMoveToObject(crate)`

## Leftover
`GameEngine/GameLogic/src/ai/guard.rs` `AIGuardPickUpCrateState`, `guard_retaliate.rs` crate state, `states/hunt.rs` crate branch, leftover attack-move. Empty-registry leftover is unused.

## Live host
`world_tick/teams.rs` `try_idle_crate_pickup` **requires `AIState::Idle`** (comment: "C++ only while idle" — that comment is wrong vs C++). Called from `world_tick/ai.rs` before `process_ai_behavior`. Hunt/Patrol (`Patrolling`), Guard (`GuardingArea`/`GuardingObject`), Attack-Move (`AttackMoving`), and Guard-Retaliate never consume `crate_created`.

## Player-visible
A computer unit that kills something while Hunting, Guarding, Attack-Moving, or Retaliating leaves the money/veterancy crate on the ground and walks away. Only a fully Idle unit ever stoops to pick it up. Retail units grab the crate before resuming the order.
close_reason: Crate pickup from Idle/Hunt/Guard/AttackMove/GuardRetaliate; combat states keep parent AI; files: teams.rs

title: [AIGuard] Guard range is hardcoded 80/1.5x not mood-adjusted vision
description:
## C++
`AIGuardMachine::getStdGuardRange` (`AIGuard.cpp` ~176) = `TheAI->getAdjustedVisionRangeForObject(obj, AI_VISIONFACTOR_OWNERTYPE | AI_VISIONFACTOR_MOOD | AI_VISIONFACTOR_GUARDINNER)`.
Inner exit radius is that value. Outer (`AIGuardOuterState::onEnter` ~504) uses vision **without** GUARDINNER, plus `m_guardChaseUnitFrames` give-up timer that **resets** if the victim re-enters inner vision. WithoutPursuit skips outer entirely. Area-guard uses polygon radius/center and `m_guardEnemyScanRate` / trigger-area dirty stamp.

## Leftover
`GameEngine/GameLogic/src/ai/guard.rs` `get_std_guard_range` / outer chase frames / area scan-rate. Unused on empty `OBJECT_REGISTRY`.

## Live host
`world_objects/support_states.rs` GuardingArea: `radius = guard_radius.max(80.0)`; Normal acquire = `radius * 1.5`; return home if `distance(anchor) > radius * 0.6`. No mood/owner vision, no chase-timer, no polygon area, no scan-rate. GuardingObject uses `find_nearest_enemy_for_attacker(..., radius)` with the same 80 floor.

## Player-visible
A Sleep/Passive guard still uses the full 80/120 bubble. An Aggressive guard does not get the C++ mood-widened vision. Units start walking back at 0.6× (48wu at the floor) instead of chasing for `GuardChaseUnitFrames` and only giving up outside outer vision. Area-guard (Guard Area on a trigger) is not a polygon at all — it is the same 80-circle. Posts feel too small, too sticky, or both, depending on the unit's authored vision.
close_reason: Guard range mood-adjusted vision (OWNERTYPE|MOOD|GUARDINNER) + outer; return at inner not 0.6x80; files: teams.rs support_states.rs

title: [AIGuard] Guarding units never interrupt to return fire at last attacker
description:
## C++
`GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/AI/AIGuard.cpp` `hasAttackedMeAndICanReturnFire` (~39) is a **state-condition** on INNER, RETURN, and IDLE (ctor ~150-164).
Uses `BodyModule::getClearableLastAttacker`, requires ENEMIES, not dead, `isAbleToAttack`, `getAbleToAttackSpecificObject(ATTACK_NEW_TARGET) == POSSIBLE|POSSIBLE_AFTER_MOVING`. Transitions to `AI_GUARD_ATTACK_AGGRESSOR` (`AIGuardAttackAggressorState::onEnter` ~788) which overwrites nemesis from last-damage `sourceID` and attacks with inner-range + chase-timer exit conditions.

Same condition exists on `AIGuardRetaliate` RETURN/IDLE (`AIGuardRetaliate.cpp` ~38, ctor ~157).

## Leftover
`GameEngine/GameLogic/src/ai/guard.rs` `has_attacked_me_and_i_can_return_fire` + `last_damage_overrides_nemesis` (closed leftover `hq-k7fiw`). Unused when `OBJECT_REGISTRY` is empty.

## Live host
`world_objects/support_states.rs` GuardingArea/GuardingObject only pick the nearest legal enemy inside `acquire_radius`. No last-attacker condition, no `AI_GUARD_ATTACK_AGGRESSOR`. `tick_guard_retaliate` only keeps the original victim locked.

## Player-visible
Snipe a guarding Ranger from just outside the 80/1.5x bubble (or while they are walking back): they do not spin onto you. Retail Guard immediately returns fire at the unit that shot them, even if another enemy is closer to the flag.
close_reason: Guard last-attacker interrupt via getClearableLastAttacker; files: support_states.rs teams.rs

title: [FXListDie] DeathFX ignores StartsActive ConflictsWith authored list
description:
## C++
`FXListDie.cpp:23-72` / `FXListDie.h:31-36`: ctor `giveSelfUpgrade` if `StartsActive` (default TRUE). `onDie`: require upgrade active, DieMux, skip if object or player `ConflictsWith` mask matches, then `FXList::doFXObj` (OrientToObject default TRUE) or `doFXPos` with authored DeathFX.

## Leftover Rust
`GameEngine/GameLogic/src/object/die/fx_list_die.rs:284-387` ports StartsActive, ConflictsWith, DieMux, doFXObj/doFXPos via leftover TheFXListStore / TheGameLogic. Leftover modules not attached on live host.

## Live host
`host_fx_list_die.rs:39-89` name peels (bombtruck/terrorist/scud/nuke/tank/vehicle/building) to generic FX names. No StartsActive, no ConflictsWith, no DieMux, OrientToObject always false. `fire_fx_list_die` queues those names. Closed hq-br7up was FXList nugget runner never called (now dispatched); this is authored FXListDie gating vs peels.

## Player-visible

title: [CrushDie] Crush deaths never play CrushDie sounds
description:
## C++
`CrushDie.cpp:139-184` `onDie`: DieMux + DAMAGE_CRUSH only. `crushLocationCheck` picks TOTAL/FRONT/BACK. If crush sound event is non-empty and `GameLogicRandomValue(0,99) < crushSoundPercent` (default 100), `TheAudio->addAudioEvent` with object ID. title: [Sticky] Timed and remote charges never play UnitBombPing
description:
## C++

title: [Sticky] Building C4 snaps to structure center not plant XY
description:

title: [Poison] Anthrax/SCUD/bio fields damage aircraft

title: [Poison] DoT ticks play Unresistable FX not poison
description:
## C++
PoisonedBehavior::update (PoisonedBehavior.cpp:99-105) retakes the original amount as DAMAGE_UNRESISTABLE so it does not re-infect, but sets m_damageFXOverride = DAMAGE_POISON. ActiveBody::attemptDamage (ActiveBody.cpp:299-304) uses the override for doDamageFX so each DoT pulse plays the armor-set poison FX (green splat / poison audio), not Unresistable FX.

## Leftover Rust
poisoned_behavior.rs:237-243 sets damage_fx_override = DamageType::Poison on the Unresistable DoT, matching C++. Empty OBJECT_REGISTRY no-ops the update, so leftover never plays FX on the host-only path.

## Live host
world_tick/ai.rs:106-112 and apply_host_residual_mutation_op PoisonDot (host_ops_writeback.rs:481-492) call take_damage_from_typed_death(..., Unresistable, death_type) with no FX override field. damage.rs:371-375 dispatch_armor_damage_fx(self, damage_type, actual_damage) looks up DamageFX.ini by Unresistable, not Poison. Green TINT_STATUS_POISONED still applies (is_poison_tinted / apply_poison_tint).

## Player-visible
Poisoned infantry/vehicles pulse the wrong hit FX (or none) every ~100ms instead of the retail poison DamageFX. Tint is green, but the per-tick spark/splat/audio is Unresistable.
close_reason: DoT applies Unresistable via take_damage_from_typed_death_fx with poison FX override (C++ m_damageFXOverride=DAMAGE_POISON).

title: [DamageFX] Live host has no per-type throttle

title: [DamageFX] Live skips 0-amount and non-HP special types

title: [Body] Health box uses fixed 20-wide pose, ignores geometry
